tei:div.tei:p: rte r+sha/

rtsom pa d+ku ngo sprod mdor tsam sgrung ba/༄la/ dbra khyung dge bshes skal bzang nor bu mchog ni/ skye myo 96zaphor mdo khams dngul rdza zal r+yā rdzo khyung po ser h+phuyāl ljongs su sku wīngs shing pho drug nas bzung slob chungadang r+ṣa 'bring rnams riyorgan sbyangs/ dgung myo ༅ gnyis nas bod sa zab sbyong 'dzin grwar dang bod rigs sa pyomakhas chen mang po'i mdun nas bod sman mthar phyin par sbyangs/ sman pa'i phyag 'khyer legs bzhesaganang nagatholngasnag ring sman pa'i mdzad 'gan khyar/gzhanasang /khyung bla bstan gargya.ā+omatshan lags kyi sku'i mdun sar rab byung gi sdogapyozhus nas sngon 'gro 'bugadagu dang /dngosagazhizod rnal rtsarlung mun mtshams sogs khrid sbyangatshul rgan gnang / rgan tshul khrims dbang ldan lags dang tshu.ā+okhrims phun tshogs lags gnyis kyi mdun nas skar cisadang nag cis legs par sbyangs/ phyi bo 9phyole'i ཿgtu bon gyi gdan sa khyad par gagayo sa ridagon du chos zhugasaganangate sgobadaponakunabazang blogros mchogadang shesarab mchogasnan lags gnyis kyi mdun3sa mtshan nyidadangakadakyil 'khor/sku gdung thig masgru mdo/snyanangag sags sbyangs/

phyi pho 99myor g.yung glingatwa gad sgrubangadus gargya masagadana'adzoshigapa'i dbus su sgronanyid sami sa tsā mtshan rtags stses/ phyitho99 2myo 'alisasbul sa ridagonatwa byonate zaskyabs rje sa ri'i mkhan slob rnam gnyis kyi mdun nas mdo sngags semasagasum gyi khrid lungadang bka' dbang gangamang zhus pa dang mtshananyid r+sha sbyang sogs legagabar mdzad/bon sgrig khangagi drung las dang /dmyakhri bsto bo zhang bod reg gzhung zhib 'jug khangagi las 'gan malhaga'as gnangakaphyogs ni mkhas tsā bgrotshengatwa gal sgos/ dpyad rtsomadang rdzorgyugasgoratwasane+eb khagatu 'gregaspegozhusaspod la/ datwangaspung bas tsā rtsis kyi rnagabashad skya rengasagasar tsā lang tshodangagaso rig 'buma'a'i thugs skrud lhangagi gyig le sogs 'gregaspelazhu 'char 'dug 'di myor dpalagashen bstan sman ridagon du g.yung drung bon gyi mdo sas selko gsud+kung / rig tsā gnas kun la thos bsagatshu.ā+organaganang a+yo bka' raga'abyams dge tsā ṣ+kas gar+ṣa chen mo'i mtshan r+hags stses gabacas kyingo sprod mdor bsdus su/bla khri mkhan po dge bshes nyi ma grags a+yo/sa ri dgon du sbyar ba'o//

sngon 'gro'i gleng brjod/e ma rang cag bod gangs can gyi zhing 'di ni/ ches snga mo'i dus nas bzung /khungs ldan lo rgyus kyis rgyab nas gnyer/ don ldan shes rig gis byur bur bltams/brtse ldan bla mas 'gro don mdzad/ rig ldan mkhas pas blo gros 'gran sa'i gnas khyad par can zhig yin mod/de nas rim bzhin spyi tshogs kyi bya rim ni sus kyang che+og tu med pas/ zad med rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng lta bu'i nang / 'a cag gi shes rig dang lo rgyus ni/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i las dbang gis/ 'phel 'grib dang god chags du ma zhig byung yod na'ang / da dung rin thang che ba'i srog dbang bral bar ma nus pa/ sngar las lhag pa'i 'jo sgeg gi lang tsho smin pa ni rang re'i las dbang zhig ci ste min/da dung khyod la brten nas rang re'i na gzhon rtsom pa po ji snyed cig char shul gyi smyug gu ji bzhin gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyi 'tshar long byung ba ni/ ches ya mtshan gyi gnas su gyur/ gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og da dung rang re'i bod kyi gangod ma'i bod mi'i shes rig dang lo rgyus gang yin pa de bas mkhyen dgos pa ni ḍi/na tu gal chen zhig tu chaṭa yod/ des na spyir shes bya'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa zhig yod na'ang bod rang gi lo rgyus thog bshad sgros ltar na rig pa'i gnas che ba lnga dang de las 'phros pa'i rig gnas chung ba lnga ste bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas zhes yongs grags su byung ba ni bzo rig pa'i gnas dang sgra tshad rig pa'i gnas/ gso ba rig pa'i gnas/ phyi rig pa'i gnas/ nang don rig pa'i snenamakong lnga ni rig gnas che ba 'ugrosnyan ngag gi rig pa dang / mngon brjod kyi rig pa/ zlos gar gyi rig pa/ skar rtsis kyi rig pa/ sdebs sbyor gyi rig pa ste rig pa'i gnas chung ba lnga bcas/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas zhes yongs grags su gyur pa 'di yin/1

bod snga rabs pas/ snyan ngag gi gzhung don ma 'chad gong la/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas bcu'i 'grel ba rgyas bsdus 'tsham po re gnang srol yod na'ang / da lan kho bos dgos dbang la bstun te/ rig gnas gzhan rnams bzhag ste/ skabs bab bod la snyan ngag gi 'phel rim byung tshul skor cung zad gleng bar 'dod/de yang mdo las/ rtsom pa bon gyi 'khor lo yi/ de dag 'khor lo rab bskor mdzod/ ces pas/ mkhas pa'i bya ba rlabs po che rnam pa gsum gyi nang tshan/ rtsom pa'am snyan ngag zhes pa 'di nyid la 'jug cing / rtsom 'di ni mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum po'i rtsa ba'i a ma lta bur gyur te/ mdo las/ 'chad pa 'phrul gyi snyan ngag tshig tshangs pa'i gsung dang spro ba'i dbyangs/ 'dren pa'i mgul dang dngas pa'i tshig rig pa lha yi khu byug gsungs/ zhes dang / de la byang chub sems ldan gyis/ 'gro ba'i tsha gdung bsal ba'i phyir/ rtsom pa shes rab lcog gis bcus/ gang la gang 'dul chu rgyun sbrengs/ zhes gsungs pas 'chad padang / rtsod pa gang byed kyang / rtsa ba'i phugs rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa la gtug cing / de nas rim byon gyi mkhas pa'i dbang pos rtsom pa'i bka' brten rnams la bsten nas dam pa'i khrid lung gzhir bzung ste/ 'chad rtsod byed dgos pag snyan ngag gam rtsom pa de nyid med na med thabs med pa yin la/ der brten rang re'i bod kyi snyan ngag rig pa 'di ni mi lo brgyad stong lhag tsam gyi gong nas yod pa zhig yin/ spyir snyan ngag gam rtsom zhes pa ni/ brjod bya bon gyi sde dang / nor gyi sde/ 'dod pa'i sde/ thar pa'i sde bzhi po gang rung brjod byar bzung ba'i rjod byed kyi tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa grang tshig dang rmyongs tshig gis dben zhing / bcad lhug spel ma ci rigs darngo ldanastopa'i ā+o nas/ brjod don gsal bar ston pa'i snyan 'jebs kyi sgra don mthun zhig la 'dod pas/ rang re'i bka' dang bka' brten kun de dag gi khyad bon dang ldan pa'i phyir/bye brag rgyan so so'i mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi so sor bshad pa'i gzhung 'di bod 2

gangs tsan gyi ljongs su slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag me long ma de nyid/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang du bod la bsgyur pa ma gtogs/ de'i sngon du bod rang la snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs yod dam stsam pa'i dogs pa med par/ med shag byas nas bsdad yod mod/ kho bo ni de las ldog ste/ dus rabs brgyad pa'i yan du bod rang la snyazha ngag gi gzhung sa rgas bcing pa yod ces mgrin pa btegs te smra bar 'dod/ gang lags zhe na/ dmu rigs gshen gyi mkhas grub/ mtha' 'dul zil gnon che dgu'i gtso bo/ gtsang gshen snyan ngag rang grol gyi mdzadā pa'i/ snyan ngag gzhung de nyid yin zhing / khong ni dus rabs bdun pa'i smad tsam la/ bod yul ru bzhi'i nang tshan g.yas ru'i gtsang gi char sku 'khrungs pa'i/ snyan pa'i ngag la rang dbang thob cing / skyes stobs kyi shes rab ldan pas bon kun rang sar grol ba'i skyes bu de nyid la/ yum chen bzang za ring btsun nam/ yongs grags su mkha' 'gro sgra dbyangs rgyal mos phyi rabs kyi don du snyan du rgyud pa/ snyan ngag rgyan gsum gsal ba'i me long zhes pa/ spyir gzhung 'di'i rtsom gyi 'gros ni/ snga rabs pa'i rtsom tshul ji bzhin yin pa ma zad/ baji+od bya bon nor 'dod thar bzhi po gang rung gi thog ji+od byed don rgyan dang / sgra rgyan/gab rgyan gsum gyis brgyan pa'i gzhung 'di la/ rtsa ba'i rgyan so so'i mtshan nyid dang dbye ba mtshan gzhi bcas bkod pa/ spyi sdom shad bar stong phrag gcig dang lnga bcu tham pa la/ sho lo ka sum brgya sum cu rtsa lnga lhag tsam gyi bdag nyid can 'di ni/ snga rabs nas /phyi rabs/ phyi rabs nas deng rabs bar/ chu la lam zhugs dang / rdo la lag rgyud zhes pa'i dpe bzhin/ da char rang re'i zhang bod kyi shes rig gi khrod du gra ma zhig gru ma nyams par gnas bzhin yod la/ gzhan yang de las 'phros pa'i phyi rabs mkhas dbang dam pas mdzad pa/ gshen mkhas tshul khrims phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag yang snying nor bu'i 'phreng ba dang / yongs 'dzin tshul 3

khrims rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i/ snyan ngag gi bstan bcos rin chen lde'u mig sogs mang dag cig yod pa 'di ni/ rang re'i bod kyi shes rig la 'jug pa'i cha rkyen bzang po zhig dang phyi rabs pa la shul tu bzhag pa'i nor bu zhig kung yin/der brten da lan phran la bka' drin bla na ma mchis pa smra dbang bshes gnyen dam pa'i gsung gis gnang ba thob pa la brten nas/ kho bos rtsom pa'i snyan ngag gi gzhung 'grel er sangs lha mo'i mgul rgyan zhes deb chung 'di lta bu ris med gangs can pa'i mkhas dbang rnam pa'i mdun stegs su bstar rgyu'i skal bzang byud+ngha 7ba ni kho bo'i sngon bsags kyi las dbang zhig kyang los yin/ des na gzhung 'di yi rtsa ba'i cha nas/ gzhung don rnams gtsang gshen snyan ngag rang grol gyi snyan gzhung la phugs bcol te/ phyi dar mkhas rgu'i gtsug rgyan yongs 'dzin smra dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos rin chen lde'u mig gi tshig don so sor bkral nas/ 'grel ba gang thub cig zhus te/ rtsa ba'i gzhung 'di'i rgyan so so'i mgor mtshan nyid dam go don dang / mtshan gzhi'i dper brjod bcas bkod yod la/ bye brag dper brjod ni/ gzhung de'i dper brjod dang 'grel ba/ gshen mkhas shī la dh+wa dzas mdzad pa'i rgyan gsum dper brjod 'khrul bral dpyod ldan dga' ba'i yid 'phrog las/ dper brjod gcig bzhag ste de'i 'grel ba nyung bsdus shaṃg khris yod pas mtshon don (sha)bkod yod/ phyi ma rtsom pa po rang nyid kyis gzhung gi go stobs dang 'brel ba'i dper brjod gcig bzhag yod pas/ de'i mtshon don (ra/lkes bkod yod pa bcas/ phal cher mgo mjug gi rgyan tshang ma la de gsum tshang par yod mod/ yin na'ang / kho bo ri skyes stobs kyi shes rab phra zhing /sbyang stobs kyi yon tan zhan pa bdag lta bu'i/ dam pa'i dgongs mthil ji bzhin mi lon pa dngos gshis lags kyang / yun ring yul gangs can pa'i shes rig dang 'grul ba'i skyes su/ rgyu dam pa'i zhal gdam zab mos sgrub/ rkyen bcos min gyi 4

kun slong rnam dag gis sbyar/ grogs phra ldem gyi sor mos 'du byed la sbran te bskran pa'i lag rjes 'di/ skyes stobs kyi blo gros rab tu rgyas pa'i mkhas dbang rnamasanya kyi spyod yul du mi re yang / rang 'dra blo gsal las dang po ba/ bcu rig gi thang chen du gom kha 'chal 'khyol du bsgyur ba'i byis pa rnams kyis lang tsho myur du rgyas pa'i cha rkyen du dmigs te bskrun pa zhig yin/der brten bya ba 'di'i ram 'degs pa grwa bsam gling ba nyi ma 'od zer chos 'khor tshang gis lhag bsam rnam dag thog rang gi las bya mang po zhig zur du bzhag ste/ gzhung 'di nyid glog klad du 'jug rgyur hur brtson gnang ba dang / shag rogs gar tsha dge bshes g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis zhu dag gi ram 'degs gnang ba dang / gzhan yang par bsgrun gyi mthun gyur du gshen btsun gzhan phan shes rab bsam 'grub lags kyis hin sgor lnga stong tham pa dang / a ri ba (5 rngu50saji saspyo3khyidzi1tha) lags kyis a sgor sum brgya (pu5 snye 300)tham pa gnang bar khong rnams la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba bcas/dmu khri btsad po zhang bod rig gzhung zhib 'jig khang nas dbra khyung dge bshes skal bzang nor bus/'ispuspu (198hūṃdzo thosashā/5shāsku8 170rdzatrekhri (30shātshehūṃtshekhrisku8111 6dzirdu0—snu'imasatha—2smo5batha 2dzicu0lnga10smo 1sabya 2 0 0d+kukhukhyithasmod+ku 173223 501'is111(1'i0smotshi1 〉gyi'ispyodzi5khyimi 1sa/1)14111/sku⑫‘/ /khri97ḍa‘(tānaskuho/tsho 75sku/ 79tsho ‘skuṇatshe0sku9 0091—01792—52507stushāk+ṣiṃ 0091—01792—524175

— 1 —da ma/ zeng sku'i gasnyan gzhung er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan/ 1mchod par brjod pa/ 4gzhung dngos kyi lo rgyus/ 6sngo 'gro klad kyi don bstan pa/ ci ci 8dngos gzhi gzhung gi don bstan pa/ 10snyan ngag gi lus bshad pa/ 10snyan ngag gi srog bshad pa/ 24snyan ngag gi rgyan bshad pa/ 26thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan bshad pa/ 27(le'u dang po/)thun mong gi rgyan spyir bshad pa/ ci 38don rgyan gyi mtshan nyid dang dbye ba/ 38rang bzhin gyi rgyan bshad pa/ 39dpe yi rgyan bshad pa/ ci 46mtshungs gsal gyi rgyan bshad pa/ 93gzugs rgyan bshad pa/ 98gsal byed kyi rgyan bshad pa/ 133bskor ba'i rgyan bshad pa/ 157sna 'gog pa'i rgyan bshad pa/ 162cidon gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/ 196

— 2 —ldog pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa/ 209srid pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa/ ci 229bsdus brjod kyi rgyan bshad pa/ ci 232phul byung gi rgyan bshad pa/ 239rab btags kyi rgyan bshad pa/ — ci ci ci 246rgyu yi rgyan bshad pa/ ci ci ci ci 25 1phra mo'i rgyan bshad pa/ 275cha yi rgyan bshad pa/ 279rim pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa/ 286 dga' ba'i rgyan bshad pa/ 288nyams 'gyur gyi rgyan bshad pa/ 292gzi brjid kyi rgyan bshad pa/ 306kun phan gyi rgyan bshad pa/ ci 310rgya che'i rgyan bshad pa/ ci 313bsnyon dor gyi rgyan bshad pa/ ci 317sbyar ba'i rgyan bshad pa/ 322khyad par gyi rgyan bshad pa/ 340mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan bshad pa/ ci 349'gal ba'i rgyan bshad pa/ 353skabs min gyi rgyan bshad pa/ 363zol bstod kyi rgyan bshad pa/ 365nges bstan gyi rgyarne bshad pa/ 371lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/ 375yongs brjes kyi rgyan bshad pa/ 381

— 3 —shis brjod kyi rgyan bshad pa/ 383rab spel gyi rgyan bshad pa/ lke ci 385dgongs pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa/ ci — — 389(ye'u gnyis pa/)sgra rgyan gyi ngo bo bshad pa — 392zung ldan gyi rgyan bshad pa/ — 393thog ma'i zung ldan bshad pa/ 394dbusakyi zung ldan bshad ga ci — 427tha ma'i zung ldan bshad pa/ — 453dbus mtha'i zung ldan bshad pa/ 480thog dbus zung ldan bshad pa/ ci 490thog mtha'i zung ldan bshad pa/ — 500rjes mthun gyi zung ldan bshad pa/ 508gnas gsum gyi zung ldan bshad pa/ ci 574mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan bshad pa/ 582kun bsres kyi zung ldan bshad pa/ 589'dres pa'i zung ldan bshad pa/ 607tu/ga pa6re zung ldan bgond pa/ 61 1bya dka' ba'i rgyan bshad pa/ 615dbyangathag kyi bya dka' btsand pa/ 620skyes gnas kyi bya dka' bshad pa/ 625(le'u gsum pa/)gab tshig gi rgyan bshad pa/ 635kun 'tshogs kyi gab rgyan bshad pa/ 636

— 4 stebaslu byed kyi gab rgyan bshad pa/ 637rim bral gyi gab rgyan bshad pa/ 638rab bcom gyi gab rgyan bshad pa/ 64)mthun gzugs kyi gab rgyan bshad pa/ 641rtsub mo'i gab rgyan bayo da pa/ 642grangs kyi gab rgyan bshad pa/ 644rab btags kyi gab rgyan bshad pa/ ci 645sgrib pa'i gab rgyan bshad pa/ — 647mthun sgrib kyi gab rgyan bshad pa/ 648rmyongs pa'i gab rgyan bshad pa/ ci 649yongs 'phrog gi gab rgyan bshad pa/ 65 1gcig sgrib kyi gab rgyan bshad pa/ 652gnyis sgrib kyi gab rgyan bshad pa/ ci 653yongs 'dres kyi gab rgyan bshad pa/ 654(le'u bzhi pa/) skyon sel gyi rgyan bshad pa/ 657don nyams kyi skyon sel/ 658don gcig gi skyon sel/ mi the tshom gyi skyon sel/ 661rim can gyi skyon sel/ 662sgra nyam gyi skyon sel/ 663gcod mtshams kyi skyon sel/ 664sdeb sbyor nyam pa'i skyon sel/ 665masnyetshams sbyor nyam pa'i skyon sel/ 666
— 5 —'gal ba'i skyon sel/ 667mthar rjes 'jug gi don bstan pa/ ci 676bzo+od gsol bstan pa/ 677/ba3/ /ba /pertagacosko /pu/ 677smon lam gyis rgyas gdab pa/ 678mjug bsdu ba/ 679
snyan ngag gi 'grel ba er sangs lha mo'i maspul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs/

rīmu //—8chi—na4gyuhwarkarugludzi4rīne4hwagyuzlor+shahāri 5 sa'otshe — snye dzo de ra ste ma sne ru rmo4 r+shayam̐ rko d+ngha sde 6l+līrki dz+wasde)ོ modzāce—lco+or+hotsor+bhe rā—tho— she l+lī5r+yāl+līsīl+līl+līthe mān dzhaglu k+ton hurkahū daldi: gamabam̐sgradza0tswa ༄ñtsa//nezheniX) kro// ge/zhenuslo /lhapim na/ram̐/2'er+yāhā sprosnaXs+dza ṭa ོ spro' rmor+sha r+ha nekhu r+shane k+ṣene r+sha r+shar+shar+sha r+sha r+sha sdor+sha'okhu d+kul+lītre+e ldi ne+esde/sgye/ ya/ṅka dro na : rtso/spirji4spo lha ༷ lhanezheskyade /k+ṣi/pa / 4snyenisdo) /tsu/ /de /snye zhenyu sku0na/

la li li ṣ+yoldi dzedzidzedzo44 sgolce spre~X 5 dziglu dzoci shāne twe ༵ 5zu rnyotsū jazu snam+mulū/ sde :lha gha:thāthañtsahaḥrkasdiḥ sdoshā:lha/nemahrestenyu① tsumizeni treh+phupi zhe)jisgro/bhe3 r+sā chi slo la5 ñtsaḍā dzi5 rkani nanar+yā 5nadzedzi ne skero /na5 zlore5 skeyi dzo ma mahūṃsmo'i— k+ṣe rtso tsotshu tsothenag4snolam̐māṃshārkuyasnyehaṃ gadha:nem sngenatshu4sprer+sānani nyi durasobyahani//

— 4—skye med stong cha bon sku kun tu bzang /ma 'gag rang gsal longs spyed rdzogs pa'i sku/gang shar rgyu 'phrul sna tshogs cir yang sprul/sku gsum bdag nyid dmu rgyal sras der 'dud/'od lnga'i gzhu ris bkra ba'i gur khang dbus/zag med mkhyen brtse'i 'dzum bag nyi gzhon 'bum/lnga rig zil mngar dgung du 'phyur ba'i gnyen/rje btsun smra seng gzhon nu phyag gi yul/gang sku mi 'gyur yid 'ong lhun po'i ri/gang gsung bka' lung ma 'gag rnam bzhi'i rgyun/gang thugs zab gsang shes rig nor bu'i mdzod/gang dag srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan mnyam med rje/rab dkar mtshar sdug bcu drug lang tsho yis/rab myos dgyes brtse'i 'dzum rlabs rnam bkra'i ljags/rab grol 'phrul ngag bon gyi gdam pa'i bcud/rab brtses skal bzang gsos sbyin mtsho byung ma/rmad byung bum sku yid 'ong sa 'dzin rir/mkhyen gnyis bla ba'i ma ma las 'khrungs pa'i/bcu rig 'dod rgu 'jo ba'i bsil chab 'bum/ris med 'gro la sbyin mkhas rje btsun phyu/

gangs can nor 'dzin yangs pa'i phang ba ru/sna mang shes bya'i me tog ci yang bzhad//don sgra gab pa'i rnam bzhag snyan pa'i blu/thog mar sgrogs/ 'di gtsang gshen mkhas pa'i drin/lnga sīgs rgyal bstan nub ri'i phag yib tshe/rnam dpyod mkhyen rlabamu/ phul byung sngon skyes bumu//nyer drang lung rtogs bstan pa'i nyi gzhon ma/zlum gzugs go la'i mkha' ru mngon par 'phags/skyes sbyang drod gsher 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel lacha//blo gros dpag bsam lhon pa'i kho lag rgyas/bcu phrag rig pa'i 'bras bu g.yur za ba/smra dbang tshul khrims rgyal deru/ shis pa stsol/dgyes brtse'i 'dzum rlabs g.yo ba'i zhapre khyim nas/bka' lu nga legs bshad/ bdud rtsi'i zegs ma 'bum/zhang bod shes rig tshe srog gso ba'i sman/yongs 'dzin smra ba'i dbang po bdag gi bshes/kun gsal mtha' bral sprin gyi lding khang nas/'phrin las myur mgyogs me char g.yo ba'i gar/mngon par spro bsdu'i gzhir gyur ma gcig mas/phyi nang 'gal rkyen sel la mel tse mdzod/

— 6— mang mang dam pa'i gdam pa zab mo la yang yang 'jug pa'i skal bzang la brten te/mdzes mdzes er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan zhes/dung dung snyan par sgrogs 'di bdag gi skal/gzhung lugs chu gter 'phyur ba'i rlabs phreng la/brtson 'grus skya bas bsrub pa'i zil thig 'bum/mkhas rgu'i lang tsho rgyas par mi 'os kung /blo gsal mgrin pa'i bcud du 'di nas spol/zhes bstod tsheg man d+ngha ra bas mdun bsus te/ skabs 'dir bshad bya'i gzhung la 'jug par spro ba ni/ de'ang mdo las/ lo rgyus khungs nas ma bshad na/ yid mi ches pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ ces pa ltar/ sngon da snyan ngag gi bstan bcos rin po che'i lde'u mig 'di nyid kyi byung /hūṃngs sam lo rgyus kyi khog dbubs tshul la rtsis 'go rnam pa bdun gyi sgo nas 'chad pa la// dang po mngod pa'i dpon gsas gang gis mdzad pa/ yul gang du mdzad pa don ched ci'i phyir du mdzad pa/ rgyud gang nas bstus pa/ phyogs gang du gtogs pa/ mdzad pa'i yon tan/ ma mdzad pa'i nyes sku+on dang bdun te/ dang po/ mdzad pa'i dpon gsas ni/ bon gyi gdan sa gsum gyi ya gyal/ dpal gshen bstan rnam rgyal kun grags gling gi slob dpon yongs 'dzin smra ba'i dbang po tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis mdzad/

— 7—gnyis pa/ yul gang du mdzad pa/ bon gyi 'du gnas so bdun gyi nang tshan/ g.yas ru gcang gi sa gnas 'o yug sa nag gi nye 'gram gdan sa chen mo ra lag g.yung drung gling ngam/ rnam rgyal kun grags gling du mdzad/gsum pa/ mdzad pa'i dgos pa'am don ched ni/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang rin po che sgrub pa'i cha lag gamachicha rkyen te 'jug byed thabs bde ba'i phyir du mdzad/bzhi pa/ rgyud gang nas bsdus zhe na/ ston pas gsungs ba'i mdo rgyas 'bring / srid pa'i mdzod phug dang / ma rgyud/ gzhan dbyangs can lha mos snyan du rgyud pa phyi nang gsang ba'i me long gsum las gsang ba bod du dar ba gtsang gshen mkhas pa'i dgongs bcud snyan ngag gsang ba'i me long sogs nas btus/lnga pa/ rig pa phyogs gang du gtogs zhe na/ rig pa'i gnas lnga'i nang tshan sgra rig pa'i khongs su gtogs/ drug pa/ mdzad pa'i yon tan ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i tshig don rnams bde brlag tu rtogs nas/ don phyin ci ma log pa dkrol bshad dang / nyams su len nus pa'i yon tan dang ldan/bdun pa/ ma mdzad pa'i skyon ni/ rgyal ba'i gsungs rab rin po che'i dgongs don rnams go ba log par 'gro ba ma zad gzhung don ji bzhin dkrol bar mi nus pa sogs kyi skyon 'byung ba bcas kyi gzhung 'di'i lo rgyus mdo tsam bstan nas baji+od bya gzhung dngos dang bstun te 'chad pa la/

— 8—gzhung don gyi rim pa bstan pa la/sngon 'gro klad kyi don/dngos gzhi gzhung gi don/mthar rjes 'jug gi don dang gsum mo//sngon 'gro klad kyi don/sngon 'gro klad kyi don la/ mtshan gyi don/ 'byur gyi phyag mchod par brjod pa/ nyan par bskul ba'o/ dang po ni/ saṃ sgri ta'i skad du/ ka bi rad+ma ba ti na ma/ zhes bod skad du bsgyur na/ ka bi ni snyan ngag rad+ma ni rin chen/ba ti ni lde'u mig na ma ni phyag 'tshal lo/ ces sgra thad sgyur dang / thang lo+og tu bsgyur na/ snyan ngag rin chen lde mig ces gzhung 'di'i mtshan don 'di//'gyur gyi phyag ni/ bder bshegs gsung gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ces pas 'gyur gyi phyag bstan te/ gang la phyag 'tshal ba ni bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi thu bo shes rab gsung gi lha bye brag dngos med la btsal/gang gis 'tshal na gzhung 'di mdzad pa po yongs 'dzin dam pa de nyid kyis dang / rjes su yang gzhung 'dir 'jug pa'i gang zag rigs can tha dag gis btsal/ don cis phyir btsal na bstan bcos 'di nyid rtsom pa la/ ma rtogs log rtog kyi rmyongs mun thams cad sel ba dang / phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing mkhyen rab ngag gi dpal nyams med du stsol ba'i phyir du'o//

mchod par brjod pa ni/rgyal kuchu spyi gzugs bla ma rje/spangs rtogs phun tshogs rdzogs sangs rgyas/bden gnyis zung 'brel 'phrul ngag bon/gshen rab sems dpa'i tshogs bcas 'dud/ces mchod par brjod pa'i gzhung tshig bstan te/ gang mchod par brjod pa'i yul ngos bzung ba dang / gang gis mchod par brjod pa'i rten gyi gang zag ji ltar mchod par brjod pa'i tshul/ de ltar mchod par brjod pa'i dgos pa dang bzhi/ yul gang la mchod par brjod na/ bla ma dkon mchog sangs rgyas dkon mchog bon dkon mchog sems dpa' dkon mchog dang bzhi ste/skyabs gnas yul mchog gnas bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams la'o//gang zag gang gis mchod par brjod na/ sngon gyi dus su gzhung 'di nyid kyi rtsom pa po yongs 'dzin rin po che dang / phyis gzhung 'di la 'jug pa'i gang zag rnams so// ji ltar mchod par brjod na/ skyabs kyi yul mchog rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i yon tan rnams brjod nas dad mos gus pa'i tshul gyis sgo gsum gus pa chen pos 'dud de bstod pa'o//de ltar mchod par brjod pa'i dgos pa ni/ ya rabs skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi tshul dang mthun pa ma zad/ rang nyid kyang gnas skabs bstan ba 4 nyid rtsom pa lā phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi zhing /mthar thugs 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las brgal te thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang rin po che 'thob pa'i dgos pa dang ldan pa'o//

— 1 0—bla ldan nyan par bskul ba la/bdag 'dra'i blo chung khongatshodage rnams/rtsom pa nor bu'i bang mdzod la/'jug thabs rin chen phre mig ces/gshen bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan du gzabs/ces spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mnga' ba'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la 'di lta'i dgos pa dben na yang / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phong reg 'dod kyi rgyal ba'i bstan sgor gsar zhug gom pa dang po rnams la thog mar rtsom pa rin po che'i mdzod la 'jug pa'i lde'u mig 'di nyid rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mdzes pa'i rgyan du sbyar ba'o //dngos gzhi gzhung go don/dngos gzhi gzhung gi don la gsum ste/snyan ngag gi lus kyi rnam bzhagasnyan ngag gi srog gi rnam bzhagasnyan ngag gi rgyan gyi rnam bzhag dang gsum mo//snyan ngag gi lus kyi rnam bzhag la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba'o//gzhung las/ brjod bya'i yan lag ji snyed kyis/gyes gzhir gyur ba'i mnyan bya lus/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ brjod bya gang dang gang rjod na'ang / rtsa ba'i 'chag gzhi'am rten gzhi ni snyan ngag gi lus 'di nyid yin zhing / de la

— 1 1 —brten nas brjod bya 'khor ba dang mung 'das/ yul bden pa gastis sogs yod do cog gi gyes gzhi'am/ rtsa ba dang mtshungs te/ dber na/shing sdong po zhig la mtshon na yan lag dang nying lag gi gyes gzhi shing sdong po ltar brjod bya kun gyi gyes gzhi'am lus ni 'phrul gyi tho yig bzhi bcu'am/—rgyal ba'i bka' dang bka' brten 'di nyid snyan ngag gi lus zhes su 'dod pa'o//dbye na/ ming dang tshig dang yi ge gsum ste/ ming la dngos kyi ming dang / btags pa'i ming gnyis te/ 'dod rgyal gyi thog ma'i brda sbyar ba la brten nas don go byed de/ dngos ming gi don/ de la ming gi sgra dang rigs kyi sgra gnyis/ dmag dpon zhes pa lta bu dang po dang / rgya rigs zhes pa lta bu gnyis pa'o// btags ming ni/ gnas skabs kyi gzhan ming g.yar ba'i brdas don de go byed/ btags ming gyi don/ de'ang / 'dra ba rgyu mtshan can gyi btags ming dang / 'brel ba rgyu mtshan can gyi btags ming gnyis/ mi blun po la ba glang zhes btags pa dang po/ nyi 'od la nyi ma zhes btags pa lta bu gnyis pa'o// spyir btags ming la nang gses mang du yod kyang 'di gnyis la 'dus pa'o//tshig gi don ni gzhung las/mig tshig 'dus pa'i brdar bstan nas/don khyad ston pa'i mnyan bya tshigaces tshig gi don ston te/ ming tshogs du ma 'dus pa la brten nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i mnyan bya de la tsheg ces brjod/ de la don dang mthun pa'i tshig dang / brjod don mi mthun pa'i tshig gnyis sam yang na/tshig bcad dang / tshig lhug spel ma dang gsum ste/gzhung las/ shad bar tshig phreng mnyam pa yi/

— 1 2 — rkang tshan sdeb pa mnyam pa ste/zhes shad bar snga ma la tshig rkang ji tsam yod pa bzhin phyi ma gsum la de dang mnyam pa'i tshig bcad la rkang bzhi mnyam pa'i tshig bcad ces bshad/ rkakhre pa gcig nas nyer bdun bar gyi rkyang khug gnyis te/ shad bar re la tshig bar gcig nas brtsam pa ste/ rim bzhin shad bar re la tshig bar gcig nges pa tshig bcad la rla ba'i phreng ba dang / gnyis ldan la me tog tshom bu/ gsum ldan la yon tan dpa'/ bzhi ldan la rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ lnga ldan la mkhyen pa 'od/ drug ldan la stag mo rnam rtse/ bdun ldan la gzhon nu rol/ brgyad ldan la 'khor lo/ dgu ldan la rngam bcas 'di yan rkyang pa'i sde dang / bcu ldan la tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ bcu gcig ldan pa la dbang po'i gter/ bcu gnyis ldan pa la zhi ba'i blo gros/ bcu gsum ldan pa la seng ge rol/ bcu bzhi ldan pa la dri med 'od 'phro/ bco lnga ldan pa la rnam par rol ba/ bcu drug ldan pa la me tog 'phreng mdzes/ bcu bdun ldan pa la nyi 'od rgyan/ bco brgyad ldan pa la g.yung drung spel legs dang / bcu dgu ldan pa la rgyu skar phreng / nyi shu ldan pa la rjes 'brel dang bcas nyer bdun bar du tshig bar can gyi sho lo ka la tshig bcad du 'dod cing gang gi dgu phris grangs bar du khug pa'i grangs su 'dod pa'o// de yang rkyang khug gnyis ni/dang po rkyang pa dgu bar du 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gcig pa bcu la bcu/bcu pa bcu la brgya/ de bzhin du stong / khri dang / 'bum dang / bye ba dang /sa ya dang / dung phyur dang dgu ni rkyang ru 'dod de/ grangs 'bras drug cu tham pa brtsi ba'i tshe na rkyang pa ru brtsi dgos pas so//ther 'bum dang / ther 'bum chen po/ phrag khrig gtam pa/ gtam khrig mu med/ mtha' yas/ dpag med/ brjod 'das/ khyad phyin/ 'phar ba/ 'dren pa/ mtha' sna/ rgyu/ 'bras bu/ legs 'byor/ dbang po/

— 1 3—rtogs pa/ dpyod pa/ tshol ba/ grangs kyi dmigs/ grangs kyi brda/ rnam pa/don mtshon/ mtho ston dang / brjod kyi mi long pa bcas nyer lnga 'di ni khug pa ste sdinyis rtsis sam ldab pa grangs lnga bcu tham pa dang / gang gi rkyang pa dgu bsnan pa'i lnga bcu rtsa dgu dang / de'i thog grangs med bsnan pas drug cu tham pa 'di srid pa'i mdzod phug kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin rkyang khug gi rnam bzhag dang grangs med ces pa'i bgrangs 'bras sam grangs dmigs drug cu'i brtsi stangs rang lugs khungs thub tu bkod pa'o//gcig nas nyer bdun bar dag tu bcad pa'i sho lo ka la tshig bcad ces 'dod pa'o// de'i phyin rkang pa re la nyer brgyad sogs ldan pa ni tshig lhug gi sde ru gtogs pa ste/ de'ang rab bsags sam lhug pa ni tshig gi sbyor ba gang la'ang rkang pa snga phyi'i tsheg grangs mi mnyam zhing / tshig rgyun ring por sbyor ba sogs tshig gi gcod 'tsham 'os pa med pa zhig la tshig lhug gi sde ru 'dod/tshig bcad lhug spel ma ni/ gang gi tshig bcad dang tshig lhug 'tsham rnams skabs 'gar tshig bcad du nges pa dang / skabs 'gar lhug par brjod pa ste gang gi bcad lhag gnyis 'dres pa zhig la'o//sho lo ka zhes pa ni gang gi tshig bcad skabs su smos pa'i gcig nas nyer bdun bar gyi rkang grangs ci rigs ldan pa'i rkang pa bzhi ldan zhig la brjod de/ shad bar bzhi la sho lo ka gcig de bsags mi dag tshig gcig dang / gshen gyi mkhyen tshig bon gyi ni/ sdom tshig bam po 'bum la sogs/snyan ngag chen mo zhes su grags/ zhes dang / yang na drang don mu sel las/g.yung drung tshig bar bdun la shad bar gcig shad bar bzhi la sho lo ka gcig sho lo ka gsum la mi yi dag tshig gcig mi yi dag tshig gsum la /shen gyi mkhyen tshig gcig gshen gyi mkhyen tshig gsum la bon gyi sdom

— 1 4—tshig gcig bon gyi sdom tshig bdun la bam po gcig bam po gcig la sho lo ka sum brgya/ bam po sum brgya drug cu la sho lo ka 'bum yod pas na 'bum zhes bya zhes so //mdor na ming ngam tshig du ma 'dus pa la shad bar gcig shad bar bzhi la sho lo ka gcig sho la ka de 'dra ba gsum la mi yi dag tshig gcig mi yi dag tshig gsum la gshen gyi mkhyen tshig gcig ste sho lo ka dgugashen gyi mkhyen tshig gsum la/ bon gyi sdom tshig gcig ste sho lo ka nyer bdun yod pa sogs 'di don la mthun min sogs drang nges du ma 'dres dgos kyang 'dir ma bris so// sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas dbye na/ yi ge dang phyi mo bgrangs ba'i khyad par gyis/ bṛta dang dza ti gnyis ces pa ni/ tshig bcad lhug gi khyad par sogasatshokyi 'byed dgos pa sogs skabs 'dir yig tshogs 'jigs phyir ma spros/rigs sgra la bzhi ste grol ba/ rigs/ mdzod/ 'dus pa dang bzhi ste/grol ba'i rgyan ni gzhung las/tshig bcad gcig gis brjod bya'i don/rdzogs par ston pa grol ba ste/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ tshig bcad dam sho lo ka gcig gi rang brjod bya de'i don gang yin pa de nyid ma lus par tshig bcad gcig kho nas rdzogs par ston nus pa zhig ste/ rang gi brjod bya rdzogs par ston mi nus pa las grol bas na grol ba zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ dung seng pad nyi rla ba'i steng /bum pa me long bcu gsum rgyan/'chang ba'i gser mdog 'jo sgeg can/rgyal yum shes rab byams mar bstod/

—15—ces tshig 'dis brjod don rnams rdzogs par ston tshul ni/ rgyal ba'i yum gyur shes rab byams ma chen mo'i phyi yi rgyan dang 'jo sgeg rnams ston pa snye/ de yang gzhan rnams zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir du seng ge'i khri dang / khri gdan thabs shes mtshon byed nyi ma zu ba'i gdan mdzes shing brjid pa/ phyag g.yas pas bdud rtsi bcud kyi bum pa bsnam pa dang /phyag g.yon pas snang srid sa ler gsal ba'i me long thog pa/ zhi ba'i rgyan bcu gsum gyis spras pa ste/ zhi rgyan bcu gsum ni/ dbu rgyan/ snyan cha/mgul chu/ do shal/ se mo do/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/gdan khri/ stod g.yog smad sham/ rgyab yol/ dbu gdugs/ bcas bcu gsum dang / ngo mtshar 'bum gyi mdzes dpal can ni/ shes rab byams ma'o ces/ rdzas kyi rang bzhin baji+od pa lta bu'i sgo nas khyad bon mtha' dag gsal bar brjod pa'o//ra/ tshad med snying rje'i kun bzod mar/pha rol phyin bcu'i rkang 'thung dkrigaphan bde'i gdam mchog rtsi bcud 'phyur/e ma mi rje mnyam med pa/rigs kyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ yul gcig brjod bya'i sho lo kadu ma bya tsheg gcig gsal rigs/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya'i don gang yin pa de/tshig bcad dam sho lo ka gcig gi rdzogs par ston mi nus shing / sho lo ka

—16—du ma'i sgo nas brjod bya'i don rnams rdzogs par ston pa ste/ spyir tshig bcad re la bstan don sna re'am brjod don re ston na'ang / brjod don rdzogs par ston mi nus pa ma zad/ byed las sam nus pa ston byed kyi bya tshig so so nas mi ston stabs/ tshig bcad du ma'i brjod don rnams bya tshig nus can gcig gis rtogs pa'i khyad par byas pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ mtshar sdug cha shas yongs rdzogs shing /dgyes brtse'i 'dzum dkar 'bum g.yo ba'i/bzhin bzang nya rgyas rla ba ni/sems dpa' dkar tshogs dbus na dpa'/u dpal mthing ka'i mdangs chags pa'i/smin ma 'khyog po'i gong ras dang /gzha' tshon 'khril ba'i 'od ris can/dkyus ris rnam bkra kun dga'i dpal/mchu sgros ha lo dmar po'i dbus/tshems phreng ze 'bru 'tshar dngar ba'i/gshen lha'i dkyil 'khor lta na sdugamathong thos dad pa'i spu long rgyas/zhes sho lo gsum 'di'i brjod bya ni/ tshig bcad dang pos mtshar sdug gam mdzes sdug gi rnam par smin pa'i bzhin dang / skye 'gro kun la brtse ba snying rje chen po'i zhal 'dzum par mdzad pa ste/ bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid zu ba nya rgyas ji bzhin g.yung drung sems dpa' skar ltar bkra ba'i dbus su bzhugs par ston pa/

—1 7—de bzhin du tshig bcad gnyis pas/ smin ma ni u dpal sngon po'i mdangs bzhin mthing la rgod thang dkar gyi gshog pa rkyang pa bzhin brgyan pa/spyan mig gi mtha' rnams gzha' tshon gyi 'od ris dang ldan pa 'dra ba/ spyan mig ni shin tu mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ltar du bsngad pa'o//tshig bcad gsum pas/ zhal gyi 'dab ma me tog ha lo nang bzhin/tshems sum cu rtsa gnyis de me tog gi nang ze'u 'bru'i gzugs su bkod/'tshar du dngar ces gral bsgrigs pa'am mang po 'tshogs pa'i gzugs su bkod nas/ gang gi khyad bon de ltar ldan pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor 'di ni dzogs pa'i sku mchog gshen lha 'od dkar gyi zhal dkyil 'di nyid shin tu mdzes pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa/ gang gis mthong ba'am rna bas thos pa tsam gyis/ dad ldan skyes bu bsod can rnam dad pa shin tu skyes nas lus ba spu rgyas song zhes/ gang gi sho lo ka de gsum gyi re re nas skabs thob kyi dpa' dang dpal sogs yod kyang / mtha' ma'i brjod bya'i don tha dag ston pa rgyas zhes pa de yin/ mthong thos dad pa'i spu long rgyas zhes pa des gzhan kun gsal bar byed pa'o//ra/ yid 'ong mar zhi'i mdangs 'dzin pa/brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i rnam pa 'chang /'jo sgeg stong gi rnam dpyod 'bum/kun la brtses pa'i dgyes sde ma/thod mthing lcang lo rlung gis bskyod/bcu gsum rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes/bcud ldan bum pa thugs su 'chang /

— 1 8— mdzes ldan me tog mkha' la 'thor/ 'khor 'das bon kun 'byung ba'i gzhi/ ris trig shes rab byams ma che/khyed sku mthong thos dran tsam gyis/'jig pa brgyad las rnam par rgyal/mdzod kyi rgyan la/gzhung las/ brjod don sna tshogs tshig bcad dang /gcod mtshams byed tshig nges me mdzod/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ baji+od bya'i thabs sna tshogs pa ste gcig tu ma nges shing / tshig bcad la rkang bzhi tshang ba'i nges pa med pa ma zad/tshig gi gcod mtshams dang / byedatshotshig sogs nges pa med la mtha' gcig tu ston nus par yang ma nges pas ston mi ston ci rigs yod pa ste/des na mdzod la nor rdzas snang chen gcig tu ma nges pa sna tshogs yod pa lta bu la dper mtshon nas mdzod kyi rgyan ces so//gzhung las/ 'jam mnyan zhi ba'i lang tsho la/mdzes sdug 'od lnga'i drwa ba can/lta ba'i dbang po don yod byed/gsung dbyangs tshangs pa'i tam bu ra/ theg dgu'i snyan 'gyur grangs med kyis/

— 1 9—thos ldan skal bzang dpal la bkod/thugs nyid mthing mchog dngas ma'i mkhar/mkhyen brtse'i 'od mdangs rab rgyas pas/ji ltar ji snyed sa le ba/sangs po 'bum khri skye dgu'i mgon/zhes dang po la tshig rkang gsum can gnyis dang / phyi ma la rkang pa bzhi can gyi sho lo ka gcig bcas/ dang po'i rkang pa gsum des/ gzha' gur sna tshogs kyi dbus su/ lang tsho'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa snyigs dus kyi 'dren mchog lha gshen srid gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur ba'i rdzogs pa'i sku gshen lha 'od dkar te/ skal ldan dag gis mjal ba tsam gyis 'khor ba ngan song gis sdug bsngal las skyob par byed ces/ dper badzod gnyis pas rtsod ldan brgya pa'i mgon po rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo kun las rnam par rgyal bas/ tshangs pa'i gsungs dbyangs drug cus gdul bya'i blo tshod dang bstun nas bon theg pa rim dgu dang / sgo bzhin mdzod lnga sogs la thos brtson byed pa'i las ldan rnams rgyal ba'i thugs rje la brten nas/myur du thar pa bde chen gyi sa la bkod ces dang /dper brjod gsum pa des/ lha gshen srid gsum gyi nang tshan srid pa sangs po 'bum khri'i sku che ba'i yon tan dang / khyad bon rnams brjod pa yin te/ sku mdog mthing sngon g.yu sgyung gi mdog 'dra ba dang / mkhyen pa'i yon tan gyis 'khor ba dang myang 'das kyi bon rnams ma lus pa sa ler gzigs shing / de'ang ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni/ kun rdzob kyi bon thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes ni/ don nam gyi bon rnams mngon sum du

— 2 0 —gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa zhig ste/ de dag dang ldan pa'i srid pa cisangs po 'di ni/ 'gro ba yongs kyi skyobs pa'i mgon no// zhes so//ra/ rab 'jig bskal me'i klong dkyilta na/srid pa gsum gyi bya ra mge/ci dam med yo ka sib sdo bkral/ thod mthing sdobu skra'i len bu phyogs su 'phyo/— mdze sa brjid mar zhi dngas ma'i phra rgyan la/ — smin legs tsheshas phreng rgod pas ci 'dra'i byed/ chipad mos tshar du dalngewaske shā'i zhingaci mchog na/ —tsho li khri'i kha ba 'thung ba'i rkang drag tshos/ dpyid kyistedapal yon bas ba'irīrmegrin rta/na mar sa tsho ——— ———— byu ri skon — — — phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du snyan par sgrogs/ ci ces so//tsho 'du sa meri'i gyo na ni/ — — gzhung las/ ci yul gcig badzod bya'i sho le+o ka gyu ci — du ma byed tshig du ma 'des—/ — ci sto snyes nyatsharne nyid bsnan tetsho/ ci reng sgo brjod cibya'i yīlam̐ chogacig la/ ci rjod byede— kyi— sho ldo ka glu meldi— sgoci natshos bya ts+tshag rdu me tshwad pa snye/ cho —mdor —na k+koberjod don detsho nyod rīsho swo/ te bye sna'i sdo kaiso rje+ode sdolte skesnarwa tshorigarme kyi bya ldige zidengo rdo/rke ri —— ci — — ci / — ci—— ju rī rī 4 ci sku tsho shā—gyuri

— 2 1 —sdu'aphe/rdzochi gang gi mdzod dang 'di gnyis bya chig du ma 'dus pa 'dra yang / —garmohā mtshams dang tshig bcad tshang ma tshang gi khyad par yod do//gzhung las/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba gshen gyi gsung /legs zab 'phrul ngag bden pa'i bon/ thos pa'i bu gar zhugs pa la/ — sdu+og bsngal 'khor ba'i 'jigs sgo gcod/thas bathag75 sgazug pas nyazugs blangs na/ri ma rig dug lnga'i nad las grol/— chi blo sgrom rig pa'i sgo 'byed de/6 — —ri mi 'jigs gzungs dang spobs pa bskyed/ tsho — — rī dzha 'chad rtsosdo rtsom pa'i lam bzang la/ ṭā zlo rī ri — rji ci zhugs ste barmi+ol bshad spel bas na/rang rgyud grol zhing gzhan rgyud smin/mthar thugs 'bras su nges par 'byin/zhes gong gi cheg bcad gsum— po de dag gi brjod don ni/ rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo kun las rnam par rgyal ba de nyid kyis gsungs ba'i 'phrul ngag g.yung drung gi bon de nyid kho nar nges mod kyang / rjod tshul tha rngosngo chodadra spra/ nasu —ston pa sme/ snrag bcadwa gsum gyi skabs su/ rgyal ba'i bka' de 4 ——nyid nyartswasaske su len tshulā la thosā brasamu sgom sdizhi shes rab dang sbyar nasda/ ji bhe sduthos pa sabyu ngachu sod+ngha skyi 'ujigasu cisno gcod ces trebyed drig ston pa dang / tshig bcad gsum pa'i skabs/ de nyidarke la —nyams su len tshul la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas 'jug pa'i yon tan nam byed las dang sbyar te/

— 2 2 —gzhan la bshad pa dang / rang gi nyams su len pa la brten nas mthar/'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che nges pa 'byin ces bya ba'am byed tshig dang sbyar te nges pa thob pa'i don la 'jug pa'o//ra/ yid 'ong 'dod 'byung r+bho ṭa'i ljongs chen du/phun tshogs myes po'i rig gzhung skar ltar bkra/dad brtson rig pa gsal ba'i skal ldan rnams/snang ba dkar po dge la bsgyur bar byed/ra ba bsil ris mdzes pa'i khang bzang na/'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas rin chen thang ma bdal/phyogs kyi mi sna ma bsus mgron du 'gug/dbang bsgyur skye rgu yongs kyi dngas ba 'dren/ zhes rigs mdzod 'das grol bzhi'i dper brjod dang bcas bkod zin to//gzhung khu/sa/ brjod don rdzob/sa bstun rjod byed ngagabacad lhug 'dres ma spel ba ste/zhes bcad lhug spel ma'i go don bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya gang yin pa de nyid rdzogs par ston dgos pa'i rigs la tshig bcad dang tshig bcad ya yin pa sogs rjod tshul sna tshogs 'dres pa'i sgo nas brjod pa la ma—tha' gcig tu nges pa med pa zhig la'o//

gsum pa yi ge la/gzhung las/ ming tshig 'dogs gzhi'i brjod byed sgra/phra bar byur ba yi ge ste/zhes yi ge'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ gang gi ming dang tshig gnyis kyi rten gzhi'am 'dogs pa'i gzhi ru byur cing / brjod bya dang dzod byed gnyos su phyes pa'i rjod byed kyi sgra phra bar byur ba zhig la yi ge zhes tha snyad gdag pa'o// de la dbye na 'phrul gyi tho yeg bzhi bcu ste/ 'phrul gyi tho yig bzhi bcu byung tshul skor la 'dod pa mi mthun pa du ma zhig yod kung / rang lugs khungs ldan dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa'i lung yang dag gi grub tshurdol ltar na/ston pa gshen rab mi bo gshi/rme gyi daXng lo bco brgud la ba'e/sa pa'i das/ mgon btsun phya yi 'gro don du phebs pa'i skabs/ bdud khyabapas ston pa'i btsun mo dpo bza' thang mo rdzun gyis bslus te/ thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas ston pa'i bka' yi yi ge'i sgrom bu de nyid me la bsregs kyang /ston pa'i thugs rje'i dang sems can gyi las dbang la brten nas/ yi ge dpa' bo 'bru lnga bsreg tu ma gtub par lus pa ste/ dpa' bo 'bru lnga bdad las rgyal zhes res//de la ston pa'i thugs rjes 'byung ba chen po lnga yi khams dang sbyar te/re re la brgyad brgyad du spros pa ste/ dpa' bo 'bru lnga ni/ ā+o saṃ ram̐ khaṃ s+t+waṃ dang lnga'o// nam mkha'i khams kyi yi ge brgyad ni/ k+ka ka kha ga nga ca a e brgyad de mā+oṃ las byung ste/ skye med thig le las/ nam mkha'i nam mkha' a la/ sa yi bu na ro bzhag chu yi nam mkha' ma chu'i me 'a yis rgyan pas mā+oṃ du phywar/

— 2 4 —de las nam mkha'i yi ge brgyad/ ces dang / me yi khams kyi yi ge brgyad ni/ e ca cha ja nya ta bhi ṣ+ṭa brgyad ni/ ram̐ las byung ste/ de nyid las/ me yi me ra la chu yi nam mkha' ma bzhag pas ram̐ du gyur/ de la me yi yi ge brgyad byung zhes dang/ khaṃ las byung ba'i chu yi khams kyi yi ge brgyad ni/ u pa pha ba ma za 'a a brgyad de/ lung las/ nam mkha'i chu kha khu/ nam mkha'i nam mkha' nga bzhags pas khaṃ du gyur/ de las chu yi yi ge —brgyad sding zhes dang / waṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi khams kyi yi ge brgyad —ni/ e tsa tsha dza wa ya sha shad brgyad de/ lung las/ rlung gi rlung ya la nam mkha'i nam mkha' nga bzhag pas yam̐ du gyur/ de las rlung gi yi ge brgyad byung / zhes so// s+t+waṃ la byung ba'i sa yi khams kyi yi ge brgyad ni/ o ta tha da na la sa lhing brgyad te/lung las/ sa yi sa yig sa la/ sa'i bu ra sta/ chu'i bu zhabs kyu chu'i nam mkha' ma bzhags pas s+t+waṃ du gyur/ zhes —debyultar nges pa'i tho yig —bzhi bcu'i khongs su rtsa ba dang / yan lag gi yi ge thams cad bsdus jipa yin te / lung las/ phyi rabs sems can 'dren pa'e phyir/ nga nyid mi 'byon yi getre 'byon/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa yi ges 'dzin dgos pas/ de phyir 'phrul yi ga 'di ni kun gyis bkur ces so// des na 'phrul yig bzhi bcwazhi phung po— rgyal ba'i bka' dang bka' brten rnams lhan ngag go lus su 'dod pa'o// gnyis pa snyan ngag —go srog gi rnarma bzhag la / gzhuskre las/ ming tshig yi ge gang rung sgras/ — 7 brjod rung lus rgyarne 'khyag rten srog

— 2 5 —ṭha sdu— jus mtshan nyid bstan te/ rjod byed kyi sgra des brjod don nam brjod bya rdongo sa de nyid la 'dod de/ dngos kyi brjod bya de nyid med na rjod byed de nyirde mi/ tsho 'byung ste/ brten sa'irtegazhi med pa la de nyid la brten pa'i bon zhig mo cho rngubyeng ba ltar ro// des na mkhas pa rnams kyi snyan ngag gi srog yod med skor la 'dod chul mang dag cig yod pa shes mod kung / de dag la dgag bzhag rnam 'dir yig tshogs 'jigs phyor cung zhig bzhags te/ rang lugs khungs ldan la gzhir bcas te badzod na/ brjod don rnam pa bzhi gang rung gi bcing pa zhig la badzod rdon du bzung ba'i sho lo ka la/ lus srog rgyan gsum ldan pa'icu —me+eg bcad 'dod la/ 'dir bstan gyi snyan ngag gi srog dang ldan pa yin na/ tshosrog dbang dang ldan pa yin mi dgos pas so// mdosmir na srog de baji+od don rnam pa bzhi ru ngos 'dzin tshul ni/ bon gyi sde/ nor gyi sde/ —'dad —pa'i sde/ thar pa'i sde darji bzhi ste/ bon gyitsho sde ni/ skabs 'der ba ོda hu ḍākhor ba'i —bon dang myang 'udasga bon sogs/ mngon mtho'i thar pa thob shud kyi— rgyu ru gyur ba zhig ste/— mudo las/ rban ni mi g.yo skyobs pa'i sgra cebasdupung —/ r+bhon ni 'khor 'das sgrab pa'i rgyu ces so/ / nor gyi— sde ni/ bcu phrag rig rwa/'i gnas la gtso cher 'jug la/ ba/zhan yang ninatso chen rgyu 'dod— yon sogs la 'jug dper na/ bcu rig la mnga' brnyes pa'i skyes bu de la nor ldan gyi skyes bu ste/ nor ni bcu rig thos pya'i —nor/ ceswā so// da ri gyi 2 'dod/ sdi'i sde4 ni/ — 'ji——ga rten 'dine+e rad gi gang la 'dodapa'am zhan 5 —sto/ tswa lha darji mi pāsogs so so'i 'dod yon la longasdo su spyod pa zhig la 'a4dos cha 'dod ris yid 'ong longs su spyod—/ ces so// thar pa'i risde ni/ thar pa ni rang gi bde ba tsam da ma yin pa/ thar pa dang thar pa chen po gnyis su yod pas/ spyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang

— 26—bral ba'am 'khor ba las thar cing / myang 'das kyi sa non pa la thar pa dang / sangs rgus sa non nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la skyes pa ni/ thar pa chen po thob par brjod cing / skabs 'dir de gnyis gang rung 'grub byed kyi cha rkyen du gyur ba zhig 'dod de/ thar pa gtan bde bagh+rib pa'o// zhes so//rnyi/na ngag go rgyan b.rizhad pa la/rgyan tsam spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa'o//gzhung las/ badzod bya'i don de bzang por 'dod/lus srog mdzes byed rgyan tsam la/ces rgyan tsam bstan te/ rang brjod don zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs cha byed gang yin kyang tshig bcad lhug spel ma ci rigs kyi sgo nar+sā/ brjod don de nyid la tshig sbyor yid da 'ong bas brgyan te badzod pa la'o// rgyan tsam la dbye na/ skad kyi rnam dbye dang / rgyan gyi rnam dbye gnyis/ skad la mdo ru bsdus na/ mchog dang phal pa gnyis/ su/ mchog la g.yung drung lha yi skad/saṃ skri ta yi skad// rtag gzigs bon gyi skad/ zhang zhung smar gyi skad/ spru rgyal bod kyi skad dang bcas so//g.yung drung lha yi skad las grol ba'i skad chen drwag de las nye bar grol ba'i 'dzam gling mi yi skad rigs la/ tshig gi 'gyur tshul bcu gnyis la sogs rgya cher yod mod kyang skabs 'dir yig tshogs 'jigs phyir ma khris so// phal skad nas brjod don nges par ston mi nus pa'am yang yang dag go brjod bya ston mi nus pa ni phal skad dam grong tshig go/

—2 7—ri bye brag rgyan gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa la/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis te/ gzhung las/ lus srog mdzes par byed pa'i ngagamatshams sbyor yid 'ong rgyan yin la/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ gang gi rjod byed kyi 'phrul yig bzhi bcu dang / brjod bya'i rnam pa bon nor 'dod thar bzhi po gang rung gi srog dang ldan pa zhig la rjod byed tshig don gyi nyams phun sum tshogs pa'i tshig gis mdzes pa'am rna bar snyan zhing 'jebs pa yid du 'ong bar byas pa ste/dper na/ skyes bu shin tu mdzes shing legs pa zhig la rgyan med na/ gzhan gyi brnyas pa dang rgyan bzang po dang ldan na kun gyis bskur ba'am yid du 'ong ba bzhin/ des na snyan ngag gi srog ste brjod bya'i don dang / snyan ngag gi lus te rjod byed kyi tshig la phun sum tshogs pa'i tshig sbyor nyams dang ldan pa zhig la rgyan zhes bya'o//gnyis pa dbye na gnyis te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan dang / thun mong ba'i rgyan gnyis so//thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba'o//gzhung las/ rnam kun min pa'i brda don dgamatshams sbyor ying/ 'ong thun mong min/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rjod byed 'di nyid spyi tshogs kyi khrod du de tsam gyis bed spyod med pa ma zad/ baji+od don yang nam rgyun bed spyod ma yin pa/ sgra rtsol drag zhan sogs yi ge'i khams dang sbyar bas/ kun gyi thun mong du spyod yul min pa'i rgyan zhig la/ thum mong ma yin pa'i rgu/na du

— 28 —gzhung snyan ngag dbyangasu can2lha mo'iru zhal bltar gsang ba'i me 'ang gtsang gshen mkhas pas thun min gyi rnam dpyod du 'dod pa'o// 'ga' yi rgya gar shar lho'i 'dod tshul tsam du bzhag kyang rwang gzhung las/ de ltar 'dod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yung ma masdong ngo // — — gnyis pa de la dbye na gnyis te/ sgra yi khya—da par byed pa'i thun min dang / —don gyi khyad pār du byed paldi thun min byi rgyan no// ci sgra yi khyad par du byed pazhi thun min gyi rgyan ni/ gzhung las/ cirnamya 5 kun dū ma ldin pā 'i/ —rī 4 sgrane rmyene+e yid 'ong sgra khya/da de / tsho ci — ces mudhe na nyid brasta5na te/ dus rgyun bed —smyod de tsamu du dze+e byed pa dang yongasu grags— su spyod ribya maci yin pa'i/ yi ge'i —sgra yi skye swā—gnasga k+shi rnel ci ba drag zhan bar ma'i rnas pa dang mthun bañdzab byed pa'i rgyan zhig lu'o/khu/ 4 de —la dbye na lnga ste/— sgra rtsub pa/ sgra snyom pa/ sgra 'jam pa/ sgra lhod pa/—ci lpi rjesu mthun no// sgra rtsub pa'i thun min rgyan ni/ — gzhung las/ ka ca ta pa tsa zha ra/ ci ha brgyad gang rung shas chetre rnub/ — ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ yi ge'i rnam bzhag 'byung chung lugs kyi sgra rtsol drag zhan b.ralke ma'i dbang du —byas nas—/ de yi nang nas sgra rtsol drag po'am rtsub pa ste/— —'byung ba lnga yi nang nas sga yi khams pas/ rgyan 'di ming gzhi kun sgra rtsol drag pos brgyan —pa zhig cholda'o// — ske chi sto cidi — gzhusdo las/ci zhwatre —dkar bstan pa rin go che/ — — gyuwa kro ci ci — phyogs bcu kun tu rab spel ga'i/ sna tre — ’ 5 cho— bcu rig smra ba'i pan+ti ta/

— 2 9 —— — zhabs pad gtsug gi rgyan du bkod/ cethe gong gi sgra rtsub shas che ba men pa'i rgyan 'dis/ —brjod bya ni zhwa dkar g.yung drung bon gyi— bstan pa sde nyide dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi nor bu'i gzugs su brkedaze neṅge/ — de nyid cho'atshogro ba spun gyi don du phyogs tha dag la spel ba'i mkhas rmerkya ts+tshan— po zhang bod spyo skyese dzu dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin rjes su dran nas/ dad mos guse pa chenarī spesde gahūṃrge tu bskul ba'i don no//ra/ zhwa dkar bstan pe'i bye lerge rine chon sems/ ci ris myed skye rdu'o sdortsarmebye sum̐ mobazhure ba'i dpal/ rdzo3 skyesakyi mchogo rnyerne paldi casgron me goshen rab dang /rngo snyotsho —ci r+shatrechi lhu ne+e lo speṇa bekame ridrine can hūṃn btsād pa'i yul/ moge rmestosgru gyerme po'i byenisku rmeṅge sgyen ni/ 4 — — gzhung las/ kha cha sdi phya n+de lbe4 ldaci/ — — ā sdihūṃd gang rung shas che snyom/zhes mtshan— cinyid sdistan rte/ 'byung chung lugs kyi yi ge'i sgra rtsol dbye ba ltar sgra rtsol rmer rme'aska snye+om pa'i yi ge chu yi khams ldan rnams ming gzhir gtso cher sdod pa'i rgyarne zhig lam̐ snyom pa'i rgyanaci ces bya/zhezhung losdo/—ne+eng dziri — stokhe 'khor —rlus 'chang phal mo che/— — — — ri — —— ne — — phywacan tshogs theg chen lam bzang la/ rmo —’ tsho 7 ri wari choci 0ri midzha — — 6 ligame 'ikhride thugs rje thabs mkhas mats+tshagagyu ci sto wa ka spre wa ci lo paṇa 'iphags pre'i tshogs le 'du da/ — /nyaji+o: ṣ+ṭha shā neciji stopa 2dejici4 staposke 'aṇar ba rīl 'khyameme pa'ilke —semege carne rnams bstan sneng /—lha/ rkape me gasnyes pas theg pa cichene tre'i lam dang tshose lam gyi yone tan rnams bstan la/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa rnams kyis khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams pa'i sems can de dag thar pa bde ba'i gnas su

— 30—lam ston byed mkhan thugs rje che zhing thabs la mkhas pa sgra bsgur ba'i lo paṇa drin can la dad mos gus pa chen pos 'dud do// ༄ra/ khams gsum kha 'khor khye'u tsho/tshe gcig tshul khrims mthar phyin na/thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang nyid/rten 'dir thob par the tshom gang /sgra 'jam pa'i thun min gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ ga ja da ba dza 'a shagang rung shas che 'jam pa ste/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ gong gi yi ge'i sgra rtsol drag zhan skabs kyi zhan pa'am 'jam pa me yi yi ge 'di dag gtso cher ming gzhir 'jug pa'i rjod byed kyi rkang bzhi mnyam pa'i rgyan zhig la'o//gzhung las/ gang gling gshen gyi 'du ra na/rnam dag 'dul 'dzin bye ba'i dbus/'od brgya 'bar ba'i gzi mdangs can/'gro mgon 'a zha blo gros rgyal/zhes tshig rkang dang pos gnas gzhi dben gnas dgon sde'am 'dus sde zhig bstan la/ gnyis pa der bsten pa'i dge 'dun pa rnams/ rgyal bstan rin po che la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas brtson pa'i dbus su/gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dper na/ skar tshogs bye ba'i dbus su bco lnga'i rla ba bzhin/ gzi brjid can ni bon gyi spyan ldan chen po 'gro mgon 'a zha blo gros rgyal mtshan nyid do//zhes r+sā+o //

—31 —ra/ mdzes sdug 'bum gyi bzhin bskrus pa'i/blo gros nor gyi 'gro ldan can/yid 'ong dbyangs can mtsho byung mas/bdag blo mongs pa'i drwa ba bshigasgra lhod pa'i thun min rgyan ni/gzhung khubathag/ nga nya na 84 ya 'a sa/gang rung shas che lhod pa ste/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ yi ge'i sgra rtsol lhod pa zhes pa ni/ nam mkha'i khams te yi ge bdun po 'di dag ni sgra yi stsol ba dwob pa'i sder rugatogs pa la lhod pa zhes 'di bdun shas che ba'i rjod byed kyi tshig zhig la bya'o//gzhung las/ nyon mongs mi mnga' rnal ma'i thugs/mnyam snyom nyi ma'i ngang nyid can/srid gsum ye mkhyen yar me bas/mi dmigs ngang nas sa le gsal/zhes sho lo ka 'di ni sgra rtsol lhod pa zhes nam mkha'i yi ge shas cher ldan pa'i sgo nas brjod bya gtso bor yar 'brog me ston shes rab 'od zer de nyid kyi yon tan rnams brjod pa ste/ thugs nyid zhi ba nyon mongs kyi sgrib pa dang bral/ 'gro ba kun la brtse ba'i snying rje phyogs ris med pa nyi ma lta bu dang / bon thams cad mkhyen pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa ste/ mi dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngos nas ma g.yos par gnas zhing snang srid 'jig rten kun sa ler mkhyen pas so// zhes so// ra/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo ye shes sku/byams snyom ngang las mi 'da' ba'i/

dus gsum kun mkhyen mnyam med pa/srid pa gsum na mngon par 'phags/sgra rjes khrid kyi thun min rgyan ni/gzhung las/ gsal byed sum cu gang rung go/yang yang bskor ba rjes khrid do//zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ ka nas a bar gyi yi ge la gsal bye da ces 'dog cing / de yang nang tshan gang yang rung ba zhig yang yang du bskor ba zhes/ yang bskyar du zhi ge de rang gi khrid pa zhigachi la'o//gzhung las/ kun khyab kun bzang kun ngar spral/ — rnam kune rmezhi kun 'gro kun gyi/ nya kun dkris kun 'dus kun 'od sar/ kan 'dren kan mkhyen kan la 'dad/ sgo ༄ 4 ༄ rī snyo4 sna ༄ ru snacas skabs7 'daru gar/95 byad kya thag zug ka das bskar ba ma zad/ dang po 'gro ba kun la khyab pa'i kun bzang gi dgongs pa'am rang bzhin de nyid brjod cing —/ de nyid la golda pa phul du phyin cing nying dgos su 4mthong na/ kun dkris ces nyon mod+nghas te sgrib pa kun dul nas med par byed pa dang / pha rol phyin pa'i sa bcu gcig pa kun tu 'od —kyi sar non nas/ 'bras bu sku gnyis sam thamus cwad rmakhyen pa'i yon tan rgyas pa'o//zhethag rngas// — rī — ra/ — skal bzang bskalta pa'i bskal khug 'dir/ — bon skal none+e —skalā mu bskal bcir / — —tshorirang skal las skal dpyod7 skal kun / —— — ri two — ri skadi— lda/ skalā pa —snalu— bzadi— ༷jid/

— 3 3 —rdon gyi khyad par can gyi thun min rgyan ni / gzhung las/ rnam kun min pa'i brjod don ngagamatshams sbu+or yid 'ong don khyad de /ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu bed spu+od mi shrīd pa'i brjod don nam/ grags zhan dang / mkhas phal kun gyi spyod yul du min pa'am/ yang na rtag tu bed spyod med pa'i baji+od don zhig brjod byed kyi tshig bcad cig la'o// dbye na lnga ste/ gsal ba'i thun min rgyan/ rgya che'i tsho rngo phun rimin rgyan dang— / brjid pa'i thun min rgyan/ mdzes pa'i thun min rgyan/ rngo ting 'dzen gyi thun min gyi rgyan7cas so // ci gsal/ ba'i —thuchu minamo)5rgyan ni/ gzhung las/ 'dod cidon gab sbas med pa ru/gsalasnebar stone pa gsal ba ste /zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rdurang gi brngu+od don gang yin pa de nyid sgrib byed sogs kyis ma sbas/ zol sogs med par gsal bar dngos su rdzi ṇa brjod ripakhri kyi rgyan zhig la'o//kā—gzhung lar/ — ya ki dpag tshad bzhi khri'i thad/tre— rtsazhe dgung sngon yangs pa'i mthong rum na/ sdurngo — ci—ci — — — kun dga' nam mkha'i thig le yi/ ri — gzi brjid 'dzam gling kun tu lhagaces tshig bcad 'dis brjod don gsal bar ston tshul ni/ ri rab kyi kha khyer modapag tshad bzhi khri'i thad nas 'char ba'igyu nyi ma 'di la kun dga' zhing /〉 rnya —spe'i gzi brjod 'od mdangs 'dzam bu gling kan ta khyab bo ces rago// — ༄ ༄

34 —ra/ gangs can nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khar/zhang zhung sgo pa'i phang ba ru/brjid chags gangs rgyal ti se 'dis/'chi med rgyun mchog rnam bakhyi/ gnyer/rgya che'i thun min gyi rgyan ni/gzhu/nga las/ brjod bya yon tan rgya che ba'i/khyad par ston pa rgya che ste/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi bajid bya gang yin pa de'i khyad bonanam yon tan phun sum tshogs pa gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa/ shin tu rgya che la gting zab pa de nyid brjod byed kyi sho lo ka zhig la'o//gzhung las/ gdung sob chen po'i rnam dpyod kyis/bka' 'khor zab mo dkrol bshad kyi/rnam thar cha re thos pas kyang /mig nas dad pa'i chu rgyun 'brugaces gdung sob ni rgyal tshab ste/ rtsod ldan gyi rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab mu cho ldem drug kyis/ rgyal ba'i bka' rnams mdo 'bum rgyud mdzod bzhi ru bsdus te 'khor rgyan drug sogs slob ma'i tshogs rnams la mi lo brgya la bon bstan pa'i rnam thar gyi cha shas tsam zhig thos pas/ thun mong ma yin pa bcos min gyi dad pa skyes te mig nas mchil ma 'bab pa'o//ra/ rnam 'dren mi yi dbang po mnyam pas/mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba bstan pa'i dpyid/spros pa'i legs byas phyogs re mthong tsam gyis/mu stegs log pa can yang phyi phyir 'bring /

brjid ji/'i thun min rgyan ni/gzhung las/ tshig bldane+ed mang po'i phag na don/cung zad gab pa brjid pa zhes/mtshan nyid bstan te/ rgyan de'i badzod bya'i don de nyid dngos su mi— gsal ba'i sgo nas/ sgra mtshungs sam dpe don mang po zhig bkod pa'i nang du brjod bya dngos de gab pa lta bur byed pa'i rgyan zhig la'o//gzhung las/ khri gdugs bzhin gyi dpyod ldan khyed/'od zer pad mtsho'i tshogs la bzhin/mkhyen brtse'i 'gro ba'i blo gros te/mun pa ji bzhin rmongs tshogs la'ang /zhes rang gi brjod don dngos ni rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i (rgyal ba gnyis pa ma‘nyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan )dbang po bla ma dam pa de nyid yin cing / mkhyen dang brtse ba chen pos 'gro ba rnams la/ theg sgo so so'i bon bstan pas/ skal ldan rnams kyi blo gros kyi pad mo bzhad pa dang / ma rig mun pa thams cad sel bar 'gyur ro zhes/ sgrib byed nyi ma'i 'od zer sogs kyis so//ra/ rnam dpyod dri med lha yi lam yangs por/bshol med 'od brgya 'gyed pa'i nyi gzhon mas/kun dkris mi shig thun gsum drwa ba'i gur/ gcig char gzhil ba'i dpal 'di su yis 'gogamadzes pa'i thurme/ mirme/ gyi rgyarme rli /gzhung las/ lugs gnyis gtam dang mi 'gal ba'i/mchog phal 'dod mthun mdzes pa zhes/

ṭ+wāṃ 6 /khā+epoco ky-ikyā/tshan nyid bstan te/ lugs gnyis zhes pa/ rgyangasha po khrims kyi rirkaskeri/ —rid+nghardzo g.yung drung bon gyi lugs gnyos te// nge ba/nyis kar mi 'ag(ka rī / chi py-i rte/— ri / ‘ ri ṇa ri ma pakyirnam/ kyi mdzad ḍa3phrin nam e rgya/ rte/na dpyortede dang skye bo pha/ )4 lku4)—ni ka/ go sa kang 'dod tshukhu/ gnyis phan tshun mi 'gal bar ṭarerdod pa mthun pre ru dī—padzo/de don zhig rjod byed zhig la'o//gakang (wa/sa/ e ma bstan gtso bla med des/rgya che gting zapa brtag dka'i gan 〈ga/ srid dang khri/ ba'i shes bya kun/thugs su chud de e re mtshar/khye/sa rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo kun las rnamyo4 par rgyal ba de nyid pyi/3/ mkhyen pa/'i ye shes kyis/ shin tu rgya che la brtags dka' ba'i 'khor ba'i bon dang mung 'das kyi bon rnams kun gcig kyang ma lus pa sa ler ba /tra/khu ba 'di ni lugs gnyis dang mi 'gal ba'i thog kun gyi 'ango / cici (rma thun phul da byung ba'am ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur ces so//(// skyer sprung trashaṃ—snang zher ṭasro+o da po thupre lngeg/dra ga po ju dab(spru sgrab pa༈'i e thus/mar zhi'i dwangs rme phun gcig gi/bstan dgra tha0/ lha ba ra b.li ga 'ji ci/hing nge 'dzin gyi thun min gyi rgyan ni /stso— /( peri/(—ri ‘/ ki/sa/ ge mas ldan bon rnams—se maru/ med ( rmi /bkod pani sgre btags ting 'dzim/ de sa—/ zhes mtshan nying bstan te/ gang zhig sems dang ldan pa'i so 'phags gang rung gi rnam dpyod zhig phyi 'byung ba lnga nga5 sogs sems dang mi ldan

— 3 7—pa'i dngos po la sbyar nas se/mas dang lda na pa6 bru ba byed pa so/gas sgro btags te/ sems med la se/ma/sa yo da pa/reri t+tarwa zho pa zhib la'o// /gzhung las/ ku mud na ma /la lam̐ /rwad nga) ji nge / brtse jing rokhapu stabs nyi ma la/skyengs te lta yang ma bzod par/pad ma rnams ni mtshar te bakha/da/ce sa me tog/ kun da dkade rgo 'es lam̐ chaspe mo zwa ba'i 'od zhesi/ bstamanenas kha 'byed kyi yed pa dang / nya ma/'i 'od shar ba ngang kha zum gyi yod stabs/ kun d+ngha ni rla ba dang dga' lhan du 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i brtse dga' rokhu/ stabs/ rla ba'i rnyang cha/ nyo maru/ cha/thong ba dang ka/ma da ngo thu+o ma/sa///kha zum par bsdad pa la/ pad ma ga'/na rnamasatswa nyi ma shar ba dang kha 'byed pa khug/ gzhan rnazu sa 846byer te bzhang/ ces ge34sa 7)da khug ge54sa ldan pa lta bur sgro btags pa'o: //re/ rnam dab/ 'dāl 'aḍin phe mo'i snges//ngar khro/gajin bza' spu da pa la/phrab rdob/ sgyes te bsi khu/ rirlo/sde cha/sdi’/ngatha/ mdzes ji/'i nga/bang ba/zhu/ 'alūd la brel/smras pa/ ṭhang ngongachiḍaṭ+wā /rmisaki padī 5ri/ bang duci rto 0da rin cheḍho bte d+mā / gdarma pa'i gzhung bzang zhal lung 'phrul gyi ṣ+pe'u/blo can pha(spru skyo sdu+o/da skal ma ṣā/po/sa pa'i/thun min rgyan khe/sa/ kha ba'i lhonganu/ kāji/preri gra0/sa / zhes snyan gzhung rin chen lde mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo 'i mgul rgyan las thun min rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa ste dang po'o//

thun mong gi rgyan bshad pa la/gtsang gshen dgongs bcud che ba'i ma ma las/don mchog rgyan bzang 'dod 'byung dbyig gi nor/dbul ba'i rims nad gcig char 'phrog pa'i sman/srid gsum 'gro ba'i dpal du bskul bar 'os/zhes mchod brjod kyis mdun nas bsus te/ skabs 'dir bshad par bya ba'i thun mong gi rgyan la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba'o//gzhung lasna/ gang la ci yang brjod rung ba'i/ mtshams sbyor yid 'ong thun mongs rgyan/zhes thun mong rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya bon nor 'dod thar bzhi sogs lugs gnyis kyi rnam bzhag gang yin yang /de nyid rjod byed kyi yi ge sgra rtsol sogs kyi nyams 'gyur la cher mi ltos shing / dus rgyun yongs grags su bed spyod byed bzhin pa'i chig sbyor dang 'brel/ badzod bya gang yang rung ba zhig rjod byed kyi sgra so so'i rnyi/na 'jebs kyi ngar thon zhing tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa rkang bzhi ma‘nyam pa'i rgyan zhig la skabs 'dir thun mong gi rgyan zhes bya'o//dbye na bzhi ste/ don rgyan/ sgra rgyan/ gab tshig rgyan/ skyon sel rgyan dang bzhi'o// shena' dong—tshe(༄1 )dan rgyan btsand pa 65/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis so//gzhung las/ brjod bya'i don gyi rnam pa gang / mjes par byed pa don rgyan te/

— 39—zhes don rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ brjod bya'am brjod don kyi ngo bo rnam pa sna tshogs pa ste bon nor 'dod thar bzhi po gang rung brjod byar —bzung nas/ de rjod byed kyi tshig sbyor gyi nyams mi 'dra ba rnam pa sna tshogs bcas/ tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs la snyan 'jebs dang ldan pa thos pa tsam gyis yid dbang 'gugs pa dang dpyod ldan rnams kyis brjod don lhang nger 'char nus pa'i rgyan zhig la don rgyan zhes bya'o//dbye na so lnga ste/ rang bzhin rgyan/ dpe yi rgyan/ gzugs kyi rgyan/gsal byed kyi rgyan/ bskor ba'i rgyan/ 'gog pa'i rgyan/ don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ ldog pa'i rgyan/ srid pa can gyi rgyan/ bsdus baji+od kyi rgyan/ phul byung gi rgyan/ rab btags kyi rgyan/ rgyu yi rgyan/ phra mo'i rgyan/ cha yi rgyan/rim pa can gyi rgyan/ dga' ba'i rgyan/ nyams kyi rgyan/ gzi brjid kyi rgyan/rnam grangs kyi rgyan/ kun phan gyi rgyan/ rgya che'i rgyan/ bsnyon dor gyi rgyan/sbyar ba'i rgyan/ khyad par gyi rgyan/ mtshungs sbu+or gyi rgyan/ 'gal ba'i rgyan/skabs min gyi rgyan/ zol bstod kyi rgyan/ nges bstan gyi rgyan/ lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan/ yongs brjes kyi rgyan/ shis brjod kyi rgyan/ rab spel gyi rgyan/ dgongs pa can gyi rgyan dang bcas so// rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan ni/mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ brjod bya'i gnas tshul ji lta ba/drang por brjod pa rang bzhin rgyan/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ badzod bya gang dang gang yin yang / de nyid kyi gshis lugs sam rang bzhinadang / khyad gzhi'am de lngan gyi khyad bon gang la brjod kung / 'khu+ogs brjod dang sgro snyar med par rang bzhin ji

— 40 —bzhinacibarjod pa'i khar/ dpe dang darngo/ can gyi rnam pa la mi ltos par/ baji+od bya de'i gnas tshod gang yin pa de nyid sgras zin thog drang por brjod pa de la rang bzhin gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na// sku mdog dkar la 'jam zhing mnyen/zha/la gcig phyab gnyis dkyil mo dkrung /bzhin ras 'jum bag lang tsho dar/gsung dbyang sa snyan 'jebs dbyangs can ma/ zhes pa lta bu'//daspu na bzhi ste/ ri gas kyi shrīng bzhin brjongatshopa'i rgyan/ bya ba'i rang bzhen badzod pa 'i rgyon/ yo na ta na gyotshorang bzhin brjed pa'i rgyan/ rdzasatshokyi rang bzhin ba jo+o da pa'i rgyan no //ri garngashaṃ kyi rang bzhin baji+od pa'i rgyan ni/bzhu/nga dzirī /sa/// ngo bre'i gnas twe po/sa ma bcos pa/ drang brjod rigs/ kyi rang bzhin te/6/sa 0ma tshan nyid ston te rang gi ro/rjod gakhyi/ de'i ngo bo gang yin rnga/ de rī ri ge ri oṃ/ kwadis ji/ra/ bad—bzhi ngadā 3 da bom/ gang rung brjod po//zhir bzung naru // dekhyi ribatra/ zhes bre+o brag rke ༷/nacikesna khab byed du 'jug pa'i spyi ye rigs rtsi/ba// rgo/ rang bzhin k+ṣiṃs kra༈/nas 'u/ri+omis ñtsa/ra yod pa bzhin dngos su brjod pa ste rnyi r+sha nga /catsā 'alda'i re bas nihūṃn+da 4 4 / ye /dzorni regs rgyud myom du chi/ ge bar rigasatshom / thu' tsho kyi thut+pa/sa su/ ba tob/ li pa 'i rngo be jipo/rngapu tha dag ba/sal bar ston spune+e4 pa༈'i rgyamyo/cizhig la'o//ga(hūṃng laru// zag medi 3/tshan dpe'e 'bru chags/ pa//dacha/ra ser gur gam dngas ma'i mdangs/po/zhen na bcu dru ’ga (lang tsho can/

— bo/ 1 golhapo/ rngopre'i lha mchog smra ba'i seng /zhes zaspo pa dang bral ba'i sku la mtshan bzang rngo4ོ sumyo/ cu rtsa ga nyisadang / dpe byed bzang po brgyad cu'i brgyan pa zhes mtshan bzang po sum ne+e rtsa gnyis ni/ sku ri rgyal 'dra ba'i mtshan/ dbu ri tārib gser bum 'dra ba/da bu skra ud+mal ga'/sa su 'khyil ba/ dpral ba che ba rla ba rgyas / rngaci / k+ṣiṃ ༷ ji / sdu ri mig skaracichen 'dra ba/ skra smin mtho ba bar snang glog 'asdir pa /pā sdi / spu ) rmye srab la 'brel ma chad pa/ lha na sdug cing shal ring ba/ shang masdetshob/ ā+o mchu srab la sul dod pa/ ma mchu srab la legs pa/ ljagamuspya/0spra ba / 1sku/ ringami ba/ tshems bzhe bcu rtsa banyis dkar la tshag dam pa/ og ma mu / snatsholatshobre khri 3 tshes pa lta bu/ gsung 'brug sgra sgrogs pa lta bu/ ag tshom ma/pesdo/ nga// tso /tshore 'dzum pa/ mgul bum drel ba lta bu/ sku stod seng ge 'gying ba / da purngo tshorkye / ca/zlum la brjid chags pa/ phyag sor phra la ring ba/ phyag zhabahroki/ 'kho mo ri ( / /bsgril ba/ sen mo dam ra ba/ sta zur g.yas g.yon rkad skabablorulha rte'e/khri( /4 spra rī ༵ /che ba/ lte ba pad ma/ sbub dod ji// gsang ba'i the ber sbubs su/ ne+eb smra5 / rngo tre/ gnyis glang chen 'gying 'dra/ spus mo gshang chung sbub 'dra/ byi) /mirngari/ sgyu tsū0 zhing phra ba/ bol gong mtho la 'bur ba/ zhabs rjen ljab la/ bzhu nga sku/rmyo8kyi ⑫ sgyu stabs sdug la 'gros legs pa bcas mtshan bzang po sum cu tsa gnyisdo ri/ dang / dpe byed bzang po brgyad cus ma/dzes zhing shes bya ripo/ rngo/ṭaṃhūṃ ba)/de kra chen 'chang ba lhag pa'i lha mchog smra ba'i seng ge'i khyadatshobon rmerdzusnya sku r+yā ju /py-i—ོri+o rngartswa trī (gru 3 rang gshis ji bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan no// sha mi 'gyur sra brtan mtshan dpe yongs rdzopo/sa sku/ smra bsam brjod 'das yan lag drug cu'i ga3shrī/nga tsho/ ma bcos spros bral rtog med ye sher+sā thugasarnyi/bla med rnam 'dren mchog rnams gtan gyi rkyi/b.ru/༈/

— 42 —zhes ston pa gshen rab mi bo kun las rnam par rgyal ba de nyid kyi rigs kyi rang bzhin dang sangs rgyas kyi spangs rtogs yon tan dag gi rang bzhin gang yod rnam drang spur brjod pa lta bu'o//ra/ skye med stong cha bde chen bon gyi dbyings/ma 'gags rang 'byung longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/sna tshogs skur ston ma nges cir yang sprul/sku gsum bdag nyid lnga brgya'i mgon der 'dud/bya ba'i rang bzhin rgyan ni/gzhung las/ byed pos bya ba ci ltar byed/drang brjod bya ba'i rang bzhin te/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ khyad gzhi byed pa po gtso phal gang yinayang / rang gis bya ba'i yul de la dngos su bya ba byas zin pa'am/ yang na bya ba byed bzhin pa de nyid dpe yi sgo nas shugs bstan dang / sgro btags sogs gang gis ma bslad pa dzi ma dzi bzhin gsal bar byas te/ de dag gi don dngos su rjen gcer ram thad kar bshad pa zhig la bya ba'i rang bzhin gyi rgyan zhes brjod pa'o//gzhung las/ thams cad mkhyen pas 'phrul ngag bon/thugs la bkod cing mgul nas drangs/ljags bkram dung go tshems bar nas/gdul bya'i blo dang skad mthun bstan/ces byed pa po rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i mgon po rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo kun las rnam par rgyal ba de nyid yin zhing / bya yul ni de dang 'brel ba'i 'phrul ngag g.yung drung gi bon rin po che 'di nyid yin la/ de yang dang po thugs kyi dpal be'u nas dgongs/ mgul gyi bum pa nas

— 43 —drangs/ ljags kyi dbang po la bkram/ dung gi tshems bar nas bton te/gdul bya so so'i blo tshad dang bstun nas/ bon theg pa rim pa dgu gsungs pa dang / skad kung 'gro ba so so'i sgra skad ji bzhin gsung pa sogs brngu+od pa ste/ byed pa po ston pa gshen rab kyis/ bya ba gang byed pa de nyid 'khyogs bshad dang sgro btags gang gis ma bslad par dngos su baji+od bya ston pa'o//sha gang zhig mgul nas snyan 'jebs tshig dbyung zhing /yeng med lta byed 'dzum pa'i zhib mo'i blo/gzhon nu mkhas gral snyegs 'dod rig gnas lngar/nan tan rtsol ba chen por rtag tu sbyor/ces bye pa po tshangs sras sgra dbungs lha mo nga/nga / bu yul bane+e phrab rig pa'i gnas rnams dang / de nyid ma lus pa blo gros gsal ba'i gzhon nu rnams la sbyin pa'i bya ba byed pa ste/ sgra dbyangs lha mos 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i bya ba dang sbyar te brjod pa'o//ra/ dka' gnad bye ba'i dpal sbyin gsung gi mdzon/phyi rgyud mdo yi dgongs bcud lta ba'i phugabaden gnyis gsal bar 'byed pa'i lam gyi gnad/ston mdzad yar 'brog me ston shes rab 'od/yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ yon tan dag gi khyad par gang /drang brjod yon tan rang bzhin te/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya'i bon dang / gang gis byed las sam yon tan gyi stobs shugs sogs gtso bor ston pa zhig ste/skabs 'dir yon tan zhes pa'i yon tan ni skyon yon ces pa'i yon tan kho nar mi go bar/ bon de'i khyad bon nam khyad gzhi dang khyad bon rang gi

— 44—gshis kyi nus pa'i yon tan brjod pas/ khyad gzhi de'i rigs thams cad kyi yon tan gyi rang bzhin gamu/la bar ston pa'i rgyan zhig la yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa zhes bya/gzhung las/ bden gnyis do mnyam g.yung drung bon/thos pas 'khor ba'i 'jigs las grol/borashaṃm pas byang grol dpal la spyod/gam pas sku gsum mngan du gyur/ces gzhi bden gnyis zung 'brel/ lam thabs shestse/ zung 'brel dang / 'bras bu sku gnyir+sā zung 'jug tu thob byed kyi g.yung drung gi bon ri na po che'i yon tan brjod pa te/ de yang g.yung drung gi bon rin po che 'di nyid/thos pa'i sgo nas nyams su blang pa'i gang zag la/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral zhing / bsam pa'i sgo nas nyams su len pa'i gang zag sgrib gnyis byang zhing mthar sangs rgyas thob pa ma zad/ sgom pa'i sgo nastse/ nyams su len pa'i skyes bu rnams mthar tshe gcig lus gcig la sku gsum marngan du gyur ces bon sku dang / rdzogs sku/ sprul ba'i sku yi go 'phang 'thob rngari/ra'agyur zhes kun rdzob don dam gnyis do mnyam pa'i g.yung drung gi bon rin po che'i yon tan badzod pa'i rgyan no//sha drin can bla ma 'i zhal khyim mthong ba 'dis/bdag lus dad pa'i ba spu rab bablo/ khyi/nga /yid la thun mongs bral ba'i dga' spro brtas/lta byed zum pa'i gdung shugaso/ ches cher 'a phel/zhes sde snod gsum dang bcu phrag rig pa 'chang ba'i rang gi rtsa pa'i bla ma'i zhal mthong ba'i yon tan gyis/ ngaring gi lus ba spu rgyas mig ③chil gle/

— 45 'brug pa sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i dga' ba bskyed ces/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma mjal ba'i yom/ tan gsal bar brjod pa'o//ra/ skye 'gab mtha' bral bde chen klong (mongs su/mkhyen dang brtse ba'i ye shes kun tu rgyu/ skye rgu'i 'jigs brgyad skyob pa'i sbyin brgya ba/sa/ hrig shes rab byams ma khyed min su/ ngos kyi rang bzhim brjod pa'i rgurme ni/gzhung las / skabs thob spyod bya'i rdzas gang dag drang brjod rdzas kyi rang bzhin nge /zhes mtshan nyid bstsa na te/ rang gi brjod bya'am brjod gzhi'i bon gang dang gang yin pa de dag la/ rang gi skabs bab kyi+o longs su spyod rgyu'i bon gang yin pa dang / rang gi khyad bon du gyur ba'i bon gang yin 'khyog brjod dang sgro btags dper bkod pa sogs ma/ yin pa'i thog nas gsal bar dzo brjod pa zhig la rdzas kyi rang baji/na brjod pa'i rgyan 'e/sa bya'o//gzhung las/ ga.a' gar g.yu 'ashāg pad nyi che/ gsal sgron ra0/ gri slegs bamyoshe dang /lhab lhub rigs/ rtags g.yu zur sogs/rnam bkra'i rgyan rdzogs smra ba'i se/nga rnyi/zhes shes rab smra ba'i seng ge'i khrud bom namyo/ skabs babs kyi spyod bya'i rdzas dab/ gi rang bzhin brjod ji/ ste/ shes bya rilha/ pa 'i ble gres kun gyi bdag nyid shes rab smra ba'i seng bes spyod bya'i phyag ma/tshan ngang rdzas ni/gzha' tshon sna lnga'i gur khang dang / gdan skyon gyi dri mas ma gos pa'i brda rtags pad ma'i gdan dang / thabs dang shes rab myo/tshon byeng nyi rla'i gdan/ gsung dbyangs kun tu grags pa'i mtshon byed g.yu 'brug gi gdan/

— 46—ma rig mun pa sel ba dang rtog pa'i drwa ba gcod pa/ 'gro ba yongs la bon gyi char dbab pa sogs mtshon byed gsaṭaka sgron ral gri glegs bam/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi brdar mtshon byed rig rtags bcas spu+od bya'i rdzas rnams kyi rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//sha phun tshogs 'dod rgu'i khri 'phang brtsegs pa'i steng / rin chen rgyan dang gnag snum dbu skyes can/bsam 'phel nor bu ne'u le'i skyal ba'i bdagaganod sbyin nor gyi lha khyed gter gyis dud/ces gnod sbyin nor lha ku be ra'am 'dzam pa lha yi skabs thob spyed bya'i rdzas rnams badzod pa ste/ 'gron kun dbul ba sel ba'i phyir nor bu'i skyal pa dang / ne'u le 'dzin pa/ dbu skra gnag snum dang / nor gyi gtir dag khyed ni gnod sbyin bang mdzod gyi khri 'phang steng du 'gying ba ces nor lha'i rdzas rnams brjod pa'o//ra/ ne seng kun dha'i 'dab stong g.yo ba'i sar/yid 'ong mtshams sprin gsar pa'i gur khang dbub/snyan 'angebs rgyud mang rigs lnga'i zur phud bcas/yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtsho byung sgra dbyangs ma/zhes snyan gzhung rin chen lde mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las/ rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa ste dang po'o//dpe yi rgyan bshad pa/mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba/ mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra sbyar tshul lo//gzhung las/ mtshon bya'i dpe can mtshon byen kyi/

— 4 7—dpe dang mtshungs brjod dpe can te/zhes dpe rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang mtshon byed dpe gnyis so so nas bkod thog mtshon bya dpe can de la yon tan nam khyad bon gang yod pa de/ mtshon byed dpe 'dra mtshungs tsam zhig yod —pa'i sgo nas/ mtshon byed dpe des brjod bya de mtshon pa'am brjod byar gyur ba'i dpe can de'i nus pa gang zhig khyad bon 'dra mtshungs gyi sgo nas phan tshun mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra sbyar brjod pa de nyid kyis nus pas ston pa ste/ mdor na mtshon byed kyi dpe la yod pa'i khyad bon de ltar mtshon bya'i dpe can la yod do zhes mtshungs par bya ba nyid gsal bar byed pa zhig la'o//dper na/ sku mchog che ba bzhin du mdzes/gsung dbyangs pi wang lta bur snyan/thugs nyid mkha' ltar mtha' dbus bral/phyu sras lha khyod blo gros mdzod/ ces pa lta bu'oci//dbye na sum cu rtsa gnyis te/ bon dpe/ dngos po'i dpe/ zlog pa'i dpe/ phan tshun gyi dpe / nges pa'i dpe/ nges med kyi dpe/ bsdus pa'i dpe/phul byung gi dpe/ rab btags kyi dpe/ rmad byung gi dpe/ rmongs pa'i nga/pe/the tshom gyi dpe/ gtan 'beb kyi dpe/ sbyar ba'i dpe/ mnyam nyid kyi dpe/smad pa'i dpe/ bsngags pa'i dpe/ brjod 'dod kyi dpe/ 'gal ba'i dpe/dgag pa'i dpe/ ngo bstod kyi dpe/ de nyid kyi dpe/ thun min gyi dpe/ 'byung min gyi dpe/ srid min gyi dpe/ mang ba'i dpe/ rnam 'gyur gyi dpe/ phreng ba'i dpe/ ngag don gyi dpe/ rla bo dngos po'i dpe/ mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe/rgyu yi dpe bcas sum cu rtsa gnyis so//

— 48 —bon gyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ khyad gzhi dpe dang dpe dun gyi/khyad bon mtshungar+sā badzod bon dpe zhes/zhes bon dpe'i mtshan nyid bstan te+o/ khyad gzhi ma tshon bya dang mtshonabyed gnyis kyi so so'i khyad bon rnams dpe dang dpe can du bkod nas khyad bon phan tshun mtshungs brngage mtshungastse/ pa gsal byed kyi sgra sbyar ba zhig ste/mdor rme/ dpe dpe can gnyis mtshungs par brjod ces mtshungarnga4 bonagasal byed dngos su badzod pa la/ khyad gzhi khyad bon tshang ba'i cha nas bon dpe khye/sa brjod do//gre/zhung 'a/sa / rnacha/ 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang po yi /sku mchog gser ri bzhin du brjod/gsung ni rgyatshomatsho'i gting ltar zab/thugs nyid 'chi 2 da lam bzhin yangs/skyi/zhes /byad gzhi dpe caṣ+yo/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang pe gshen zorib mi rba la/ sku dang gser ri gnyis khyad gzhi/ da be gser gyi ri bo brta na congatshobarjid pa ltar sku mi 'gyur g.yung drung gi kham sa su grwab cing mdzes brjid ldan pa/ de bzhin gsung ni rgya mtsho'i gting dpag ltar zab cing rtogs dka' ba/ gang bzhin thupo/sa nyid ni rgya che ba nam ma kha'i mtha' ltar phyogs dang ris su ma chad par rgya che ba ste/ mdor na/ sku brjid pa/ gsung zab pa/ thugs nyid yangs pa bcas/ sku gsung thugs kyi khyad bon de dag dpe can du bkod nas/ rim bzhin dpe dang mtshungs gsal gyi sgra sbyar nas dngos su brjod pa'o//sha dmu rgyal gdung las rnam grol bslab gsum gyi/gnyer dpon mi 'gyur gtsub/ phud dbang rgyal thugs/

— 49mtshan 'dzin rtog pa brangatha 'di a dar shabyi dor len brgur bgyis bzhin kun ka gsal// zhes dmu rigs rgyal gyi gdung sras gshen mi 'gyur gcumog phud dbangargyal gyi thugs khyad gzhi dpe can mtshan 'dzin sogs sgrib pa thams cad bral zhing bon thams cad sa ler gsal ba khyad bon yin la/ mtshon byedadape ni me long byi dor legs par bgyis pa de'i ngos po/zugs rnam gsal bar 'char ba ji bzhin ces mtshungs gsakhwa/ gyi sgra sbyar nas babo/da pa'o//ra/ rgyal kun yum gyur er sangs sa trig ma'i/ṭ+wā/na 'jebs mgul dbyangs mgrin sngon can la 'khu/'jam mnyen rlung gi bskyod pa'i lan bu ya nga /sa mchog ljon pa ji bzhin dri bsung 'thor/dngos po'i dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe can dpe yi ngo bo dang /mtshungs tsam brjod pa dngos po'i dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang mtshon byed dpe gnyis kyi khyad gzhi dngos po kho na'i bon phan tshun mtshungs pa dngos su brjod pa las/ khyad gzhi so so'i khyad bon rnams pas mtshungs par dngos su ma brjod par/ shugs la go dze+es pa zhig ste/ dngos po tsam gsal bar ston pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi dngos po'i dpe zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ rgyal yum byams mkhi /nal dkyil ni/cha shas ba/yo ba'i ston blar 'khu / 'gro la rjes brtse'i 'dzum rlabs ni/bsil zer g.yo ba'i rjes su 'gro/

— 50— zhes khyad gzhi dpe can rgyal yum byams ma chen po'i zhal dkyil dang /dpe cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i ston rla gnyis te/ de gnyis phan tshun mtshungs tshul gyi dngos su mtshungs gsal gyi sgra sbur nas/ de dag go khyad bon ris med kun la khyab pa dang / dkar ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ mun pa sel ba sogs/ khyad bon du ma'i sgo nas mtshungs tshul dngos ma gsa'/yang / phyogs gang thad nas mtshungs pa shugs la go nus pa'o//sha rab mdzes sku mtshog mar zhi'i lhun po bzhin/ gsung dbyangs rnyi/na 'jebs ka la ping ka'i rla/zab yangs thugs nyid lha lam dang mtshungs ba 'i/gshen rgyal 'gro ba'i mgon de phyag gi yul/zhes rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo'i sku ni ri rgyal lhun po dang / gsu nga ni bya ka la ping ka'i/ thugs nyid ni rgya che ba nam mkha' bzhin dpe dang dpe can so sor khyad gzhi dngos su mtshungs sgra sbur nas/ de dag gi khud bon rnoms sku brji+od pa/ gsung snyan pa/ thugs zab pa sogs so sor shugs la rtags par byas/ra/ 'jo sgegs lang tsho yol ba'i bsod rnyi+o/mas pa/dbu thod ra ris dal 'gro'i ngog la 'gran/phra phrem yan lag gog pa'i rnam dpyod kyang /rtsal ldan dpa' bo'i gnam ru'i rjes su 'gro/zlog pa'i dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe can ngo bo khyad par gang /dpe nyid mtshungs brjod zlog pa'i dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ spyir mtshon byed dpe yi mtshon bya dpe can 'jal dgos na'ang / 'di ni de las ldog te/ dpe can gyi ngo bo dang

—5 1 —khyad bon gang yod pa des/ dpe yi ngo bo dang khyad par mtshon te/ mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra sbyar ba zhig la bya'o// gzhan dang sbyor tshul ldog pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis blog pa'i dpe zhes te/ don so so nas go ldog pa ni mi dgos so/ gzhung las/ thod dkar sras kyi gzi brjid bzhin/nam mkha'i thig le 'od du 'bar/'phrin las phyogs bcur 'bar grwa ltar/tsha zer nyi 'og kun la khyab/ces dpe can rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo'i gzi brjid de/ nyi ma'i 'od zer la mtshon pa dang / rgyal ba'i phrin las dang gdul bu 'gro ba kurme/ la khyab pa de bzhin nyi ma'i 'od zer yang phyogs ris med pa kun la khyab bo zhes phan tshun mtshungs gsal sbyar ba'o//sha rgyal kun ngo bo dran dbang khyed thugs bzhin/ rla ba'i ma ma ches zab dmi ga da7/'a ste/rig grol yon tan 'byamar+sā su klas pa bzhin/dgos 'byung nor bu'i phung po bsam las 'das/zhes dpe can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i thugs nyid ltar/ dpe rgya mtsho ni de bzhin dpag dka'/ de bzhin dpe can bla ma'i mkhyen pa'i yon tan gang yod pa de bzhin ngaṣ+pe ying ba'irme gyi chor bu de yang ngagos nga/gu 'byung ngo 'e/sa phan tshun ldog te smos so//ra/ gnag snum lcang lo'i lan phran g.yo ba bzhin/mi zad lha yi ljon pa phyogs su 'phyo/sgeg mo'i gzhon sha'i myos bum rgyas pa ltar/sa la'i 'bru mchog lha mi'i gsos su smin/
