—52 —phan tshun gyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ gang zhig dpe dang dpe can gnyis/phan tshun mtshungs brjod phan tshun dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya dpe can dang dpe gnyis so so nas khyad 'phags kyi rang bzhin rnams bkod nas/ dpe dang dpe can phan tshun res mos su 'jal res su bkod pa ste/ dpe blang res byas nas dpe can la bstod pa lta bu'i sgo nas sbyor ba'i rgyan zhig la phan tshun gyi dpe zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ dbal chen gdangs grags rngam pa'i gsung /g.yu 'brug dar ma'i gdangs gyis mtshon/dbyar skyes rnga gsangs dar ma'i sgra/lha rgod thog pa'i gsung ltar grags/zhes dang po gnyis la mtshon na/ dpe can khro bo dbal chen rngam pa'i gsung dbyangs de dpe 'grug gi sgra ltar snyan par mtshon pa dang / phyi ma gnyis nas g.yu 'brug gi sgra dpe can du byas nas dpe khro bo dbal chen gdangs grags sam lha rgod thog pa'i gsung ltar mtshon pa ste phan tshun res mos dpe dpe can bsnol ba'o//sha ngag dbang dbyangs can rgyal mo'i thugs dkyil bzhin/'bras ldan dus kyi shar gyi thig le ste/rnyog bral cha shas rgyas pa'i bsil zer ltar/khyed sku nyon shes sgrib pa rnam par grol/zhes dpe dbyangs can lha mo'i thugs nyid dang / dpe can ston kha'i che ba/ phyi ma dpe cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i ston kha'i che ba dang / dpe can

—53 —sgrib pa bral ba'i dbyangs can ma'i thugs sogs phan tshun mtshungs gsal sbyar te dpe brje res byas pa zhig la'o//ra/ yid 'ong er sangs bu mo'i 'dzum rlabs ni/cha shas rdzogs pa'i bsil zer rjes su 'gro/dal 'bab mdzod nas 'khrungs ba'i ri bong gzugs/rgyal ba'i yum gyur shes rab byams mar 'khu/lnga pa nges pa'i dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe can mtshon byed dpe gcig las/mthun dpe gaḍā/na 'gogs nges pa'i dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ dpe can gyi ngo bo'am khyad par phul du phyin pa yin pa'i dbang gis/ de nyid mtshon byed kyi dpe shin tu dkon pas/ dpe gcig kho na las gzhan dpe can 'di mtshon byed kyi dpe snang srid 'dir btsal kung ma snyed pa lta bu ste/ gang bkod pa'i dpe las gzhan dpe can de mtshon byed kyi dpe ru 'gro ba 'gogs pa'i sgo nas rbeji+od pa'i rgyan zhig la'o//gzhung las/ bye brag dngos med mtshan dpe'i rten/byu ru'i rdul brtsegs kho nar mthun/de dang dpe mtshungs srid pa gzhan/rgya che yangs pa'i khams 'dir dben/zhes dpe can gsung gi lnga bye brag dngos med dam/ rigs lnga'i nang tshan du byur ba'i nub tu bye brag dngos med dmar 'bar byu ru'i thig pa 'dra ba zhes/ sku yi mtshan dpe dmar ba byu ru'i rdul brtsegs pa 'dra ba ni shin tu mdzes la dmar ba 'di 'dra ba ni/ dpe byu ru'i rdul brtsegs kyi kha dog

—54—las gzhan ma mchis zhes/ dpe gzhan yod pa bkag nas gzhan ldan pa rnam pa gcod pa'i sgra sbyar ba'o//sha so thar bslab byar mkhas grub yar me bas/g.yung drung gtsug gshen rgyal ba'i ngang tshul 'gogagazhan du khyed kyi brtul zhugs 'chang ba po/gang du ma mthong mgon khyed kho nar nges/zhes dpe can yid kyi khye'u chung ngam g.yung drung gtsug gshen rgyal ba'i bslab gsum gyi rnam dpyod de dpe rje btsun yar 'brog me ston shes rab 'od zer gyi so thar bslab pa'i ngang tshul des mtshungs par nus pa las gzhan g.yung drung gtsug gshen rgyal ba'i mkhyen dpyod la mtshungs nus zhing 'dir ma mthong ngo zhes so//ra/ bcu rig ma ma yid 'ong tshangs lha'i zhal/cha shas gang ba'i ston rla'i dpal la 'khu/gzhan mtshungs dpe blar 'os pa srid pa'i bon/'dzin ma'i khyon 'diratsholan brgyar snyegs kyang min/nges pa med pa'i dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe can mtshon byed gcig kho nar/ma nges gzhan 'dren nges med dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can gang yang rung ba zhig la/ mtshon byed kyi dpe zhig bkod nas/ dpe de kho nar ma nges par da dung gzhan zhig nas de'i dpe 'os pa med pa ma yin stabs de 'dra yod tshe dpe can de nyid mtshon byed kyi dper bkod kyang rang ngo zhes/ dpe gcig kho nar ma nges par gzhan yod pa shugs la ston pa'i rgyan zhig la nges med kyi dpe zhes bya'o//

gzhung las/ ye mkhyen phywa sras keng tse'i sku/gangs la nyi ma shar ba 'dra/de mtshungs snang cha gzhan srid tshe/de yi rjes su ci mi 'gro/zhes dpe can phyu keng tse'i sku mdog dkar po shin tu gsal la dwangs ba ste/ mtshon byed gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba lta bu'o// zhes dang de gcig pu ma yin pa gzhan dkar la gsal ba zhing 'dir yod pa rnams dpe can de nyid mtshon byed du bkod kyang rung la dper 'os so zhes bya'o//sha rnam 'dren mkhas dbang me ston sher 'od rje/so thar sdom par gtsug gshen rgyal ba dang /yang dag marbengs te de yi rigs mthun pa/srid na khyed kyi gzugs rlar 'os mchis so//dpe can g.yung drung gtsug gshen rgyal ba dang / de mtshungs yar 'brog me ston shes rab 'od zer gzhan so thar gyi sdom pa rtsa lags ma nyams par srung ba'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyang / g.yung drung gtsug gshen rgyal ba'i dpe ru mtshungs so//ra/ rmad byung mtshams sprin gyis mdzes rigs mthun grogs/nyal 'gro'i srub la rgyu ba'i gnyis skyes bzhin/der mtshungs 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir gzhan srid tshe/nyid kyi dpe rlar bstegs kyang ngal ba ci/bsdus pa'i dpe/ gzhung las/ dpe can cha res dper mtshungs min/du ma'i sgo mthun bsdus pa'i dpe/

—56—zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang / mtshon byed dpe gnyis so so nas bkod pa'i thog dpe can de'i mtshon byed dpe'i khyad bon gcig bkod nas/ dpe de'i dpe can la mtshon par nus pa ma zad/ rjes su dpe yi khyad bon gcig kho nas dpe can de nyid la mtshon nus la gzhan gyi mtshon du nus pa ma yin te/ dpe can gyi khyad bon du ma bsdus nas dpe de nyid dang mtshungs par sbyor ba dang bcas pa'i rgyan zhig la bsdus dpe zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ 'di lta'i snang cha mi rtag pa/gcig pus gzha' dang mtshungs min te/yid 'ong rnam par bkra ba dang /don gyi snying po dben pas so//zhes 'di ltar gyi snang thams cad mi rtag yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni dpe gzha' tshon de nyid lam sang 'gyur ba tsam kho nas/ dpe can mi rtag pa mtshon pa ma yin kyang / dper na/ 'di ltar snang ba khra chag ge ba/ kun gyi yid du 'ong ba/ mdzes tshon rnam par bkra ba/ brtags cing dpyad na snying po med pa la sogs/ khyad bon du ma'i sgo nas dpe gzha' 'dis dpe can 'di ltar gyi snang ba'i bon rnams mi rtag par mtshon nus pas so//sha ngag gi dbang phywag dmu dbang nyi ma'i mtshan/lus can dpyid du gyur ba kho na yis/'od gsal sur ya'i skal bzang 'phrog min te/srid 'dir kun gyi bla na 'phags pas kung /zhes dpe can dmu rigs gshen gyi gdung sras nyi ma rgyal mtshan dal 'byor gyi mi lus mchog tu byur ba thob pa'am lus can gyi phul du byung ba tsam gcig pu ma yin par/ srid pa gsum gyi spo nas legs byas kyi yon

—5 7—tan mngo+on par 'phogs pa sogs kyis dpe sur ya zhes nyi mas mtshungs par brjad pa lta bu'//ra/ mar gros gting mtha' bral ba kho na yis/dam pa'i mkhyen dpyod dag la 'degs mi 'joga'adod rgu ma lus 'byung ba'i ngang tshul gyis/gang de'i dpe blar bstegs kyang ci mi rung /phul byung gi dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe dang dpe can 'byed byed kyi/khyad bon bkod pa phul byung dpe/ zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang mtshon byed dpe gnyis bkod pa las/ de gnyis kyi gnas gzhi'am yang na khyad bon gang rung zhig gi sgo nas tha snyad tsam ma gtogs/ phyogs kun nas mtshungs ba'i tshig brjod pa te/ de yang brtags cing dpyad pa'i tshe na/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis khyad bon du ma'i sgo nas khyad par shin tu che yang / dpe de nyid phul du byung ba brjod pa ste/ skabs 'dir khyad par med pa lta bur ha cang gi thal cha che ba'i sgo nas brjod pa la 'ga' zhig gi khyad par gyi dpe yang zer ro//gzhung las/ lha mo'i zhal dang rla gsar gnyis/khyad par lha zhal spyan zung dang /rla gsar ri dwags gzugs kyis mdzes/de min gang la gzhigs kyang min/zhes dpe can sgra dbyangs rgyal mo'i zhal dkyil/ dpe cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i rla ba gnyis/ rla ba la ri dwags kyi gzugs ldan yang spyan med pa dang / lha mo'i 'al la spyarme lngarme/ yang ri dwags bzlegs meng/ pas 'byed pa las/ gzhan khyad bon gang gi sgo nas khyad par mi 'dug ces

—58—dngos su brjod pa la/ spyir ni de gnyis mkhyen dpyod ldan min sogs phyogs du ma'i sgo nas khyad par yod kyang / med par brjod pa la phul byung gi dper brjod du bzhag pa'o//sha dmu rigs gtsang gshen bzhad pa'i bshes gnyen dang /ji snyed shes bya'i gter chen phyu sras lha/tshangs spyod brtul zhugs lngan min cung zad kyi/khyad par tsam las gzhan du dbyer ma mchis/zhes dpe dmu rigs 'phrul gyi gdung gsas gtsang gshen snyan ngag rang grol dang / dpe can phywa sras keng tse len med gnyis phan tshun phyogs gang nas gzhigs kyang / so thar gyi sdom pa ldan min tsam zhes/ phyu keng tse ni so thar gyi sdom pa ldan la/ dmu rgyal dam pa ni rgyal sa 'dzin pa tsam laso gzhan khyad par med do zhes brjod pa ste/ dpe de nyid phul du byung ba brjad pa'//ra/ kun gsal thig le dri med lha yi lam/bcu rig 'dod 'byung nor 'dzin dga' ma'i pang /gnas gzhi khyad par brtag pa tsam ma gtogs/ji tsam dpyad kyang 'byed byed yo re dkon/rab btags kyi dpe ni/ gzhung las/ dpe can snyem pa gzhom byed bon/nus ldan bkod pa rab btags dpe/zheso mtshan nyid bstan te/ dpe can dang dpe gnyis so sor bkod thog dpa des dpe can snyem pa 'chang ste/ dpe can de yi dper 'os pa rang las gzhan med do snyam pa'i snyem pa de/ snyem pa 'gogs byed dam gzhom byed/ dpe can de'i dper 'os pa gzhan la la yang yod par brjod

—59—pa don du dpe la de ltar snyem pa med kyang yod par sgro btags nas baji+od pa zhig la rab btags zhes bu'o//gzhung las/ mu tig dwangs ma'i dpal 'dzin zhes/dngul chu'i thig le snyem mi 'tshal/rtsa ljang mchog ma'i zil pa yis/mu tig skal bzang 'phrog par nus/zhes dpe can mu tig la dpe dngul chu'i thig le bzhag nas/ dpe des dpe can 'di mtshon byed nga las gzhan/ med snyam pa'i khengs pa la/gzhan zhig nas dngul chu'i thog le las gzhan pa mu tig bi 'od la mtshon par byed pa zhogs ka'i rtswa yi 'go la yod pa'i zil pas kyang mu tig dwangs mar mtshon nus zhes brjod pas dngul chu'i rig le'i snyem pa 'gog pa ltar byas pa ste/ de ltar du sgro btags te brjod pa'i rgyan no//sha rgyal ba'i dbu las skyes pa'i mdangs 'dzin zhes/in+d+ra ni la'i gyen 'phyur khengs pa'i tshal/smin pa'i dus gsum khu bor bral ba yi/rgyu skar lam yang sngo zhing dwangs pas so/ zhes dpe can rgyal ba'i dbu thor gtsug gam gtsug gtor sngon po dang /dpe in+d+ra ni la zhes rin po che mthing sngon zhig ste/ rgyal ba'i gtsug gtor ma tshon dpe rang las ma mchis snyam snye khengs pa skyes pa la/ gzhan zhig nas sprin bral gyi nam mkha' yang shin tu mthing mdog dbu yi gtsug gtor mtshon nus zhes/ dpe sngon ma'i snyem pa 'gog pa ltar brjod pa'o //ra/ dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal stod mdzad phyu yi skur/mtshon byed rla ba gzhon nu snyem mi 'tshal/yid 'ong lho ṭa'i ljongs kyi sa 'dzin 'dis/

ci— 60— /gang sku'i gzi dpal 'phrog la smyon du med/ rmad byung gi dpe ni/gzhung las/ da dung dpe la dpe can bon/gcig ldan dpe 'gyur rmad byung dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can de/ mtshon byed dpe las ches dga' ba'i ngo mtshar che ba zhig brjod de/ dpe des dpe can la 'gran rla'am yon tan mtshon mi nus pa/ dpe can de'i yon tan khyad par 'phags pa zhig brjod nas/ gal te rtag pa mthar bzung dbang gis de 'dra'i khyad bon de dpe la ldan na/ dpe can de'i dper rig par brjod pa ste/dpe can de'i rmad byung gi yon tan dngos su brjod pa'i cha nas rma da byung gi rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ yid 'ong dkar 'jam mdzes sdug can/la stod gangs dkar ti se la/slob tshogs skyongs pa 'i blo yod na/phyu sras dpa' bo'i sku rlar 'os/zhes dpe can phyu keng tse sku mdog dkar po'i rang bzhin can la/ dpe —yid 'ong mdzes sdug can gyi gangs ti se ste/ dpe can gyi khyad bon 'khor la bon ston nus pa'i yon tan brjod nas/ dpe la med pas/ dpe can de khyad du 'phags shing / gal srid gangs ti se la blo dang ldan pa zhig yin na/dpe can phyu keng tse de nyid mtshon nus par 'gyur zhes brjod pa'o//sha dgos 'dod kun 'byung yid bzhin nor bu la/gzhan phen brtse ba'i nang byed dang ldan na/phyogs bral bon gyi sbyin pa 'gyed mkhas pa'i/ mi 'gyur gtsug phud dbang gi gzugs zur rigaru//

mo — 61 —zhes yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dpe dang / dpe can gshen gyi gdung sras mi 'gyur gtsug phud dbang gi rgyal po/ de yang dpe can gyi khyad bon/ gzhan 'gro la brtse ba snying rje chen po zhig yod pa ni gshen sras dang /nor bu rin po che la blo dang mi ldan pa ste/ gal te gzhan brtse'i snying rje dang ldan na gshen sras mi 'gyur gtsug dbang gi dper 'os zhes brjod pa'o//ra/ nam mkha'i bla bre gshog pa'i nyi gzhon mar/rmad byung thar bde bstsal ba'i mthu mnga' na/tshogs gnyis gter las bskran pa'i rje bla ma'i/dgyes zhal 'dzum pa'i tshul rdong cis mi mtshungs/rmangs pa'i dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe dang dpe can 'dra ba'i phyir/ma phyed nor ba rmangs pa'i dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ dpe dang dpe can so so nas yod pa larang gi gang brjod bya'i dpe can de ngo ma shes nas 'khrul ba ste/ dpe deyang dpe can du gzhan nas phan tshun mtshungs che ba'i su+o/ nas/ dpe demathong tshe dpe can de ru 'dzin pa dang / dpe can mthong tshe dpe de ru 'khrulab bcas rmongs pa'i dbang gi de gnyis so so nas 'byed ma shes pa tsam la 'jog go/ phan tshun dpe dang nor bar mi bya ste/ phan tshun 'khrul ma'akhrul gyi khyad par yod pa sogs kyis 'byed dgos so//gzhung las/ zu 'od thib/ le 'o ma'i mtshor/rlom ste so gos rlabs kyis dwob/slar yang 'o mtsho rla ba'i mdangs/ yin snyaka yug pas 'bog tsam mo//

62—zhes dpe can rla 'od las byung ba'i khang pa'i nang gi rla 'od thig le de/'o mas bkang pa'i snod gcig tu 'dzin te kha ru sbyar nas 'thung grab kyis mchu tos hub kyis rngub/ slar yang dpe 'o mas khengs pa'i snod de tsha 'od phog pa'i khang pa'i rla thig zhig la 'khrul nas rkang pas 'bog pa sogs/phan tshun res mos kyi 'khrul bar gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rmongs pa'i dper bzhag pa'o//sha legs bris gnas su lha la bon ston phyir/nyi ma rgyal mtshan mkha' la gshegs pa dang /kang ka rgod gnyis 'dra phyir rmangs brtul 'gas/rgod po mthong tshe dpral gong thal mo sbyor/zhes gshen nyi ma rgyal mtshan lha yi yul du bon ston ji/ dang gzhan rnam thar 'ga' las rgyal rong yul du byon pa sogs bya rgod thang dkar zhig gi gzugs su sprul nas byon pa la/ phyis dbang brtul 'gas/ bya rgod thang dkar yod do cog la/ mthong tsam nyid nas gshen nyi ma'o snyam nas/thal mo sbyar ba sogs brjod pa'o// ra/ lha mchog phyag gi ral gri mthong ba'i tshe/srog la rgol bar 'dzin te mgo bo gtum/phyis su bshan pas phyag cha g.yug pa la/shes rab stsol bar sems te thal mo zlum/the tshom skyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ de dang dpe can 'dra phyir gang /brtags kyang ma phyed the tshom dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ dpe can dang / mtshon byed dpe gnyis yod pa gzhir bcas kyang / dpe dang dpe can gnyis gang gis thog nas

—63—brtags kyang / shin tu 'dra che ba dang / khyad med du brjod nas dpe dang dpe can gnyis kar ldan pa'i khud bon zhig brjod nas/ daye de nyid mtshon bya dpe de nyid min nam snyam pa'i the tshom gyi blo skyes nas/ gang yin thag ma chod nas the tshom gyi 'chang ba zhig la the tshom gyi dpe ru stsod pa'o//gzhung las/ dkar gsal rnam bkra'i snang ba can/gangs dkar dbang gzhu 'khyud pa'am/smra dbang rgyan gyis spras pa gang /brtags kyang som nyi ldog ma gyur/zhes dpe can phywa sras keng tse'i sku de nyid dkar gsal 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khang lta bu dang / dpe gangs dkar ti se la gzha' sprin gyis 'khyud par bkod nas/ yang naba'iyang du brtags dpyad byas kyang / gangs rgyal ti se yin nam yang na phywa keng tse'i sku yin min rmyongs pa'i dbang gis so sor 'byed ma nus the tshom zos nas lus pa lta bur bzhag pa'o//sha 'od dkar can la dbang gzhu gar bu yis/spud dam yang na shes rab lha mo'i sku/mkha' la 'phags te gzha' gur bkra ba'am/bdag blo 'phyang mo nyug las grol ma nus/zhes mtshon bya shes rab lha mo sgra dbyangs rgyal mo dang / mtshon byed dpe ni bco lnga'i rla ba dang / de gnyis kar ldan pa'i khyad bon ni gzha' tshon gyi 'od gur dang / des na khyad bon de dang ldan pa'i bon de nyid gang gi dpe dang / dpe can gnyis gang yin rmyongs pa'i dbang gis 'byed ma shes pa'o//ra/ 'od zer mdangs can dkrig pa'i dga' tshal na/mkhas mang rnam dpyod 'gran pa'i thal ngag gam/sgra brgya dgyes te mgrin glu sgrogs sam ci/

—64—gang yang ma nges kho bo som nyi'i grogs/gtan 'bebs kyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe can dpe dang mtshungs pa las/dpe can khyad 'don gtan 'bebs dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe dang mtshon byed dpe can gnyis 'dra mtshungs su bkod nas/ dpe la mi ldan pa'i dpe can gyi khyad bon zhig bkod nas rgyu mtshan de'i dbang gis/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis so sor phyes nas/ khyad bon de ldan pas dpe min la/ dpe can no zhes dpe can gtan la phabs pa'am gang du 'dra mtshungs su bkod kung phyis so so nges pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gtan 'bebs kyi dpe zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ dmar ser li khri'i mdangs 'dzin 'di/brtan brdzid ldan kyang ri rgyal min/mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bas na/bstan pa'i 'khor lo'i sku dkyil nges/zhes dpe can ni shes rab smra ba'i seng ge'i sku'i dkyil 'khor dang /dpe ni gser gyi ri rgyal la/ dpe las dpe can khyad par 'phags pa'i bon rno/ 'gyur med sku/ 'gag med gsum / 'khrul med thugs/ legs par 'byung ba'i yon tan/ lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las bcas mchog gi dngos grub lnga dang / 'chi med tshe/ longs spu+od zas/ dmu yad nor/'phen dar ngapal/ snyan grags rigs rgyud bcas thun mong gi dngos grub lnga sogs ster bar nus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ dpe can bstan pa'i 'khor lo las gzhan dpe ri rgyal la mi ldan par ston nas/ dpe can nges pa rnyed pa'o//

—65 —sha chu 'dzin gzhon nu'i dpal 'phrog dkar mdzes 'di/sprin gyis g.yog sgrib byed do rla gsal min/'dzad med snyan pa'i ngag gi 'dod pa kun/'jo phyir dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i gzugar/ sku nges/zhes rgyan 'di la mtshon bya'i dpe can ni sgra dbyangs lha mo dang /dpe ni bco lnga'i zu ba gnyis te/ dpe can la khyad 'phags kyi bon ni 'char nub med par ngag gi dpal ster nus pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs kyis so//ra/ lnga rig nor bu'i rdzing chen yangs pa'i klong /rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i blo gros can/dbang phyug nyer gnas lha yi bla min ste/'khor tshogs thar lam ston phyir rje bla ma/sbyar ba'i dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi bon/ma phyed mnyam sbyor sbyar ba'i dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang mtshon par bya rgyu'i dpe can dang / de nyid mtshon byed kyi dpe gnyis kyi phan tshun khyad bon du ma'i sgo nas 'dra mtshungs su gnas pa'am/ yang na dpe can gyi khyad bon rnam dpe de la sgra don gang rung gi sgo nas 'dra phyir dpe dang dpe can gnyis so so nas dngos su ngos ma bzung par khyad bon sbyar nas mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgras dngos su zin pa zhig la sbyar ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ sgrib med 'od kyi rnam pa can/blta ru yod la 'dzin du med/snye bdag mdun gsal ba'i lha tshogs rnams/chu bla'i dkyil 'khor nyid daḍi mtshungs/

—6kyo—zhes mtshon bya bskyed rim mtshan ma'i lha sku sgom pa dang / mtshon byed chu nang gi zu gzugs te/ de gnyis kar ldan pa'i khyad bon ni/ gang gis ma sgrib pa dang / mig gis mthong du yod pa khra chi ler lha sgom pa dang /chu nang gi rla gzugs yang mig gis mthong du yod pa gnyis/ lag gis bzung ngam 'dzin du med pa ste/ dpe don gnyis kar mtshungs pa ma zad mtshungs gsal gyis sgras phan tshun 'dra bar ston pa'o//sha rab gsal nyin mor byed pa'i dgra rla dang /gang dang 'tshams par sprul pa'i rnam rol ston/kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i thod dkar sras/snying stobs dbang phyug 'jug pa bcu ba bzhin/ces dpe can ston pa gshen rab mi bo dang / dpe khyab 'jug gnyis/khyad bon gang la gang dgos kyi sprul pa ston nus pa'i don dang / kun las rnam par rgyal zhes pa sgra sbyar nas/ snying stobs zhum pa medapa sogs phan tshun mtshungs gsal gyis sgra yis lam nas ston pa'o//ra/ gting mtha' bral ba'i shes reg chu gter cher/ngal med skya bas bsrub pa'i blo gsal dgayid 'ong 'dab chags rgyal po ngang rgyal dang /mtshungs zhes brjod la 'bad pa ci ste mchis/mnyam nyid kyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ mtshungs dpe mnyam pa'i rgyu mtshan la/bstan nas mtshungs brjod mnyam nyid dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can nam don dang / mtshon byed dpe gnyis sgra dang don gnyis ka phan tshun mnyam pa'am 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis mnyam nyid kyi dper bzhag la/ sgra mtshungs pa'i sgo nas nang

— 6 7—gses so sor go rgyu yod pa'am/ yang na sgra yi gcod mtshams tha dad pa'i dbang gis/ don gnyis ston pa sogs/ mdor na/ sgra mtshungs 'dres nas don gyi ngo bo tha dad pa dang / sgra mtshungs shing gcod mtshams kyis 'gyur nas brjod bu'i don shin tu tha dad par go ba zhig la dpe rgyan gyi nang tshan du gyur ba'i mnyam nyid kyi dpe ru brjod do//gzhung las/ dge bcu'i snang ba rtag 'bar ba'i/gangs ljongs rtsa gsum lha gnas bzhin/rko'u shi ka yi dpal yon gyis/kun nad+dha/ yongs su brgyan pas so//zhes dpe can sum cu rtsa gsum/ dpe gangs can ljongs gnyis la/khyad bon dge ba bcu'i snang ba yongs su khub pa dang / bod gangs can gyi spyongs la mkhas pa'i legs byas kyis yongs su brgyan pa dang / dpe can sum cu rtsa gsum la'ang / lha dbang brgya byin gyis brgyan pa sogs dang /sku'u shi ka zhes pa sgra sbyar ba ste/ mkhas pa brgya byin gnyis la go ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis rmanyam nying rgyarme/ gyi da'er baji+od du bkod pa'o//sha shes bya'i dpal yon mchogaster ngag gi dbang /tshangs pa'i sras mo'i sku yi dkyil 'khor ni/rdul bral snang srid rgyal mtshan gzhon nu bzhin/gī tī ke sa ro nā mdzes pas so//zhes pa 'di kā tā ke sa ro na zhes pa blu'i skad dod gī tī dang skra dang — ze'u 'bru'i skad dod ke sa ra la rnam dbye gsum pa'i ṭ+wā byin nas/ ṭ+wā khud don yin pas phyi srog gi a bzhag a ru yi zhi nar bsgyar/ rtags mtha'i ya yig phral nas i'i yi ge e ru bsgyur nas sbyar ba'o//༄ dbyangs can zhal

—68—gyi glu dang dbu skra mdzes pa dang / pad+ma bung ba'i blu dang ge sar mdzes pa ston no//ra/ bsil ldan dga' ma 'dzum pa'i skyed tshal na/dkar gsal rnam bkra'itsho'od 'chang mtshan mo'i mgon/dal 'bab mdzod las 'khrungs ba'i bsil zer can/bla 'od 'thung ba'i kun dha'i dpal la 'khu/smad pa'i dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe la mngon smad dpe can ni/bstod cing shugs smad smad pa'i dpe/zhes mtshan stid bstan te/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis 'dra mtshungs su so so nas bkod de/ mtshon byed dpe de nyid tshig zin la dngos su smad nas/ mtshon bya dpe can de tshig zin la dngos su ma smad kyang / dpe can de nyid dpe de dang mtshungs zhes brjod nas skyon med lta bu'i khyad du 'phags pa'o// zhes tsheg zin la dpe can de nyid bstod la/gang gis dpe la smad nas dpe can de nyid de dang mtshungs par brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ dpe can de'ang shugs la smad par 'gyur bas smad pa'i dpe zhes baji+od pa'o//gzhung las/ lha lam mi srun dregs sdes 'gengs/chu gter dug can klu yi gnas/rnam 'dren khyed thugs mkhyen brtse'i gter/yin phyir mtshungs las khyad par 'phags/zhes dpe can rnam 'dren bla ma'i thugs la/ dpe nam mkha' lta bu dang rgya mtsho lta bu bkod nas/ dpe nam mkha' ni lha ma srid sde brgyad kyis khengs 'dug rgya mtsho ni klu rigs gdug pa can gyis khengs 'dug ces

— 69—dngos su brjod pas/ dpe can shugs la rnam 'dren bla ma'i thugs la dug lnga dug gsum gyisatshokhengs yod pa bstan/ de yang dpe can bstod tshul ni mkhyen dang brtse ba chen po'i gter yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyad par che zhes badzod kyang / de ltar min na rgya mtsho nor bu'i 'byung gnas dang / nam mkha' ni nyi zu'i zhing yin pa'i phyir te/ des na dpe smad pas dpe can shugs la smad pa'//sha rin chen dang po'i rgyan brtsegs rdul gyis 'bagapad ma'i rtsa lag 'char nub kyi rang bzhin/stobs bcu mnga' bdag mdzes sku gnyis sgrib las/rnam par dag phyir mtshungs las dpa' zhing 'jebs/zhes dpe can rin chen rdul rtsegs ri rgyal dang / pad ma'i rtsa lag nyi ma gnyis dpe can stobs bcu'i mnga' bdag 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po lha dbang rgya byin la/ dpe la smad tshul ni ri rgyal ni rdul gyis 'bag dang /nyi ma ni 'char nub can gnyis/ dpe can shugs la sgrib gnyis kyis gos pa sogs bstan/ dpe can khyad 'phags ni/ dpa' zhing brjed pa'i khud paragyis 'byed ces so//ra/ ku mud 'od mdangs gsal yang nyi mor yib/rlung gi rgyal mtshan mdzes kyang reg byas dben/'du 'dzin 'jig rten phan bde bya ba gang /yang dag de rjes 'gro yang khyad par che/bsngags pa'i dpe ni/ chigazhung las/ dpe la mngon bstod dpe can ni/ shugs kyi bstod pa bsngags pa'i dpe/

— 70—zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi mtshon byed dpe du ma zhig gi khyad bon khyad 'phags sngon nas brjod cing mtshon bya dpe can de'i khyad bon dngos su brjod pas bstod pa ma byas kyang / dpe de la khyad 'phags kyi yon tan du ma zhig ldan pa bsngags pa'i sgo nas/ dpe can de yang de dang mtshungs par brjod pa tsam gyis/ dpe can de nyid shugs la bstod pa'am bsngags pa'i dbang gis bsngags pa'i dpe zhes badzod pa'o//gzhung las/ 'chi med rdzing ring nyi zu'i zhing /rla ba'i ma ma nor bu'i mdzod/rnam 'dren dam pa nyid kyi thugs/rnam kun de dang yang dag 'dren/zhes dpe can rnam 'dren dam pa'i thugs nyid de/ dpe 'chi med rdzing ring zhes nam mkha'i yon tan rgya che zhing nyi rla bgrod pa'i gzhir gyur ba dang / rla ba'i ma ma ni rgya mtsho yid bzhin nor bu 'byung ba'i gzhir gyur ba sogs/ dpe rgya che ba gting zab pa des dpe can rnam 'dren bla ma'i thugs nyid de dpe dag dang mtshungs par brjod pas shugs la bla ma'i thugs nyid rgya che zab pa sogs kyi yon tan ldan pa shugs la rtogs nus pa sogs kyis bstod pa'o//sha mar zhi ri dbang kun gyi yi gar 'ong /bcu gnyis po yi gling bzhi'i smag rum gzhil/brgya pa'i mgon po'i sku dkyil de dag gis/ rjes 'gro srid zhi'i gtsug gartor rgyan du mdzes/zhes dpe gser gyi ri bo dang / rla ba gnyis te/ ri rgyal ni ri bo kun gyi mchog tu gyur cing brtan brjid ldan pa dang / rla bas ni gling bzhi'i mun pa thams cad sel ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i yon tan mngon

— 71 —du brjod pas/ dpe can ston pa gshen rab mi bo'i sku ni shugs la bstod pa'o//ra/ sum rtsen khang bzang 'dod rgu'i nor gyis bltams/'od stong can des ris med snang ba sbyin/phun tshogs de yi rjes su 'degs 'jog pa'i/rgyal ba gnyis pa mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon/brjod 'dod kyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ gnyis kar skyon yon gang ldan yang /mtshungs zhes brjod sems brjod 'dod dpe/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon byed dpe de nyid la skyon dang yon tan ji 'dra zhig ldan na'ang / mtshon bya dpe can de dang mtshungs zhes baji+od pa la dge skyon ji ltar 'gyur rung / phan tshun mtshungs par brjod par 'dod pa de la 'gog tu med pa'i shugs la dpe don gnyis ka'i yon tan gsal tsam mtshungs par baji+od pa la/ de'ang dpe de dpe can la sbyar ba'i tshe sbyar ltangs thad dpyad zhib legs par ma byas na/ dpe la zur za'i tshig tu 'gyur bzo yod pas dpyad par bya'o//gzhung las/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad ldan nam/rmyongs pa'i bag rgyar 'thums kyang rung /dran dbang khyed dang rgyal gshen gnyis/mtshungs zhes brjod 'dod snying na gnas/zhes mtshon bya rgyal ba gshen rab dang / mtshon byed rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis/ phan tshun mtshungs par brjod pa la/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad par ldan pa'am/ yang na gangs yang ma shes rmyongs pa'i dbang da gyar na

— 72—'dra/ gang gi dpe dang dpe can de gnyis phan tshun mtshungs par brjod pa ni su gang gis 'gogs pa med par snying la gnas pa'o//sha lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan nam/kun rtog rmongs blos gang gyur ji ltar na'ang /dam pa khyed dang ku byi mang ke gnyis/'gran ces brjod 'dod bdag blor gtan tu brnags/zhes rnam 'dren bla ma dam pa de nyid dpe dang / de la lung rtogs yon tan ldan pa'am/ skongs pa'i blos gos pa ji yin kyang / dpe can gsung gi lha ku byi mang ke dang mtshungs zhes brjod 'dod dus rtag tu yid la 'char bar gyur ro//ra/ snyan 'jebs yon tan 'bum gyis byug pa'am/don dben mdza' bos bor ba'i skyo glu gang /gnyis skyes bu mos sbyin pa'i mgrin dbyangs 'di/'phang 'gro'i rgyun zhes brjod 'dod snying la 'chang /'gal ba'i dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe dang dpe can bon mtshungs kyang /ngo bo tha dad 'gal ba'i dpe/zhes 'gal ba'i dpe yi mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon byed dpe rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis tsam bkod nas/ khyad gzhi dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi khyad bon rnams mtshungs shing / ngo bo'am gnas gzhi'i ngo bo tha dad pa dang 'gal ba'i rgyu mtshan te/ mdor na dpe dpe can gnyis kyi khyad bon mthun yang / khyad gzhi 'am gnas gzhi 'gal bas 'gal ba'i dpe zhes brjod pa'o//

gzhung las/ dal 'byor ldan pa'i mi lus dang /lha gnyen 'tshos pa'i shel sgong dang /yid bzhin nor bu mtshungs mod kyang /gzhi gcig steng du mthun pa 'gal/dpe can lha dang gnyen gnyis bshos pa'i 'bras bu shel gyi sgo nga de byi dor legs par byas na/ dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i khyad bon dang ldan pa dang / dpe phyi yi dal ba bzhi dang nang gi dal ba bzhi ste dal ba brgyad dang / rang 'byor lnga dang gzhan 'byor lnga ste 'byor ba bcu dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che gnyis khyad bon yid bzhin gyi nor bu yin pa mtshungs kung /gzhi gcig gi thog tu mi lus rin po che dang lha gnyen 'tshos pa'i shel sgong gnyis ka yin pa mi srid pa bzhin no//sha bsil ba'i zer brgya spro ba'i mtshan mgon dang /mdangs mtshar 'chi med 'dab brgya man dha ra/rgyal yum tshangs pa'i sras mo'i sku dkyil gsum/'gran yang phun tshogs tha dad dbang gi 'bul/dpe can rgyal yum tshangs sras sgra dbyangs rgyal mo'i sku'i dkyil 'khor dang / dpe bco lnga'i rla ba/ me tog kun dha dkar po rnams khyad bon dkar ba'i cha nas mtshungs kung / gzhi gcig steng du gsum ka yin pa mi srid pa ste phun tshun 'gal ba'o//ra/ ji ltar dal 'gro'i mes po'i nyams 'gyur dang /'chi med lam du rgyu ba'i bsil zer can/nges lnga'i bdag nyid gong de'i dkyil 'khor rnams/mtshungs kyang gnas gzhi gcig tu 'grub pa dkon/dgag pa'i dpe ni/

— 74—gzhung las/ dpe dang dpe can don mnyam nus/ khyad bon 'gog pa dgag pa'i dpe/zhes dgag pa'i dpe'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang /mtshon byed dpe gnyis so so nas bkod thog mtshon byed kyi dpe de nyid cung zad smad pa'i khar dpe dang dpe can gnyis khyad bon 'ga' mtshungs par balngod cing / dpe can de'i khyad bon khyad du 'phags pa zhig ston te/ rgyu mtshan de'i dbang gis dpe des dpe can la 'gran pa'am/ do rla ma mchis te/ dpe can de'i khyad bon la dpe de'i khyad bon gyis do rla mchis pa bkag nas ma mchis pa ston pa'i rgyan zhig la'o//gzhung las/ ming tshig brjod pa dang bral ba'i/dpyid kyi dpal mo'i 'gyur khug gis/'chad pa sgra rig 'byung ba'i khungs/bya rgyal gsung la nam zhig 'gran/zhes dpe dpyid dpal zhes bya khu byug gi ngag dang / dpe can bya rgyal khyung chen te/ khyung chen ni srid pa sangs po 'bum khri'i rig pa'i gnas chen po lnga gsung ba'i skabs su bya rgyal khyung chen khri la bzhugs nas sgra rig pa'i bon sde de bya khyung spyi rje rgyal po las byung zhes khyad bon de dang ldan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ming dang tshig gi baji+od bya dben pa'i khu byug gsung des nam yang 'gran mi nus zhes so//sha zhib mor ltos na snying po dben pa yi/yun du mi brtan rlung gi rgyal mtshan gyis/rnam 'dren mtshungs med thod dkar sras po yi/rab bkra'i dkyus ring can la nam zhig 'dren/

— 75—zhes dpe rlung gi rgyal mtshan ni gzha' tshon dang / dpe can rnam 'dren rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo yi spyan mig la nam yang 'gran mi nus te/gzha' tshon ni snying po dben pa sogs kyis shin tu khud par che'o zhes so//ra/ mkhyen dpyod mdza' bos bor ba'i sngo sangs ma/yid 'ong mtha' bral 'chi med lha lam 'dis/skye rgu'i phan dang bde ba ster ba'i dpal/rnam 'dren bla ma'i thugs la ci ste 'gran/ngo bstod kyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe dang dpe can tha dad kyang /mtshungs bon gcig bkod ngo bstod dpe/zhes ngo bstod kyi dpe'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang mtshon byed dpe gnyis so so nas ngo bo tha dad pa bkod de/ de gnyis dang mtshon byed dpe gnyis so so nas ngo bo tha dad pa bkod cing / de gnyis phyogs gang ci'i thad nas phan tshun khyad par che na'ang / skabs 'dir dpe la ngo bstod dmatshokhyad 'phags brjod pa'i ched/ gnyis ka'i mtshungs ba'i bon gcig gi thog tu mtshungs par brjod pa ste/ spyir ni dpe las dpe can khyad par 'phags kyang skabs 'dir dpe la ngo bstod kyi phyir du baji+od pa'o//gzhung las/ mu cho ldem drug rgyal ba'i tshab/khri gtsug rgyal ba dngos yin kyang /rgyal dang rgyal tshab gnyis kyi khyad/so skye'i dbang po'i yul las 'das/zhes dpe rgyal ba'i gsung bstan gyi zur sdong du byon pa mu cho ldem drug ste rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab tu bu+on pa dang / dpe can rtsod lngan tshe lo brgya pa'i ston pa rgyal ba khri gtsug rgyal ba gnyis phan tshun phyogs gang nas gzhigs

— 76—kyang / khyad par ci yang ma mchis zhes brjod pa ste/ don du ston pa dang mu cho gnyis spangs rtogs kyi yon tan la khyad par yod kyang / dpe la bstod nas yon tan sogs phyogs gang gis thad nas khyad par med par brjod pa'o//sha gshen rab spyan dkyus gzha' tshon mdangs 'dzin cing /rlung gi rgyal mtshan 'ja' ris dngos nyid kyi/rang bzhin yin mod gdul bya'i mthong yul du/dbang po'i gzhu dang khyad par ga la zhigazhes rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo'i spyan dang / nam mkha' la shar ba'igazha' tshon gnyis phyogs gang nas gzhig kyang shin tu khyad par che yang ngo bstod kyi ched du gdul bya'i mthong tshul la khyad par med par brjod pa'o//ra/ 'dren mchog mi yi seng ge rje bla ma/theg dgu'i mdzod 'chang gshen rgyal dngos min kyang /phan bde'i re bskang brtse chen dam pa'i gshis/tha dad bdag blos 'byed la dmigs su med/de nyid kyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ gang zhig dpe min don yin zhes/dgag pa dang sgrub pa de nyid dpe/zhes de nyid kyi dpe'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ gang zhig mtshon bya dpe can de dang / mtshon byed kyi dpe de gnyis/ phan tshun khyad bon 'dra che ba'i dbang gis rnam par 'byed dka' ba lta bu badzod cing / dpe don gnyis gcig la gcig 'du ba lta bur gyur nas/ dpe de dpe can du 'khrul ba la/slar 'khrul ba'i mongs pa de nyid las thar te/ dpe de nyid ma yin la/

— 77—dpe can 'di nges so ces so sor rnam par 'byed byed kyi khyad bon zhig gtso bor ston pa'i rgyan zhig la de nyid baji+od pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ mtshar sdug rdzogs pa'i yid 'ong 'di/rgyal ba'i sku yin lhun po min/nyi rlas 'khyud min mkhyen brtse'i 'od/dpag bsam ma yin gtsug gtor lags/zhes dpe can sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gtso bo dang / dpe gser gyi ri bo gnyis/ mtshar sdug rdzogs pa dang nyi ma'i 'od zer dang mkhyen brtse'i 'od/ dpag bsam shing dang dbu skra 'am gtsug gtor rnams khyad bon mtshungs pas rnam par 'byed dka' na'ang / dpe can khyad 'phags kyi bon bstan gtso'i mkhyen brtse'i 'od dang / dbu yi thor gtsug sogs su ngos 'dzin pas so sor rnam par 'byed pa'o/ /sha las ldan yid 'ong 'dzin 'di drin can gyi/bla ma'i sku ste shel dkar bum bzang min/lha regs spud pa ma yin ngur smrig gos/rnam bkra'i sgro mdangs ma lags pad zhur nges/zhes dpe can drin can bla ma'i sku dang / dpe shel gyi bum pa bzang po gnyis khyad bon du ma'i sgo nas gnyis med du snang nas/ dpe can de dpe ru 'dzin pa'am zhan pa'i blo de nyid dgag nas shel gyi bum pa ma yin bla ma'i sku dang / bum pa'i mgul rgyan min bla ma'i na bza' yin/ bum pa'i kha rgyan sgre ni min la bla ma'i pad zhu yin zhes dpe nyid dgag nas dpe can de nyid yin par ston pa'o//ra/ dran mchog shar ri'i spo nas rngo 'cha' ba'i/'gro ba'i sgron me ma yin lus kyi sgrom/

— 78—ris med bde dga' 'dzum mdangs g.yo ba 'di/drod skyed ma lags brtse ba'i sems pa nges/ thun mong min pa'i dpe ni/gzhung las/ khyad par dper mtshungs gzhan med pas/rang dpe rang bkod thun min dpe/zhes thun min rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ dpe can nam mtshon bya de nyid 'jig rten na yongs su grags pa'i khyad du 'phags par/ stobs shugs dang mdzes dpal sogs phyogs gang nas yang rtser son pa zhig sngon du bkod nas/ de mtshon byed kyi dpe srid 'dir ma rīd pa'am/ dpe gzhan gyis dpe can der mtshon mi nus pa'i stobs kyis/ dpe can de mtshon byed dpe can de las gzhan med par ston nas/ rang dpe rang 'jog dgos byung ba ste/ dpe can de'i nus pa thun mong ma yin pa badzod pa yin pas thun min gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ srid dang zhi ba'i bon kun las/khyad par 'phags pa'i gshen rgyal mchogakhyod mtshungs srid pa gzhan med pas/nyid sku nyid kyi dpe cher 'os/zhes mtshon bya dpe can ni/ srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha' dang / zhi ba myang 'das kyi mthar mi gnas shing / 'khor ba'i bon dang / myang 'das kyi bon thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i sku/ rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i ston pa gshen rab mi bo kun las rnam par rgyal ba 'di nyid mtshungs ba'i dpe snang zhing srid pa'i khams 'dir gzhan med pas/ rang gi dpe rang 'os par ston pa'i rgyan no//

sha rab mdzes kaṅka ri dang gangs ldan gyi/mtshar sdug las 'das rje btsun keng tse phyu'i/yid 'ong bltas pas mi ngom sku dkyil de'i/mtshungs zur khyed nyid 'os so ngag gi dpal/zhes mtshon bya dpe can phyu keng tse'i sku'i mdangs dang / de nyid mtshon byed dpe shel gyi ri dang / gangs kyi ri sogs gang gis kyang mtshon par mi nus pas/ khyad par 'phags pa'i sku'i mdangs de'i mtshon byed kyi dpe khyed sku khyed kyi dpe ru bya ba las gzhan ma mchis par ston pa'o//ra/ mang 'dus mkhas brgya 'gran pa'i gnas/bsil ldan kha ba ri pa'i sder/nyid kyi dpe rlar srid 'di na/dkon pas nyid sku nyid kyis mtshon/'byung min gyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe can srid can dpe srid min/bon zhig bkod pa 'byung min dpe/zhes srid min gyi dpe'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang mtshon byed dpe gnyis bkod pa'i khar/ dpe du ma zhig bkod nas/ de rnams gcig tu 'gyur mi srid kung / gcig tu 'gyur bar dpe ru bkod pas/ dpe srid min/ dpe can la de lta'i yon tan khyad 'phags sogs ston nas/ dpe la de ltar yin pa me da kyang / dpe can la de ltar yin pa srid pa bkod pas/ dpe de ltar 'byāng mi srid pas srid min nam 'byung min ces dang / gzhan sdes 'das tshig sbyar te 'byungs min sbyar ba la/sding min ces ma 'ong par sbyar na mi legs par 'dod kung / rang lāgs

— 80—la yin pa mi srid pa zhig bkod pas de'i rgyu mtshan gyis dngos bstan lngar 'byung min sbyar na legs par sems/gzhung las/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mdzes dpal kun/chabs cig bsdus pa ji lta bu/rgyal yum shes rab byams ma yi/mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor lta na sdugaces dpe can rgyal ba'i yum shes rab byams ma chen mo'i mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor ni mthong ba tsam gyis dwangs ba 'dren nus pa'i lta sdug gam mdzes sdug ldan pa ni srid pa yin la/ mtshon byed kyi dpe ni stong dang po spyi phud kyi 'jig rten/ stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten/ stong gsum pa mthar thugs kyi 'jig rten te/ 'jig rten de gsum gyi mdzes dpal kun gcig tu bsdus pa zhig yin pa mi srid pas/ dpe srid min ces 'asding min du brjod pa'o//sha gangs can ljongs 'di'i rtogs ldan thams cad kyi/nyams dang rtogs pa phyogs gcig spoms pa bzhin/mi g.yo bsam gtan sgom pa'i dbang po ba/dgongs mdzod ri khrod chen po bstan 'grobiskubs/zhes dpe can rtse gcig mi g.yo gnas lugs de nyid kho nar ‘ṭ+wāṃms skyongs pa'i rdzogs chen gyi rnal 'byor ba chen po rje btsun dgongs mdzod ri khrod chen po dang / dpe gangs can ljongs kyi rnal 'byor ba thams cad kyi nyams rtogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i bon zhig mi srid pa ma‘ lnga'o dpe can nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la shar ba'i rnal 'byor ba dgongs mdzod ri khrod chen po srid pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi dpe can srid la daspre srid min zhes bya'//

— 81 —ra/ brjid chags ltun rdzogs yid 'ong sa ṭapedzin dkar/sgeg ldem mgo lcog g.yo ba'i kun dh+wa dang /bsil sbyin mkhan gyi dgyes pa'i 'dzum rlabs bcas/phyam du dril bzhin mdzes ldan dbyangs can ma/srid min gyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe la med bzhin dpe can la/med par brjod pa srid min dpe/zhes srid min gyi dpe'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis so so nas bkod pa'i khar/ mtshon byed dpe de 'dra zhig 'byung mi srid pa dngos su bstan pa gang zhig de'i mtshon bya dpe can la'ang / de 'dra 'byung ba mi srid par bstan pas srid min gyi dpe zhes brjod do//gzhung las/ sman mchog rnam par rgyal ba las/dug gi lo ma mi skye bzhin/blo gros ldan pa'i skyes mchog las/log pa'i spyod pa 'byung mi srid/zhes dpe can blo gros dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa dang / dpe sman gyi mchog tu gyur ba a ru rnam par rgyal ba ste/ dpe a ru rnam par rgyal ba ni dug gi sman du 'gyur ba las dug mi bskyed pa bzhin du/ dpe can blo gros can gyi skyes bu dam pas yang dag pa'i lacha/ las log par ston mi srid pa'o// zhes dpe la mi srid bzhin du dpe can la yang mi srid pa'o//sha mi gtsang ljan ljin khrod la dri gtsang dang /tsher ma'i shing la rig 'jam med bzhin du/nyes gzhi'i g.yon mar rtse dga' rol 'dod kung /sred ldan skye bor gtan bde srid pa min/

— 82 —zhes dpe mi gtsang ba'i khrod du dro ma bzang po dang / tsher ma'i shing la reg bya 'jam pa yod mi srid pa bzhin/ dpe can gtsang khrims phung ba'i gzhi ma bud med la rtsed dga' rol ba'i 'khor ba la 'khyam pa skye bo rnams ni gtan gyi bde ba ni mi srid pa ston pa'o//ra/ nam mkha'i thig les bskrun pa'i thun gsum smagatsan dan ljon las sdang ba'i mi gtsang dri/lus bskyed ma mas bstsal ba'i dug sbyor zas/srid 'dir 'phar 'gro'i spu las dkon par snang /mang ba'i dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe can gcig la mtshon byed dpe/du ma bkod pa mang ba'i dpe/zhes mang ba'i dpe'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon byed dpe 'dra ba du ma zhig bkod nas/ des mtshon bya dpe can de la mtshon byed dpe du ma'i yon tan nam khyad bon ldan pa zhig sī/ dpe can dang / dpe du ma'i sgo nas phul du phyin pa zhig gsal zhing / dpe can gcig la dpe mang po'i yon tan 'dus pas mang ba'i dpe zhes brjod pa'o//gzhung las/ dri za'i dbyangs dang pe wang sgra/khu byug cong dang gling bu'i 'gyur/tshangs pa'i gsung bzhin dbyangs can ma'i/mgrin snyan thos ldan rna ba'i dpyid/ces dpe skad snyan pa'i rigs/ dri za'i dbyangs dang / pi wang gi sgra/bya khu byug gi ngag gling bu'i sgra/ lha tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs ji bzhin/dpe de dag tshangs ma'i yon tan rang la tshang ba'i dpe can dbyangs can

— 83 —ma'i gsung ni/ rna bar thos pa tsam gyis snyan 'jebs kyis dwangs ba 'dren pa'o//sha man dh+wa ra dngu u dum wa ra'i tshal/yid 'ong dbang po'i tshon dang 'od brgya pa/zu dkyil ji bzhin ngag dbang keng tse phyu'i/sku mchog lus can snying gi nyer 'tshor mtshar/ces dpe mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba'i me tog man d+ngha ra ba/ me tog u dum wa ra/ gzha' tshon/ zu ba'i mdangs sogasani dpe la/ mtshon bya dpe can ni rjes btsun phywa keng tse lan med kyi sku mdog 'di la dpe de dag tshang ma'i yon tan ldan pas sems bskyed pa'i rten gzhir lta bu gyur ba'o zhes so//ra/ bsil ri'i mgul du 'cha' ba'i g.yu ral can/nam mkha'i bla bre g.yo ba'i sgra brgya dang /myur mgyogs rtsal ldan rdo rje'icame char bzhin/mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum 'di ci zhigarnam 'gyur gyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe can dpe yi rigs mthun las/bkol 'drar brjod pa rnam 'byur dpe/zhes rnam 'gyur gyi dpe'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can de rang gi rigs mthun dpe gang rung zhig gi nang nas bkol zhes/ zur du phyung ba 'dra ba brjod pa'am/ dpe can rnam pa snang ba la/ dpe de'i khyad 'phags kyi yon tan rang dang 'dra mtshungs zhig dpe de las bton pa dang / dpe de'i rnam pa 'gyur nas dpe can de'i ngo bor gyar ba lta bus brjod pa zhigal/ rnam 'gyur gyi dpe zhes brjod do//

—84—gzhung las/ rnam khyen sangs rgyas yongs kyi gtso/gshen rab rnam par rgyal ba'i sku/nyi ma'i khongs nas phyung ba bzhin/'od du 'bar zhing zer du 'phro/zhes dpe can bon thams cad dus gcig tu mngon sum gzigs pa'i rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo kun las rnam par rgyal ba de nyid yin la/ dpe ni nyi ma'i nang nas nyi 'od thams cad phyung ba ji bzhin/ 'od zer phyogs kun la khyab/ ces dpe nyi ma las rnam pa 'gyur te/ nyi ma'i nang nas bton pa'i nyi 'od bzhin du 'od zer ldan zhes baji+od pa la/ rnam 'gyur gyi dpe ru bzhagarngan pa'//sha rkang gnyis gtso bo'i mdzesdo/ sku 'od 'bar ba/gser sbyang btso ma'i dkyil nas phyung ba bzhin/zab rgyas bon sgo'i 'byung gnas 'dzum g.yo'i zhal/bisba'i khongs nas thon ma thag dang mtshungs/dpe can ston pa khri gtsug rgyas ba'i sku de/ dpe gser dwangs ma nas bton pa lta bu dang / dpe can bon sgo thams cad 'byung gnas zhal gyi sgo ni/ dpe bisba zhes pa ni gzugs brnyan te de'i nang nas thon ma thag pa bzhin/ dpe gser dang bisba gnyirngage rnam pa 'gyur nas dpe can ston pa'i sku'i mdangs dang / zhal sgo ru gyur ba lta bu brjod pa'o//ra/ mnyam med rgyal ba'i mgon po'i mtha' bral thugs/dri med lha yi zhing nas phyung ba bzhin/tshad med thugs bskyed zad pa med pa'i cha/nyal 'gro'i rgyun nas drang ba'i ngang tshul 'gran/phreng ba'i dpe ni/

— 85 —gzhung las/ dpe nyid phreng ba 'brel ba ltar/ dpe can mtshungs brjod phreng ba'i dpe// zhes phreng ba'i dpe'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ dpe de nyid snga phyi rim bzhin 'brel ba chags pa'i sgo nas 'brel ma chad par bkod thog dpe can de yang de bzhin snga phyi 'brel ldan gyi sgo nas rim bzhin rgyun ma chad par bkod pas/ snga phyi dpe dpe can gnyis go rim bzhin bsgrigs te mtshon du yod pa ma zad/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis ka 'brel ma chad par phreng ba bsgrigs pa ltar bkod pas phreng ba'i dpe zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ son las ljang 'khrungs bzhin ljang las/myug gu de bzhin myug las 'bru/'byung bzhin byang chub sa bon las/thar pa'i 'bras bu rim gyis smin/ces dpe sa bon dang ljang bu/ myug gu 'bru bcas rim bakhyin lnga phyi 'brele can phreng ba ltar bsgrigs pa ma zad/ dpe can/ thar pa dang thams —cad mkhyen pa thob byed kyi rgyu dang po/ skyabs 'gro dang / sems bskyed ‘ sogs/ lam rim rnam pathori smin nas/ 'bras bu thar pa dang thar pa chen po thob pa sogs/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis sems bskyed dang / nas myug gi sa bon gnyis dpe can dang dme mtshungs bakhyin phan tshun mtshon nus pas so/sha nyi mor byed pas rma da mo mdzes byed bzhin/de yi skyed tshal des ka/nga ngabyigs lden ma/mdzes bzhin spyod ldan yongs kyi gtsug gtor du /shes rab lha mchog smra ba'i seng ge 'jam/

cho 86—zhes dpe nyi mas pad mo rgyas pa dang / pad mos skyed tshal mdzes pa ma zad/ skyed tshal rgyas pas sa gzhi mdzes par byed pa bzhin/ dpe dpyod ldan dam pa ni skye rgu'i gtsug gtor ltar/ shes rab lha mchog smra ba'i seng ge dang 'jam dpal dbyangs bcas dpe can snga phyi 'brel ba dang ldan pa ma zad dpe yang 'brel ba ldan pa'o//ra/ skya rengs nu bos drang ba'i rta ljang can/des kyang pad mo'i 'dab grol dri ldan gyi/rwa yig gnyis pa'i gtan khyo btsal ba bzhin/deng dus kun dga' don 'grub yid bzhin nor/ngag don gyi dpe ni/gzhung we sa/ ngag don bzhin sgra gcig da mas/gang dgos dpe don grangs kyis dpogs/zhes ngag don gyi dpe'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ spyir ngag don gyi khyad gzhi dang / khyad bon nam khyad par ston byed kyi mnyan bya zhig la skabs 'dir 'dod kyang rung ste/ ming tshig yi ge tshogs su snang ba lung gi bye brag gi cha nas bzhag pa de ngag don gyi sgra bshad du 'dod do// de la rnam dbye gsum pa dang / gnyis pa/ lnga pa sogs shas che la/ rnam dbye gzhan 'jug pa yang yod/ ngag don de dag tshad mas rtogs par bya rung ba gzhal bya dpe can dang / de 'jal byed dpe gnyis ka bya byed las gsum gtso bor ston pa'i rnam dbye sbyar ba zhig la'o//gzhung las/ 'bras dang sran ma'i sa bon las/rang 'bras so sor smin pa bzhin/dkar dang nag pa'i las spyod kyis/bde sdug 'bras bu nges par 'byung / —

—8 7—zhes dpe can dkar nag gam dge sdig gi las spyod kyi/ 'bras bu bde sdug so sor 'byin pa ste/ dpe 'bras dang sran ma'i sa bon gyi 'asnas bu sran ma dang 'bras bu so sor 'byin pa lta bu ste/ dpe can bya byed las gsum tshang ba dang rnam dbye lnga pa'i rkyen sbyar nas bzhin sgra gcig ston pa'i ngag don gyi dper brjod do//bzhin sgra du ma ldan pa'i dper brjod ni/ gzhung las/ rgyal ba'i sku stod seng ge bzhin/sku smad rab brtan glangarmobazhin brling /zhal ras ston zu bzhin du dkar/spyan mig skar chen bzhin du bkra/zhes dpe can rgyal ba'i sku stod dang / sku smad/ zhal ras/ spyan mig ste/ dpe rim bzhin/ seng ge/ glang chen/ rla ba/ skar chen bcas phan tshun mtshungs tshul gyi bzhin sgra sbyar nas brjod pa'o//sha 'od dkar can bzhin phyu sras sku'i dkyil 'khor/ri dbang bkra bzhin mtshan dang dpe byed rdzogs/bsil ba'i zer bzhin blo gros dngos grub kun/bdag gi longs su spyod 'di e ma phul/ces dpe che ba dang / rla 'od/ rla ba'i nang gi gzugs ris/ rla ba'i bsil rlung bcas dang / dpe can rje btsun phyu keng tse'i sku mdog gam zhal mdog mtshan dang dpe byed/ phyu keng tses bstsal ba'i blo gros kyi dngos grub bcas kun bdag cag la nod bzhin pa ste/ dpe can dpe che gnyis snga phyi rim bzhin 'phreng ba bzhin bstar bsgrig pa'i rgyan no//ra/ 'chad pas gzhung lugs rnam par 'byed pa yis/ma 'dres so sor ston pa'i a dar sha

—8 7—zhes dpe can dkar nag gam dge sdig gi las spyod kyi/ 'bras bu bde sdug so sor 'byin pa ste/ dpe 'bras dang sran ma'i sa bon gyi 'asnas bu sran ma dang 'bras bu so sor 'byin pa lta bu ste/ dpe can bya byed las gsum tshang ba dang rnam dbye lnga pa'i rkyen sbyar nas bzhin sgra gcig ston pa'i ngag don gyi dper brjod do//bzhin sgra du ma ldan pa'i dper brjod ni/ gzhung las/ rgyal ba'i sku stod seng ge bzhin/sku smad rab brtan glangarmobazhin brling /zhal ras ston zu bzhin du dkar/spyan mig skar chen bzhin du bkra/zhes dpe can rgyal ba'i sku stod dang / sku smad/ zhal ras/ spyan mig ste/ dpe rim bzhin/ seng ge/ glang chen/ rla ba/ skar chen bcas phan tshun mtshungs tshul gyi bzhin sgra sbyar nas brjod pa'o//sha 'od dkar can bzhin phyu sras sku'i dkyil 'khor/ri dbang bkra bzhin mtshan dang dpe byed rdzogs/bsil ba'i zer bzhin blo gros dngos grub kun/bdag gi longs su spyod 'di e ma phul/ces dpe che ba dang / rla 'od/ rla ba'i nang gi gzugs ris/ rla ba'i bsil rlung bcas dang / dpe can rje btsun phyu keng tse'i sku mdog gam zhal mdog mtshan dang dpe byed/ phyu keng tses bstsal ba'i blo gros kyi dngos grub bcas kun bdag cag la nod bzhin pa ste/ dpe can dpe che gnyis snga phyi rim bzhin 'phreng ba bzhin bstar bsgrig pa'i rgyan no//ra/ 'chad pas gzhung lugs rnam par 'byed pa yis/ma 'dres so sor ston pa'i a dar sha

—88—rnam dpyod rtsod sgrub rig pa'i gom stabs kyis/lung rig srang la badzāgs bzhin gsal bar smra/yang na/ yid 'ong kun dga'i mdangs 'chang 'jo sgeg ma/snyan pa'i dpal 'dzin dbyar gyi lang tsho bzhin/bdag blo rig pa'i sgo 'byed er sangs yum/ngo mtshar 'bum ldan dpyid kyi dpal yon bzhin/che dngos kyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe dang dpe rla ji lta bu/dpe can mtshungs brjod zu dngos dpe/ zhes rla bo dngos po'i dpe'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang / mtshon byed dpe gnyis rkang pa snga phyi rim bzhin zla bo ltar bkod pa ste/rkang pa dang po'am sngon mar mtshon bu dpe carme/ de babod nas/ de'i rla bo'am grogs po rkang pa phyi mar mtshon byed dpe bkod nas/ dngos su mtshungs dpe ma sbyar yang / dpe don gnyis kyi don mnyam par go nus pa'i dper brjod zhig la bya'o//gzhung las/ phyi nang grub po'i mtha' mang ya nga /g.yung drung ban dang mnyam nus/ su/mkha' la gza' skar grangs mang yang /nyi mor byed dang 'gran nus su /zhes phyi pa dang nang pa'i grub mtha' rnams dang / nam mal/ 'a la gza' skar gnyos dpe can dang dpe/ gru3ba mtha' de dag las khyad du 'phags pa g.yung drung bon gyi grub mtha' dang / gza' skar de'i nang nas phul du byung ba nyi ma gnyis rim bzhin dpe can dang dpe ru babo/da de/ de

—89—dgaphan tshun dngos su mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra ma sbyar yang / dpe don gnyis ka'i don so sor mnyam par brjod pa'o//sha 'dzam gling zhing 'dir rigs rus mang bdog kyang /dmu dbang gshen gyi gdung dang mnyam nus bral/chu gter gdengs can phal gyis 'gengs gyur mod/r+sā pu tsam rad rna gnyis pa mchis na su/zhes dpe can ni 'dzam gling 'dir spyir mi'u gdung drug dang / gzhan yang 'gro ba 'dren ga'i gdung rgyud bru zhu spa rme'u khyung sogs mang po zhig yod na'ang / de'i nang nas khyad du 'phags pa dmu rigs gshen gyi gdung las grol ba'i rgyud pa 'di ni 'gran pa'i zu thams cad dang bral ba yin te/dper na/ chu mig thams cad la klu yi rigs rnams gnas na'ang / nor bu'i gtsug gtor can gyi klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen ni kun las phul du phyin pa'am mchog tu gyur ba yin pa bzhin no// pu tsam rad+ma ni zhang skad de/gtsug gtor nor bu la'o//ra/ blos byas ris can grub mtha' 'gas/mnyam med srol la 'gran nus gang /dug ngan rag na'i 'od mdangs kyis/btso ma'i gser la do rla bral/mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe ni/gzhung las/ dpe don gnas gzhi khyad par gang /tha dad mtshungs sdeb mtshungs sbyor dpe/zhes mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan ston te/ dpe dang dpe can so sor khyad bon rnams smra ba ste/ dpe de dpe can las dgar ba'am khyad par dang ldan pa zhig bkod cing / de dang mtshungs par brjod pa'i dpe can ni dpe las

—90—cung zhan pa tsam zhig bkod nas/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis kyi dpe dang dpe can gnyis bstan zhing / phyi ma gnyis kyi khyad don so sor ston te/ dpe don gnyis ka bya byed dam byed las ston tshul phan tshun mtshungs par sbyor ba zhig la mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ lha dbang skabs gsum dbus na spa/kong tse mi yul mthil na brjid/gong gi snyan pas phyogs bcur khyab/ gcig shos grags pa'i mu khyud 'gengs/zhes dpe can lha dbang brgya byin dang / dpe rgya rje kong tse 'phrul gyi rgyal po bkod nas/ gnas gzhi tha dad kyi sgo nas dpe can gyi snyan grags phyogs bcu la khyab pa dang / dpe yi grags dkar ni mu khyud ces lcags ri ste tshangs rgyung 'jig rten gcig la khyab pa ste/ de yang dpe can gyi snyan grags ni 'dzig rten bon brgyad kyi grags pa dang / dpe yi grags dkar ces legs pa'i yon tan gyi grags pa ste/ phan tshun khyad par che yang / grags pa'am byed las ston tshul gyi sgo nas mtshungs par sbyor ba'o//sha gyer spungs dran pa zhang bod lo paṇa dang /dmu gshen gtsug dbang blo gsal dbus na yang /gang des skad rigs nyer gcig thogs med bsgyur/mgon khyod bdag cag dga' dang spro ba'i bsnyad/ces dpe can dmu gshen dran pa nam mkha' ste/ lnga brgya'i mgon ghar/ dpe ni dmu rigs gshen gyi gdung sras mi 'gyur gtsug phud gnyis la/ khyad bon dpe can gyi stag gzigs kyi skad rigs 5mas bod skad sogs su bsgyur ba'i lo paṇa dron can dang / gshen mi 'gyur gtsug phud dbang

—91 —rgyal yang bcu phrag rig pa'i bon rnams 'khor la ston pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa gnyis phan tshun mtshungs par sbyor ba'o//ra/ 'dren pa mchog de seng ha'i khri la 'gying /bcu gnyis bdag po shar ri'i phrag nas 'dzum/phan bde'i gdam bcud skye rgu'i gsos su smin/'od mdangs ris med kun la sbyin brgya 'gyed/rgyu yi dpe ni/ gzhung las/ dpe can dag gi rgyu mtshan gyi/dpe dang mtshungs brjod rgyu yi dpe/zhes rgyu yi rgyan bstan te/ de yang rgyu yi rgyan ni/ dpe can de sngon du bkod nas/ dpe can de rgyu ru bus pa lta bu'i sgo nas rgyu mtshan la brten nas/ mtshon byed dpe bkod pa ste/ dpe can gyi rang bzhin las byung ba lta bu'i mtshungs gsal gyi rgyu bkod nas dpe don mtshungs par brjod pa'i rgyan zhig la rgyu yi rgyan ces bya'o//gzhung las/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje yangs pas mkha'/'dzad pa med pas sa gzhi dang /phyogs ris med pas nyi ma ste/rgyun chad med pas chu bor 'gran/zhes rnam mkhyen rgyal ba gshen rab kyi thugs nyid ni rgya che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis nam mkha' dang 'dra ba ma zad/ phan dang bde ba'i dpal zad pa med pas sa gzhi/ ris med skye rgu kun la phan bde ster bas nyi ma 'dra ba dang / du sa rtag tu rgyun chad med pas chu bo lta bu'o// zhes dpe can gyi rgyu mtshan re re bzhin dper mtshungs par brjod pa'o//sha skye bo'i yid 'ong 'gug pas lcags kyu dang /

—92—mtho ris rgyun bzang 'ching bas zhags pa ste/thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i rno mtshon gyi/rjes 'gro rkyen rtsa'i rnams la yid ga ldogaces dpe can bu med mdzes ma ste/ skye bo'i yid 'ong 'gug pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ dpe lcags kyu dang rim bzhin/ mtho ris thar pa'i lam 'gegs pa'am thar pa mi ston pa'i cha nas bzhag pa dang / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang gi srog rtsa gcod byed kyi ral gri/ 'di dag 'khor ba'i mtshor bying ba'i skye rgu rnams ni yid du mi 'ong ba'o//ra/ gang gsung snyan pas dbyar skyes mgrin sngon ma/ — rnam mang mdzes pa'i rgyan spras gar mkhan gzugs/blo gros pad mo bzhad pa'i rta ljang can/bdag blo'i bu ga dgyes par cis mi rol/dpe yi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ dpe can mtshungs dpe bkod pa'i steng /dpe mtshon dpe bkod dpe yi dpe/ zhes dpe yi dpe'i don ston te/ mtshon bya dpe can de nyid mtshon byed kyi dpe zhig bkod pa gzhir bzhag thog dpe de nyid slar dpe can du bzung nas/ de mtshon byed kyi dpe zhig bkod pa la dpe yi dpe zhes de'ang 'di ni phreng ba'i dpe dang cung mi 'dra ste mtshon bya dpe can dang / mtshon byed dpe gnyis snga phyi rim bzhin phreng ba ltar bkod dgos min sogs kyi khyad par 'byed rigs pa'o//gzhung las/ shes ldan skyes bu sgron me bzhin/gang brten thar pa'i lam sgo snyed/gsal ba'i zhug mar nyi ma bzhin/

—93—mun pa'i dpung las rnam par rgyal/zhes dpe can ni blo gros dang ldan pa'i skyes bu la/ dpe til gyi mar me dang mtshungs pa'i mun smag sel ba'i khyad bon dang ldan pa bkod nas/slar gong gi dper gter gyi mar ma de'i dpe nyi ma ru bzhag pa sogs/ snga ma'i dpe de phyi mar dpe can du bzhag nas sbyar ba'i rgyan zhig go//sha rab mdzes lha mo bzang za ring btsun sku/gangs kyi gos gyon lhun po dang mtshungs kyi/dkar mdzes brjid chags ke la sha de yang /nya gang zu bar 'gran la su yi bsnyon/zhes dpe can rgyal ba kun gyi yum du gyur ba yum chen bzang za ringabatsun dang / dpe can gangs kyi ri bo dang mtshungs par brjod pa ma zadaslar yang dpe gangs kyi ri bo de nyid mtshon byed kyi dpe bco lnga'i nya rgyas kyi rla ba dang / mtshungs par brjod pa ste snga phyi rim bzhin dpe dang dpe canasbyor ba'o//ra/ mdzes rgyus 'ching ba tshangs pa'i bu mo bzhin/lang tshos yid 'phrog dga' ba'i 'dzum zhal ston/skye bo'i yid 'phrog bde dga'i rkad med ma /rkang drug sdud pa'i dri ldan dag dang 'gran/ zhes pa lta bu'o//dpe rgyan la khyad par gyi sgra sbyor mtshungs gsal ni/bzhin/ ltar/ lta bu/ ji ltar/ rigs mthun/ 'dra/ mtshungs/mthun/ mnyam/ 'khu/ phyogs mtshon/ rigs mthun ldog rab gsal/nges gsal/ yang dag gsal/ gzugs0zu/ dgra rla/ co 'dri/ 'gran/

—94—sor rtogs/ bltal bcas/ bslu ba/ gzugs brnyan/ rjes smra/ so sor sdebs/ mtshan nyid mthun/ ngang tshul 'gogs/ 'thab pa/ 'phya ba/ sma 'beb/ smod/ rgod pa/ dman/ cung zad dman/ rab smra/ spangs ba/ mi mthun sgrogs/ mdzes pa zum pa/ bskal bzang 'phrog tshar gcod/ rjes su rkang pa 'jog rjes su 'ching / rjes su 'gro/ rjes su mthun/ rjes su 'jug tshig sdud mtshungs pa/ lhag par mdzes/ 'jebs pa la sogs ni mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra skabs 'dir re re bzhin gyis dper baji+od re phyis su 'bri srol snang yang yig tshogs 'jigs phyir gong gi dper brjod rnams kyis mthus chags byas te bzhag pa'o//dpe don gyi sbyor stangs skor gyi skyon yon du 'gyur tshul la cung zad dpyad na/gzhung las/ pho mo ma ning rtags tha dad/sbyor ba shes na skyon med de//stag skyes lha bu'i rgyu rtsal gyi/srid gsum rgyal mo'i ngang tshul 'gogs/khyed yum thugs rje byams ma ni/rgyal dbang ji bzhin thams cad mkhyen/zhes dpe can stag la me 'bar gyis/ dpe srid pa'i rgyal mo'i ngang tshul 'gogs zhes stag la me 'bar gyi khud bon baji+od pa ma zad/ stag la me 'bar gyi yum thugs rje byams ma dpe can dang / dpe rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo 'am thams cad mkhyen pa ji bzhin snang srid kun sa ler gzigs pa lta bu ste/ dpe dang dpe can snga phyi pho mo'i rtags tha dad na yang sbyor ba legs pas skyon du mi 'gro ba'o//

—95—sha gyer spungs dran pas las ldan skyes bu la/brtse gzigs mi lhod rgyal yum byams ma bzhin/khyed kyi dgyes yum 'od ldan 'bar ma yang /mtshar sdug rgyu skar bdag po'i rjes su 'gro/zhes dpe can bla chen dran pa nam mkhas bstan pa la phan pa'i skyes bu kun la/ phan bde 'jo ba dper na rgyal kun yum gyur shes rab byams ma dang mtshungs pa ma zad/ yang dran pa nam mkha'i lcam 'od ldan 'bar ma ni/ bla ba bzhin da dkar gsal ldan zhes pho mo phan tshun dpe dang dpe can du bkod kyang sbyor ba mkhas pas skyon me do//mang nyung tha dad pa'i rgyan ne/gzhung las/ gcig gnyis mang tshig tha dad kyang /sbyor ba shes na skyon med de/gshen rab phyag gi sor rdo gcigabadud dmag bye ba'i dpung ltar 'jigs/drang dang nges pa'i rnam thar kun/ud 'bar me tog gcig pus mtshon/zhes dpe can gshen rab kyi phyag gi sor rdo gcig dang / dpe can bdud dmag bye ba'i dpung tshogs rnams 'dul bar ston pa dang / 'dul byed gcig dang / gdul bya bye ba gnyis dpe dang / dpe can bkod kyang /sbyar bya sprul pa'i skus drang don dang nges don gnyis mtshon byed yin pa sogs kyi skyon med do//sha gshen chen klu dgas bod yul mun rum du/bstan pa spel la paṇa grub tshogs dang mtshungs/

—96—khyed kyi slob bu bru zhu spa rme'u tshogs/bkrid drang mdzad la gdung tshob mu cho bzhin/ zhes gshen chen klu dga' dpe can/ dpe sgra bsgyur lo paṇa tshogs rnams bod yul la bstan pa spel ba mtshungs ba ma zad/ gshen gyi slob ma bru zhu spa rme'u tshogs rnams ni gdul bya bkrid drang mdzad tshul larnadape mu cho ldem drug dang mtshungs zhes so//gzhung las/ dpe mchog dpe can dman pa'am/de ldog sbyor shes skyon med do//bde 'byung gtsug gi zla tshes ni/dung phrug gzhon na'i mdangs ltar dkar/'dam bu u dpal sngon po'i tshogs/rgyal ba'i dbu skyes bzhin du mdzes/ces dpe can bde 'byung gtsug bo/ rla tshes ni/ da pe dung gi mdangs dang / dpe can rgyal ba'i skra dang dpe u dpal dang rim bzhin dpe can mchog dang / dpe dman par gnas kung sbyor ba legs pas skyon can du mi 'byung ngo //sha lung bon lha gnyan dka' ba thub pa ltar/thod dkar sras kyi rnam thar e ma phul/gang des bon sgo legs par bshad pa la/sga ston chen po'i rnam thar dpyod pa 'gran/dpe can dman pa bla ma lung bon lha gnyan dang / dpe brgya pa'i mgon po ston pa gshen rab dang / dpe can rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo'i bon sgo

— 9 7—brgyad khri bzhi stong legs par ston pa dang / dpe sga rib/sa ston pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar dang mtshungs par brjod pa'o//skyon du 'gyur tshul ni/gzhung las/ dpe don rtags tshig mchog dman gang /sbyor ba ma shes skyon du 'gyur/mdzes pa'i na chung bzhin mdangs rnams/khro gtum nag mo'i gdong la 'khu/lhu thung sbom rags khro bo'i tshogs/sba dkar ldem pa'i rjes su mjes/ ces dpe dang dpe can gnyis yon tan khyad gzhi tshig don 'gal bsogs tha dad cing 'gal bar ston pa'i rgyan 'di lta bu ni sbyor ba ma shes pa'i skyon can gyi dper brjod du 'dod do// sha lus phra'i blu bzhin phyu sras gsungs dbyangs snyan/snang byed tshogs bzhin srin bu me khyer gsal/khyi bzhin gnyis 'thung dgra bo dpa' rtsal che/ri dbang ji bzhin 'khri shing rtse mo mtho/zhes dpe dang dpe can phan tshun 'brel med don gzhan dang phan tshunamatshon mi nus kyang mtshon byed du bkod pa lta bu'o//'dis mtshon skyon yon ji snyed cig gi 'byed tshul dam pa'i zhal rgyun las shes par mdzod/ zhes snyan ngag rin chen lde'u mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las dpe yi rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa ste gnyis pa'o//

— 98—gsum pa gzugs kyi rgyan bshad pa la/mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa'o//gzhung las/ dpe can dpe yi gzugs byas nas/dbyer med balngod pa gzugs rgyan te/zhes gzugs rgun gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ 'di ni dpe can nam gzugs can dang / de mtshon byed dpe 'am gzugs gnyis ngo bo tha dad sbyor nas/ de gnyis 'dra mtshungs su sbyor ba ma yin par/ gang zhig mtshon bya 'am brjod bya gzugs can de mtshon byed dpe yi gzugs su bkod nas/ gzugs dang gzugs can nam mtshon bya mtshon byed gnyis so sor tha mi dad par ston pa ma zad/ gong gi mtshungs gsal gyi sgra rnams ma byir ba'i sgo nas gzugs dang gzugs can gnyis/ ngo bo so sor ma phyes shing dbyer med du sgro btags nas ston pa ste/ dpe can nam gzugs can de dpe'i gzugs su bkod pa gong gi dpe can dang skabs 'dir gzugs can gnyis don gcig la gong gi dpe dang 'di'i gzugs gnyis don gcig tu 'jug pa zhig la gzugs rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na/ dpyod ldan blo yi nyin byed kyis/gzhung lugs pad tshal kha phyes te/legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i mchog stsol bas/blo gsal bung ba tshim par mdzad/ ces pa lta bu'o//gzugs rgyan la dbye na nyer cig ste/ bsdus pa'i gzugs rgyan/ ma bsdus pa'i gzugs rgyan/ bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs rgyan/ ma bsdus pa'i gzugs rgyan/ mtha' dag gzugs rgyan/ cha shas kyi gzugs

—99—rgyano / cha shas can gyi gzugasar+shargyan/ yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs rgyan/ldanapa'i gzugs rgyan/ mi ldan pa'i gzugs rgyan/ mi mnyam pa'i gzugs rgyan/ khyad par gyi gzugs rgyan/ 'gal ba'i gzugs rgyan/ rgyu yi gzugs rgyan/ sbyar ba'i gzugs rgyan/ dpe yi gzugs rgyan/ ldog pa'i gzugs rgyan/'gog pa'i gzugs rgyan/ mnyam 'jog gi gzugs rgyan/ gzugs can gyi gzugasargyan/ bsnyon dor gyi gzugs rgyan dang nyer cig gam yan lag gnyisagasum so sor phyes na nyer gsum du yod do//bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/gzhung las/ dpe can dpe gzugs 'brel ba'i mtshams/'brel sgra bsdus pa bsdus gzugs te/zhes bsdus pa'i gzugs rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa ste/ mtshon bya gzugs can de la rang nyid mtshon byed dpe yi gzugs su bkod nas gzugs dang gzugs can gnyis ngo bo tha mi dad pa ston pa'i thog gzugs can dang gzugs gnyis 'brel ba'i mtshams su phan tshun 'brel ba'i sgra med pa'am don thog tu 'thob pa gzhir bcas/ 'brel sgra bsdus te de mtshams su ma sbyar nas rnam dbye drug pa bsdus pas/ don de dpe'i gzugs su bkod pa zhig la bya'o//gzhung las/ sku luru/ gangs dkar nyi shar la/g.yu ral nam mkha'i sprin spungs gtibs/mjug ma chu klung rgya mtsho mer/seng gsas lha dbang sprul pa'i sku/zhes gzugs can rnam rgyal rtsa ba'i lha bcu'i nang tshan seng gsas lha dbang ste/ de'i sku lus ni gangs ri dkar po la nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i gzugs su bkod/ seng ge'i g.yu ral ni sprin spungs kyi gzugs su

— 1 00—bkod/ seng ge'i mjug ma ni bangs ri'i chu rgyun gyi gzugs su bkod pa dang / rkang pa phyi mas gzugs can— de nyid ngos bzung ba ma zad/ gong gi dpe sku lus dang gangs dkar bar la drug sgra bsdus pa dang / g.yu ral dang sprin bar bsdus/ mjug ma dang chu klung gnyis dbar gyi 'brel sgra rnams bsdus pas bsdus pa'i gzugs can no//sha gshen bstan phun tshogs 'chi med lam yangs por/legs bshad kun gsal snang ba 'bum 'gyed pas/mkhas rlom rgyu dkar tshogs kun zil gyis gnon/dran dbang ku mud gnyen de rgyal gyur cigaces gzugs can rgyal ba gshen gyi bstan pa rin po che de/ nam mkha'i gzugs su bkod/ legs par bshad pa'i bon rnams/ nyi ma'i gzugs su bkod/ mkhas rdzun rnams rgyu skar gyi gzugs su bkod/ phyi ma khyad bon de dag dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa ni zla ba'i gzugs su bkod pa ste/snga phyi dpe gzugs 'brel mtshams su drug sgra mi ldan zhing / rnam 'dren mkhas pa'i dbang pos ris can mkhas rlom tshogs kun zil gyis gnon par bstan pa'o//ra/ mchog sku lhun chags sa 'dzin dkar po'i mgul/rnam dpyod bcu rig gangs phrug rtsed 'jor rol/rmangs pa'i khengs sems gzhom pa snyan pa'i dbyangs/sgrogs la mkhas pa yongs 'dzin smra ba'i dbang /ma bsdus pa'i gzugs rgyan ni/gzhung ge/sa/ dpe can dpe gzugs 'brel ba'i mtshams drug sgra ldan pa ma bsdus gzugs/

— 1 01 —zhes ma bsdus pa'i gzugs rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya gzugs can dang / mtshon byed gzugs gnyis ngo bo dbyer med du brjod ci pa'i thog gzugs dang gzugs can gnyis kyi bar 'brel ba'i drug sgra nges par du yod pa ste/ de yang dmigs bsal gyi drug sgra dgos min la ma ltos par 'brel sgra la don go rung yod pa zhig la ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can ces bya'o//gzhung las/ mtshan dpe'i khri gdugs gzhon nu las/mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong rab 'bar bas/'khor ba'i mun pa 'joms mdzad pa/ston pa'i nyi ma de la 'dud/ces khyad gzhi gzugs can ston pa gshen rab mi bo dang / gzugs ni nyi ma gzhon nu bkod nas/ ston pa'i mkhyen pa dang brtse ba ni/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi gzugs su bkod/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi mun rma de/ mtshan mo'i mun pa'i gzugs su bkod nas ston pa'i thugs rjes 'khor ba'i mun pa 'joms pa dang / nyi mas mun pa gsal nus pa sogs dpe don so sor 'brel ba'i dbar 'brel sgra ldan pa'i dper brjod do//sha gang zhig sdom pa gsum gyi gru gzings la/pha rol phyin bcu'i dpyod pa'i dar gzugs te/g.yung drung gnas bzhi'i dpon rjes su 'breng nas/srid pa'i chu gter che las bgrod par 'gyur/zhes phyi so thar gyi sdom pa/ nang gsang ba sngags kyi sdom pa/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyi sdom pa dang gsum ni gzugs can la/ gtsang po la —bsgrod byed kyi gru ni gzugs/ kyi ni drug sgra yin la/ de bzhin phar phyin bcu ni/ sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/

— 102—stobs/ snying rje/ smon lam/ thabs/ shes rab bcas kyi pha rol phyin bcu ni gru'i ru dar gyi gzugs su bkod nas/ g.yung drung gnas bzhi bla ma sangs rgyas bon dang gshen rab ni gru'i rje bo'i gzugs su drang ste de'i rjes su 'breng bas/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi chu las brgal nus par 'gyur ro zhes so//ra/ dbyangs can thugs kyi sa 'dzin da7/ra po las/rnam shes chu klung 'bum phrag g.yo ba'i dpyid/bdag blo'i chu gter gyen du 'phyur ba'i rtser/snyan 'jebs rgyan gyi me tog ci yang bzhad/bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/gzhung las/ dpe gzugs sbrel mtshams 'brel ba'i sgra/stod bsdus smad ldan bsdus ma bsdus/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ gzugs can de mtshon byed gzugs kyi ngo bo dang dbyer med du baji+od nas/ gzugs can dang gzugs gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i mtshams 'brel sgra de/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis la mi ldan zhing /rkang pa phyi ma gnyis la dpe gzugs 'brel ba'i mtshams su drug sgra ldan pa ste bsdus shing zhes pa snga ma gnyis dang / ma bsdus zhes pas phyi ma gnyis khab go dgorngan rngago// gzhung las/ mdzes sku nor bu'i 'khri shing la/sdom gsum phang phung rgyas pa'i rtser/sku lnga'i 'bras bu g.yur za ba/mkhas pa'i yongs 'dus srid zhi'i dpal/zhes gzugs can mkhas pa'i sku de 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i nor bu'i 'khri shing dpag bas ma shing gi gzugs su bkod/ de'i rgyud kyi sdom pa rnam pa

d+ngha1 03—— ga sum de dpag bsam shing gi yal 'dab kyi gzugs su bkod nas/ de gnyis dpe gzugs bar drug sgra bsdus shing / mthar thugs mngon du gyur ba'i sku lnga ni/ bon sku/ rdzogs sku/ sprul sku/ ngo bo nyid sku/ mngon par byang chub pa'i sku de nyid/ dpag bsam shing gi 'bras bu'i gzugs su bkod/sku lnga'i 'bras bu g.yur du smin pa ni dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'bras bu'i gzugs su bkod nas srid zhi zhes srid pa 'khor ba dang / zhi ba myang 'das kyi khyon du bsngags 'os su gyur zhing / phyi ma gnyis ni dpe gzugs 'brel ba'i mtshams su drug sgra ldan pa'o//sha bskal stong sangs rgyas bstan pa chu gter bcud/ rtsa ba gyer bstan 'od dkar can dor nas/'ga' zhig de las spros pa'i gdos bu ru/bslad bcos kho na'i rla gzugs 'char la brten/zhes skal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi bstan pa 'di ni rgya mtsho'i gzugs su bkod/ de dag kun las dus 'dir khyad par 'phags pa'i gyer zhes zhang skad la bon te bon gyi bstan pa 'di ni chu gter 'phel ba'i ston kha'i rla ba'i gzugs su bkod pa ma zad/ dpe gzugs 'brel mtshams drug sgra mi ldan zhing / phyi ma 'ga' zhig bon gyi bstan pa las logs su gyes pa gdos bu zhes shing sogs la bzos pa'i chu snod chung ngu la zer te/ bon gyi bstan pa rla ba'i gzugs su bkod nas de las logs su gyur ba ni/ chu snod la che gzugs slad ma 'char ba la rla bar 'dzin pa lta bur gyur ba'i grub mtha' gzhan te/ kun gyi rtsa ba ni g.yung drung gi bon gyi bstan pa yin par ston zhing / phyi ma gnyis nas dpe gzugs 'brel mtshams su drug sgra ma bsdus pa zhig la bya'o//

— 1 04—ra/ tshogs smon las 'brel dal 'bab yangs pa'i mtshor/'du byed skya b.ru/ bskrun pa'i 'gros bstun te/rnam dkar dge ba'i 'dod rgu dud nye ba'i/dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i rin chen nor bu 'di/ma bsdus shing bsdus pa'i gzugs rgyan/gzhung las/ dpe gzugs 'brel mtshams 'brel ba'i sgra/stod ldan smad bsdus ma bsdus bsdus/zhes bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can bstan te/ gzugs dang gzugs can gnyis bkod khar/ gzugs can de dpe'i gzugs su gnyis med du bkod nas/ de gnyis kyi dbar drug sgra de rkang pa dang po gnyis la ldan zhing / rkang pa phyi ma gnyis la mi ldan pa ste/ ma bsdus zhes pa ni snga ma gnyis dang / bsdus zhes pa phyi ma gnyis la'o//gzhung las/ thos dang bsam pa'i ral khur can/skyes mchog mi yi gdong lnga pa/gshen bstan gangs ri'i rtse mo nas/bcu rig seng skad sgrogs 'di mtshar/zhes rgyal ba gshen gyi bstan pa la thos pa dang bsam pa'i sgo nas nyams su blang ba ni seng ge'i g.yu ral gyi gzugs su bkod cing / de 'dra ba'i skyes bu ni seng ge'i gzugs su bkod/ de gnyis karu 'brel sgra ldan la/phyi ma rgyal ba gshen gyi bstan pa 'di ni gangs kyi ri bo'i gzugs su bkod nas/ de dag dang ldan pa'i skyes bu'i rnam dpyod ni seng ge'i skad kyi gzugs su bkod pa ma zad/ mkhas pa'i mkhyen rlabs kyi mkhas rdzun borlag pa dang / seng ge'i sgras sder chags gzhan zil gyis gnon pa bzhin skyodi//

sha bgrod dka' bcu phrag rig pa'i mtsho rdzing la/'bad dang rtsol ba'i gru gzings 'phrul bo che/nyer bcas legs bshad rig grol dbyig bzang po/len mkhan yo/ngas 'dzin dad dpon mchog de rgyal/ces bcu phrag rig pa ste rig pa'i gnas che ba bzo sgra gso phyi nang rig lnga dang / chung ba sgra snyan skar rtsis rlos gar blub sbyor mngon brjod dang lnga bcas bcu phrag rig pa ste/ rgya mtsho'i gzugs su bkod la/ de la brtson pa'i 'bad pa de gru yi gzugs su bkod nas/ dpe gzugs mtshams drug sgra lden zhing / de las thon pa'i mkhas pa'i legs bshad ni rgya mtsho'i nor bu gzugs su bkod cing / de nyid mngon du len mkhan ni rang gi slobadapon yongs 'dzen mchog de'o// ces so//ra/ smra dbang mi yi 'od brgya pas/phan bde'i kho lag gnyer ba'i skabs/mongs mun thun gsum drwa ba'i gur/bshol med sa 'dzin phag tu yib/mtha' dag gi gzugs can/gzhung las/ dpe don gnyis ka'i khyad gzhi dang /khyad par tshangs mnyam mtha' dag gzugs/zhes mtshan nyid bstan pa ste/ mtshon bya gzugs can dang / mtshon byed gzugs gnyis kyi khyad gzhi phan tshun gzugs su bkod nas/ gzugs can dang gzugs kyi khyad bon rnams so sor gzugs can dang gzugs su bkod nas/ rjes su dpe don gnyis bsdus pa'i chig sbyar ba gang zhigagazugs dang gzugs can gnyis khyad gzhi dang khyad bon mtha' dga'abrel ba'i sgo nas bkod pa'i gzugs rgyan la mtha' dag rgyan zhes bya'o//

— 7 06— gzhung larngage/ mi lus rin chen ṅko/nga bu ru/tshor sdong 'dus shes dar gyis klubs/'du byed rtsi bcud dngas mas bltams/rnam shes gsal ba'i sgron me 'bar/zhes gzugs can ni dal 'byor gyi mu lus rin po che/ dpe rkong bu'i gzugs su bkod/ de gnyis khyad gzhi dang khyad bon ni/ gzugs can tshor ba'i phung po dang 'du shes phung po gnyis/ sdong bu ras kyis drel ba'i gzugs su bkod/ 'du byed kyi phung po ni mar khu'i gzugs su bkod/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po de sgron me'i gzugs su bkod pa ste/ mdor na gdag gzhi phung po lnga po ni sgron me'i gzugs su bkod nas yod pas/ snga phyo rnams rten 'brel sbyor 'byung dang rim bzhin sbyar ba'o//sha dal 'byor kun tshang pad mo'i sdong bu la/blo gros bzang po'i 'bras bu 'bum mnga' zhing /rnam dag sdom gsum mngar ba'i bsung ldan na/mchog dmar ser skya'i bung tshogs shugs kyis 'dud/ces gzugs can blo gros kyi bltam pa'i dal 'byor mi yi lus dang /dpe me tog go gzugs su bkod/ de'i rgyud kyi bcu phrag rig pa'i yon tan ni/ me tog gi 'bras bu'i gzugs su bkod/ de'i rgyud kyi sdom pa rnam gsum ni/ me tog dri zhim pa'i gzugs su bkod/ de lta bu'i skyes bur bu slob ser skya kun 'dus pa la/ pad mo la sbrang bu 'khor ba lta bu'i gzugs su bkod pa ste/ khyad gzhi dang khyad bon mtha' dag gzugs su bkod pa'o//ra/ rgyal bstan mi nub brjid ldan lhun po'i rir/bden gnyis bon gyi khri 'phang rnam par mdzes cipha rol phyin pa bcu yi stobs 'khor bkra/

bla med theg pa'i bya gri mngon par mtho/cha shas kyi gzugs can/gzhung las/ dpe la mi ltos dpe con gyi/khyad par ba/zugs bkad cha shas gzugs/zhes cha shas kyi gzugs can gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ skabs 'dir gzugs can la/ cha shas dang cha shas can gnyis kyi nang nas/ cha shas nam khyad gzhi'i ldog pa'i khyad par ram khyad bon kho na gzugs su bkod nas ston pa ste/ de'ang gzugs can las dpe'i khyad bon la ltos mi dgos pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i gzugs rgyan zhig la cha shas kyi gzugs rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ dal dus bsod nams ma bsags pa'i/sprang rgan sma ra'i nags gseb na/pra mo ha yi stag khyu 'tshogs/'dod pa med kyang bya thabs ci/zhes rkang pa dang pos sgra ji bzhin du rang gi lus zha gtsang ma yong ba'i thabs shes la ma 'bad pa'am yang na rang la dbang yod pa'i dus su thar pa dang bde ba 'thob byed rgyu la ma 'bad nas don med du g.yengs ba'i gang zag zhig bstan/ rkang pa gnyis pas mi lus kyi khyad par du byas pa'i phe mtshan gyi 'gram du skyes pa'i spu de nags tshal gyi gzugs su bkod/ gsang lam gyi 'gram spu gseb tu pra mo ha zhes zhang skad du shig la zer bas shig de/ nags gseb tu 'tshogs pa'i stag khyu'i gzugs su bkod/ phyis mi mang po 'dus pa'i sar mi 'dod pa'i snang ba ster yang bya thabs med ces/don ni don med kyi mi tshe khrog brlag dus tshod dam du ma 'dzin par slob

— 1 08—sbyong la 'bad pa ma byas na/ phyis mkhas mang gi dkyil du sdug bsngal ngo tsha myang yang bya thabs med ces brjod pa'o//sha so thar gces par bsrung ba'i dge bshes rnams/tshul khrims pad mo nyams zhig sar lhungs te/las grogs bu med phyag ma dang 'grogs nas/ngan song ljan ljin khrod las bsgrod thabs ci/zhes phyi 'dul ba'i khrims dang lngan pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi rgyud la gnas pa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa de pad mo'i gzugs su bkod nas/ gal te tshul khrims 'chal nas nyams pa de/ pad mo sad khyer gyi sa la lhungs ba'i gzugs su bkod/ las kyi rla grogs bu med dang 'grogs pas/ ngan song sdug bsngal de/ mi gtsang ba'i 'dam rdzab kyi gzugs su drang nas de las thar pa'i thabs med par bstan pa'o//ra/ khyed thugs dri bral lha yi lam yangs su/sna tshogs rgyan tu shar ba'i rgyu skar phreng /tshad med kun phan yid 'ong rtag lngang can/brtse dga'i 'od zhags 'khyud pa rje bla ma/cha shas can gyi gzugs can/gzhung las/ dpe la mi ltos dpe can gyi/khyad gzhi gzugs bkod cha shas can/zhes cha shas can gyi don bstan te/ gzugs can gyi cha shes dang yan lag sogs khyad par du byed pa'i rigs gang yang gzugs su ma bkod par/cha shas can kho nar gzugs can du bkod pa ste/ de yang cha shas can ni bon de'i bye brag dang yan lag gang yang ma yin par rtsa ba'i khyad gzhi de la 'jug cing / de dpe yi gzugs su bkod nas dbyer med du brjod pa ste /

— 1 09—dpe la de ltar dgos pa med cing / gzugs can gyi cha shas can de dpe'i gzugs su dbyer med du bkod pa'i cha nas cha shas can gyi gzugs rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ g.yung drung gtsug gshen rgyal ba zhes/rten bzang u dpal me tog la/rnam dag mtshan dpe'i 'dzum rlabs can/gang mjal dad pa'i spu long g.yo/zhes cha shas can g.yung drung gtsug gshen rgyal ba'am yid kyi khye'u chung gi mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin zhing / de nyid kyi sku de dpe u dpal me tog gi gzugs su bkod/ ska yi mtshan dpe ni mchog ta gyar ba de ska cha thā 4 ༄ nya ༄4 sheshas da gang gas gzugs su ma bkad nas/ rnam par dag pa' mkhas spyad dang ldan pa'i 'a dul 'dzin g.yung drung gtsug gshen rgyal ba de nyid/ sus mjol na'ang dad 5 dbang med du 'dren nus pa'i skyes bu'i mtshan nyid bajid pa bcas/sha gang gi mdzes sku gser sbyangs bamyo+o ma'i rir/sgrib gnyis rnam byang mtshan dang dpe byed rdzogs/mtha' klas 'dul bya'i blo dang gang 'tshams kyi/bon sgo so sor ston mkhas thod dkar sras/zhes gang zhig cha shas can de gshen rab khri gtsug rgyal ba kun las rnam paḍar rgyal ba'i sku de nyid gser gyi ri bo'i gzugs su bkod nas/ gang sku cha shas mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byed bzang po brgyad cu rtsa gnyis de gang gi gzugs su ma bkod par/ mchog gi mdzad bzang mtha' yas 'gro bki blo dang bstun nas/ bon sgo theg pa sogar+sā gang mthun

— 1 1 0—gsungs pa'i bdag nyid ni rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo kun la rnam par rgyal ba'o zhes so//ra/ sku mchog mi 'gyur bsil ri'i lhun po la/5/da byung yid 'ong shi shon dar gyis spud/ rnam dpyod phan bde'i kho lag mtha' dag rdzogs/gang 'brel bde ldan thar pa'i shul lam ston/yan lag can gyi gzugs rgyan/gzhung las/ dpe la mi ltos dpe can gyi/yan lag gcig sogs bkod pa'i gzugs/zhes yan lag can gyi gzugs rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya gzugs can gyi yan lag gam khyad bon gang yang rung ba gcig gnyis gsum sogs ci rigs dpe'i gzugs su bkod pa la/ de yang dpe'i yan lag gi gzugs su bkod dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang / yan lag grang nges kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ dngos su khyad gzhi de'i yan lag gam/ khyad gzhi de dang dngos su 'brel ba'i cha shas shig la go dgos la/ des na yan lag can gyi gzugs rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ skal pa brgya la rnyed dka' ba'i/dal 'byor nor bu rin po che/thob dus byang chub ma sgrub na/thob dang ma thob khyad par gang /yan lag gnyis gzugs ni/thugs nyid nam mkha' dri med la/ thugs rje'i me char rab g.yos pas/mi srun dregs sde'i klad 'gems pa/

stag lha me 'bar sprul pa'i sras/gsum gzugs ni/rgyu lus sdong rgan gog po'i rtser/ral pa ka shi'i me tog can/dri chen thang tshil nyil bzhin du/'khor ba'i gsang gtam sgrog 'di mtshar/ risho lo ka dang po/ gzugs can ni mi lus kyi khyad bon dal brgyad 'phyor bcu de 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i yid bzhin nor bu rin po che'i gzugs su bkod nas/ gzhan rkang pa phyi ma gsum po gang gi gzugs su ma bkod nasda/ mi lus khyad par can 'di thob dus thar pa dang bde ba'i don la ma brtson na mi lus ma thob pa dang khyad par med do// zhes dal brgyad 'byor bcu ni mi lus la dngos su yod pa'i yan lag go//sho lo ka gnyis pa/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi yon tan gzugs/ can gyi yan lag dang / de nam mkha'i gzugs su bkod/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las de me char ces thog gi gzugs su bkod/ rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi gang gi yon tan de dag dang ldan pa'i skyes bu stag la me 'bar brjod pa'o//sho lo ka gsum pa/ rgyu lus de sdong rgan gog po'i gzugs su bkod/skra de sdong ras kyi gzugs su bkod/ dri chen ces chab chen de sdong rgan gyi thang chu'i gzugs su bkod pa ste/ snga phyi gzugs can de nyid mi lus kyi yan lag gam cha shas su gyur ba sha stag ston zhing rkang pa phyi mas de ldan gyi gang zag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la sbyang bzhin pa bstan pa'o//sha stong rgyung dngos byon gshen chen klu dga' ba/bka' rgyud bstan pa spel ba'i nyin byed kyi/kha ba'i ljongs kyi gdal bya smin grol la/

— 1 1 2—'god pa'i rnam dkar mdzad bzang e ma ho//zhes dmu rigs gshen gyi gdung sras klu dga' bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyi sgo nas spel ba de sti ma'i gzugs su bkod nas/ phyi ma rnams kyis rang cag kha ba ri pa'i zhing 'dir rang bstan la bka' drin che zhing / skye rgu'i mgon du gyur ba 'di'i mdzad pa 'di la ngo mtshar che'o zhes so//ra/ phyi tshul gzab pa'i ser gzugs pa/tshul khrims gces par mi srung bar/gzhan mgo bskor ba'i g.yo rgyu can/bon sgor zhugs kyang phan pa gang /rmad byung thugs bskyed nor 'dzen dga' ma'i khyon/'phrin las sna tshogs rkeng 'thung tshar du/ nga/ngar//srid zhi phan bde'i dpal smer lhag pa'i lha/rnam 'dren mi yi seng ge mnyam med pa/skal bzang rten gyi mi lus ri dbang mgul/rnam mang mthong ba'i dkyur ris nyi che'i rgyan/lcugs ldan sor phran 'byung lnga'i khri 'phang brtsegs/mi nub gtsug gtor bya gri dbyings su gzengs/ldan pa'i gzugs can /gzhung las/ don la mi ltos dpe snga phyi/phan tshun 'brel ba ldan pa'i ba/zugs /
