— 1 74—tshig gis 'gog pa dbang 'gog ste/zhes dbang gi 'gog pa'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi 'dod pa'i bya ba gang zhig sgrub par 'dod pa de dgag bu ru bzung nas/ de 'gog byed kyi tshig nus can gyi dbang yod kyis 'gog par byed pa ste/ des yang bsgrub bya 'ga' zhig sgrub na līgs par yod tshul sngon nas/ de la sgrub tu mi ster bar rang gis btsan po dbang shad kyi gal tshig gis/ nan cher byas nas bkag pa'am 'gog pas dbang yod kyi 'gog pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ rgyal bu legs pa'i dpal 'dzin khyed/so thar bstan pa'i sgor zhugs na/dge 'dun bye ba'i rgyal po ru/'gyur kyang yab mes gdan sar 'thad/ces rgyal bu legs pa'i dpal 'dzin de nyid sa thar zhes tshul khrims nod nas grwa pa bya rgyu dgag bya/ yin na'ang gnang ba ltar gyi 'dul 'dzin grangs mang dbus nas gtso bor 'gyur yang / 'gog byed ni dbang yod kyi 'khor ba bzung nas pha shul bus 'dzin dgos pane dngos su bstan nas sdom pa len sems de 'gog pa'o//sha mang du thos khyed gzhan du gshegs gyur na/phyogs der bstan srid cher 'phel grags snyan 'bar/gdul bya smin grol la 'god gor ma chags/'on tang 'di gar bzhugs dang rnam 'dren kye/zhes dgag bya ni bla ma dam pa de nyid yul gzhan zhig la bstan pa spel du 'gro bar 'dod pa de dang / 'gog byed ni dbang yod kyi yul 'dir bzhugs shig kye zhes bskul ba'i tshig brjod pa ma zad/ 'don don bzhin yul gzhan gshegs na 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel shing sems can ma smin

— 1 75 —pa smin/ smin pa grol/ grol ba mtha' ru phyin par 'phywar ba de yin pa bcas so//ra/ shes bya'i dpal ster shes rab lha mchog rje'i/kun gsal mkhyen pa'i brtse chen nyi gzhon mas/ris med rmongs brgya'i thun gsum batrī/la na yang /mi 'bral kho bo'i rī/nga gi gur du rol/ma gus pas 'gog rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rang gi mi 'dod pa yi rib/sa/drang smros 'gog pa ma gus 'gogaces ma gus pa 'gog pa'i rgyan gyi 'gog rgyan ni/ gzhan zhig gi bya ba gang yang rung ba sgrub pa la/ rang nyid yid ma rang nas/ sba gsang med par bskor ba'am/ de dgag bya ru bzung nas/ bya ba de sgrub pa la ma gus par dngos su brjod pas ma gus pa'i rgyan zhes badzod pa'o//gzhung las/ bdag ni thar pa'i go sa las/che btsan dregs pa'i go sa mirme//nyid kyi bskyon dang ma bskyon rung /rang gi gshis lugs gson po lags /zhes rang gi mi 'dod bzhin du grogs gzhan zhig gi 'jig rten bon brgyad dang du len dgos par bskul ba de dgag bya/ de nyid 'gog byed thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i don la 'bad dgos pa 'gog byed du bzung nas/ rang gi bsam don drang por zhus tshul dang / rang gi mi 'dod pa ni che btsan khe grags sogs la ma gas nas 'gog pa'o//sha bdag ni so thar sdom pa bca' khrims ltar/dam par bsrung 'dod log g.yem de ni min/

— 1 7kyo—mdza' mo 'di ru phebs sam mi phebs kyang /rang cag gnas tshul drang por spros pas so/zhes dgag bya ni 'dod pa log par g.yem pa'am mi gtsang ba spyod pa de dgag bya dang / 'gog byed ni phyi so thar gyi sdom pa mi 'bral bar mig 'bras bzhin du srung 'dod pa des dgag ste/ de yang so thar sdom ldan zhig gi 'gram du bu mo zhig 'dod spyod don du re rme/sa yang yang slebs kyang / de don mi spyed nas sdom pa dam par bsrung ba de'o//ra/ dal 'byor khron pa'i srub las 'khrungs pa 'di/thar pa don du bsnyel ba'i dge spyod las/tshe 'di'i grags snyan re g.yab slang phyir min/kho bos gsong por smra 'di drang po lags/shis brjod kyis 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ bden smos zol nas gzhan 'dod gang /shugs 'gog nus ldan shaṃs brjod 'gogaces shis brjod kyi 'gog rgyan bstan te/ rang gi dgag par bya ba'i yul rang gi mi 'dod pa de nyid gsal por bstan nas/ dgag bya de nyid 'gog byed kyi shis par brjod pa ste/ dgag bya de la bkra shis pa'i smon tshig dngos su smras nas/ dgag tshig dngos su ma badzod par/ shis badzod kyi sgo nas brnag par dgag pa ste/ phyis des 'gal rla 'bras bu gya nyes pa zhig yong ba thabs mkhas kyis gsal por bstan nas/ smon tshig gis 'gog pa zhig la bya 'o//gzhung las/ mgon khyed 'ol mo'i gling chen du /gshegs pa'i bzhed don 'grub gyur cigamagon med lus rgya myur zhig nas/

— 1 77nyid kyi zhabs drung skye bar shogaces yul de'i mgon byed skyes bu dam pa de nyid/ yul de'i 'gro don mi mdzad par yul gzhan zhig gam yang na/ mkha' spu+od gnas su zhal gzigs su 'gro ba de dgag bya/ de smon tshig gi sgo nas/ don de nyid 'gyub par bstod pa dang / gzhan gzhis su lus pa rnams skyabs gnas gzhan med pas/ myur du lus sems bral nas khyed rang yod sar skye bar smon pa'i stobs kyis/ shugs la dgag bya de nyid 'gog par nus rnga/'o//sha byang chub rdo rje rnga yab gling mchog tu/gshegs pa'i dgongs bzhed gegs med 'grub par rizhogamagon med bdag ni lus rgya myur zhig nas/khyed dang mnyam por zhing der skye bar smon/ zhes 'gog bya ni byang chub rdo rje ste/ 'gog byed mgon med lus rgya myur du zhig par smon pa ste/ 'di phyi don kun ster ba'i bla ma byang chub rdo rje rnga yab zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bor 'gro don du phebs rgyu'i bzhed don de dgag bya/ 'gog byed 'dir yod rnams skyabs med mgon med du lus pas myur du 'chi bar smon nas byang chub rdo rje'i 'aspo/ ra du skye bar smon pa bcas thes//ra/ yang dag bstan pa'i bdag 'chang slob dpon mchogarang don sgrub la 'dod don myur 'grub smon/kho cag rig pa smra ba'i khyu tshogs yang /smra med 'di don sgrub las bya thabs gang /rgub mos 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/ —gzhung las/ gzhan yid 'gem pa'i tshig rtsub kyi/'dod don shugs 'gog rtsub mo'i 'gog

— 1 78—ces rtswab mo'i 'gog pa'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ gzhan gyi bya ba gang zhig sgrub pa la/ de sgrab tu mi ster zhing yul gzhan la mi ltos par/ tshig rnyeb mo brjod pa'i sgo snas gzhan gyi 'dod dbang la mi ster bar/shugs la bya ba gang zhig sgrub 'dod de 'gog byed kyi tshig rtsub mos 'gog ci par byed pa la rtsub mo'i 'gog pa zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ bu khyed grags phyir 'breng bden na/g.yo khram sdig pa'i 'khor lo bskor/kho bo sdug gi rtse mo la/byang chub sems dpa'i ba'i/ba gral ge/gas/zhes rigs dang ldan pa'i skyes bu zhig gtam sān grags pa sogs 'jig rten bon brgyad la grags par zhen nas de yang bon brgyad cho// grags mi grags/ bde mi bde/ snyan mi tra//na/ thob ni/ mi thob bcas la 'dod pa de dgag bya dang / 'gog byed ni gang de'i mi daṣ+pe/ ba sna tshogs pa la spu+od cig zhes rtsub mo'i tshig de'i shugs la gtacha/ ṭ+wā/na gragar+sā pa la sogs pa de 'gog par 'ashār te/ gang des mi dge sdig spu+od sogs la mi mos kung des spu+od chog par zhes dgag pa ma zad bu khyed grags rnyi/na 'breng na/ pha ma'am grogs po de ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya nyams su len pa las 'jig rten bon brgyad la ci nas kung mi 'jug go/sha khyed me+e ted bon la lta ba lob/ bden na/grogs 'ga' tshol la bstan pa bsnub thabs rim/nged cag tshul bzhin spyod rnams do nub la/'chi bar 'gyur gyis de ste bsdad nas ci/zhes dgag bya ni g.yung drung gi bon rin po che'i sgo la zhugs nasamathar de la yid ches zad nas lta ba log nas kha smra ngan pa byas pas/

— 1 79—'gog byed ni khyed rang go rogs pa gzhan pa tshol nas bstan pa bsnub na'ang spyod/dze sngon nas ma‘ ṭ+wāṃm danyi 'grogs pa'i grogs po nged cag ni/ de'i bya ba spyod pa las/ do nub shi ba'i thabs lam btsal rgyu yin brjod pa'o//ra/ rang sems g.ya' bral thun min g.yung drung ldin/mi ngo nor phyir gya gyu'i mgron po btsal/ltos bcas 'dren byed khron pa'i ma ma las/rngul chu 'khrungs shing grogs gzhan mi btsal ci/grogs kyis 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ 'dod 'grub grogs tshig mngon gyur gyis/'dod don shugs 'gog grogs 'gog ste/zhes grogs 'gog gi rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ gang zhig gi 'dod don de nyid sgrub pa la bskur lta bu'i sgo nas grogs tshig mngon da brjod cing /shugs la rjes su rang gi 'dod pa'i don de/ 'grub pa'i skabs med pa lta bu'i bya ba zhig baji+od nas/ gang des 'dod don de nyid thabs mkhas kyi sgo naso 'gog ste mi 'grub par byed pa de la grogs kyi 'gog pa'i rgyan zhes bu+o'//gzhung las/ sras khyod rgyal srid kun spangs te/gcig pur 'dod na mūr du gces/phyis na lugs gnyis rnam bzhag gi/gzhan phan nyes pas bya dka' 'gyur/zhes rgyal sras dam pa'i lugs gnyis kyi khrims zhes bstan srid dang rgyal srid gnyis kyi lugs la mnga' mdzad pa'i skyes bu de/ khong nyid 'khor bar nges 'byung skyes nas/ 'khor dang longs spu+od kun spangs nas/ bya bral pa'i rnal 'byor du 'dod pa de dgag bya/ 'gog byed grogs gzhan zhig

— 1 80—nas/ khyed rang kho nar thar pa thob 'dod na de ltar gces zhes gnang ba ltar byas nas slar 'gog byed ni rgyal gshen gyi bstan srid nyams nas mthar gzhan 'tshe'i mi dge ba smyod pa dang sems can rnams sdug bsngal gyi gnas su 'khyams nas/ gzhan phan gyi bya ba sgrab mkhan shin tu nyung bar 'gyur zhes pas/ 'dod don de nyid dgag pa'o/rī/sgrosha rang la yod pa'i sgyu ma'i nor rdzas dgamachod dang sbyin pa gtong na myur du thongs/slar la ar pa'i tshogs kyi rgyu 'phrog gis/cha med brlag pa'i dus shig 'ong ste mchis/zhes rang gi bsags pa'i rgyu nor de nyid yar dkon mchog la mchod pa mar ngan song la sbyon pa ste dman sprang la sbyin mi gtub pa dang / rang gis kung longs su spyod mi bra ba de dgag bya dang / 'gog byed ni nam yang rtag tu mi gtan rkun bus 'phrog pa dang / yang na pha rol gyi dgra tshogs 'chi bdag gi 'jigs pa zhig yongs nges pas/ des na mchod sbyin gyi tshogs su gtong bar bskul ba'o//ra/ rmad byung drang srong pho mo'i sde/bslab gtong gtan grogs phya rgya ma/btsal 'dod don la rims shaṃg gabastan pa'i sa bon nyams kyang ci/ 'bad pas 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ mi 'dod bon la 'bad byas nas/kha dmar log pa 'bad pa 'gog chices 'bad pa 'gog pa'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ pha rol po'i sgrub bya ru bzung ba gang zhig gi 'dod don de dgag bya ru bzung dgos kung / de rang

— 1 81 —gis mi dgag nas sgrub bya ru bzung bar 'bad pa brgya phrag byas na'angaci/ pha rolapo'i 'dod don ji bzhin de sgrub bya ru bzung ba'i thabs gtan nas med paṃr/ rang gis drang por brjod pas dbang med du gang de'i 'dod don de dgag bya ru 'gyur ba lta bu ste/ gzhan gyi 'dod don ji bzhin badzod par 'bad kyang / kha nas dbang med du drang por thal bas gzhan de 'gog pa'o//gzhung las/ kho nas brkus pa'i 'dod 'byung 'de/khyed la phan phyir ma mthong zhes/brjod par 'dod kung rdzun spang gisdom ldan lags phyir tshad mar thal/zhes rkun bu zhig gis mi gzhan pa'i nor rdzas brkus par/ sdom ldan zhes so thar gyi sdom ldan btsun pa zhig gis mthong bar gyur ba la/ bdag po des btsun pa de la rkun po de mthong ngam zhes dris pa'i tshe/ rkun ngo/ de'i ngo la bltas tshe ma mthong zhes brjod dgos stabs// de 'dra brjod par 'bad kyang btsun pa de ni rdzun spangs ba'i gang zag zhig yinatshopa'i phyir/ rkun po de mthong zhes dbang med du ngag las thon pa ste tshad mar bshad pa lta bur brjod pa'o//sha phra rags pham par gyur rnams gas nga sbas thabs/mdzod ces grogs khyed dgyes phyir brngu+od 'dod kung /bdag nyid rgyu 'bras gzhung bsrang drang gtacha/ gyi/tshig 'ga' thal la de ste bya thabs/ ci/zhes sngom pa ldan pa'i gang zag ga ge mo zhig rtsa ba yan lag gang rung zhig gi pham pa'am nyams pa byung ba de grogs gzhan zhig gis shes rtogs byung bar/ grogs gzhan des khyed rang sbas pa'am 'chab par bya dgos rma ra brjod 'dod kyang / las rgyu 'bras la drang por srung dgos phyir drang por

— 1 82—khrel dang ngo tsha dgos pa'i gtam 'ga' dbang med du thal bar gyur ba lta bur brjod pa'o //ra/ lnga snyigs dus 'dir mi ngo nor phyir du/g.yo dang rdzun gyi mchod tshogs bsags 'dod kyang /shin tu ma bzod tshul mthun drang srong bdag bden tshig smra ba'i lam las gzhan brjod bral/dbang gis 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ gang gi 'dod don 'gog nus pa'i/gnyan po gzhan 'tshol gzhan dbang 'gogaces dbang gi 'gog pa'i don bstan te/ gang zhig rang gi mi 'dod pa yi don nam bya ba zhig bang zab ga'/ma zhib be/ sgrub par 'dod pa de dgag bu ru bzung nas/ dgag bya de 'gog byed kyi gnyan po gzhan zhig la kha 'phang nas/ gzhan pa de'i stobs kyis rang gi mi 'dod pa yi don de nyid 'gog pa zhig la dbang gi 'gog pa zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ so thar bge/na rdzogs dge slong khyed/gsang ba'i phyag rgya bsten pa'i gros/'dal 'dzin mkhan po'i ngag la drirngage/ci gsung bdag gi yi rang 'bul/zhes btsun pa ga ge mo zhig gis bu med la mi gtsang ba spyod par 'dod pa de la grogs kyis dgag par 'dod pa la/ thabs gzhano zhig gis sgo nas 'gog pa ste/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa de'i bka' yi gnang ba khrol na ma gtogs gzhan mi legs par bstan te/ 'dul 'dzin mkhan po des drang srong gi sdom ldan zhig la bu med la chags

— 1 83—7spyod kyi bya ba sgrub pa ni/ gnang ba thob mi srid bzhin grogs gzhan zhig gi dbang gis 'gog pa'o// 4she7 tshe 'dir srid 'byor glog gi bu mo la/longs su spyod ces bdag la smra ba rnams/dge sdig khrims dpon dag la blang dor zhus/de yi dzi ltar mnar bzhin bdag kyang spyod/ces thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob phyir dkar po dge ba la spyod bzhin pa'i skyes bu la/ mi tshe'i bde skyed 'jig rten gyi 'du longs la longs su spyod dgos par bskul ba la/ skyes bu de grogs gzhan zhig gis dge sdig gi dkar nag dbye ba'i khrims dpon la dge spyod dam sdig spyod bka' chab zhus nas des sdig pa spyod ces pa'i bka' khrol na/ bdag gis kyang 'jig rten 'khor ba'i 'du lang la spyod par bya'o zhes brjod pa'o//ra/ 'dren pa'i rla bral dren can bla ma des/rang yul spangs zhes snying gi gdam pa de/ lus bskyed ma ma dag dang zhal 'chem na/kho bo phyogs med rgyal khams 'grims la dga'/thabs kyis 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ 'dod don gnang ba lta bu'i ngang / sgrub thabs bral brjod thabs 'gog ste/zhes thabs kyis 'gog pa'i rgyan gyi don bstan te/ rang gi mi 'dod pa yi bya ba gang zhig gzhan zhig gi 'dod don de dgag bya ru bzung nas de yang thabs legs kyi sgo nas 'dod don bzhin mos mthun yod khul ltar du byas nas thabs gzhan zhig nas rīd pa dang 'grub par dka' ba'i sgrub bya zhig

— 1 84—bkod te/ de 'grub par byung na/ dgag bya de nyid dgag mi dgos pa lta bur brjod pa ste/ thabs legs kyis 'gog pas de bzhin brjod pa'o//gzhung las/ kun dga' nam mkha'i thig le khyed/nub ri'i phag la yib kyang bzod/'dzam gling snang ba mi nub pa'i/'od gsal nga la skal par zhogaces dgag bya ni nam mkha'i thig le zhes nyi ma ste/ nyi ma ni nub ri'i phag tu gab nas sdod pa de/ 'gog byed ni 'dzam bu gling gi gnas 'dir mun pa gsal byed kyi nyi 'od de nyid bzhag nas nyi ma khyed rang nub ri'i phag tu gab na yang mos mthun yod tshul smos bzhin/ de ni sgrub thabs bral ba ste/ nyi ma med bzhin nyi 'od yod pa ni spyir mi srid bzhin gang de'i dgag bya nyi ma nub ri'i gseng la gab rgyu'i 'dod don de 'gog pa'o//sha gso rig pa khyod phyogs gzhan phebs bzhud na/bdag sogs nyid dang bral ba'i sems kyis bzod/ slar la nad las grol cing rnam kun tu/srog 'tsho'i a smri ta yi rgyun stsol cigaces dgag bya ni yul de'i sman pa zhig phyogs gzhan zhig la 'gro bar 'dod pa de/ yul mi nad kyi mnar ba 'ga' yi bshul bar 'dod pa la/thabs kyis rang tsag rnams la nad sel 'chi ba gso ba'i sman a smri ta zhes zhang skad yin/ bod skad du bdud rtsi la go zhing skabs 'dir 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi dus rtags tu gnang na/ khyed dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa med ces thabs kyi brjod pa'o//ra/ blo gros sbyin brgya 'byed pa'i tshangs sras mas/gnas 'dir ngal na sum rtsen gnas su bzhud/

— 1 85—nyid kyi shes bya'i dpal yon yod cog gang /kho bo'i blo gros gzhon nu'i bag mar zhogakhro bos 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ khro tshig drag pos gzhan dbang gis/'dod don 'gog pa khro 'gog ste/zhes khro bo'i sgo nas 'gog pa'i rgyan bstan te/ bya ba gzhan bya ba gang zhig sgrab pa de nyid dgag bya ru bzung nas/ de la rang gis mi 'dod pa'i rnam ḍābyur dang bcas/ khros pa'i dbang gis ngag la sdom par/ kha ngan gyi rnam pa dang 'brel tshig rtsub mo'i sgo nas 'dod don de nyid sgrub tu mi gtub par dngos su 'gog pa zhig la khro 'gog ces bya'o// gzhung las/ phyi nang grub mtha'i rtsod grwa ru/bdenadze don sna gcig mi 'grub par/dam pa smad pa'i ku co can/khyod 'dra'i grub 'dzin med na ang /zhes bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la sbyang brtson zhan cing / rang che dang tshul 'chos la gzab pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin tshul gyi bla sprul 'ga' dgag bya/ de nyid 'gog byed ni/ mkhas pa mang po 'tshogs shig grub mtha' mang po 'du ba'i sar/ bden don gyi rtsod pa byed pa'i dus su/ bden don sne gcig mi lon pa'i rang mtshong de 'gog byed dam yang na/ gzhan mkhas pa tshul dang ldan pa dang / bla ma dam pa rnams la phrag dog gis smad ra byed pa sogs rang bzhin brjod nas/ khyod 'dra'i grub mtha' 'dzin mkhan med na legs zhes dngos su khro tshig gis 'gog pa'o// rna shatsho than pas gdung tshe char 'bru gcig tsam yang 'bab pa med mod phyis nas rtsi thog kun/

— 1 86—bskam nas gdengasda can rnams kyis sprin bcud rgyun/phab kyang ma phab pa dang ci khyad yod/ci—dbyar gyi dus su lo tog dang rtsi thog sna tshogs la skye byed kyi sbrang char zeg ma 'thor bar shin tu re yang / char rdog gcig kyang ma btang ba'i gdengs skyes zhes mngon brjod klu la go zhing mthar lo tog dang me tog tshang ma skam nas slar sos pa'i thabs zad pa'i dus su/ klu yi sprin bsdus nas char pa btang ba 'di ni char pa dgos pa'i dus su med par/ dus min du char bab dang ma bab khyad par ci zhig yod pa'o zhes so//ra/ bcu rig gnas la gcun pa'i do ra na/ltos bcas nor dben lus kyi mdangs nyams skabs/zas skom mdza' mos bor ba'i 'byor ldan grogs/dal dus bsod nams bsags kyang dgos don ci/mu ngan gyis 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/ gzhung las/ dngos po'i bya ba ma rdzogs pa'i/chud zos skyo ba mya ngan 'gogazhes mya ngan gyi 'gog pa'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi bya ba gang zhig grib par 'os kyang longs su spyod pa'i skal pa bed spyod bya ba'i dus med pa'ame longs su ma spyad pas/ don med ngos rang gi go skabs bzang po de dbang med du brlag pa'am bor bar/ rang nyid sngon ma bed spu+od bu rgyu'i go skabs yod pa ra 'phrod byung tshe/ mya ngan skye 'os pa zhig gyur ba'i skabs/ snying rje skye bas mu ngan gi 'gog pa zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ mchod yul mnyes par ma byas shing /sbyin yul sbyin par ma phod la/rang bder ma nus bsags pa'i nor/

— 1 8 7—ar pas brlag 'di snying re rje/zhes gang zag ga ge mo zhig gis tshe 'dir nor rdzas ji snyed cig bsags nas/ ser sna'i dbang gis yar dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul ma nus la/ mar ngan song dang sprang po la sbyin mi thub pa ma zad/ rang gis kyang gang 'dod longs su spyod ma nus pa'i skabs su/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas rang nor dbang med du jag pas bcom 'phrog byas nas song ba la khong rang shin tu mya ngan dang sdug bsngal myang ba 'di la/ snying rje'i yul du mchis pas/ des na rang nor mchod sbyin du gtong mi nus pa de dgag bya/'gog byed dbang med 'phrog nas mya ngan skye ba ste/ des na snga phyi don rnams rtogs nus so// sha 'dren ston pa dang bstan 'dzin phal cher ni/sdig las rnyed bkur 'ba' zhig don du gnyer/mkhas btsun zung re snang yang khyad du gsod/kye ma gyer bstan nub 'di'i snang tshul gzigs/zhes snga phyi snyigs dus kyi khol bu 'dir bstan pa 'dzin khul gyi bla gzugs phal cher 'jig rten bon brgyad kyi kun nas bslang ste snyan grags dang chags sdang kho na'i don du 'bad cing / mkhas shing btsun pa'i skyes bu dang yang dag me'i bden don lo rgyus la khyad du gsod cing mthong du mi 'dod pa'i snang tshul 'di ni ya nga la sems sdug pa'i gnas su gyur ba'o//ra/ bcu rig bslarbe pa'i nor dang ma ldan zhing /mdza' mthun sgeg mo'i grogs la ma regs pa'i/rnyed dka'i dal rten mi lus rin chen 'di/yud cig skra lo dkar ba snying rje'i gnas/'gyod pas 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/

— 1 88—gzhung las/ rgyu la ma 'bad dgos che'i skabs/'bras med blo 'gyod 'gyod 'gog ste/zhes don bstan te rang gi snga sa nas sgrub par 'os pa'i bya ba gang zhigarang gi sgrub na 'grub pa'i rgyu de la ma 'bad nas/ don med snang chung du bzhag nas rnam g.yeng du lus pa la/ phyis rang la dgos pa'i dus shig shar ba'i tshe/ rgyu de la 'bad kung 'grwab par mi 'gyur ba'i dus der/'bras bu med par rang nyid sngon nas bya ba de la ma 'bad nas snang med du btang ba la/ skyo ba skye zhing / kha skyengs ba/ 'gyod pa byed pa bcas don bton nas brjod pa la'o//gzhung las/ dam pa'i zhal snga ma 'grims shing /rig pa'i gnas la ma bslab pa'i/gnas lugs rjen par ma skyol bas/mkhas mang 'dus sar skyengs 'di skyo/zhes rang gi sgrub par 'os pa'i bya ba ni/ mkhas dbang bla ma'i zhal snga nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyang brtson dgos pa dngos gshis kyang / don med du rnam g.yeng gi dbang gis dus 'das par skyel bas/ rang la dgos pa'i yon tan khungs thub med pa'i dbang gis/ mkhas pa mang po 'dus sar rang nyid ngo ritsha'i ba mo shin tu bzhur bar gyur ba ste/ dgag bu don med du rnam g.yeng la dus 'da' ba de/ 'gog byed ni phyis 'gyod pa skye ba'am/ ngo tsha ba'i rnam pa 'byung bas gang de 'gog pa'o//sha skye ma bdag ni phyi ma'i don ma bsgrub/'di don ma byung bstan pa'ang spel ma nus/rang dbang can gyi mi lus g.yengs la zad/ da ni 'khor lam 'gro ran 'di ko 'gyod/

— 1 89— ces dal 'byor ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che'i rten 'di la phyi ma'i don dkar po'i dge ba la yang 'bad par ma nus shing / tshe 'di yi don bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba yang skyil bar ma nus pa ma zad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel ba'i mthun rkyen yang sgrub par ma nus par/ don med g.yeng ba'i ngang mi tshe 'di rdzogs nas/ myur bar ngan song 'gro ran pas sdug bsngal ba'am shin tu 'gyod pa ste/ dgag bya mi tshe g.yeng ba'i ngang zad du 'jug pa/'gog byed rgas gud mthar sdug bsngal myong du ran pas 'gyod pa dang bcas so// ra/ 'jig rten phan bde kun dga'i nor mchog dben/gso rig bye ba'i gzhung la 'dren byed zum/skabs thub zung ngu'i mgron pos bsus pa'i tshe/yang yang 'gyod kyang bya thabs rnyed ma gyur/the tshom gyis 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ dpe don mtshungs kyang dpe can chas/gnyis 'dzin bache+og pa the tshom 'gogaces the tshom gyis 'gog pa'i rgyan bstan te/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis phan tshun mtshungs ba'i don gyi/ de gnyis rgyu mtshan gang yang rung ba zhig gi sgo nas dbye ba so sor 'byed pa la mongs par gyur ba de nyid dgag bya ru bzung nas/ mtshon bya dpe can gyi khyad gzhi la khyad bon gang yang rung ba zhig 'gog byed du bkod de/ gang de'i dpe can gyi khyad bon gang yang rung ba zhig dpe la mi ldan pa'i cha nas/ dpe de nyid dpe can dngos yin par 'dod pa'i the tshom de nyid 'gog pas the tshom gyi 'gog rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ gang 'di salke mchog ljon pa'am/7 yang na drang srong rgyal ba'i sku/

d+ngha 1 90—skal ldan tshogs kyi dga' ston du/ legs bshad 'byin phyir tsan dan min/zher+sā dpe can drang srong rgyal ba'i sku dang / dpe sa mchog ljon pa zhes dpag bsam shing dang gnyis bkod nas/ 'di gnyis phan tshun dri mchog ngad dang ldan zhing phan bde'i grib bsil g.yo ba'i cha nas/ drang srong rgyal ba'i sku de dpag gsam sngon pa yin nam snyam pa'i the tshom zhugs shing / so sor 'byed mi nus pa'i skabs/ dpe can gyi khyad bon skal ldan 'khor la legs bshad kyi dga' ston 'byin nus pas dpag bsam shing ma yin par drang srong rgyal ba'i shī ru nges pa rnyed/ dgag bya ni drang srong rgyal ba'i sku de dpag bsam ljon pa yin nam min snyams pa'i the tshom de dang / 'gog byed ni skal ldan 'khor la legs bshad kyi dga' ston 'byin pas gong gi the tshom de 'gog pa'o//sha gang 'di rje rgyal ta pi hri tsa'am/yang na theg chen ru shing nyi ma 'od/ngur smrig na bza'i 'phur mas skal ldan tshogs/yid 'ong 'dren phyir spral pa'i sku mchog min/zhes dpe gnas lugs rdzogar+sha pa chen po'i mnga' bdag sprul pa'i sku mchog ta pi hri tsa dang dpe can gyer mi nyi ma 'od zer yin zhing / kun la brtse chen gyis theg chen bon gyi sbyin brgya 'gyed pa sogs la brten nas/ nyi ma 'od zer de nyid ta pi hri tsa yin nam min nam snyam pa'i the tshom skyes mthar brtags dpyad byas nas na bza' ngur smrig gi rgyan mdzes gyi 'khor la spro ba skye ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis nyi ma 'od zer ru nges pa rnyed pa'o//ra/ snyan 'jebs gnyis skyes mgrin glu'am/ yang na ma ma'i dgyes brtse'i ngag

brda' don tshig gi rgyan dang ldan/phan par bslab phyir khu byug min/sbyar ba'i 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ dpe don khyad bon mnyam sbu+or dpe/don gyi 'gog pa sbyar 'gog ste/zhes sbur 'gog gi mtshan nyid bstan te/ sbyar gzhi dpe don gnyis kyi phan tshun sgra don so so'i sgo nas khyad bon mnyam du sbyar nas so sor dbyer med da brjod pa la/ mtshon byed dpe dag don nam dpe can dngos yin pa 'gog pa'am dgag bya/ 'gog byed ni dpe can dpe yi gzugs su bkod nas/ dpe de don gyi 'gog par byed pa zhig la sbyar ba'i 'gog pa zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ dri med don gsal kun dgo'i dpal/lung rig smra ba'i blo gros can/'gro ba'i bla ma yod bzhin dwa /lha yi bla ma ci zhig bya/zhes dpe can 'gro ba'i mgon gyur bla ma dam pa dang / dpe lha yi bla ma zhes gza' phur bu dang / sgra mthun dang phan tshun khud bon lāng dang rig pa'i blo gros rtsal mnga' ba sbyare nas/ mthar dgag bya dpe lha yi bla ma zhes phur bu yin pa dang / 'gog byed 'gro ba'i bla ma'am rang go bka' drin sum ldano gyi bla ma yod bzhin pa des 'gog pa'o//sha dathen pa'i sa gnas drung du 'khod rnams skyong /zilabasnyes kun gnon rgol ngan klad pa 'gems/ mkhas grusge mi yi seng ge yod bzhin du/gangs khrod seng ge de yi ci zhig bya/

— 1 92—zhes dpe can bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la byang chub pa'i mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes bu dang / dpe sder chags kyi rgyal po seng ge gnyis dang /sbyar gzhi ni/ mtshan seng ge sder chags seng ge dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po la'ang 'jug ste mi yi seng ge zhes dang / khyad bon ni/ dben pa'i gnas su rang gi 'khor tshogs skyongs ba dang / rgol ba'i rigs kun gyi mtshang brtol zhing zil gyis gnon pha sogs mtshungs shing / de yang dgag bu dpe seng ge de don smra dbang mi yi seng ge de yin pas/ 'gog byed bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la dbang bsgyir ba'i mi yi seng ge yod pa de yin zhing / des na don gyis 'gog pa'o//ra/ —dgyes brtse'i 'dzum rlab g.yo ba'i phul/thun gsum gzhil ba'i rnam dpyod can/ston pa'i sgron ma yod bzhin du/srid pa'i sgron mas ci zhig bya/ci don gzhan gyis 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ sgrub bya bkodacirjes nus ldan pa'i/sgrab byed kyis 'gog don gzhan 'gogaces don gzharno 'gog pa'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ gang zhig rang gi bya ba byed bzhin pa'i khyad par 'phags pa'am/ ngo mtshar skye 'os pa zhig sgrub bu ru dngos su bkod nas/ de la don gzhan dag cig nas mtshungs bon de dang 'dra ba zhig dpe don gyi tshul du bkod nas/ gang de'i sgrab bya de nyid kyi khyad par ngo mtshar skye ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i rigs rnoms/ de mtshungs kyi dpes dngos su 'gog nus pa zhig la/ don gzhan gyis 'gog rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ lung rig smra ba'i dbang po yi/

— 1 93—da dung thos brtson byed 'di ci/'on kyang gang ga'i ma ma yis/phyogs bcu'i dal 'bab bsdus la ltos/zhes lung dang rig pa'i gnas la rang dbang thob pa'i skyes bus yang / da dung g.yung drung gi bon rin po che la thos brtson dang bcu rig gi gnas la sbyang pa byed pa de ya mtshan 'dzin pa'i blo de dgag bya/ de 'gog byed ni dpe'i tshul du/ gang ga'i ma ma zhes mtha'i rgya mtsho'i ming ste/ rgya mtsho chen pos ngom med nyin mtshan rtag tu phyogs nas 'bab pa'i chu phran rnams bsdus pa bzhin du/ rang la yon tan cung zad re yod kyang da dung yon tan cha phra ba nas sbyang dgos pa'i don bstan pa'o//sha rje btsun 'brug lhas lus can mtha' dag la/phyogs dang ris med phan bde sbyin de rmad/'on kyang sems med yongs 'dus dbang pos kyang /skye rgur dgos 'dod 'bad med 'jo la ltos/zhes mtshon bya dpe can rje btsun khro tshang 'brug lhas 'gro ba kun la phan sems dang nye ring bdag gzhan med pa kun la snying rje byang chub mchog tu gems bskyed nas thar pa dang bde ba'i gnas la bkod thabs gnang ba decal ya mtshan pa de dgag bya/ 'gog byed ni yongs 'dus shing ngam dpag bar+sārma ljon pa la sems med kyang / 'gro ba kun la ris su ma chad par dgos 'dod ster ba la gzhigs na/ sems ldan mi la ya mtshan skye ba ci yang med ces brjod pa'o//ra/ 'dren mchog mi rje slob dpon dam pa yis/ rtag tu bcu rig 'khor la sbyin 'di rmad/'on tang rgyal bu gsal mchog dam pa des/

— 1 94—sku lus 'gro la sbyin par gnang la gzigs/rgyu yis 'gog pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ grags sam grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/dgag bya 'gog pa rgyus 'gog ste/zhes 'gog pa'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ spyir 'jig rten yongs grags kyi bstod yul khyad par can nam/ dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig gi khyad bon yon tan de nyid gsal bar bkod de/ de nyid bstod pa bya ba ni dgag bya/ 'gog byed ni lo rgyus dang ldan pa'i gshis lugs sam/ rgyu mthun gyi nas mthu kho nar grub pa'i rgyu mtshan las grub par brjod pa la/lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i rgyur bstod tshul 'gog cing / lo rgyus dang 'brel ba ldan pa'i cha nas rgyus 'gog pa zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ 'khor med drin gyi bdag nyid ces/ma ma khyed la mi bstod de/ji phyir srid pa'i lugs bzang la/bu skyong ma yi skal pa lags/zhes bka' dren nam yang gsob tu med pa lus bskyed pa'i drin can ni rang gi ma ste/ 'di la bka' dron can zhes brjod pa ni dgag bya dang /'gog byed ni/ lo rgyus sam gshis lugs la/ ma yis bu skyong ba ni srid pa chags nas da dbar lugs srol yin pa las/ ya mtshan skye dgos pa ni ma yi na no zhes snga ma'i don de yongs grags kyi rgyus 'gog pa'o//sha dbang dang byin rlabs stsal zhes rje khyed la/sgo gsum gas pas zhabarngage rtogs mi bgyid de/ci phyir gdam ngag rnams no 'o skol zung /las 'brel dpon slob yin no snyam pas zhu/

—195—zhes dbang dang byin rlabs sogs bcu rig sbyin pa'i slob dpon la slob yon dang / dngos rdzas sogs zhabs rtogs 'bul ba dang sgrub pa ni dgag bya/ 'gog byed ni rang cag bla slob tshe sngon las kyi smon lam 'brel ba yin bsam pa las gzhan gang yang min par 'dod pa bcas so//ra/ skyes rgu'i 'jigs skyobs shes rab byams ma zhes/ yum chen khyed la bstod pa mi 'os te/srid mtshor 'phyan pa'i yid can pho mo rnams/skyobs pa rgyal yum nyid kyi mdzad 'phrin lags/zhes snyan ngag rin chen lde'u mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las 'gog pa'i rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa ste drug pa'o//

—196—don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don ni/gzhung las/ bsgrub bya bkod rjes nus ldan gyi/sgrub byed bkod pa don gzhan bkod/ces don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ tshig gi sbyor ba gang yin kyang / rang gi brjod don nam/ bsgrub bya de sngon du bkod nas/bsgrub bya de las rgya che ba'i nus pa can gyi dngos po'am don gzhan zhig bkod cing / sgrub byed kyi tshul du bkod nas/ bsgrub byed des rang gi snga ma'i bsgrub bya bkod pa de bsgrub par nus pa'i las can don gzhan zhig gis bsgrub pa la don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na/ khyed kyi legs bshad kun dga'i dpal/yin kyang log lta can gyi dugakun gyi gsos gyur 'o ma yang /dug sbrul gyis ni 'dod dam ci/ zhes pa lta bu'o//dbye ba so so'i don la brgyad yod de/ kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ khyad par gyi don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ sbyar ba'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ 'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ 'os dang mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ mi 'os 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan dang bcas brgyad kyi sgo nas bshad pa la/kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa ni/gzhung las/ 'dod tshul spyi ltos sgrub pa'i rjes/

—197—sgrub byed nus ldan kun khyab ste/zhes kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan bstan te/ spyir rang gi brjod bya gang yang rung ba zhig gi yongs khyab kyi rang bzhin nam khyad bon gang yang rung ba zhig bsgrub bya ru bkod nas/ de nyid sgrub byed rang dang 'dra mtshungs kyi rigs kun la khyab thub pa'i sgrub byed nus ldan yongs su grags pa zhig bkod pa kun la khyab pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ rigs dang ldan pa'i lus can gang /skyes nas 'chi ba'i rang bzhin te/'od dang ldan pa'i nyi ma yang /shar ba'i tha ma nub la ltos/zhes srog dbang dang ldan pa'i lus can kun skyes nas 'chi mi srid pa med pas 'chi ba'i rang bzhin yin pa bsgrub bya dang / de nyid bsgrub byed yangs khyab la mthong bzhin pa'i nyi ma 'di la zhogs ka 'od zer dang bcas te shang nas shar ba'i dgong mo nubawā'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa bzhin/ rgyu mtshan 'dis skyes nas 'chi ba dang dngos po thams cad 'jig pa'i rang bzhin can du ston nus pa bcas mdor na skyes nas 'chi ba'i rang bzhin yin te/ nyi ma shar ba'i tha ma nub pa bzhin no/ zhes so//sha phyi nang snod bcud dngos kun mi rtag par/skye 'gag kho na byas pa 65 tsa ma/'on tang ston pa mchog gi spral sku yang / g.yung drung sku mchog zhi b.re gshegs la ltos/ zhes 'di ltar snang ba'i dngos po kun skad cig skad cig skye 'gag dang rmitshonag 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can du gnas par bsgrab bya dang / sgrab byed ni skye smo ṣ+kamanga' ba g.yung drung gi skur brnyes pa'i rnyen mchog gi gyel skus

—198—kyang / 'chi ba'i ngang tshul ston la gzhigs pas shes par 'gyur ro// zhes so//ra/ thos bsam don la brtson pa'i blo gsal grogs/bcu rig bsam 'phel dbang po 'byung nges te/phyogs kyi nyal 'gro bsdu ba'ik+ṣu yi grong /'dod 'byung gter gyi zhing du gyur la ltos/khyad par can gyi don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ 'dod tshul khyad ldan bsgrub bya'i rjes/ sgrub byed nus ldan khyad par can/zhes khud par can gyi don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan bstan te/ rang gi gang 'dod pa'i bsgrub bya'i dngos po gang yin pa zhig gi don nam byed las khyad par can zhig bsgrub bya ru bkod nas rjes su de mtshungs kyi khyab byed nus can gyi sgrub byed gzhan zhig bkod nas/ sngon gyi 'a/ dod tshul ltar gyi bsgrub bya de nyid nges par sgrub nus pa'i thun min khyad par can gyi don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ 'di ltar snang ba'i dngos po kun/skye med rgyu ma lta bu ste/ rang las skye ba la sogs pa/mu bzhi dag dang bral ba'i phyir/zhe so so'i skye bo la snang ba'i dngos po yod do lcog kun/ skye ba med pa yin pa dang / snang la dngos med rgyu ma lta bur gnas te/ dgag bya bden par grub pa'i rang bzhin las skye ba dang / gzhan las skye/ rang gzhan gnyis ka las skye ba/ rgyu med pa las skye ba sogs med pa la skye ba'i mu bzhi dang bral ba zhes dang / rgyu ma lta bu ni snang la dngos med kyi dpe ste/ rdzas

— 1 99—dang sngags kyi sgyu ma mkhan gyis rde'u shing rta rdang glang por sprul ba'i dus de'ushing rta dang glang po ru snang yang rta dang glang po dngos ma grub pa ste/ gong gi 'di ltar snang ba'i dngos po kun skye med sgyu ma lta bu de bsgrub bya dang /sgrab byed skye ba'i mu bzhi dang bral ba bcas so sor bkod pas gsal lo//'e bon dang gang zag bdag med tshad ma zhigabatsal kyang mi rnyed ye nas ri bong rwa/gsal bar mthong ba'i chu zla'i dkyil 'khor de/dar la btsags kyang rnyed par 'gyur ram ci// zhes khyad gzhi'am yul bon gyi bdag med rtogs pa'i tshad ma yang yinayang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i tshad ma yang yin pa'i blo ngo bo gcig la mi sīd/ gang zag bdag med rtogs pa'i blo'i rnam pa can yang yin/bon3glebadag med rtogs blo'i rnam pa can yang yin pa mi srid par dus gcigam/yul mi 'dra ba gnyis kyi rnam pa shar nas rtogs pa'i blo mi srid de dzesaper na/ chu nang la shar ba'i zu gzugs btsal bar chu btsags te bca'akhabs kyang mi rnyed pa bzhin no//ra/ bslab gsum dam du 'chang ba'i dge 'dun sdes/rgyu 'bras bon la gces su 'dzin 'os te/ ci gzung 'dzin bden par smra ba'i phyi rol pas/son las 'bras bu skyes pa 'dod la ltos/sbyar ba'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/gzhung las/ bsgrub bya dang ni sgrab byed dgakhyajo bon mnyartsa rmye+or sbyar ba ste/ cici phyo 6 chiḍa ji sbyar ba'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya'i pa de nyid bsgrub bya ru bkod nas/ de dang mtshungs pa'i bsgrub

— 200— byed kyi khyad bon gnyis phan tshun sgra sbyar te/ sgra gcig gi don gnyis ston nus pa la phan tshun so sor bkral ba'i tshe bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed gnyis so sor go ru gtubs shing rang gi 'dod don nam bsgrub bya de nyid sgrub nus par ston pa'i rgyan zhig la sbyar ba'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ skyes mchog mi yi seng ge la/rgol ngan gzhan gyis mi tshugs te/nus ldan rnam par rgyal ba yis/log rtogs ngang gi gzhil la ltos/zhes sgra sbyar nas brjod pa ste/ mi yi seng ge zhes pas mi yi nang nas mchog tu gyur ba dang gcan gzan gyi rgyal po gnyis la go zhing / phyi ma gnyis kyi rnam par rgyal ba zhes pas/ gshen rab mi bo kun las rnam par rgyal ba dang / sman mchog rnam par rgyal ba gnyis la 'jug pas/ bsgrub bya ni skyes bu dam pa bcu rig gnas la dbang bsgyur ba'i bdag po la/ rgol ba gzhan gyis mi tshugs la/ gzhan yang gcan gzan gyi rgyal po la sder charges gzhan gyis bag mi dpog pa ston te/ phyi mar ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis log rtog rang bzhin 'bad med kyi gzhil ba de dang / sman mchog a ru rnam par rgyal bas nad rnams ngang gi zhi ba bzhin no// zhes snga phyi gnyis nas rim bzhin bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed so so nas sgra sbyar te brjod pa'o//sha sku gsum thugs rje yas bab ma rgyud kyis/'gro rnams thar pa smin grol lam la 'god/gdul byar gyur ba'i sarla sa tā ni/daskyogs dbyung mdzad pa'i bka' drin sus gzhal nus/zhes sbyar gzhi lha gsang mchog dang bla ma dam pa gnyis kyi khyad bron 'gro rnams thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par mdzad pa

— 201 —ma zad/ khyad par sarla zhes thams cad dang sa tā ni sems can zhes pas de gnyis sgra sbyar te gang gis ma rgyud dang rnam 'dren bla ma gnyis kyi khyad bon sems can thams cad thar par bkod pa'i yon tan gyis phan tshun snga phyi bsgrab bya dang sgrub byed du bkod pa'o//ra/༄ dal 'byor rten bzang yid bzhin nor bu la/dngos grab rnam gnyis ngang gi 'byung nges te/'dab brgya grol ba'i nyi ma'i snying po 'dis/blo gsal bcu rig sbrang rtsi 'byin la ltos/'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/gzhung las/ don gyi khyad par 'gal tsam gyi sa/bsgrub bya sgrub byed 'gal ba ste/zhes 'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod pa bstan te/ brjod bya'i dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig gi khyad bon skyon yon mi mthun pa gnyis 'gal ba can gyi las zhig bsgrub bya/ de sgrub byed khyad bon mtshungs shing / skyon yon gyi phyogs gnyis las sam bya ba dang 'gal can gyis don gzhan zhig sgrub byed du bkod nas slar mi 'gal bar ston pa zhig la 'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ dam pa dben sar sbas na yang /legs pa'i rnam bzhag kun tu khyab/nor bu dar gyi dril na yang /'dod pa'i re 'bras kun tu khyab/ces rig pa'i gnas kun la mkhas shing khyad par du bla med rdzogs pa skyi chen po'i rnal 'byor pa dag grags snyan sogs 'jig rten gyi bon brgyad la mi mos pa'i skyes bu dam pa gcig pur dben pa'i ri sul du gnas na'ang /

— 202—de'i yon tan phyogs kun tu khyab pa bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed ni/ de dang bon mtshungs ba'i don gzhan yid bzhin gyi nor bu de dar sna'i nang du dril na'ang / de dang 'gal ba legs pa'i yon tan don dam thams cad kun la khyab pas so// ces snga phyi don mtshungs shing / bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed rnams rang gi bya las sam las 'gal bar ston pa'i cha nas so//sha yid bzhin nor bu 'dam gyis sbas nus kyang /'bad pa med pa dgos 'dod ci yang 'jo/mnyam med shes rgyal spyan la skyon ldan yang /ji snyed bstan g.yo'i zhingar+shadu gsal bar gzigs/zhes mtshon bya ni rgyal ba mnyam med chen po'i spyan la 'jig rten pa'i snang ngor skyon yod par snang yang / ye shes kyi spyan gcig gi mtshon byed du rung ba la/ de yang rgyal ba mnyam med pa'i spyan la skyon ldan yang 'khor 'das kyi bon thams cad sa ler gzigs pa sgrub byed du bkod nas/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che 'dam gyis sbag sdo yin yang / 'dam gyis skyon mi 'byung bar dgos 'dod thams cad 'bad med du 'jo ba'o// zhes spyan skyon ldan pa dang spyan gyis kun gzigs pa gnyis bya thabs 'gal yang skyon med du sgrub par nus so//ra/ mkhas pas dman pa'i sar 'dzin yang /slob bus spyi bo'i gtsug tu bskur/'dam skyes dri ldan pad mo yang /tshogs ldan lha yi rdzas la spungs/ mi 'os pa'i don gzharne bkod pa ni/gzhung las/ 'thad pa'i don la mi 'thad pa'i/ngag don bkod pa mi 'os ga

—203—zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi bya ba gang yang rung ba zhig 'os pa'i bya ba yin yang bya ba des mi 'os pa'i 'bras bu bskyed pa bsgrub bya ru bkod nas/ de bsgrub byed ni spyir mi 'os pa yin cing / bye brag tu dngos po 'ga' zhig gi ngo la 'os par bkod kyang / spyir mi 'os pa'i las yin pas ma mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o// gzhu4 lan/ snyigs dus rgyal ba'i balhan pa'il/mkhas btsun bzang gsum nyin skar tsam/srid na blun po snying kham sa pas/mi 'dod ngan pa'i mtshangs 'di 'dra/zhes lnga snyigs kyi dus 'dir mkhas btsun bzang ga/sum 'dzoms pa spi shin tu dkon pa ste/ dper na nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin zhes/ srid pa tsam 5sa mang po med bzhin de dag la bstan zhing / bkur bar 'os pa ni 'dod pa'i don dang / de la mi 'os pa'am mi 'thad pa'i don ni/ blun po rang snang can rang kha mas/ rang nyid yon tan med bzhin gzhan gyi yon tan la phreg dog nas/ mi 'dod pa'i bskur 'debs byed pa ni mi 'os pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur zhes so//sha kun grol grags pas bder gshegs bka' ba/nga las/dpyad pa las byung legs bshad snyan 'jebs kyang /log par lta ba'i snying la mtshon du gyur/ phyogs lhung skal dman rnams kyi mtshangs 'di 'dra/ sku — zhes mdo smad sde dge'i yul du 'khrungs pa'i rig 'dzin kun grol bsastsa pas/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'phags pa'i lung / rang gi rig pa gsum kha sbyar nas/ thar pa dang thams cadamimakhyen pa'i go 'phang sgrab byed sti ngang zab gter mang dag cig bskrun pa la/ skal dman lor+sha lta ru

—204—tra'i kun dkris kyis 'ching ba dag gis/ mi 'os pa'i 'chal tshig sna tshogs kyis bskur 'debs byed pa ni mi 'os pa dngos su bstan pa'o //ra/ blo gsal bstan mchog bslab pa'i grogs 'grul yang /sred ldan lus phras mi 'dod smod tshig smra/mkha' gsal ye shes kun dga'i dpal du yang /gnyis skyes zhag mig can gyis thal ba phyar/'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/gzhung las/ bsgrub byar mtshungs pa'i nus ldan gyi/ bsgrub byed 'thad ldan 'os pa ste/zhes 'os pa'i rgyan bstan te/ rang gis shes don gyi dngos po mtshungs bon dang ldan pa zhig bsgrub bya ru bkod pa'i rjes/ de sgrub byed de'i bon dang gang dang mtshungs ba'i don gzhan zhig bkod nas/ bsgrub byar 'os pa'i khyad bon ldan pa'i bon khyad 'phags la/ sgrub byed 'os par bkod de sgrub pa'i cha nas rang lugs la 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan du bzhag kyang rung ngo //gzhung las/ 'khrul bral rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang /tshad ldan skyes bur gshe ba gang /thar pa'i srog gcod ha la dang /mthun pa'i rnam 'byed 'os par gozhes dbya da gsum rnam par dag pas grub pa rgyal bstan rin po che dang / de nyid 'dzin skyongs spel gsum byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa la gshe bskur dang sma 'beb byed pa'i skye bo rnams ni/ dper na mi lus rin po che 'di la brten nas thar pa'i go 'a phang thob par mi nus pa ha la nag po'i dug dang khyad med pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ de yang bsgrub bya ni/ rgyal ba'i

—205—bstan pa dang / bstan 'dzin skyes bu la gshe bskur mi rung ba dang / sgrub byed ni gal srid byas na dug ha la nag po zos pa dang / khyad med do zhes so//sha shes rab byams mas 'dzum ldan zhal bstan pas/khro bdag klad 'gems rgol ngan phyogs zlog mdzad/mthu byin rno la myur ba me char dang /'dra ba'i phrin las de ltar mi rigs sam/rdzogs sku shes rab byams mas 'dzum pa'i zhal bstan pa tsam gyis/mu stegs kyi ston pa rgol ba'i khro bdag gi rgol ba rnams dmigs med du gzhil bas/ dper na byams ma chen mo ni thugs rje che zhing thabs la mkhas pa ste/ pha rol gyi rgol ba rang dbang med par gzhom pa la gzhigs na/ byams ma'i thugs rje ni nam mkha'i thog dang 'dra ba lta bu'o//ra/ 'di phyi gtan gyi skyabs gnas bla ma lha'i/gdam pa zab mo nod la rdzun 'dzin pa'i/snod med 'khor mtshor byings pa'i skye bo 'di/mu stegs log pa can dang mthun par 'os/'os shing mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/gzhung las/ bsgrub bya 'os dang mi 'os gnyis/sgrub byed nus ldan 'os mi 'os/zhes 'os shing mi 'os pa'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi bkod pa'am 'dod pya'i bsgrab bya 'os pa dang mi 'os pa gnyis sngon du bkod rjes/ phyi mar de ba ༄byed nus can dngos po gzhan zhig gis/ gong gi ci —bsgrub bya 'os pa dang mi ces sam yang na nus pa dang mi nus pa gnyis so

—206— so nas bsgrub nus pa'i don gzhan zhig bkod nas brjod pa la don gzhan bkod pa'i mi 'os 'os pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ 'phags pa rnams kyis bdag med kun/rtogs kyi so so skye bos min/rta bdun can gyis mun pa kun/ sel gyis srin mjug 'o dadzhakyis min/zhes bdag med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa ni 'phags pa rnams kyis rtogs pa ni 'os pa la/ de las gzhan pa'i so so'i skye bo rnams kyis rtogs par mi srid cing mi 'os pa bsgrusmebya/ sgrub byed ni thun gsum mun pa sel ba'i gnyen po ni mkha' la shar ba'i nyi ma las/ srin 'bu me khyer gyi mun pa gsal mi nus pa bzhin no//sha skya rengs nu bos dug can lto 'gro kun /za bar nus kyi bya phran phal gyistomin/maphyortsal che bas skyon rnams gel rgyur mod/r+ha chung rnams kyis de ltar ci ste nus/zhes skya rengs nu bo ni bya rgyal khyung chen la zer gyi/ bya khyung gis sbrul gdug pa can rnamaspodabang du bsdus te zas su bza' bar nus pa ni bsgrub par 'os pa dang / bya phran gzhan gyi dbang du bsdus pa dang bza' bar nus pa bsgrub par mi 'os pa ste/ sgrub byed ni mthu byin phul du phyin pa'i bla ma dam pas/ lha 'dre bran du bkur nus la/ blo chung khongs dge rang 'dod can rnams kyis mi nus pa bzhin zhes sgrub byed du bkod pa'o//ra/ blo gros rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i skyes bu des/don ldan rig pa'i gsang tshig sgrogs par spro/ 'jo sgeg gzan la rol ba'i skye bo rnams/

—207—mkhas pa'i 'du rar 'grim pa'i go skabs dben/mi 'os shing 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/gzhung las/ mi 'os—'os pa'i bsgrub bya dag sgrub byed nus ldan mi 'os 'os/zhes rkang pa dang po'am snga ma gnyis la bsgrub bya mi 'dra ba mi 'os pa dang 'os pa gnyis bkod thog de sgrub byed dngos po mi 'os pa'i sgrub byed dang 'os pa'i sgrub byed gnyis don gzhan zhig nas bkod thog gong gis bsgrab bya de nyid nges par du sgrub nus pa'i dngos can gzhan zhig gi mi 'os pathe sgrub mi 'os shing 'os pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ mkhas pas log pa'i lung ston na/blun pos nor yang lhan skyes gshis/ma mas zas la dug sbyar na/sha snos sbyar yang 'os pa'i gnas/zhes bsgrub bya mi 'os pa ni mkhas pa dam pas log pa'i lam ston pa dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs sam log par 'khrid pa mi rig pa'am mi 'os pa dang / 'os pa ni blun pos log par 'khrid 'os pa'arme srid pa gnyis bsgrub byar bkod nas/ rim bzhin de sgrub byed gnyis mi 'os pa sgrub byed ni ma mas bu la zas dug sprad mi srid pa'am mi 'os pa dang / rang la sdang ba'i dgras zas dug sprod 'os pa'am srid pa lta bu'o//sha bru ston rgyal ba rtogs 'dzin dang ldan na/rtogs ldan ba rnams mtshan mar ci mi sprod/gang des skal ldan log par khrid pas na/blun sgom gol bar 'phyan yang ci mi 'os/

—208—zhes bru yi ston pa rgyal g.yung drung la bdag 'dzin gyi mtshan mas 'ching ba de mi 'os pa'i bsgrub bya dang / 'os pa'i sgrub bya ni/ tha mal ba'i rtogs lden ming tsam 'dzin mkhan gyi bdag 'dzin gyi blos bden par 'dzin nas spu+od pa gnyis bsgrub bu dang / sgrub byed bru ston bla mas sems can rnams log pa'i lam la 'khrid mi srid cing srid pa ni mi 'os pa'i sgrub byed dang / yang dag pa'i don la blo ma phyogs pa'i blun pos log par gol ba 'os pa'am srid pa bzhichu zhes brjod pa'o//ra/ bla mas nor la zhan chags na/skye bos ser sna rang bzhin gshis/btsun pas ma byin pa blang na/byi las rkun bu dngos po'i gshis/zhes snyan ngag rin chen lde'u mig 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las/ don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa ste bdun pa'o//

— 209—ldog pa can gyi rgyan/mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don/gzhung las/ mtshungs pa dngos sam shugs bstan yang /'byed byed bkod pa ldog pa can/zhes ldog pa can rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ gang zhig dpe dang dpe can gnyis so sor bkod thog mtshon bya dpe can dang mtshon byed dpe gonyis kyi dbar phan tshun mtshungs gsal gyi sgra dngos shugs gang rung gi — brjod pa'am yang na/ don skabs thob kyi sgo nas shugs la bstan pa sogs ci rigs kyis/ rang gi brjod 'dod kyi dngos po gnyis phan tshun mtshungs par brjod nas/ slar 'byed byed kyi bon 'ga' zhig bkod nas/ sngar phan lhun mtshungs par bajid pa las ldog te mi mtshungs par ston pa zhig la ldog gcan gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//dasar na/ skyes bu'i bzhin dang 'od dkar can/ — dkar zhing mdzes pa nyer mtshungs mod/de ni rgyu skar dbus su spa/khyed ni chab 'bangs khrod na brjid/ ces pa lta bu'o// ༷ne rdzi—dbye ba so so'i don ni/ gcig gi ldog pa can/ gnyis kyi ldog pa can/sbyan tsā'i ldog pa can/ 'gog pa'i ldog pa can/ gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can/rten gyi ldog pa can/ lhag pa'i ldog pa can/ 'byed byed sgras zin gyi ldog pa snyi ji mtshungs bon ma zin 'byed byed kyi sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can/ rigs gi bye lha/ nāsdi ldog pa can dang bcas bcu'o//wa skre disna sgyu~X rī

—21 0—gcig gi sdog pa can ni/gzhung las/ dpe don mtshungs sbyor dpe khyad re/'byed byed bkod pa gcig ldog ste/zhes gcig bi ldog pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa ste/ mtshon bya dpe can dang / mtshon byed kyi dpe gnyis so so nas bkod cing / phan tshun khyad bon du ma'i sgo nas de gnyis phan tshun mtshungs par ston pa'i sgra dngos shugs gang rung gis ston pa gang zhig la/ slar dpe don gyi khyad bon nam 'byed byed khyad par gcig bton nas/ de kho na rgyu mtshan du byas nas slar dpe don mi mtshungs par ston pa zhig la gcig ldog bya'o//gzhung las/ tshom rngam drag po'i 'jig rngam can/bdud 'dul drag chen rngam pa'i sku/'jig byed dus kyi me dpung dang /mtshungs kyang dur khrod chas kyis 'byed/ces dpe can drag po'i tshad bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i bdud 'dul gsang ba drag chen dang / dpe me dpung rab tu 'khrugs pa bskal pa'i me dpung gnyis/ phan tshun dmar 'bar me ri rab tu 'bar ba sogs phan tshun mtshungs par bstan zhing / slar don gyi khyad par dur khrod kyi chas chen brgyad mi ldan pa kho na rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ dpe de dpe can dang mi mtshungs par bstan pa'o// de yang drag po'i tshad bcu gcig ni/ 'gying ba/brjid pa/ dpa' ba/ sgeg pa/ gtum pa/ rngam pa/ gshe ba/ bzhad pa/gzir ba/ rlog pa/ khros pa'i tshul dang brtsu gcig ni drag po'i tshad do//dur khrod chas brgyad ni/ rus rgyan/ thod 'phreng / g.yang gzhi/ ko long /shun dmar/ stag sham/ sbral gyi rkad rags/ thod rlong do shal dang brgyad do// rī

—21 1 —sha 'dul bstan 'dzin skyongs skal ldan rjes su 'dzin/rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob gshen ston nam mkha'i mtshan/mu cho ldem drug dang mtshungs dam pa khyod/gangs can gshen bstan spel te tha dad do//zhes mtshon bya ni phyi 'dul ba'i bstan pa 'dzin mkhan gyi skyes bu gshen ston nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ni/ rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob mu cho ldem drug dang rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob yin pa/ 'dul bstan spel ba sogs khyad can du ma'i sgo nas phan tshun mtshungs par sbyor nas/ slar dpe can gyi khyad par gshen ston nam mkha' ni bod gangs can gyi bstan pa spol ba sogs gnas gzhi tha dad pa gcig pu rgyu mtshan du byas nas gang las ldog ste phan tshun mi mtshungs par ston pa'o//sa tshang tshing rnam par bkra ba'i zhing /gangs can bsil ri'i grong khyer 'di/ngo mtshar lha yi zhing khams dang /mtshungs kyang dal 'gro'i mes pos 'byed/gnyis kyi ldog pa can ni/—gzhung las/ dpe don mtshungs kung so so'i khyad/r+sha ’ smi 'byed byed bkod pa gnyis sgrib ste/ zhes gnyis ldog gi mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang /762na byed dpe gnyis phan tshun khyad bon du ma'i sgo nas phan tshun mtshungs 1par brjo da nas bkod pa'i rjes/ slar dpe dang dpe can gnyis mi 'dra ba'i dzid bon so so nas bkod de/ sngar gyi mtshungs par brjod pa las ldeg ste mi mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gnyis bkod nas brjod pa zhig la gnyis kyis ldog pa zhis brjod pa'o//

— 2 1 2—gzhung lar+sā / dbyangs can ma dang rgyal bzhad yum/mtshar sdug kun dga'i dpal yin kyang /tshangs sras snang stong sgu ma'i 'phrul/rgyal yum gdos bcarme mtshan dpe'i rten/zhes dpe can lha mo dbyangs can ma dang / dpe byams ma'i rnam spral yum yo phyi rgyal bzhad ma gnyis phan tshun mtshungs bon mtshan dang dpe ༄ byed rab tu rdzogs pa dang / zhal mjal ba tsam gyi dga' ba ster nus pa'i sgo nas dpe dang dpe can du bkod thog de yang slar dpe dang dpe can gnyis mi mtshungs pa'i rnam pa ni/ dpe can dbyangs can ma ni snang stong sgya ma'i sku gdos bcas su ma grub la/ rgyal bzhad yum ni gdos bcas r+sha khrag gi phung po dang bcas pa so so nas bkod pas mi 'dra bar bstan pa'o//sha rdul brtsegs dbang po dang ni mi bdag khyed/gzi brjid rab 'bar brten zhing mngon par mtho/lhun po ri bdun kun gyi bla na 'phags/gang khyed rgyal phran du ma'i dbus na 'gying /zhes dpe can ri rgyal lhun po dang dpe rgyal po gnyis phan tshun sku gzi brjid dang ldan zhing / gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa sogs rgyu mtshan du byas nas phan tshun mtshungs par brjod cing / slar mi mtshungs pa ri rgyal ni gser gyi ri bdun gyi rtse nas mtho zhing mngon par 'phags pa ma zad/mi rgyal ni rang gi 'khor rgyal phran rnams kyi dbus na brjid par gnas pa sogs so so nas 'byed byed bkod pa'o//ra/ yid 'ong rmad byung sde dang ngang pa'i khyu/ngur smrig mdzes pa'i sham bus ragatu mdzes/don ldan bslab gsum tshul khrims rtsa bas spud/

— 2 1 3 — gnyis skyes pho nyas chags 'khor rang khar spyod/sbyar ba'i ldog pa can ni/gzhung las/ dpe don mtshungs bon gcig sbyar bas/khyad 'gas sor 'byed sbyar ldog ste/zhes sbyar ba'i ldog pa'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ khyad gzhi dpe dang dpe can gnyis so sor bkod pa'i khar/ dpe don gnyis kyi khyad bon du ma'i sgo nas phan tshun spyi khyab kyi sgra sbyar nas mtshungs par bstan pa gang zhig slar dpe dang don gyi khyad bon thun min re bkod cing / de mi 'dra ba'i khyad par so sosanas bstan pas/ sngar mtshungs pa de las ldog te mi mtshungs par lhan pa zhig la sbyar ldog ces bya'o//ci gzhung las/ mdzes ma'i lus dang dpe sdong gnyis/ — phra ldem ke sa rab mdzes pa/mtshungs kyang 'dzum ldan bung ba dang /ri/ r+ṣa gcig shos skye bo'i rtse dga' 'o //zhes khyad gzhi dpe can mdzes ma bud med kyi lus dang / dri ldan pad —rma'i sdong po gnyis kyi khyad bon phra zhing mnyen pa ma zad/ ke sa ra zhes pa me togadzize'u 'bru dang dbu skra gnyis la go zhing phan tshun mtshungs bon sbyar ba casgotshe da/ slar de las ldog ste me tog gi khyad bon ni bung ba dga' bar byed pa tsho/rnyi da tshwapo bud med mdzes ma des skye bo'i tshogs kun la rtse dga' rol ba bcas so sor ston pa'o// sha mi lus bsam legs klu rgyal 'jog po gnyis/ma hā bya/ na se dang ham sa bcas/mtshungs med de ni lag 'gro'i bdag bo ste/khyed ni dbu nag mi la dbang mdzad do//

—21 4—zhes khyad gzhi dpe rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs dang / klu yi rgyal po 'jog po gnyis ma hā mā na zhes glang po che dang mtsho chen gnyis la go zhing / ham sa zhes mi dang ngang pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sogs phan tshun mtshungs par ston zhing / slar de las ldog pa ni mtshungs med bla ma dam pa ni glad po che'i bdag po dang / klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen ni mgo nag mi la dbang bar mdzad pa sogs khyad bon so sor baji+od pa'o//ra/ 'phags zhing 'ol gling gangs can sman gyi lngongs/gtsang mdzes rgyal ba'i basmi gnas mngon dga'i dpal/mtshungs kyang sman ljongs so skye'i mthong byed yul/so ka bon gnas las can skyes bu'i zhing /'gog pa'i ldog pa can ni/gzhung las/ dpe don phan tshun sbyar ba'i dpe/don mtshon nus 'gog 'gog ldog ste/zhes 'gog pa'i ldog pa can gyi rgyan bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang /mtshon byed dpe gnyis so sor bkod thog phan tshun khyad bon du ma'i sgo nas sgra don ci rigs sbyar te mtshungs par sbyor zhing / slar dpe de dpe can dang mtshungs pa 'gog byed ni dpe la khyad bon de mi ldan pa'i skyon dang /dpe can nam don la ldan pa'i khyad bon zhig brjod nas dpe don dang mtshungs par bkag nas/ mi mtshungs par ston pas 'gog ldog ces bya'o//gzhung las/ dkar gsal gangs ri'i gzi mdangs can/phas rgol 'jom pa'i skad gsang yang /rnam dpyod dben pa'i gdong lnga pa/mkhas pa'i rtsod zur nam zhig 'gyus

—21 5—zhes dpe can phyu sras keng tse len med dang / dpe gangs kyi seng ge gnyis khyad bon sku mardog dkar po gangs ri'i 'od 'chang ba dang / rgol ba gzhan rnams 'jom byed kyi skad gsang snyan par sgrogs pa sogs phan tshun sbyar nas mtshungs par brjod nas/ slar dpe seng ge la bcu phrag rig pa'i yon tan mi ldan pa'i skyon gyis gang gi phyu sras kyi dpe zur mi ldanari te/masas pa'i rnam dpyod 'gran pa'i rla bo mi 'gyur ro zhes pa lta bu'o//sha lus rnams dkar zhing 'khor lo'i lag pa ldan/mgrin dbyangs snyan 'jibs rna bar sgrogs mod kyang /blun zhing brtse sems dang bral ngang mo de/tshangs pa'i sras mo'i 'gran rlar ci zhig 'gyur/zhis mtshon bya dpe can lha mo dbyangs can ma dang / mtshon byed dpe ngang mo'i khyu gnyis te/ sku lus dkar ba zhes pa tshangs sras ma bstan zhing /'khor lo'i lag pa ldan zhes pas/ ngang pa'i mngon brjod du bshad pas/de gnyis mthun zhing sbyar ba'i khyad bon mgrin pa'i blu dbyangs shin tu snyan zhing rkun gyi rna dbang 'phrog pa'i khyad par phan tshun mtshungs par brjod pa dang / slar de las ldog te gzhan phan gyi snying brtse dang rang bzhin blun pa sogs kyiskyon dang bcas pa'i ngang mo des/ gzhan phan bcu rig ster ba'i lha sku1 dbyangs can ma la nam yang 'gran pa'am mtshungs par nus pa 'ashog pa'o//ma rmad byung tshu 'dzin khongs seng na/gzhan yid 'phrog pa'i dbyangs snyan ma/snying po dben pa'i dbyar skyes ngagalha mo'i gsungs la do zu dben/

—21 6—gtan tshig can gyi ldog pa ni/ gzhung las/ dpe dang mtshungs kyang khyad par 'ga'i/rgyu mtshan gyis 'byed gtan tshig ldogaces gtan tshig gi ldog pa can gyi don bstan te/ rang gi brjod 'dod kyi dngos po gang yang rung ba gnyis/ mtshon bya dang mtshon byed du bkod nas/ phan tshun mtshungs bon 'ga'i sgo nas mtshungs par ston zhing / slar dpe can gyi khyad bon nam yon tan zhig rgyu mtshan nam gtan tshig tu byas nas/ sngar mtshungs pa las ldog te mi mtshungs par ston par byed pa'i rgyan zhig la gtan tshig ldog pa zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ thun mtshams gsar pa'i mdangs chags shing /gsung snyan dal 'gro gzabs na yang /gzhan phan bral ba'i ngang mo'i khyu/byang sems pa las cung zad dman/zhes dpe can bslab ldan byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa'i sde dang / dpe ngang pa'i khyu tshogs gnyis khyad bon dmar ser mdangs 'chang gos dang / gsung dbyangs snyan pa sogs phan tshun mtshungs par brjod de/ slar gzhan phan gyi sems de rgyu mtshan du byas nas g.yung drung sems dpa' las dman pas mtshungs par mi nus te/ dpe ngang pa'i khyu la byang chub kyisems med pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu'o//sha smra ba'i dbang phyug rgol ba'i tshogs las rgyal/mkhyen pa'i mdzod 'dzin blo mun sel mod kyang /g.yung drung sems dang bral ba'i me bzhi skyes/dmu rgyal nyi ma'i dbang po nyid bas dben/

—21 7—zhes mtshon bya dpe can dmu rigs 'phrul gyi gdung sras gshen nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang / mtshon byed dpe ni me bzhi skyes zhes gza' phur bu'i mngon brjod de/ phan tshun mtshungs bon pha rol gyi rgol ba'i tshogs las rgyal zhing / bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la dbang bsgyur ba 'khor tshogs ril bcu rig gi blo gros stsol ba sogs la brten nas mtshungs par brjod cing / dpe can gyi khyad bon gzhan phan brtse ba dang snying rje sems bskyed sogs bral ba'i gza' phur bus smra dbang nyi ma rgyal mtshan la mtshon mi nus pa'i gtan tshigs su bkod pa'o//ra/ phun tshogs bsil zer 'bum gyis nyer drangs pa'i/yid 'ong mdzes ldan kun d+ngha dkar po'i sder/r+sha blo ldan rkang drug rtag tu rtsen na yang /zag med gshen lha'i sku rlar btegs mi 'os rten gyi dbye ba'i ldog pa can ni/gzhung las/ brten pa'i khyad par shugs mtshungs pa/rten khyad gyis 'byed rten ldog ste/zhes rten gyi ldog pa'i rgyan gyi don bstan te/ gang zhig dpe dang dpe can gnyis bkod nas mtshungs sgras dngos su ma zin yang—/ mtshungs bon shugs la khyad gzhi de gnyis kyi brten pa'i bon ston zhing / slar de gnyis rten gzhi'i khyad par ram rten gnas kyi khyad par tha dad pa dang mi mtshungs rnam/ 'i ston pas rten ldog gi rgyan zhes brjod do// sgo kha las/ rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs dang / ri yam̐/ ri byang chub ljon pa gnyis kyi khyad/dpag bsam lha ri del dkar rtser/rgyal gshen bsril mo'i ljongs la gnas/

— 2 1 8— zhes brten pa dpe can ni/ zhang bod kyi rgyal po rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs dang / dpe dpag bsam ljon shing gnyis phan tshun mtshungs gsal gyi sgra ma sbyar yang / shugs la legs byas kyi dri bsung lha dang mi yi gsos su smin pa sogs la brten nas dpe dang dpe can du go zhing / rten gzhi'i khyad par gyis dper na ri rgyal gyi rtse dang gangs can gyi ljongs gnyis phan tshun mi mtshungs pas/ mtshungs pa las ldog par ston pa'o//sha 'gro ba'i mgon po sangs rgyas sman gong ba/yid bzhin dbang rgyal gnyis kyi dbye ba'i khyad/nor bu rlab 'phreng can gyi 'jing na gnas/rje khyed kha ba can gyi gdul bya'i dpyid/ces dpe can brten pa'i rje btsun sman gong ba zhes 'gro mgon mar ston rgyal legs dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che gnyis phan tshun dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'jotshuba'i rgyu mtshan gyis shugs la mtshungs par brjod pa ma zad/ rten gzhi'i khyad par ni nor bu ni rgya mtsho chen po'i gting la gnas pa dang / rje smanatsigong ba ni bod kha ba can gyi yul du bzhugs pa sogs rten gzhi mi mtshungs pas/ snga ma'i mtshungs brjod la ldog te mtshungs par ston pa'o//ra / mtshar sdug rnamajipar bkra ba dbang gzhu'i gur/cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsil zer can/chu shel thun gsum gzhil yang ri rgyal skad/gshen lha gtsang lnga'i yang steng 'og min zhing /dpe tsan lhag pa'i ldog pa can ni/gzhung las/ dpe don shugs mtshungs deperir med pa'i/don khyad kyis 'byed lhagaldog ste/

—21 9—zhes lhag pa'i ldog pa'i rgyan gyi don bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang mtshon byed dpe gnyis phan tshun mtshungs gsal gyi sgra dngos su gsal yang / shugs la mtshungs par go nus pa dang / gang zhig khyad bon phul byung zhig dpe can la ldan zhing dpe la med pa zhig bkod nas/ dpe can de dpe las lhag pa dngos su bstan nas brjod pa'i rgyan zhig la/ lhag ldog can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o// rigazhung las/ bang rim can la mkhyen brtse dang /mtshan dpe nges pa'i tho yig med/ cir yang sprul pa'i sku mchog la/zag pa med pa'i yon tan rdzogs/zhes dpe ri rgyal lhun po dang / dpe can zag pa dang bral ba'i gshen rab mi bo gnyis phan tshun mtshungs gsal gyi sgra dngos su ma sbyar yang mtshungs par shugs la baji+od cing / dpe can de dpe las lhag pa'i yon tan/ nges pa'i tho yig bzhi bcu dang / mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis/dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu rtsa gcig sogs ldan la/ de yang gong gi nges pa'i thog yig bzhi bcu'i grangs cir ltar 'dod ce na/ nyi sgron las/ a ni skye med snying nas nges par yod pa'i tho yig ā+oṃ ni phung po bzhi la nges pa'i tho yig hūm̐ bzhi ni g.yas dkar g.yon dmar rtsa dang snying rtsa g.yas g.yon banganges par yod pa'i tho yig ka cha ja ba ma lnga ni/ 'byung ba lnga la nges ji sgong yod pa'i tho yig pa kha tsha nya tha ya ho sha brgyad ni/ rnam shes brgyad 'di rdo s+t+ra sa par yod pa'i tho yig la nga wa ca pha ha dang drug ni/ gnas drug la ngegapar yod pa'i tho yig ra ga tsa ja na za gathe brgyad ni/ yul brgyad la jinges par yod pa'i tho yig rngog da zha hu bzhi/ yan lag bzhi la nges par yod pa'i tho yig ta 'a he sgo bzhin ni/ ag sho ngag la nges par yod pa'i

—220— tho yig hi lcags kyus thams cad 'dren par mjub mo bzhi la nges par yod pa'i tho yig ste zhe lnga'o//sha srid pa'i sgron mes las can mtha' dag la/bka' lung 'doms dang rjes su 'dzin nus dben/bstan pa'i sgron me skyabs ston rin chen 'od/ rnam kun yorme tan khyad 'phags de dag ldan/zhes mtshon bya dpe can ni skubs stan rin chen 'od zer dang /mtshon byed dpe nyi ma ste phan tshun khyad bon 'gro phan ris med bde ba ster ba sogs mtshungs pa dngos su ma sbyar yang / shugs la rtogs nus shing /dpe can gyi khyad bon 'khor la rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'phags pa'i lung rnams 'chad cing / bstan pa'i rjes su 'dzin pa'i yon tan de dag dpe la mi ldan pas daṣ+pecan lhag pa ston pa bcas kyis 'byed pa'o //ra/ snyan 'gyur ngag la dbang bsgyur mgrin sngon mar/thar mchog nges par 'byin pa'i brjod don dben/dal 'bab mdzod las 'khrungs pa lha'i bu mos/phan bde'i 'bras bzang bcu rig 'dod pa 'jo/sgra yis zin pa'i ldog pa can ni/gzhung las/ dpe don mngon mtshungs mthun bon gsal/'byed byed sgras zin ldog pa ste/zhes sgras zin gyi ldog pa can gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ mtshon bya dpe can dang de mtshon byed kyi dpe gnyis kyi mtshungs bon dngos su bstan zhing /mtshungs gsal gyi sgra dngos su ma sbyar yang shugs la mtshungasdo/ par go nus pa la/ so so'i ngos nas so sor 'byed byed kyi khyad bon sgras zin dngos su bkod pa zhig la sgras zin gyi ldog pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//

— 221 —gzhung las/ 'a zha'i thugs dang 'chi med lam/bsam yangs dngas gsal spros mtha' bral/sngo bsang gsal 'tsher nyi rla'i zhing /gang thugs sgrib med mkhyen brtse'i gter/zhes mtshon bya 'gro mgon 'a zha blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dang /mtshon byed nam mkha' gnyis mtshungs bon gting zab cing brtags dka' ba gsal zhing sgrib pa dang bral ba dngos su bstan pas/ phan tshun mtshungs par rtogs nus shing / slar dpe don so so'i ngos nas/ dpe nam mkha' ni nyi rla bsgrod sa'i gzhi yin zhing / 'a zha'i thugs ni mkhyen pa dang brtse ba'i yon tan thams cad 'byung sa'i gzhi ru nges pa bcas/ so so nas sgras zin gyi 'byed byed khyad bon bkod pa'o//sha tshe mchog mtha' yas sku dang ke la sharab tu dkar zhing gzi 'od 'bar ba ste/gangs kyi ri nas bsil chu klung du 'bab/bder gshegs thugs las tshe yi dngos grub spro/zhes mtshon bya dpe can ni tshe yi lha tshe mchog mtha' yas kyi sku dang /mtshon byed dpe ni ke la sha zhes gangs kyi ri bo gnyis phan tshun mtshungs bon rab tu dkar zhing 'od mdangs g.yo ba'i khyad bon mtshungs kyang dngos su mtshungs gsal ma sbyar thog shugs la rtogs zhing / slar so so'i khyad thoni tshe yi lhas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol gdang / gangs kyi ri bos rtsu bzhi phyogs su 'jo ba bcas so sor 'byed byed sgras zin du bkod pa'o// lda/ lang tsho'i mgron byis bsus pa'i sgra 'dzin ma/dpyid kyi dpal mor 'grogs pa'i u dpal gnyis/mdzes kyang dri ldan rkang pa drug pa'i gsos/

—222—yid 'ong sgro ldan sgra rgyal ngag la 'grogs/mtshungs bon ma zin 'byed byed kyi sgras zin pa'i ldog pa ni/gzhung las/ dpe don shugs mtshungs mthun bon gab/khyad bon gsal ba'i ldog pa ste/zhes mtshungs bon ma zin 'byed byed kyi sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya gang yang rung ba zhig gi dpe dang dpe can gyi tshul du so sor bkod nas/ dpe don gnyis kyi thun mong mtshungs bon rnams dngos su ma bstan nas gab pa'i tshul du gnas shing /mtshungs sgra yang dngos su ma sbyar yang mtshungs pa shugs la go bar byas nas/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis phan tshun 'byed byed kyi sgras khyad bon so sor brjod pas mtshungs pa'i don las ldog par gyur ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ gzha' ris sna lnga mkha' yi rgyan/ye shes 'od lnga sems kyi rgyan/mkha' la nyi zu gza' skar bkrasems la 'khor 'das so sor bkrazhes mtshon bya dpe can ni sems nyid dam sems/ mtshon byed dpe ni nam mkha' gnyis phan tshun mtshungs sgra sogs dngos su ma sbyar yang /shugs la rgya che gting zab mtha' dang bral ba sogs gab nas dngos su ma smos kyang / shugs la mtshungs par go ba ma zad/ 'byed byed sgras zin gyi bon ni/ dpe nam mkha' la nyi ma dang zu ba skar ma sogs kyi zhing du brtan zhing / dpe can sems la 'khor ba'i bon dang myang 'das kyi bon thams cad kyi 'byung gnas thims pa'i gzhir gyur ba bcas/ mtshungs pa ldog pa'i khyad bon sgras zin la smos pa'o//sha phang phung lo 'bras sa mchog ljon pa'i dpyid/

—223—rnam gsum na bza' rnam par 'dren khyod rgyan/ljon pa'i tshal du 'dab chags skad snyan sgrogs/khyed kyi 'khor du slob mas zhu mchid gleng /zhes dpe can rnam 'dren rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / dpe dpag bsam gyi ljon pa gnyis kyi phan tshun mtshungs bon 'gro la phan bde'i sbyin brgya 'gyed pa'am/ skye 'gro'i gsos su gyur ba rnams dngos su ma smras shing gab pa ma zad/ dam pa'i sku la na bza' rnam pa gsum gyis brgyan patsāzhes gzhan sdes rmad 'og rmad sham/ pad lham gsum du 'dod pa'i lugs kyang yod/dpag bsam ljon pa la lo 'bras yal gas brgyan pa sogs kyi shugs la phan tshun mtshungs par rtogs shing / slar sgras zin gyi khyad bon ni/ dpag bsam ljon pa la bya rigs sna tshogs 'dus shing brtse ba ma zad/ bla ma dam pa la 'khor/ thar pa'i lam la zhugs pa'i bu slob 'khor bcas 'chad rtsod rtsom la brtson pa bcas mtshungs pa ldog byed kyi sgras zin du bkod pa'o//ra/ thun mtshams gsar pa rta bdun dbang po'i grogs/ngur smrig na bza' rnam dag 'dul ba'i rgyan/ tsha zer can des gling bzhi'i mun pa gzhil/'dul ba'i rgyal pos 'khor ba'i ba mo gzhom/rigs mthun las 'byed pa'i ldog pa can ni/gzhung las/ dpe don rigs mthun dpe can gyis/dben pas 'byed pa rigs mthun ldogaces rigs mthun gyi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis so so nas bkod thog de gnyis kyi byed las sam khyad bon 'ga' zhig phan tshun byed las kyis sgo nas/ phyi rol gyi bon rigs mthun tshul mtshungs pa'i rigs mthun yang / dpe dang dpe can gnyis 'byed

—223—rnam gsum na bza' rnam par 'dren khyod rgyan/ljon pa'i tshal du 'dab chags skad snyan sgrogs/khyed kyi 'khor du slob mas zhu mchid gleng /zhes dpe can rnam 'dren rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / dpe dpag bsam gyi ljon pa gnyis kyi phan tshun mtshungs bon 'gro la phan bde'i sbyin brgya 'gyed pa'am/ skye 'gro'i gsos su gyur ba rnams dngos su ma smras shing gab pa ma zad/ dam pa'i sku la na bza' rnam pa gsum gyis brgyan patsāzhes gzhan sdes rmad 'og rmad sham/ pad lham gsum du 'dod pa'i lugs kyang yod/dpag bsam ljon pa la lo 'bras yal gas brgyan pa sogs kyi shugs la phan tshun mtshungs par rtogs shing / slar sgras zin gyi khyad bon ni/ dpag bsam ljon pa la bya rigs sna tshogs 'dus shing brtse ba ma zad/ bla ma dam pa la 'khor/ thar pa'i lam la zhugs pa'i bu slob 'khor bcas 'chad rtsod rtsom la brtson pa bcas mtshungs pa ldog byed kyi sgras zin du bkod pa'o//ra/ thun mtshams gsar pa rta bdun dbang po'i grogs/ngur smrig na bza' rnam dag 'dul ba'i rgyan/ tsha zer can des gling bzhi'i mun pa gzhil/'dul ba'i rgyal pos 'khor ba'i ba mo gzhom/rigs mthun las 'byed pa'i ldog pa can ni/gzhung las/ dpe don rigs mthun dpe can gyis/dben pas 'byed pa rigs mthun ldogaces rigs mthun gyi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ dpe dang dpe can gnyis so so nas bkod thog de gnyis kyi byed las sam khyad bon 'ga' zhig phan tshun byed las kyis sgo nas/ phyi rol gyi bon rigs mthun tshul mtshungs pa'i rigs mthun yang / dpe dang dpe can gnyis 'byed

—224—byed kyi khyad par dpe can gyi khyad bon nam rigs de rang bzhin sogs kyi sgo nas khyad par tha dad gnas pa'i dbang gis so sor ldog pas na/ rigs mthun pa las tha dad 'byed pa'i ldog pa can zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ nyi ma'i zer gyis mi non zhing /nam mkha'i bla bres mi sgrib pa'i/bstan 'gror lhag bsam dkar ba'i zus/rnam dkar rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams bskyed/ces dpe rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar ba'i khyad dang / 'gro drug sems can rnams la phan bde 'byung 'dod kyi dam pa'i thugs rgyud dang /dpe nya rgyas che ba gnyis phan tshun gnyis ka'i byed las 'phel bar byed pa'i rigs mthun la/ dpe can la khyad bon sprin gyis mi sgrib pa dang / nyi ma'i 'od kyi mi non pa sogs kyi rang bzhin des rang gi dpe'i rigs de las mthun pa las ldog pa'o//sha sor bcu'i 'phrul dang rtsol bas mi dkrol zhing /ngar ldan mtshon cha rnon pos zlog min pa'i/dngos 'dzin 'khrul bas dam du bcings pa 'dis/bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab ring du bskal/zhes dpe bdag 'dzin gyi ma rig pa dang / dpe can bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab gnyis khyad bon nam byed las sor bcu'i 'phrul gyis rtsol bas mi dkrol zhing / ngar ldan mtshon cha rnon pos zlog tu med pa yin pa mthun la/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi khyad bon la rtsol bas mi dgrol ba ma yin pa'i khyad bon dang ldan pa bcas so//ra/ bsil chab bsil ma'i khrus kyis mi 'dag la/dpal dum dri gzhon bzang pos mi bsang ba'i/

log rtogs bag chags ngan pa'i dri ma 'dis/phan bde'i snang ba dkar po 'gog par byed/ces snyan gzhung rin chen lde mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las ldog pa'i rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa ste brgyad pa'o//

—226—srid pa can gyi rgyan/mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ yongs su grags pa'i rgyu bkag nas/'bras bu gsal ston srid pa'i rgyan/zhes srid pa can rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya gang yang rung ba zhig gi skye byed kyi rgyu yongs grags 'jig (rten na bshad pa'am grags che ba'i rgyu de 'gog byed kyi dgag tshig sbyar nas/ de las gzhan pa'i phyi nang gi rgyu mtshan cung zad tsam mam/ yongs su grags ma grags gnyis kar ma ltos par/ rang gi ngo bo 'byung srid tsam ston pa'i tshig nyams ldan zhing mtshar ba'i rnam pa brjod par ston pa la srid pa can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na/ mthing gi byug min lha lam sngo/sus kyang ma byas rgya khyan yangs/ma bkod rgyu skar tshom bus mdzes/tsha 'ded med par dal med 'gro zhes pa lta bu'o//dbye ba so so'i don ni/ phyi yi srid pa can gyi rgyan/ nang gi srid pa can gyi rgyan/ ngo bo ston pa'i srid pa canartagyi rgyan dang gsum yod/phyi yi srid pa can gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rig pas ma zin phyi yi bon/rgyu bkag 'bras ston phyi srid can/zhes phyi srid can gyi rgyan bstan te/ shes pa'am rig pas zin ma zin gnyis su'am/ phyi don bem po dang / nang don bem po gnyis su phyes nas/skabs 'dir shes pas ma zin pa'i bon gang rung zhig gis yongs grags kyi

—22 7—rgyu rkyen 'ga' zhig bkag nas/ rgyu de dag la ma ltos par phyi yi rgyu cung zad tsam gyis mtshon pa'am/ phyi don kyi 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin dang sbyar te 'bras bu srid pa tsam ston par brjod pa'i rgyan zhig la phyi srid can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ ma bstod gangs rgyal dpang re mtho/ma phyis dkar gsal dri med dgam brkos chu klung so sor 'beb/ma btegs gnas brgya'i bla na 'phags/zhes shes pas ma zin pa phyi yi bon du gyur ba gangs rgyal ti se 'di nid badzod bya ru bzung nas/ 'di'i khyad bon 'ga' 'grub byed kyi rgyu bkag ste 'bras bu grub par bstan pa ni/ yongs grags su dpang mtho ba la bstod pa ste brtsegs pa dang yang na spungs pa sogs la ltos dgos pa dang / dri ma med pa dngas shing gsal ba la rgyu khyad par can/ phyi bkru bdar gsum la ltos dgos pa dang / chu gter 'jo ba la yongs grags sa brko dgos pa ni rgyu'i khyad par du grub la kun gyi gtsug tu 'khur ba'am bstod na kun gyi bla na 'phags pa sogs yongs su grags kyang skabs 'dir de dag tshang ma bkag nas ngo bo'am khyad par srid pa tsam la btag nas gangs rgyal ti se ni ma bstod kyang dpang mtho ba / ma phyis kung dri med gsal ba/ ma bkos kung chu mig brdol ba/ ma btegs kyang bla na 'phags pa sogs yongs grags kyi rgyu rnams bkag ste 'bras bu grub par ston pa'o//sha gang na sa btsal min nyi 'od dro 'jam snyoms/ched du ma byas ljongs bkra'i rtsi thog rgyas/sus kyang ma bskul ku hu'i mgrin blu snyan/rab dga'i yid dbang 'dren byed dpyid kyi dpal/

—228—zhes dpyid dus kyi dpal yon brjod pa ste/ kun la drod cing 'jam pa'i phul byung / 5ོna tan thob pa la dang po btsal ba'am 'bad dgos pa ni rgyu khyad par can dang / mdog sngo zhing rtsi thog rgyas pa ni ched du gnyer nas bsgrub dgos pa rgyu'i khyad par can dang / blu len pa dang bro 'khrab pa ni de nyid bskul ba'i byed po zhig dgos pa sogs rgyu de dag mi dgos pa ste/'bras bu srid pa tsam du dro zhing 'jam pa / ljongs bkra'i rtsi thog rgyas pa/khu byug mgri+on blu sgrogs pa sogs rang bzhin tsam la brten nas 'bras bu grub par stan pa'//ra/ ma bskul rkang 'thung mgo lcog ldem/ma phyes ze'u 'bru so sor bzhad/ma bskrun kha dog rnam par bkram bkod 'dzin ma'i rgyan du gzab/nang gi srid pa can ni/gzhung las/ rig pas zin pa nang gi bon/rgyu bkag 'bras ston nang srid can/zhes phyi nang gnyis su phyes pa'i nang gi bon shes pas zin pa'am rig pas zin pa'i bon ga ge mo zhig gi khyad bon gang rung zhig grub pa la 'grub byed kyi rgyu khyad par can de dgos pa yongs grags yin na'ang / skabs 'dir yongs su grags pa'i rgyu de bkag nas shes pas zin pa'i skyes bu'i khyad bon nam/ sems ldan gyi khyad bon gang rung zhig gi 'bras bu ston pa zhig—la nang gi srid pa can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ ma spras dkar dmar mdangs kyis mdzes/ma bris mtshan dpe'i ri mo bkram brgyan mtshar rdzogs dbyangs can mas/

—228—zhes dpyid dus kyi dpal yon brjod pa ste/ kun la drod cing 'jam pa'i phul byung / 5ོna tan thob pa la dang po btsal ba'am 'bad dgos pa ni rgyu khyad par can dang / mdog sngo zhing rtsi thog rgyas pa ni ched du gnyer nas bsgrub dgos pa rgyu'i khyad par can dang / blu len pa dang bro 'khrab pa ni de nyid bskul ba'i byed po zhig dgos pa sogs rgyu de dag mi dgos pa ste/'bras bu srid pa tsam du dro zhing 'jam pa / ljongs bkra'i rtsi thog rgyas pa/khu byug mgri+on blu sgrogs pa sogs rang bzhin tsam la brten nas 'bras bu grub par stan pa'//ra/ ma bskul rkang 'thung mgo lcog ldem/ma phyes ze'u 'bru so sor bzhad/ma bskrun kha dog rnam par bkram bkod 'dzin ma'i rgyan du gzab/nang gi srid pa can ni/gzhung las/ rig pas zin pa nang gi bon/rgyu bkag 'bras ston nang srid can/zhes phyi nang gnyis su phyes pa'i nang gi bon shes pas zin pa'am rig pas zin pa'i bon ga ge mo zhig gi khyad bon gang rung zhig grub pa la 'grub byed kyi rgyu khyad par can de dgos pa yongs grags yin na'ang / skabs 'dir yongs su grags pa'i rgyu de bkag nas shes pas zin pa'i skyes bu'i khyad bon nam/ sems ldan gyi khyad bon gang rung zhig gi 'bras bu ston pa zhig—la nang gi srid pa can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ ma spras dkar dmar mdangs kyis mdzes/ma bris mtshan dpe'i ri mo bkram brgyan mtshar rdzogs dbyangs can mas/

—229—ma bos skye rgu'i dwangs ba 'dren/zhes khyad gzhi lha mo sgra dbyangs rgyal mo ste/ de'i khyad bon gyi rgyu bkag pa ni/ dper na/ yongs grags su dkar po dmar po'i mdangs bkra ba'am mdzes par byed pa'i rgyu ni tshon yin bzhin de bkag nas/ dbyangs can ma'i zhal mdangs dkar dmar mdangs kyis mdzes par ston pa dang /ri mo bkra ba ni rgyu bri ba las 'byung bzhin skabs 'dir mtshan bzang po dang dpe byad bzang po'i ri mo bkra ba zhes pas/ mtshan dpe ldan pa tsam gyis mtshan dpe'i ri mo bkra ba brjod pa'am sgrab/ shin tu yid du 'ong zhing mdzes rgyan phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dar sman la sogs kyi rgyan spud dgos pa gzhir bcag skabs 'dir de dag la ma ltos par rang bzhin gyi mtshar sdug rdzogs po yongs grags kyi rgyu dag bkag pa'am ma brtag par 'bras bu grub par bajid pa'//sha ga pur khu bas byug min bzhin mdangs dkar/sgrig mkhan med par so 'phreng tshar du dngar/ma bsdus na dar 'dod ldan g.yon mig kun/'gugs byed hri tsa gzhon nu'i mdzes sku'o//zhes nang gi shes pas zin pa'i bon rnams kyi khyad bon 'grub byed kyi rgyu dper na/ bzhin mdangs dkar po yong ba la ga pur byug dgos pa dang /rim bzhin tshar du bsgrig pa'am gra 'grigs pa la sgrig mkhan zhig dgos pa de med pa la gral rim 'grigs pa dang / 'gugs pa'am 'khor du sgyur ba la bsdu dgos pa'i rgyu de dag bkag nas/ so 'phreng bsgrig pa/ bzhin mdangs dkar ba/ bcas gang gi hri tsa zhes pa ni zhang skad de/ bu pho la zer ba bcas kyis go nus so//ra/ ma bsam bslab pa'i mgron po khongs su zhugs/

— 230—ma dor brtse ba'i dga' ma ring du song /ma btang lang tsho'i bkrag mdangs nyirme bzhin yal/ma bsgrubs mkhyen pa'i rtsal rdzogs sprul pa'i sku/'bras bu rang gi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i srid pa can ni/gzhung las/ bar ma'i rigs kyi rgyu bkag nas/'bras bu gsal ston ngo bo tsam/zhes ngo bo tsam ston pa'i srid pa can gyi rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/'jig rten na grags ma grags bar ma'i rigs kyi rgyu rnams bkag nas/ de dang lhan du ngo mtshar ba'i rgyu gzhan gang yang med pa'i sgo nas/ 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo tsam ya mtshan pa zhig gi ngo bo nyid kyi 'bras bu tsam ston pa'i rgyan zhig la bya'o//gzhung las/ ma bkrus 'dul khrims rnam par dgam bsdus rig pa'i gnas kun 'tshogs/ma btsal don ldan skyes bu gang /ma gzabs bstan pa'i rgyan du che/zhes rnam par dag pa la chus dri ma bkru dgos pa bkag nas/ 'dul khrims dri ma dang bral0bar ston pa dang / yongs grags la rig pa'i gnas kun rang rgyud du 'tshogs pa la re re bzhin sbung nas bsdu dgos shing de bkag nas/ kun 'tshogs par ston pa dang / dad ldan gyi bu slob btsal dgos pa bkag nas/ rgyal bstan rin po che'i rgyan du mdzes par gyur ba sogs yongs grags kyi rgyu dag bkag nas ngo bo tsam gyi 'bras bu grub par ston pa bcas so//sha phan sems kyis dben gzhan gyi re 'dod skong /'khon 'gras med parachodabul phongs rgud pa'i dgra

— 23 1 —phyogs ris bral yang kun la 'byung ba dka'/rgyu mtshan dben kyang dal 'bab mdzod du gnas/zhes gzhan dag sems can gyi 'dod don bskang ba la gzhan la phan pa'i sems sngon du 'gro dgos par gnas kyang / de dang bral nas gzhan gyi 'dod don sgrub nus pa dang / dbulda ba'i dgra bo min kyang dbul ba dang phongs pa'i rigs kun pham par byed pa zhes dbul ba las ldog ste phyug por 'asgyur ba/ bdag gzhan ris su med kyang / kun la khyab pa min pa dang / rgyu mtshan med par rgya mtsho'i klong du gnas pa 'di ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu'o zhes so// ra/ ma bsags zang zing nor gyis khengs/ma sbyang sgrib gnyis bag chags zad/ma bslab rig pa'i gnas kun mkhyen/ma bkod gser khri'i dbus na dpa'/zhes snyan ngag rin chen lde mig gi 'grel ba er sang bu mo'i mgul rgyan las srid pa can gyi rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa ste dgu pa'o//

bsdus brjod kyi rgyan ni/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don/gzhung las/ don bsam dpe khyad mngon brjod pas/brjod don bsdu ba bsdus brjod de/zhes bsdus brjod kyi rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi gang brjod par 'dod pa'i don nam baji+od don dpe can dngos po 'ga' zhig la bsam nas/ bsam bya'i dngos po de dang mtshungs pa'i dngos don zhig dper bkod cing / dpe de'i khyad gzhi dang khyad bon rnams rdzogs par dngos su brjod pa'i stobs kyis/ pha rol po rang gi bsam bya dngos po'i don de nyid brdzus te go bar byed par ston pa ste/ rang gi dpe can dngos su ma badzod kyang / dpe yi shugs kyi rtogs nus pa'am bsdus te go bar byed pa zhig la bsdus brjod kyi rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na/ gang zhig yan lag brgyad ldan chu/kun kyang 'thungs pas mi ngom par/chu gtsang yin na zag pa mang /gang nas btsal te 'thung la ltos/ zhes pa lta bu'o//dbye ba so so'i don la bzhi ste/ spyi yi bsdus brjod/ khyad par can gyi bsdus brjod/ don gyi khyad par sbyar ba'i bsdus brjod/ sngon na med pa'i bsdus brjod kyi rgyan dang bzhi'o//spyi yi bsdus brjod kyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ don bsam dpe khyad mngon brjod pas/don bsdu tsam ni spyi bsdus te/
