— 295 —su brjod pa'i tshig sbyor snyan 'jebs dang ldan pa'i sho lo ka la drag shul gyi nyams thun zhes bya'o// gzhung las/ srid gsum dbang bsgyur mthu mo che/g.yo ba'i gar gyis sa gzhi ldeganya ri rab 'dar zhing rgya mtsho 'chol/zhing bcu nyams pa khams su rol/zhes srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur ba'i ma mchog srid pa rgyal mos khros pa'i nyams 'gyur 'bum phrag g.yos pas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa la gnod skyel ba'i ma rung pa'i sde bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur ba rnams 'atul nas thar pa bde ba'i gnas su bkod pa ste/ bsgral ba'i zhing bcu ni/ dkon zhumachog gi dbu 'phang smad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ sems dpa'i 'dul sgo 'phrog pa/ theg pa che chung gi bon la smod pa/ bla ma'i shī la bdo ba/ g.yung drung spun la nang dbyen byed pa/ dge byed la bar du gcod pa/dam lbig— las la 'das pa/ snying rje med pa/ bon dang gshen po la log lta byed pa dang bcu'o//sha las log zhing bcu 'bum phrag skad cig gis/rjes med bsha' bshus byed la ches dpa' ba'i/bstan pa'i bka' srung dpal mgon lcam bral tshogs/snying khrag sha rus lngags par longs su spyod/spra ༷ṅka trezhes bdag cag ston pa'i sku'i 'dul dus su/ rgya kong tse 'phrul rgyal r+ṣa 7) 7tshesas khang dkar nag bkra gsal bzhengs pa la/ srin gyi bar chad 〉8cams dīmi la/ ston pa gshen rab rnam par rgyal ba'i sku ru bzhengs nas ṇ+ḍasmonaji skyo rterī gyi dpal mgon rnams dam la btags te bstan pa srungs bar ri ya stsa blang blozhin/ phyis bstan dgra nyams pa rnams bsgral ba'i phyir du dpal

—296—mgon rnamaru/ ngug po khros pa'i cha byed du sha khrag dmar la longs su spyod nas 'jigs tshul ston pa la/ sbyar nas bshad pa'o//ra/ tshe gcig grub pa brnyes pa'i gyer spungs kyis/ tshe dmigs bstan dgra'i bla dpal cog pa'i phyir/tshad ldan gser gyi dzā dmar phun gang gis/dam med rgyal 'gong thal bar brlag par grags/dpa' ba'i nyams kyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rgyu yi khyad par ma dmigs kyang /rang skya thub pa dpa' ba'i nyams/zhes dpa' nyams can gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang nyid kyi bya ba 'grub par 'os pa'i rgyu'i khyad par zhig sngon du ma bsgrub pa'am/ ma dmigs par rang nyid kyi 'dod pa'i don de nyid 'grub pa'i stobs kyis/nang gi spro nyams chen po zhig thos pa'i stobs kyis phyi yi rnam 'gyur yang spro ba'i nyams de mngon gsal dod po'i sgo nas tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan zhig la dpa' ba'i nyams kyi rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ tha snyad kun la ma sbyang zhing /lo mang dka' spyad bsgom bsgrub la/brtson pa min kyang klu dbang mtshan/bru zhu spa rme'u'i gtsug na rgyal/zhes mkhas par 'gyur ba la dang po tha snyad la byang chub par sbyangadagos pa la/ de nas nang don gyi rig par dka' spyad dang bla ma'i brdathabs la bsten dgos pa gzhir bcas kyang / mkhas pa'i dbang po dmurigs gshen gyi gdung sras gter ston gshen chen klu dga' ni/ skye ba 'dil tha snyad dang sgom sgrub sogs la brtson sbung mdzad pa dngos su ma gsal

—29 7 yang / 'dod don bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la rang dbang thob pa ma zad/ mkhas pa'i dbang po'i nyams kun ldan zhing / bru zhu spa rme'u sogs /mkhas grub dam pa 'byung ba'i gnas dmo pa rnams kyis kung gtsug tu khur bar gyur ba sags gsal bar brjad pa'//sha thos bsam sgom gsum dpyis phyin ma bslabs shing /mtshan gnyis dge la ma 'bad 'gro ba rnams/dang 'dren cha byed mi ldan grub pa'i dbang /kun gyi dpa' bo nyid gyur jo rnon rtse/zhes skye ba 'di yi dus su g.yung drung gi bon rin po che la thos pa'i shes rab dang / sgom pa'i shes rab/ bsam pa'i shes rab gsum gyis dpyad pa ma gnang zhing / mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi dge ba rnams la ma 'bad pa dang / shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i cha byad dang / mdzad spyod dang mi ldan pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad grub thob kyi mdzad pa kho nar zhugs shing / tshur snang la mdzad spyod ma nges pa sogs kyi bya ba la 'bad bzhin pa'i gter ston gu ru rnon rtse ni/ srid 'dir kun gyi mchog tu gyur ba'am/kun gyi phul du byung ba bskur bar 'os pa dang pa'i nyams can no zhes so//ra/ byed rtsol tshon gyi 'bad par ma ltos shing /g.yo thabs bslu ba'i tshig gis ma bran pa'i/mdzes pa gsum ldan yid 'ong tshangs sras ma/kho bo'i sning gi mdza' mor rol 'di phul/snying rje'i nyams rgyan ni/ ’ gzhung las/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bzod med la/ ji gdung tshig brjod pa snying rje'i nyams/

—298—zhes snying rje'i nyams rgyan gyi don bstan te/ yul gang yang rung ba zhig la shin tu sdug bsngal drag po bzod brlag med pa zhig myang bzhin pa'i yul dang 'phrad pa'i stobs kyis/ rang nyid gang zag de la shin tu snying rje chen po skyes pa'i rnam 'gyur rang dbang med par phyi la mngon pa'i gdung tshig gsal bar ston pa'i rgyan zhig la snying rje'i nyams zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ dal ldan rang dbang yod pa'i dus/brda 'jam rnyed bskur grags phyir 'breng /gces dbang 'gag shul me rlung chu/dug mtshon reg bya skyi re 'jigs/zhes dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i brlan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di thob pa'i dus/ yang dag pa'i bdag gzhan gnyis med kyi gzhi bzung nas thar pa'i don la ma bsam nas/ 'jig rten bon brgyad kho nar don du gnyer ba'i bla sprul 'ga'/ tshe yi 'phan pa rdzogs nas phyi ma'i lnga lam du phyin dus/las mkhan rnams kyis dbang med dmyal ba'i gnas su khrid nas gcod sbyang gi sdug bsngal bzod med myang ba 'di mthong tshe/ rang dbang med par mig nas mchil ma 'brug pa dang / lus kyi ba spu zing ba sogs phyi rtags snying rje'i nyams dngos su thon pa'o//sha tshe 'di 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod kyang /tshim pa med rnams pha rol 'gro ba'i dus/dmyal khams bco brgyad gnas su 'chi bdag gis/dbang med gcod sbyong byed tshe a tsa ma zhes mi tshe 'di la 'jig rten bu ba dga' ston pa la sogs la dus 4 'da' bzhin pa'i skye bo pho mo rnams ni/ ngom pa rtsa ba nas med par mi tshe hril por 'dod yon lnga la chags shing zhan pa ste/ 'dod yon lnga ni/

— 299—gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa dang lnga la longs spyod nas nam zhig tshe yi 'phan pa rdzogs pa'i das/ pha rol gshin rjes rang dbang med par khrims gcod kyis sdug bsngal myang ba shā'odi ni shin tu sha tsha ba dang snying rje dngos su skye ba sogs brjod pa'o// ra/ ya ki'i mkha' yangs 'grims pa'i nyi gzhon mas/rgya dgyes brtse'i 'dzum zhal shar ri'i 'phrag shar tshe/g.yo can 'jug brgya'i snying la ma bzod nas/dbang med gyur mid btang ba snying rje'i gnas/mi sdug pa'i nyams rgyan ni/gzhung las/ 'bag btsog yid du mi 'ong ba'i/skya nesku rnam 'gyur ngan pa mi sdug nyams/snye/ ṅka4 mo cho zhes mi sdug nyams rgyan bstan te/ pha rol gyi bya ba yid du mi 'ong ba snyo skyogo9sgo ྅ba'i dngos rdzas dang / phyi yi rnam 'byur shin tu mi mdzes pa dang /jo ma ngan pa/ gzugs dbyibs mi mdzes pa/ tsheg mi snyan pa la sogs/shin tu mi legs pa'i bya ba'am dngos po zhig gi rkyen gyis yid ma rang ba la brten nas phyi yi rnam 'byur shin tu mi mdzes pa zhig ston pa'i rgyan la mi sdug pa'i nyams rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung 'kho/ 'bum ldan gling gi ro langs rnams/mig 'phyang klad rdol rgyu long 'drud/— rnag khrag bshang gci mnyam du za/glo dze dri ngan kun khyab zhe re sme/ ma che khyi ji ka sa dur khrod chen po bzhi yi nang tshan lho phyogs 'bum ldan gling gi tsū༈ rishā da du gnas pa'i ro langs zhes/ 'dzig rten 'dir sdod pa'i tshe/ci— gyu ci /cosad 'u/ḍire 95ra b.ranagathag 6gong / nor rdzar 04 3gen ta zhan skyosdugs rdzi ṭ+wāṃtsho wa ཿ4 ༄

—300—che ba/ bsam pa ngan pa'i rigs 'ga' srogaru/ dbang bral ma thag phung po la gdon zhugs nas/ mi phyugs la gnod bskyal ba ste/ mig zum du med pa/klad pa phyi ru 'pho ba/ nang khrol rnams phyi ru thon nas drud cing 'gro ba/ rnag — dang khrag la sogs bshang gci mnyam du bza' ba/ de rnams mthong ba tsam gyis yid du mi 'ong ba'i rnams 'gyur phyi ru mngon gsal dod po ldan pa dngos su ston pa'i rgyan no//sha ma rung gdon gyis brlam pa'i mi sdug la/mtshon gyis rang lus rmas pa'i rnag khrag dang /bshang ba gcin rnams spags te mnyam du za/'phyan pas rul dris zhe mer skyugs bro'i gnas/zhes 'dre gdon gyis rkyen te rang phus tshal par mtshon gyis rmas pa 'ga'/ khog la gdon zhugs nas/ rang sha rang khrag bza' ba ma zad/rang gi bshang gci sogs bza' nas nye 'gram phyin pa tsam gyis skyugs bro ba'i rnam pa dang ldan par gyur ro//ra/ shar phyogs tsi na'i yul gyi mi rnams kyis/mi gtsang khrod du nyul ba'i 'bu sbal rigs/mthong ba tsam gyis ro 'dzin ldab khrib ngang /hab thob byed de rol 'di skyo ba la/bzhad bgad kyi nyams rgyan ni/gzhung las/ tshogs kyi gnas su bag tsha ba'i/spyod lam khyad mtshar bzhad bgad nyams/zhes bzhad bgad kyi nyams rgyan bstan te/ rang gi mthong thos phyi rol gyi yul gang yang rung ba'i bya ba dang / spyod pa rgod bro ba'i rnam 'gyur te/klad chung blun po'i mi shes pa'i bya ba dang / zlos gar dang / rtse mo la

sogs la brten nas phyi mngon pa la brten te rang dbang med pa'i —sgo3 //1 —gad mo slang ba sogs kyi nyams 'gyur mngon par ston pa'i rgyan zhig la bzhad bgad kyi nyams rgyan zhes brjod do//gzhung las/ lang tsho gzabs pa'i dge bshes lags/chas gos glegs bu'i tshal gseb na/rna rgyan mu tig chun po de/mkhas pa'i rtsod gral rbed na ang /zhes phyi tshul la gzabs pa'i tshul 'chal can gyi dge bshes 'ga'/mkhas mang 'dus pa'i sar bgrod bzhin pa la/ rmad gos kyi gseb nas ji khyim pa bud med kyi rdzas gser gyi rna rgyan dang / mu tig gi ske rgyan sogs/〉 trīzhazhan gyis mthong bas ya mtshan skye ba dang / bzhad bgad slang ba bcas/sha na zhig nas khyed kyi bud med la sbyin rgyu'i rdzas de rnams/ rab byung pa'i rtsod gral du sbas na khyed rang ngur smrig gis rgyan dang ldan pa'i cha nas mi bzang ngam zhes brjod pa'o//sha gson dang sgom ma gnya' ba'i skra zad ma/phyi tshul zab med 'on kyang log skyes dang /lto ba cung zad sbos rnams gos dag gis/— bsgrib pa'i thabs la rol par byos shig gusnye 3 zhes phyi tshul bzang zhing nang khroms lhod pa'i skra zad ma ces a ne'am ri shathe na ma la zer zhing / 'chal spyod kyi bya ba'i 'bras bu lto bar phru gu yod pa tsho skrumadze pa bar dog nas/ lto ba sbos par smra bzhin yod pa la/ gzhan rnams ༷wari / tāchirtsi hūṃrdachi ldis ya mtshan skyes pa la/ rang gis grogs des sgrib pa'i thabs sna ༷ rmi rī/rī bye bar byos shig ces bskul ba lta bu'o//ri // /tsa —〉stoṇa5 tshoji/sna / bden rdzun khrims kyi ga dar bskos bdag lags/ tsho —rtswaX /khrigyi

—302—shi shon dar gyi khud du dril ba yi/srid kyi 'byor ba kun dga' don 'grub de/shag kyi do rar cung zad sbas na ang /rmad byung gi nyams rgyan ni/gzhung las/ gang zhig ngo mtshar yid 'ong cha/'jebs par brjod pa rmad byung nyams/zhes rmad byung nyams rgyan bstan te/ yul gang yang rung ba zhig la brten nas de nyid kyi khyad bon sngon na med pa'i/ lang tsho'i 'byor ba'am yang na/ mkhas spyod sogs phun sum tshogs pa yid du 'ong ba'i cha gsar pa zhig la brten nas/ de nyid gsar du mthong ba'i rkyen skyis/ yid la ya mtshan sngar med kyi ngo mtshar skyes pa'i stobs kyis/ phyi yul gyi lus la rnam 'gyur mngon gsal dod po'i ston pa'i tshig rgyan zhig la rmad byung gi nyams rgyan zhes brjod pa'o//gzhung las/ rtse la phyogs bcu'i bder gshegs bkrasked par yi dam lha tshogs gsal/rtsa bar pho nya las tshogs 'khyugabon ri chen po'i spro nyams la/zhes sngar nas bod kyi yul der kong po'i sa char ri 'di dag yod par snang yang / ri de la 'di lta'i khyad bon dang lngan pa ma yin zhing /bdud khyab pas rkyen bskul te/ ston pa gshen rab mi bo kong yul du zhabs bcag nas/ phyis sems can rnams thar par 'dren pa'i ched du/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs te/ mtshan yang bon ri chen po zhes btags te mthar/ rtse mo bder gshegs rnams gnas pa dang / rked par yi dam khro phur zhang gsum sogs yi dam lha tshogs gnas pa/ rtsa bar

— 303—bstan skyongs pho nya las mkhan tshogs rnams gtan du 'khor ba'i khyad bon de rnams mthong bas/ nang sems spro bas phyi lus kyi rnams 'gyur yang snyoshin tu dang spro ba'i rnam pa dang lden pa'o//sha ṣ+ṭṛ mor gzha' sprin bla bre'i tshul du g.yo/dri zhim sman ljongs tshal gyis 'khor yug bskor/khadz+nya bzang rtsa gsum gnas kyi ngang tshul can/bstan spel gling gi ri khrod nyams re spro/zhes bstan spol gling gi 'dus gnas 'di nyid/ rtse mo gzha' gur sprin tshogs bla bre dbub pa nang bzhin du g.yo ba ma zad/ phyogs kun du'ang dre zhim spos kyi sa 'khor yug bskor ba/ gnas khang de yang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi khang’bzang lta bur cha/dzes brjid dang ldan pa 'di 'dra'i skyid nyams la zhes lta bu gsal bar brjod pa'o//ra/ tshangs tshing g.yu lo'i ljon pas tshar du dngar/'jam mnyen ma gad 'dab gshog ljon shing lde ma/snyan 'jebarngage mgrin glus ri klung kun tu g.yo/dpyid kyi dpal yon dus 'di'i skyid pa la/'jigs rung gi nyams rgyan ni/gzhung las/ gdul bya gang yin skrag nus pa'i/rme tshom rngam drag po 'jigs rung nyams/zhes 'jigs nyams rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ phyi yi rnam 'byur 'a/ shin tu khros pa'i tshul gyis rngam pa'i drag tshad bcu gcig la sogs gegiglu dzobar ston zhing / gzhan yang brjod cing 'dzigs pa'i nyams sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i stobs kyis/ gang zag su zhig gis mthong ba yin na'ang / rang dbang che/da par skrag cing 'jigs pa'i dbang gi phyi'i rnam

— 304—'gyur yang / shin tu skrag pa'i nyams mngon gsal dod po thon pa'i rgyan cozhig la drag po'i ‘nyams rgyan zhes bya'o// drag po'i tshul bcu gcig ni/ sku 'gying ba/ brjid pa/ dpa' ba/ sgeg pa/ gtum pa/ rngam pa/ gshe ba/bzhed pa/ gzer ba/ zlog pa/ khros pa dang bcu gcig go/gzhung las/ bdud 'dul drag chen rngam pa yi/tsha 'bar me ri'i dbal zer de/log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyi/yid ngor 'char ma thag tu brgyal/zhes yon tan gyi khro bo dbal chen ge khod kyi dzā+o dmar me ri 'bar ba'i dbal zor ram/ me ri me dpung 'bar ba'i rna ru dbal chu khol ma'i drwar de mthong ba tsam mam yid kyi ngor 'char ba tsam gyis/ skrag ste brgyal ba dngo ring ba la sogs 'jigs pa'i mtshang phyi la mngon par 'char ba'i khyad ban dngas su stan pa'//sha stag la me 'bar phyag gi dbal phur rtser/me dpung 'bar bas snang srid sgrol la dpa'/de phyor bdud srin tshogs kyi phyag mtshan de/dran pas don snying dag kung lgog mar slebs/zhes yi dam khro bo stag la me 'bar gyi phyag gi dbal gyi phur 5'i ce mo drag po'i me ri me dpung rab tu 'khrug cing / snang zhing srid pa'i dam med log can rnams sgrol ba'i nus mthu can de nyid/ bdud dang srin po'i tshogs rnams kyis dbal phur de nyid dran pa tsam gyis shin ta skrag ste/ snying ṣ+kog mar 'byin zhes or 'gor slebs pa sogs drag po'i nyams dngos su bstan pas 'jigs pa'i rnam 'byur thon pa bcas so//

—305—ra/ gangs can mar zhi dga' ma'i khyon yangs su/ grags pas mu khyud 'gengs mdzad gnya' khri rjes/rgyal khrims gser gyi chags shing bstegs tsam gyis/g.yo can ar pa'i zag phung bsil bur spyod/zhes snyan gzhung rin chen lde mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las nyams rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa'i skabs te bco brgyad pa'o//

—306—gzi brjid kyi rgyan ni/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ so so'i don no//gzhung las/ gang brjod yul de'i gzi brjid kyis/gzhan kun zil gnon gzi brjid rgyan/zhes gzi brjid rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi gang brjod byar gyur ba'i yul de'i brdzid nyams dang dregs pa'am/ yang na/ nga bo la sogs skyes pa gsal bar brjod byed kyi tshig gzengs su mtho ba'i gzi brjid ldan pa'i tshig kyis/ pha rol po rnams zil gyis gnon pa'am/ khyad bon yon tan 'ga' yi gzi brjid dang rnam dpyod dag gzhan la ngom pa'i tshig bcad cig la/ gzi brjid badzod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na/ smra ngan rgol ba tshar gcod ces/khyed cag ma skrag phyir ma phyogs/gzhan snang zil gnon gtsang gshen rje/mgon du bsten dang rjes su 'dzin/ zhes pa lta bu'o//gzhung las/ dregs pa spyi 'dul dbal gsas zhes/sde brgyad yo ka ma brgyal ciga'adren stabs yin gyi srog gshed min/dad spobs bskyed dang zhi skur 'gyur/zhes lha srin dregs pa'i sde tshogs kun 'dul ba'i sku yi khro bo dbal gsas rngam pa khro rgyal mkha' 'gying kha yi mdun du bstan la log par phyogs pa'i ma rung dregs pa'i sde tshogs kun bkug nas/ mdun du lhag pa tsam gyis brgyal ba dang rings par gyur ba la/ des na khyed rnams thar

— 30 7—par bgrod ched yin la/ srog dbang 'phrog par min pas/ dad pa dang mos 'dun gyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan sgor zhugs na/ khro tshogs rnams ni zhi ba'i skur 'gyur bar 'gro'o//sha klu grub snying po dbal gsas khyung gi skur/bzhengs pas klu srin snying khrag rngub ces te/klu rnams skrag par ma byed gdug sems spongs/zhabs zung spyi bor bsten dang skyabs su 'gyur/— zhes klu yi gshen po klu grub ye shes snying po drag po khyung gi sku ru bzhengs nas klu srin gdug pa can gyi snying khrag hub kyis 'thung bar grags rizhes klu rnams skrag mi dgos la/ gzhan la gnod sems dang gdug pa'i sems kun spangs nas/ gshen la skyabs su song na rang la phan pa'i dz+wa grogs su 'gyur ro// / hūm̐ ra/ lha 'dre sems su gcod pa'i rnal 'byor zhes/— lha srin gzhi bdag kun ka sngang mi bya/sangs rgyas bstan la sdang stabs ci tshug tu/spyod na zag phung sbyin par bkyes kyang rung /zhes snyan gzhung rin chen lde mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i ma la rgyan las gzi brjid kyi rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa ste skabs bcu dgu pa'o//

—308—rma/ma grangs brjod pa'i rgyan/mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ so so'i don no// gzhung las/ gang gi 'dod don 'grub bya'i phyir/chi+og skyob gzhan dkri rnam grangs brjod/ces rnam grangs baji+od pa'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi gang 'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub pa'i phyir du/ thabs dang thugs rje bag yangs sgo nas/ 'dod don de dngos su tshig gi sgras zin du ma baji+od par/ tshig gi grogs rnam grangs gzhan zhig gi sgo nas ston te/ sgrib bya'i dngos po de nyid sgrib byed kyi rnam grangs gzhan zhig gi sgo nas yid du 'ong bar brjod pa'i rgyan zhig la rnam grangs kyi rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na/ bdag ni do nub mkhan slob drung /gso sbyong byed du 'gro ba yis/khyed gnyis dal bur 'dir bzhugs la/gsung gleng bzhad don ci dgyes mdzod/ ces lta bu'o//gzhung las/ kho bo nam gyi stod cha la/gnyan sar bsam gtan skyang la 'grakhyed cag gzhon nu lcam dral gnyis/ma skrag thugs dam bde mor bzhugs/zhes gnas gcig tu sdod pa'i dge slong dang gzhon du lcam dral gnyis zhes gzhon nu pho mo gnyis bcas gnas pa la/ gzhon nu pho mo gnyis der dus la 'debs rgyu'i go skabs dang 'brel/ gtsang khrims pa des mthong gi dogs pa la/ thabs gzhan zhig gis rnal 'byor pa des/ gzhon nu pho mo

— 309—gnyis kye 'dod don 'grub pa'i phyir/ sgreb bya ci dgar smros te ngo tsha bar dogs te de dang 'brel med kyi kho bo phyogs gzhan zhig la nyams len byed par ma song thabs med lta bur brjod pa'o//sha snying sdug slob ma 'ga' zhig rkyen 'tshes gdungs/de skyon bsal ba'i ched du bdag 'gro yis/grogs rnams 'dir bzhugs bag pheb dal bu ru/ci 'dod dogs slong med par bsgrub 'tshal lo//zhes slob ma mang po'i tshogs bzhin pa'i skabs/ dus zhig na slob ma 'ga' 'jig rten gyi sred pas gdung ba la/ rgan la dogs nas gsang bzhin pa la/ rgan des shes nas thabs legs pa'i sgo nas/ kho rang slob ma 'ga' yi don du phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'gro dgos par kha g.yar nas/gzhan gnyis la dogs slong mi dgos pa'i bag phebs par sdod rgyu'i bya ba sgrab pa lta bu'o//the/ phyogs 'dir mos pa'i blo gsal lang tsho can/'jig rten bde ba'i lam bur dgyes mgur mdzod/kho bo mi sdod mkhas mang 'dus pa'i sar/re zhig rtsod pa'i zhal lce 'gran du 'grozhes swān ngag rin chen lde mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las rnam grangs rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa'i skabs te nyi shu pa'o//

kun phan rgyan/mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ so so'i don no// gzhung las/ 'dad dan rtsal bas ma bsgrub kyang /bzang rkyen grogs shar kun phan rgyan/zhes kun phan rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi gang bsgrub par 'dod pa'i don de nyid la ched du dmigs nas 'bad pas ma bskrun kyang /rang gi sngon ma'i las dang smon lam bzang po'i skal pas/ rang gi gang 'dod pa'i don de nyid sgrub byed kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu glo bur du byung ba'i tshe/ rigs mthun kun gyi 'dod don bde brlag tu 'grub phar ston pa'i rnyi/na 'ardobs kyi tshig bcad cig la kun phan gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na/ ha ra ci par zhag gsum nas/'chi ba'i dus la babs tsam na/tshe yi lha mo'i zhal bstan pas/sum brgya'i lor bzhuṭa bon srid bskyangs/ zhes lta bu'o/gzhung las/ ser chags bye ba 'dus gling nas/drang srong legs pa'i blo gros kyis/mu stegs rgol ba tshar bcad phyin/kun gyis mkhas pa'i grags pa thob/ ces mkhas mang 'dus pa'i gling du/ nang pa'i lta spu+od la skyon du 'dod pa'i phyi rol pa'i mkhas pa 'ga' rtsod 'gran du yong ba la/ drang srong legs pa'i blo gros kyis/ tshad gsum gyi lam nas/ rnam dpyod kyi rigs pas/ mu stegs pa rnams rang ltar skyon du mthong ba lta bur byas nas/ mu

— 3 1 1 —stegs kyi rgol ba rnams tshar thag bcad de/ kun gyis bstod bsngags brjod pa ma zad mkhas pa'i grags rnyi/na phyogs bcur khub pa lta bu'o//sha sngon tshe mi dbang tha tshan hri sangs kyi/gdung rabs chad las ma la rgyal 'bangs kyis/smre sngags cho nge btab tshe rgyu'i lha mos/srid kyi dngos grub mi lus bsam legs sbyin/gzhung las/ mi la rgyal po byung ba la snga ba/ tha tshan hri sangs kyis/thams cad dbang bsgyur byas/ de nyid dgang lo du ma bzhugs nas/ gdung rabs 'dzin pa'i sras ma mchis pas/ mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal phran rnams shin tu dga' ste/ yab rgyal po gshegs la nye/ de nas dbus 'gyur rje blon thams cad nyam par 'gro ste/ de tshe dud 'gro phyugs dang 'dra ba yin/ de gyi nas rang cag bstan pa nub pa yin zhes/ smros nas yul sham r+bha la dbus gyur rgyal blon kun sdug bsngal bzod med mung pa la/ rgyal khams 'gengs pa'i cho nge btab ste/ byams ma la gsol ba btabs te bos pas/ de tshe nam mkhar gzha' lnga'in gyi 'od bkra nas/ sa gzhi g.yo zhing gzha' tshon bris legs dbus/ byams ma rgyu yi yum chen la 'khor rigs bzhi byams ma bzhi dang 'khor srid pa'i lha mo bye ba bcas/ bar snang la sa ler gsal ba kun gyis mthong bar gyur/ byams ma chen mo nga ni 'gro la brtse/ thugs rje smon lam dbang gi shīr bzhengs pa'i/ thos pas chog pa rgyu yi gzugs gcig brjod/ mi phyed dad pas nga la 'dun byed na/ khyed rnams don du mi rje srid pa'i sras/ rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal/ spral pa'i sku ru da lta lo gcig nas/ des 'byung sgrab byed gzungs bsngags 'edi — bzus pas/ gang 'dod ster 'gyur the tshom smad par gyis/ thos pas bon sto gyi rgyal srid skyong bar 'gyur/ zhes so// phyis yum la rgyal bu mtshan rab

— 3 1 2—tu ldan pa/ shes rab rnam par dag pa zhig 'khrungs pas mi lus bsam legs su btags so// zhes sngon dus tha tshan hri sangs sam zhang skad de bod skad la thams cad dbang bsgar zhes de nyid la ba med pas/ rgyal rī rig ra 4 risna'abangs kun gyis yum la gshe ste smre ngag bsham nas gdung ba' skabs/nam mkha' nas byams ma srid pa rgyu yi lha mos nyin zhig dngos grwab tu mi lus bsam leṭa gnang ba soṭa rnam thar la bshad pa ji bzhin la btaṭa te sbyor ba'i rgyan no//ra/ zab yang mkhyen brgya'i bdag nyid bla ma lhas/lhag bsam dag pas nye bar brnag pa'i sems/ blo gsal tshogs la legs bshad char ba'i rgyun/chal chil bab pas 'phags pa'i mtshan rnyi/na bzhes/zhes snyan gzhung rin chen ldi mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan lar+sā kun phan rgyan / rab tu byed pa ste nyer gcig pa'o//

—31 3—rgya che'i rgyan/mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ bsam mam 'byor ba dpag med du/mnga' bar ston pa rgya che'i rgyan/zhes rgya che'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid ston te/ rang gi brjod bya gang yin pa de las lhag pa'i mkhas spyod dang khyad bon/ bsam pa'i stobs dang blo shad rgya che zhing khyad par du 'phags pa'am/ yang yo byed dang 'byor ba sogs phun sum tshogs pa sogs gang yang rung ba yang rtser son pa'i stobs kyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa snyan 'jebs kyi tsheg gi sbyor ba dang 'dogs te 'dren pa'i rgyan zhig la rgya che'i rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na/ rgyal bu kun dga' rang dbang dang /srid 'byor che yang gzhan phan gyis/srog lus gces 'dzin rgyab bskyur nas/ rgya mtsho'i gling naro/ moratshubu hwangs// 'e/sa pa lta spru'o/ //dbye ba so so'i don la/ bsam pa rgya che ba'i rgyan dang // 'byor ba rgya che ba'i rgyan gnyis so//bsam pa rgya che ba'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ gzhan phan bzod sems dpag med du/mnga' bar ston pa bsam rgya che/shāshurwa — zhes bsam pa rgya che'i rgyan gyi don bstan te/ nang se mas sam bsam / rnok+ṇi2 spra'i tsha'akhyer phyogs te/ sems bzang gi 'gro ba ma nu/sa sdug bsngal dang sbyar garnams la/ phan thabs kyi de dag kun sdug bsngal dang bral zhing / bde ba

—31 4—dang 'phrad par bsam pa'i blo dang / gzhan gyi don du rang nyid sdug baṇil dang dka' ngal ci tsam byung yang bzod sran nus pa/ gzhan gyi don rlabs po che zhig khur du len nas/ bya ba de nyid sgrub nus pa'i bzod sran dka' spyad nus par ston pa'i rgyan zhig la/gzhung las/ rgyal bu dam pa shes ldan— gyis/ 'gro rnams nying sha nying za'i dus/rgyal srid lus srog rgyan dang bcas/sbying gtong mu ge'i 'jigs las bskyabs/zhes bdag cag gi ston pa gshen rab mi bo che'i sngon skye ba grangs med tshogs bsags skabs rgyal bu shes rab ldan gyi skye ba ru bzhes pa'i dus/yul der mu ge'i skal pa shar nas yul mi rnams/ gdung ba la rgyal srid dang longs spyod kun sbyin pa btang ba ma zad/ mthar de dag rdzogs nas/rang nyid kyi sha khrag sbyin pa btang nas/ rus pa skya seng nger song ba'i rnam thar bcas sngon gyi dam pa'i mdzad spyod dang sbyar nas dper brjod drangs pa'o/sha bdud rtsi lha mo gnam phyi gung rgyal mas/gza' bdud nag po brlag par nus na yang /brtse gdung rgyun ma bcad de bka' nan gyis/dam btags ri dbang ngos la brtod de bzhagazhes rgyal ba'i yum chen gnam phyi gung rgyal mas/ 'gro ba kun la gnod skyel mkhan gza' bdud nag po 'dul ba'i tshe/ gza' bdud thal bar brlag par nus pa'i yon tan mnga' na yang / gzhi brtse ba snying rje chen po dang ma bral ba'i stobs kyis/ bka' bgos dam du btags te/ ri rgyal gyi grong du bstan srung du bzhag pa'o// zhes so//

— 3 1 5 —ra/ lnga snyigs rgyal bstan nub ri'i phag song tshe/rnam dpyod mtha' bral rgyal gnyis mnyam med pas/'bad pa du mas ngal ba jikhyad bsad nas/mdo sngags zung 'brel bstan pa'i rgyan du bskrun/'byor ba rgya che'i rgyan ni/ gzhung las/ langs spud 'byar ba bsam mtha' yas/ mnga' bar ston pa 'bu+or rgu che/ zhes 'byor ba rgya che ba'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang la longs su spyod rgyu'i bon nor 'dod thar bzhi'i nang chan du gyur ba'i skabs 'dir nor gyi longs spyod gtso cher brjod pa'i sgo nas/ gnas dang / lus dang— /longs spyod sogs 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa lhan 'thug pa/ gang zag phal gyi blo'i yul du 'das pa gang yin pa de ni stobs 'byor mnga' thang dang ldan pa'i khyad bon/ dngos su gsal bar brjod cing stsan 'jebs can gyi rgyan zhig la'o//gzhung las/ 'dod dgu phun tshogs mngon dga' zhing /dmu rigs 'phrul gyi rgyal sa ru/rin chen khams las ma grub pa'i/rdzas rigs phal pa btsal kyang min/zhes dmu rigs 'phrul gyi rgyal sa rtag gzigs 'ol mo'i gling gi dbus rgyal sa bar po so brgyad du dbus gsas mkhar sham po lha rtse ru/g.yung drung dgu brtsegs kyi ri dang gzhan ri thang kun rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa sha stag las/ gzhan rdzas rigs phal pa btsal kung rnyed par ci mi 'gyur ba ste/ kun rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa kho nar ldan pas so//

— 3 1 6—des na gang zag phal gyis thos pa tsam gyis kyang ya mtshan dgos pa sogs khyad par du ma dang ldan pa'o//sha rin chen las grub pho brang gzhal med khang /nor bu'i gram pa rab mdzes khri 'phang steng /'dod rgu'i gter 'chang mi mdzan rgyal po de/gnod sbyin bye ba sa ya'i dbus na brjid/ces gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag po'i pho brang ni rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal med khang dang / gzhan yang bzhugs khri ni/ nor bu rin po che las grub pa'i khri shin tu brjid pa'i thog gnod sbyin nor gyi bdag po nor bu rin po che 'chang zhing / gzhan rang nyid kyi 'khor du mdzes brjid nor gyis phyug pa'i gnod sbyin sde tshogs bye ba sa yas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po de la nor gyis rnam pa nor bu'i rigs kyis khengs par gyur ba'o//ra/ bsil ba'i ra bas mdzes pa'e gangs ljongs su/rang 'byung kha mas las grub pa'i gter kha dang /ri lung spang ljang gnag lug skar ltar bkragling phran gzhan gyis bsngags pa'i zhing 'dir rmad/ces snyan gzhung rin chen lde mig 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las rgya che'i rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa'i skabs te nyer gnyis pa'o//

bsnyon dor gyi rgyan/mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don no/gzhung la sa/ dngos don min gyi de mtshungs gzhan/yin zhes brjod pa bsnyon dor rgyan/zhes bak+to/na dor gyi rgyan bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya'i bon gang yin pa de ngo bo'i gnas lugs dang rang bzhin khyad bon gang yin pa de la brnyi+o/na nas yin pa la min par bsnyon te/ spyir bsnyon zhes pa ni/ yul de'i gnas tshod gang yin pa de ltar bkag ste dgag tshig ci rigs zhig sbyar nas/ min zhes brjod pas don dngos de dor nas/ de dang 'brel ba'i don gzhan zhig gi ngo bo cung zad ston pa'i rgyan zhig la bsnyon dor te dngos de dor nas brjod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na/ gshen lha'i phyag mtshan lcags skya de/gcig tu ma nges grangs las preldas/'khor ba'i 'dam nas sems can kun/gcig gis 'dren pa ga la dben/ zhes pa lta bu'o//dbye ba so so'i don la/ bon la balhon pa'i rgyan dang / yul la brnyi+o na ri pa'i rgyan dang / rang bzhin la brdo/na pa'i rgyan dang gsum /bon la bsnye+o/na pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las5 badzod bya'i don gyi khyad bon de/ma yin gzhan 'dod bon la bsnyon/zhes bon bsnyon gyi rgyan bstan te/ rang gi brjod bur gyur ba'i bon de'i khyad gzhi dang khyad bon gnyis su phyes pa'i khyad bon de'i rang bzhin nam

— 3 1 8—gnas tshod kyi sgo nas ji ltar gnas yod pa de la bsnyon nas/ de ltar min par brjod pa ste 'di'i skabs bon zhes pa ni khyad bon la go dgos pa ma zad de'i shugs la/ rang dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po gzhan zhig sgrub byed dane+e bkod pa'i rgyan zhig la bon la bsnyon pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o// hagazhung las/ rgyal ba mchog la ye shes spyan/gcig tu ma nges bsam mtha' yas/srid dang zhi ba'i shes bya kun/gcig bis gzigs na ga la khyab/ces bsnyon bya sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan te/ sangs rgyas la yod pa'i ye shes kyi spyan gcig kho nas srid dang zhi ba'i bon thams cad dus gcig la gzigs nus pa ni min zhes/ khyad bon de la bsnyon nas/dngos po 'dra mtshungs sems can gyi mig gcig gis thams can gzigs mi thub bzhin zhes sangs rgyas sems can mtshungs par ston nas/ sangs rgyas kyi dngos po'i gshis lugs de dang 'gal bar smra ba bcas so//sha ye shes dbal mo'i phyag gi ral gri ni/gcog tu ma zad stong las brgal ba ste/bstan la 'tshe ba'i gyi gran yod do cogadrung du phyung 'di gcig gi ga la nus/zhes bstan skyongs ye shes dbal mo la phyag gi ral gri de gcig kho nar ma nges pa ste/ bstan dgra sgye gran grangs 'das kun/ thams cad dus gcig la sgrol ba'i phyir zhes dam can srung ma'i rdzu 'phrul la bsnyon pa ste/'dra mtshungs su/ sems can rang la bltas na/ dgra bo mang po zhig bsgral ba la gri gcig gis dus gcig la bsgral smu nus pa bzhin zhes/ ye shes dbal mo'i rdzu 'phrul la bsnyon te brjod pa'o//

— 3 1 9—ra/ rje btsun mnyam med bla ma sman ri bas/mardo sngags zung du 'brel bar mdzad min te/rim gnyis sngags kyi phyag rgya gsang ba'i grogs/'grogs pa'i tshul ldan drang srong yong re dkon/yul la bsnyo/na pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ snang ba'i yul gyi rnam pa gang /de min gzhan 'dod yul la bswon/zhes bsnyon dor rgyan bstan te/ 'jug byed mig gi dbang po dang / rna ba'i dbang po/ sna yi dbang po/ lce yi dbang po/ lus kyi dbang po sogs dbang po lnga po gang rung gi bzung bya'i babruhoṃ/na pa ste/ gnas tshul gang yin pa de min zhes dgag tshig sbyar nas gang yin pa de dor te min par ston pa ma zad/ mthong snang gi rnam pa gzhan zhig ston par byed pa'i rgyan zhig la/ yul la bstson te sbyor ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ thig le mchog gi rjes 'gro ma/dka' thub gzhol ba'i srin mo dngos/ma yin chags ldan skye bo'i ngor/'dod don sgrab pa'i dgyes sde ma/zhes rkang pa dang po'i balngojo bya ni khrel dang ngo tsha bral ba'i smad 'tshong ci ma zhig gi rang bzhin ni/ tshul ldan rnams la bar chod rtsom pa dang / dam pa'i darke' thub 'phrog pa'i srin mo yin pa yang / de la bsnyo/na te srin mo ma yin zhes/ —dgag tshig sbyar te/ don gzhan zhig la sred pa can gyi 'ardod pa ster ba'i lha mo zhes gang de'i tshul khrims 'phrog pa'i srin mo zhes pa'i don de bka' pa'am yul las dbang gi yul du gyur ba bcas sngon nas lwal de bsnyon pa 'o//

— 320—sha chang dang bud med 'dir snang 'ad 'dze rnams/nges 'byung thar pa don gnyer gcod pa'i dugabade skyid dpal yon phun chogs snang ba'i dpal/'jig rten phal gyi blo ngor spro dga'i yul/zhes yul dang / chang dang bud med/ 'ding snang gi 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba rnams kyis 'khor ba'i las la yid mi rang ba'i thar pa don gnyer gyo skyes bu rnams kyi bar du gcod pa'i nad dug mtshon lta bu yin pa la/ bswon te 'khor ba'i phun tshogs rnams ni/ 'jig rten pa'i blo ngor spyod bya'i yul phul du phyin pa yin pa gsal bor ston pa'o//ra/ shar ri'i phrag nas 'dzum pa'i rta ljangs can/yid 'ong pad mo bzhad pa'i dgyes sde zhes/ma yin mgo lcog ldim pa'i kun d+ngha'i tshogs/mi bzang skyo gdung thun gsum sbyin la re/rang bzhin la bsto/na pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung lar+sā / dngos po'i rang bzhin gnas chul gang /de min gzhan 'dod ngang bzhin bano/na/zhes rang bzhin la bsnyon pa'i don bstan te/ skabs 'dir rang bzhin zhes pa'i khyad gzhi khud bon khyad par med pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi brjod bya'i don gang yin pa de'i gshis/ lugs sam rang bzhin gnas stangs ji bzhin brjod nas/ brjod don de la rang bzhin de ltar mi ldan par/ rang bzhin de las ldog pa zhig ldan par ston pa'i nyams dang 'grogs pa'i rgyan zhig la rang bzhin de la bsnyon pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ dga' bde ster ba'i smin legs ma/gtan grogs bzang mor 'bod kyang min/

byang chub chen po'i rgyal srid kun/nges par 'phrog pa'i dgra bo dngos/zhes sred ldan gyi skye bo phal pa la rtag tu dga' ba dang bde ba/ brtse ba sogs sbyin pa'i bud med mdzes ma ni/ skye bo'i rten grogs zhes mi tshe ma‘nyam du bskyel ba'i bza' rla ma de bud med legs shos shig tu 'bod kyang rung ba min te/ thar pa don du gnyer ba'i tshul ldan gyi bslab pa dngos su 'phrog par byed pa'i dgra bo dngos ni bud me/da je yin zhes/ rang bzhin gyi gnas tshod de dang bsnyon te gzhan zhig tu snyed de brjod pa 'o//sha sgra dbyangs zhu〉04 84ོ blo gsakhun 84tha' dag gis/ngag la 'dod 'jo'i dpal spyon ma lags te/bang sku mdzes pas dbang med sred zhi'i yid/'phrog pa'i chom rkun yin par gdon mi za/'es blo gros kyi sbyin brgya 'gyed pa'i sgra dbyangs rgyal mo'i rang bzhin ni/ blo gsal tshogs la blo gros ster zhing / ma rig gi mun pa gel ba'i dpal gyur ba min zhes de la bsnyon te/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas sku mdzes pa'i skyen gyi blo gsal tshogs kyi yid dbang 'phrog par byed pa'i rkun ma 'dra ba ste/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen par geṭa lta bur bar+hoco/na te brngu+od pa 'o//ra/ rang lus bskyed pa'i drin can pha ma zung /bka' drin gzhal du med pa brjod kudza skamin/thar du med pa 'khor ba'i duḥkha ru/skyed byed sa bon skran mkhan khyen min su/ ri ci zhes snyan ngag rin chesna lde mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i rdone+e/〉 r+ṣamagul rgyan las bsnyon dor rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa'i skabs te nyer gsum kyi/bye shā sa'o//

sbyar ba'i rgyan/ mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ brjod pa re res badzod bya'i don/du ma ston nus sbyar ba'i rgyan/zhes sbyar ba'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ skat+pās 'dir sbyar zhes pa ni mtshon bya dang mtshon byed phan tshun/ ming don gang rung gi sgo nas phan tshun mtshungs pa la/ don de gnyis kar ston pas bon de gnyis sbyar zhes bya/de'ang dzod byed ming tshig gam sgra tshig gcig kho na la sbyar nas sbyar gzhi'am brjod bya'i don mi 'dra ba du ma bo/ rgyu yod pa'i khyad bon dang ldan pa ste/ ming don ci rigs kyi sgo nas dpe don sbyar ba zhig la sbyar ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na/ blo ldan tshig brgya smra ba'i dbang / rtsod spobs chen pos rgol ba 'joms/gsar bu'i blo bskyed sgra la mkhas/shes bya'i mdo 'dzin mongs pa sel/ zhes paltobu'o//dbye ba so so'i don la dgu tshig tha dad min pa'i sbyar rgyan/ tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar rgyan/ bya ba tha dad min pa'i sbyar rgyan/ bya ba 'gal ba min pa'i sbyar rgyan/ 'gal ba'i las can gyi sbyar rgyan/ nges pa 'gal ba min pa'i sbyar rgyan/ nges pa 'gog pa'i sbyar rgyan/ 'gal ba med pa'i sbyar rgyan/'gal ba can gyi sbyar ba'i rgyan dang dgu'o//tha dad min pa'i sbyar rgyan ni/gzhung las/ brjod ngag tshig gzung re re la/brjod don gnyis 'tshogs tha dad min/

— 3 2 3 —zhes tha dad min pa'i sbyar rgyan gyi don bstan pa ste/ brjod byed tshig gi dpe don gnyis 'tshogs kyi don rnams phan chun mtshungs par sbu+or zhing /de yang mtshon bya dpe can dang / mtshon byed dpe gnyis/ rjod byed tshig gcig kho na la brten nas/ sbyar gzhi dang sbyar bon gnyis don tha dad min pa ma zad/ gcod mtshams kyis tha dad du mi 'byur ba'i sgo nas/ sbyar gzhi dang sbyar bon gnyis kyi don mtshungs pa du ma zhig tshipo/ gcod mtshams gcig gis ston nus pa zhig la tshig gi gcod mtshacha/sa tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ gzi brjid 'bum ldan lang tsho'i bdagayid 'ong lha bu rta ljang can/ (nyi ma dang bge ban/)gzhan la phan bde sbyin brgya pa/sgra gcan phyogs la dog zon gces/sbyar gzhi yid 'ong lha yi bu zhes pa ni/ nyi ma dang lha dbang brgya byin ri da snyis ka la 'jug cing / sbyar bon gzi brjid 'bum ldan ces pa dang /da la phan dang bde ba ster ba'i phul du byung ba bcas/ dpe can lha yi 6de bong po brgya byin la mtshon na/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mdzes dpal/ gzi ba da rnams tshang ba khyad du 'phags pa ma zad/ lha dang mi'i bde ba ster ba pa ma/ dpe nyi ma la mtshon na/ shar ri'i phrag nas mngon pa'i nyi ma ni/langarmicu'i rnam pa gsar zhing gzi 'od mngon par 'bar ba ma zad/ lha dbasamangoyang sgra gcan gyis mi'u thung du spral nas gom gsum sa gnang spyosdo 497lo rgyus dang / nyi ma yang sgra carne khyab 'jug gis gnod skyel ba'i khrir+shabye ( mapa'in pa sogs lo rgyus du ma dang sbyar te bkod pa'o// lha lhu dri ma med pa'i tsan+d+ra dngas bas na/lots+tshasnye/ —gnyis skyes du ma dga' ba bskyed pa'i dpyid/

— 324—reg pa bsil bas lus can tsha gdung 'phrog sa mos tshal rnams rab tu rgyas par byed/ces dri med tsan+d+ra zhes pa ni che ba la 'jug cing / gnyis skyes ni dbang phyug dang bya sogs la 'jug pas sbyar gakhyi/ dbang phyug dang srin bya gnyis 'a//sgyar bon che ba shar bas rang gi don kun rab 'grub par 'gyungari ba dang / tsha bas gdung ba sogs sel ba'i khyad nus dang ldan zhing / kun d+ngha dkar po rab tu rgyas par byed pa bcas so//ra/ sngo bsang sgeg mo'i lang tsho dar la bab/sna tshogs mdzes pas dar dkar 'a/ ba gyon/bcud ldan ro mchog zegs ma phyogs su 'thor/'dzig rten bde skyid dpal yon g.yur du smin/tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar ba'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ tshig 'dra badzod don tha dad pa/ dzeso sor brjod pa tha dad de/zhes tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar rgyan bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya'i dngos po gang yin pa de'i dpe dang dpe can gnyis sam sbyar gzhi gnyis phan tshun mtshungs pa'i sbyor ba snye/ de yang brjod byed sgra tshig gcig gi badzod don mi 'dra ba gnyis so so nas mtshon par ston nus pa ma zad/ rjod bya de gnyis kyi khyad bon nam sbyar bon phan tshun mtshungs par ston pa'o// tshig gi gcod mtshams kyis sbyar gzhi so so tha dad par ston pa ste/ skabs 'dir tha dad ces pa ni tsheg gi gcod mtshams sam brjod bya de tha dad du phan tshun so sor don dang bya ba mi mthun par tha dad par ston pas tha dad tshig 'dra'i sbyar rgyan zhes bya'o//

gzhung las/ theg chen dbu ma'i rnal sbyor ba/'a zha gsang ba 'dus pa zhes/phyi rgyud bstan pa'i gnyer dpon rje/sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i gtsug‘na mdzes/rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor ba/gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa zhes/nang rgyud bstan pa'i gnyer dpon rje/ dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i gtsug na mdzes/zhes sbyar gzhi 'a zha gsang ba 'dus pa dang / gshen chen gsang ba 'a rdus pa gnyis yin la/ sbyor byed tshig gsang ba 'dus pa zhes pa de nyid zhin la/ sbyar bon rnal 'byor ba dang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srol 'dzin rnam gnyer dpon/ mkhas mang rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas phul du byung ba bcas te/ don tshang tshul ni/ dang po rnal 'byor zhes rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'a zha gsang ba 'dus pa dang / 'bras bu gsang sngags pa'i dz+wal 'byor gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa gnyis/ tha dad du ston zhing sgestan pa'i gnyer dpon zhes phyi 'dul ba'i gnyer dpon 'a zha gsang ba dang /speng gsang sngags kyi gnyer dpon gshen gsang ba yin la/ de dag tshig gecig2khog snga phyi don tha dad ston par 'os pa'o// she tsho rki rgyal mkhar ba chod gnas su sgrub pa snyems/ r+sha /gi —sna rnya blo gsal rnams la legs bshad dga' ston 'gyed/ byesdo ri snyan tshig gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po ba/dir+sha ༈perwa rgyal gshen bsam legs lo paṇa mkhas pa'i mchog

— 326—g.yas ru gtsang gi ri la grub pa snyems/skal ldan rnams la phan bde'i dga' ston 'gyed/snyan tshig gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po ba/slob dpon gtsang gshen lo paṇa mkhas pa'i mchogazhes rgyan de gnyis kyi sbyar gzhi ni snyan ngag tshig brgya smra ba'i dbang po rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs dang / gtsang gshen snyan ngag rang grol gnyis yin zhing / sbyang bon skal ldarme blo gros tshogs la legs bshad la sogs dga' ston 'gyed pa/ snyan ngag tshig brgya smra ba'i dbang po sogs/grub pa snyems zhes pas rgyal mkhar ba chod ces zhang zhung bar pa'i sa char rgyal khams thams cad 'od lus su bsgyir nas grub pa brnyes pa ni rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs dang / g.yas ru gtsang gi sar 'gro don thog pa med par grub nas mthar 'gyur med g.yung drung gi skur grub pa brnyes pa ni/ dmu rigs 'phrul gyi gdung 'dzen gtsang gshen snyan ngag rang grol ba/dga' ston 'gyed ces pas rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs kyis 'phrul ngag bon gyis blo gsal rnams la legs bshad dga' ston 'askyed pa dang /gtsang gshen snyan ngag rang grol gyis 'khor rnams la thar pa dang bde bar bgrod byed kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa/ snyan ngag tshig brgya smra ba'i dbang po zhes pas/ rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs kyis 'phrul ngag bden pa'i bon kun thugs su chud nas/ rang brdol du snyan tshig lam nas smra ba la rang dbang thob pa dang / gtsang gshen snyan ngag mkhan la mkha' 'gro sgra dbyangs rgyal mos snyan du rgyud pa'i snyan gzhung gsang ba'i me long sogs bcu rig gi gnas kun la gding thob pa ma zad/ gnyis kar sgra bsgyur la thogs pa med pa'i lo paṇa mchog tu gyur ba'o//

ra/ dri bral snang ba'i dga' ston 'bum mnga' ba'i/sus kyang ma bkod ris med phan bde'i miga'abyed pas dge legs phun tshogs 'od snang gis/sdug bsngal mun stug gzhil ba dngos po'i gshis/ bya ba tha dad min pa'i sbyar rgyan ni/gzhung las/ brjod pa gcig gis don gnyis bsdu/don bya mthun ston tha mi dad/ces bya ba tha dad min pa'i rgyan gyi don ni/ rang gi brjod bya de gang yin yang rjod byed kyi tshig brjod byar gyur ba'i sbyar bon gyi bya ba gtso bo de nyid/ sbyar gzhi'i bon de gnyis ngo bo tha dad pa yin na'ang / brjod don de'i khyad bon du ma zhig sbyar nas brjod pa gang zhig de yang khyad bon 'ga' zhig tha dad par gnas kyang / brjod byar gyur ba'i sbyar bon bya ba gtso bo de gnyis phan tshun tha dad min par bya ba gcig byed par ston pa'i rgyan zhig la bya ba tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ mdzes sdug rnam bkra'i ri mo dang /yid tsam g.yo ba'i 'dzum dkar can/snang ba'i dpal ster keng tse phyu/che bas snang ba'i dpal ster ro//zhes sbyar gzhi ni rje btsun phyu sras keng tse len med dang / dpe nya rgyas kyi dkar gsal rla ba de gnyis/ sbyar gzhi'i bon du bzung nas/ sbyar bon ni gnyis ka shin tu mdzes sdug gi ri mo bkra ba dang / rtag tu 'dzum dkar rnam par ston pa ma zad/ gtso bo'i byed las kyang tha mi dad par/ kun gyi snang ba'i dpal ster zhes/ phyu sras kyi blo gsal gzhon nu'i blo gros kha 'byed nas/ ma rig gi rmun pa sel nas snang ba'i dga' ston sbyin pa ma zad/

—328—dkar gsal zu bas kyang thun gsum gyi mun pa sel nas/ kun d+ngha'i tshogs rnams ze'u 'bru 'byed pa dang / snad+ngha ba dkar po ster ba sogs gnyis ka'i byed las su/ snang ba'i dpal ster ba mthun par ston pa'o//sha brda sprod gzhung brgya smra la 'gran bral zhing / skal bzang smin grol la 'god bstan pa skyong /lo tsā chen po sha ri dbu chen dang /kun grol grags pa yis kyang phan bde ster/zhes sbyar gzhi sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba mi bzhi'i nang tshan lo tsā ba sha ri dbu chen dang / de dang mtshungs ba sprul sku rnam bzhi'i thu bo gter ston kun grol grags pa gnyis sbyar gzhi la/ sbyar bon brda sprod rig pa'i gnas kun la byan chud pa dang / 'gran pa'i rla thams cad dang bral ba/ gzhan blo gros gsal ba'i skal ldan skyes bu'i 'khor tshogs la drang dang nges pa'i bon rnams so so'i blo dang bstun nas yang dag pa'i lam la ston nus pa'i byin mthu dang ldan pa ma zad/ sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa 'di nyid phyogs kun tu dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzad pa sogs ni skyes bu rnams gnyis kyi thun min gyi rnams dpyod du nges par gcig mtshungs su ston pa'o//ra/ khyed thugs brtse ba'i 'od zhags dkar po yis/nam yang mi 'dod dam bca' rtag 'cha' ba'i/rnam 'dren dam pa mi ya'i seng ge dang /drin can ma ma lus kyi sgrom bus kyang /bya ba 'gal ba min pa'i sbyar ba'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ brjod pa gcig gis don gnyis bsdudon bya 'brel chags ston 'gal min/

—329—zhes bya ba 'gal ba min pa'i sbyar ba'i rgyan gyi don ni/ ji+od byed gdig gi ston nus pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi badzod bya'i dngos po de gnyis phan tshun gyi don dang bya ba tha dad par gnas kung / brjod bya de gnyis phan tshun 'gal bar mi gnas shing don mtshungs par ston pa ma zad/ brjod bya de gnyis kyi bya ba phan tshun 'gal ba ma yin zhing / 'brel chags pa'i sgo nas/ byed las mi 'gal bar gcig tu ston pa ste/ skabs 'di yi 'gal ba min zhes pa ni sbyar gzhi la mi go zhing / sbur bon gyi bya ba mi 'gal ba'i rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ bya ba mi 'gal ba mi 'gal ba'i sbyar rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ gur gum mdangs chags mu khyur 'tshogs/dal 'gros gzabs pa'i gsung snyan can/ngur pa'i tshogs rnams grags pa dang /drang srong rnams kyis mdo sde sgrogs/zhes sbyar gzhi ni/ bslab pa gsum dang ldan pa'i dge 'dun pa dang /de mtshungs bya ngang pa gnyis yin zhing / sbyar bon gur gum mdangs chags zhes pas/ dmar ser gyi mdangs 'chang ba ni/ btsun pa dang / ngang pa gnyis kar ldan zhing / mu khyur tshogs zhes lhan du rang dang rigs mthun dang lhan du 'jog pa bcas so// gsungs snyan pos rang gzhan kun dngas ba shādren pa dang / 'gros gzab pa drang srong rnams kyis mdo sde sgrogs pa dak+to / ngur pas mgrin glu len pa gnyis bya ba tha dad kyang / skye 'gror spro ba rto ragasal mi 'gal ba ma zad/ gang gi sbyar gzhi dang sbyar bon gnyis nas gyudonismudang // bya ba ston tshul sogs la gzhigs nas 'gal bar mi gnod pa 477rdzo sgyu —chigasgas don de dag bya ba mi 'gal ba'i sbyar ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o// sha bslabs gsum gces 'dzin rab 'byams mkhas pa'i dbang / 'chad rtsod rtsom pas rgyal ba'i ring lugs skyongs/

— 330—rong ston tshul 'od zhing 'dir phebs pa dang /blo gros chen po'i sa lam rgyas par bkral//zhes sbyar gzhi rong ston tshul khrims 'od zer dang / bon gyi spyan ldan 'gro mgon blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis yin zhing / sbyar bon bslab pa gsum gyi rgyud 'dzin nas mdo sngags sems gsum gyi sde gang la'ang ma rmangs pa rab 'byams chen po'i mtshan snyan bzhes pa ma zad/ gzhan don du g.yung drung gi bon rin po che 'chad rtsod rtsoms gsum gyi sgo nas mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyi legs byas la brten rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di nyid tshul bzhin du bskyangs ba'o// zhes rnam dpyod kyi 'phrin las mi 'gal bar ston pa'o//ra/ e dbyings mtha' bral mtshan med yangs pa'i klong /brtse chen mkhyen brgya'i 'od stong g.yo ba'i gzis/skye rgu'i rmangs mun thun gsum gzhil ba'i phul/mi yi dbang po rta ljang can min su/'gal ba'i las can gyi sbyar rgyan ni/gzhung las/ badzod pa gcig gis don gnyis bsdu/don bya skye 'gag ston pa 'gal/zhes 'gal ba'i sbyar rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi gang brjod pa'i dngos po de dang sbyar gzhi de gnyis sgra don gang rung gi sgo nas sbyar zhing /sbyar bon gyi bya ba gtso che ba zhig mi mthun par/ dper na mun pa dang gsal ba lta bu mnyam pa'am/ gzhi gcig la phan tshun gcig gi gcig la phan tshun mi mthun par 'gal bar ston pa ste/ skabs 'dir 'gal ba zhes pa ni/ sbyar gzhi gnyis kyi phan tshun bya ba 'gal ba'i tshul gyis 'jug pa la sbyar ba'i 'gal rgyan zhes bya'o//

— 33 1 — gzhung las/ phyi nang gsang ba'i 'khor tshogs rnams/kha lo bsgyur ba'i rje gcig pu/rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar ba dang / bdud rje'i bstan pa nub par 'gyur/zhes sbyar gzhi rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i mgon po gshen rab mi bo dang / bdud rje khyab pa lag ring gi sbyar bon rang gi phyi 'khor dang nang 'khor gsang ba'i 'khor bcas la dbang bsgyir ba'i cha nas/ don sbur ba ma zad/ de yang byed las mdzad 'phrin gyi cha nas/ ston pa'i thugs rjes/nag po bdud kyi bstan pa nub par gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa bcas kyi 'gro don 'phrin las kyi cha nas byed las 'gal bar ston pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'o//sha bka' btsan gtso la 'khor tshogs du mas bskor/'dul ba'i sems ldan dog slong gzon dang bcas/ston pa khro bzhi'i sku ru khros pa dang /gto bu dod de'i dmag tshogs zhi bar gyur/zhes sbyar gzhi ston pa gshen rab mi bo dang / sdig po che gto bu dod de gnyis te/ sbyar bon gzhan la bka' btsan pa'am lha srin sde brgyad la bka' btsan pa/ rang dang mthun pa'i 'khor tshogs du ma'i dpung dang bcas pa/gzhan 'dul ba'i sems dang ldan pa bcas dang / sdig po che gto bu dod des 'jig rten 'dir srid 'byor kho na dang du blang nas/ las dge sdig la ma brtsis par/ mi dge ba'i las tshogs kyang bsags pa la/ ston pas de dag dge la 'jug par bskul ba'i phyir du ston pa yul der phebs pa la gto bu'i dmag drang bas/ ston pa khro bo bzhi yi skur bzhengs nas/ gto bu'i dmag tshogs rnams rang dbang med par zhi bar gyur ba'o// zhes so//

— 332—ra/ mkhas mang rnam dpyod 'gran pa'i do ra nas/lung rig rtsal gsum mnga' ba'i kha lnga ji/sa/gshen bstan grags dkar phyogs bcur bsgrags dang lhan/stong can dbyar rnga pa yi rtsa sgo 'gaganges pa can gyi sbyar ba'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ tshig res dpe don gnyis bsdu yang /don nyid ston pa nges pa can/zhes nges pa cam/ gyi rgyan gyi don ni/ rang go badzod bya gang yang rung ba'i sgo nas/ sbyar gzhi'i bon gnyis spyor sgra mtshungs tsam la sbyar ba te/spyir ni sbyar byed kyi sgra de'i dpe dang don gnyis kyi sgo nas ston pa yin yang /skabs 'dir brjod don de nyid gtso bor byas nas/ 'os pa'i don rnams dang ldan pa'i sgra yi phyogs rnams sgra don gnyis kyi sgo nas bsgrab ste/ nges pa'i don dngos su bzung nas/ sbyar gzhi dang mi mthun pakhru dpe don la 'jug pa ni mi 'os pas 'jig pa bkag ste/ dpe don mthun pa'i do na la nges par gnas pa dang / nges pa zhes pa sbyar bon dpe don gnyis kyi sgo nas don de dang mthun pa nges par ston pa zhig la nges pa can gyi sbyar ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ rgya che gting zab dpag dka' ba/dge legs phan bde 'byung ba'i mdzod/shes rab ldan pa'i blo gros khong /yin gyi nor ldan rgya mtsho min/zhes sbyar gzhi dpe can ni bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i shes rab can dang / rgya mtsho gnyis te/ sbyar bon ni/ mdzod ces pa'i sgra yi sgo kun nas sbyar ba ma zad/ de gnyis kyi khyad bon/ rgya che ba/ gting dang

— 333—mtha' bral ba ste/ don mkhas pas mkhyen pa'i yon tan gyi+o 'gro ba kun la phan bde stsal ba dang / rgya mtsho'i yid bzhin nor bu rin po ches/ 'gro ba rang mthun gyi dgos 'dod thams cad ci go ba'i nās mthu dang ldan pa la/skabs 'dir dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi nang nas khyad bon phun sum tshoṭa pa dang ldan pa ni/ dpe can thams myod mkhyen pa'i dbang po de nyid yin pa las/ rdzas kyi nor bu 'byung sa'i rgya mtsho ni min no// zhes brjod pa'o//sha zhang zhung lig mi rgyal khyod sa tu cha/ma hā ta dza dang ni ham sesnra/snying stobs gzi brjid chen po mi yi dbang /de dag yin gyi cig shos yo ga min/zhes sbyar gzhi dpe can ma hā ta dza ni me ston chen po dang / dpe zhang zhung gi rgyal po lig mi rkya gnyis yin zhing / sbyar bon ni/ sa tu cha ni sems can gyi stobs/ hamasen+d+ra ra zhes ngang pa'i rgyal po dang mi yi dbang po bcas/ phan tshun khyad bon sbyar ba yin la/ saṃskrota yi skad du haṃsesnra zhes pas ngang pa'i rgyal po zhes 'dul 'dzin mkhan po dang mi yi dbang po gnyis la 'jug cing / gong gi khyad bon tha dad tshangadzo ba ni/ yar 'brog me stone shes rab 'od zer ro zhes brjod pa'o//ra/ yid 'ong rkang 'thung dkrig pa'i dga' tshal na/snyan 'gyur 'bum gyis spud pa'i mgrin blu 'di/tshul ldan mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod ston pa las/gnyis skyes gzhan la re ba'i ngag brda min/ ṭ+wāṃs pa 'gog pa'i sbyar rgyan ni/ gzhung las/ tshig res dpe don 'ga' bsdu zhing /don gcig ma nges nges 'gog sbyar/

— 33 4—zhes nges pa 'gog pa'i sbyar ba'i don ni/ rang go badzod bya sbyar gzhi dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig gi sbyar bon nam/ khyad bon sogs legs pa'i yon tan gyi khyad bon de ltar ldan pa'i khyad gzhi de las/ gzhan dkon pa lta bur brjod nas/ slar yang de gcig pu ma yin par/ bon gzhan la khyad bon de dag ldan pa yod par ston pa'am/ yang ma khyad bon las gzhan pa khyad gzhi de la yod par ston pa zhig ste/ skabs 'dir nges pa 'gog pa ni/sbyar gzhi de la sbyar bon phun sum tshogs pa rnams ston zhing / sbyar gzhi de tsam du ma nges par/ bon gzhan la sbyar bon de 'dra ldan par yod par ston pas gcig tu ma nges pa'o//gzhung las/ 'khor ba'i dri mas ma gos pa/rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/'on kyang dag pa gnyis ldan pa/ngo bo nyid kyi sku yang snang /zhes gang gi sbyar gzhi rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la/ sbyar bon 'khor ba'i dri ma'am skyon gyis ma gos pa dri med rnam par dag pa'i sku ru nges par ston pa ste/ de tsam gyis ma nges par nyon mongs pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis kyi dri ma tha dag dang bral ba'i dag pa gnyis ldan gyi ngo bo nyid kyi sku yang gang de'i khyad bon tha dag dang ldan pa 'o// zhes badzod pa'o//sha phan bde'i 'od snang bde legs 'byung ba'i dpal/mtshan dpe'i rgyan ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/'on kyang ma nges mchog gi sprul sku yang /gang 'dul der ston snang brnyan ci yang ston/zhes sbyar gzhi longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / cir yang sprul pa'i sku gnyis yin la/ 'gro kun phan bde'i dpal sbyin pa dang / mtshan bzang po

— 335 —dang dpe byad bzang po ldan pa sogs sbyar zhing / de yang gong gi mtshan dpe dang rdzogs pa'i chas thams cad rdzogs pa ni rdzogs sku gshen lha 'od dkar kho nar ma nges te/ cir yang spral pa'i sku yang gang la gang 'dul du sprul rung bas so// zhes phyi ma la yarngo spral pa yod par ston pa'o//ra/ 'dam gyi dri mas ma rgos gos dkar can/'od zer 'bum ldan kun dha dkar po'i tshogs/'on kyang dal 'bab klong nas 'khrungs ba yi/yid 'ong bsil zer can yang dri mas dben/'gal med kyi sbyar ba'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ don gcig dpe mang sbyar ba'i bon/mthun par bkod pa 'gal med sbyor/zhes 'gal med kyi sbyar rgyan 'di lta ste/ rang gi brjod byar gyur ba'i sbyar gzhi dngos po dpe can gcig la/ de mtshon byed kyi dpe du ma zhig bkod nas sbyar gzhi de dang mtshungs pa'i sbyar bon mtshungs par ston pa ma zad/ skabs 'dir 'gal med ces pa ni/ sbyar gzhi de mtshon byed dpe daha ma zhig bkod nas dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi sbyar bon mi 'gal bar gsal tsam ston pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i dper brjod pa'o//gzhung las/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dri ma med/bder gshegs kun 'dus 'od lnga pa/gsung gi dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen/ gzi brjid chen pos bgegs dpung 'dul/zhes dpe can nam sbyar gzhi ni/ dang po rigs brgya ni ston pa/ khyab bdag ni kun tu bzang po ste/ khyad bon sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i bon mtshungs pa/ gnyis pa sbyar gzhi dpe ni bder gshegs kun

— 336—'dus zhes pas ston pa gshen lha 'od dkar dang / sbyar bon 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khang nang du bzhugs par ston cing / gsum par sbyar gzhi shes rab smra ba'i seng ge la sbyar bon thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pa/ bzhi pa la khro bo chen po'i sku la/ sbyar bon mi mthun bgegs kyi dpung tshogs kun 'joms pa ste/ gong gi sbyar gzhi'i dpe dang dpe can gyi sbyaratshobon rnams mi 'gal bar so dza| nas gsal ba'o//sha rgyal ba'i gdung sob 'dul bstan ring lugs skyongs/sngags kyi bdag pos bskyed rdzogs mngon du gyur/khyab bdag chen po sems nyid rjen par ston/sgra bsgyur lo paṇa tshig don kun la mkhas/zhes (nya)sbyar gzhi rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin sum ldan bla—ma dang / gdung sob mu cho ldem drug dang / sbyar bon g.yu nga drung bon gyi ring lugs 'dzin skyongs ṣ+pel gsum gyi sgo nar+sā bstan pa spel ba dang /(3)sbyar gzhi gsang ba 'dus pa dang / glur bon bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gshātes kyi srol 'dzin zhing ma lus pa mkhyen pa/ (3)sbyar gzhi spral skya ta pi hri tsa zhang zhung skad de bod skad du srid pa'i khyaru/ sbyar bon rlams nyed kyi gnas lugs rjen par ston pa/ (4)sbyar gzhi lo tsā ba sha ri dbu chen dang / sbyar bon sgra dang tshig kun ma lus byan du chud pa bcas kyi zug8bye+oskyed rnga/9)ོ//ra/ rnam 'dren (blam/〉mi yi seng ge (seng ge)kun gyi mgon/mchog gsum bla ma (blam/)'dod rgu (nor bu/)'byung ba'i phul/ngag dbang (bla ma/)sgra brgya sgrogs (smraseng /tor glog gi lce/mkhyen brtse (blam/)nyi 'od 9ma/)skye 'gro'i gsos su smin/yi

'gal ba can gyi sbyar ba'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ don gcig dpe mang sbyar bon phyed/mthun dang phyed 'gal 'gal ba can/zhes 'gal ba'i sbyar rgyan gyi don bstan te/ gang brjod pa'i brjod don nam sbyar gzhi dpe dang ngape can gnyis la/ mtshon bya dpe can gcig la/mtshon byed tha dad pa da ma zhig bkod nas/ dpe de dag gi sbyar bon namyo//khyad bon rnams sbyar gzhi dpe can de la ldan zhing mi 'gal ba dang / sbyar bya'i dpe can de'i khyad bon rnams dpe la mi ldan pa ma zad/ med par ston pa ste/ skabs 'dir cha/thun zhes pa ni dpe'i khyad bon dpe can la ldan ji/sa mthun pa dang / dpe can kyi khyad bon rnams dpe la mi ldan pas khyad 'gal bar ston pa ste 'gal ba can gyi sbyar ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ dkar 'jam ldan yang 'phel /'grib med/sman rgyal yin yang mkhyen bortse mnga'/rtsal gsum rdzags kyang 'khar la byams/sgra rig mkhas kyang dregs sems bral/zhes rim bzhin rkang pa dang po nas bshad par bya ba la/ sbyar gzhi dpe can phyu keng tse dang dpe che ba gnyis/ sbyar bon mthun pa ni dkar gsal gyi 'od mdangs rnam par bkra ba dang / phyed mi mthun pa ni/ dpe can phyu sras sku la 'od ma/dngas 'char nub med cing / dpe zu ba la 'char nub dang ldan pa/ de bzhin rkang pa gnyis par/ sbyar gzhi dpe can phywa sras dang dpe sman mchog a ru rnam par rgyal ba/ mthun pa'i sbyor bon ni/ kun la phan dang zug ngu'i sdug bsngal las skyabs dang / mi mthun pa ni mkhyen dang brtse ba chen po'i gzhi dang ldan pa dang / rkang pa gsum pa/ sbyar gzhi dpe can phyu keng tse dang dpe seng ge gnyis la/ sbyar bon mthun pa ni rang mthun gyi rtsal

—338—rnam pa gsum rdzogs pa de yin la/ mi mthun pa ni rang gi rigs mthun gyi 'khor rnams la byams dang snying rjes skyongs pa'i yon tan de ldan min no// rkang pa bzhi par sbyar bzhi dpe can phyu keng tse dang gza' mchog phur bu gnyis la sbyar bon mthun pa sgra rig pa'i gnas dang gzhan rig pa'i gnas rnams la byang chub pa de yin la/ sbyar bon phyed mi mthun pa ni phyu keng tse la 'khor la byams dang brtse ba sogs dregs pa'i sems rnams rab tu zhi ba de/ dpe gza' mchog phur bu la mi ldan pas sbyar bon phyed 'gal ston pa'o//sha gser mdangs mngon par bkra yang rdul las grol/gzi brjid che yang kun d+ngha'i tshal mi bcom/kun las rnam par rgyal yang brtse sems ldan/'gro ba'i dri ma 'khrud kyang rnyog mas dben/zhes rkang pa dang po sbyar gzhi dpe can sangs rgyas dang / dpe gser gyi ri bo sbyar bon mtshungs ba 'od mdangs dmar ser gyi phyogs kun khyab pa dang / mi rme tshungs pa'i sbyar bon rdul gyi ma gos pa'i khyad bon dang /gnyis pa dpe can sangs rgyas dang dpe nyi ma/ sbyar bon mtshungs pa'i bon ni gzi 'od kyi rnam pa rab tu bkra ba'i nyams 'gyur/ mi mtshungs pa'i sbyar bon ni kun dha dkar po'i tshal rnams zum par mi byed pa'i khyad bon dang / gsum pa dpe can sbyar gzhe sangs rgyas dang gza' khyab 'jug sbyar bon mtshungs pa ni stobs dang mnga' thang gi kun las rnam par rgyal ba tsam las/ mi mthun pa'i khyad bon ni/ 'gro ba kun gnod pa'i sems spangs nas phan pa dang bde ba ster ba'i yon tan no// bzhi pa sbyar bon dpe can ni sangs rgyas dang gtsang chu gnyis 'gro ba'i dri ma 'khrud ba'i khyad bon nam sbyar bon mthun par ldan yang / mi mthun pa'am dpe la mi ldan pa'i dpe can gyi khyad bon ni/ rnyog ma'i tshogs kyi dben pa bcas/ khyad bon dpe

— ci2 3 9 —yi don rlums dpe can la ldan zhing dpe can gyi khud bon rnacha/sa/ dpe la mi ldan pa'o//ra/ phul byung (bla ma/)mdzes sdug ྅na chags (ri rgul/)mtshan dpe'i rten/rnam dpyod (bla ma/)khri 'phang ldan (khri 'phang /)zhing 'khor tshogs/ skyong /phul phyin (bla ma/)'dod rgu'i gter 'chang (rgya mtsho/)phan bdekhā+e dpal/'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan (bla ma/)dam pa (nor bra/)khyad min ྅/spya/zhes snyan ngag rin chen lnge mig gi 'grel ba er sa/ngas bu ma'i mgul rgyan las sbur ba'i rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa ste nyer bzhi pa'o//

— 340—khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan/mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ 'grub byed khyad par ma tshang yang /grub 'bras gsal ston khyad par brjod/ces khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi brjod byar gyur ba'i dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig gis rang la nye bar mkho ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'grub byed kyi rgyu'am/ yang na rang gi khyad bon rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas sogs gang rung gi khyad par ram khyad bon ma ldan pa'am ma tshang pa bzhin du/ khyad bon ldan pa las lhag pa'i bya byed nus pa'i rgyan te/ skabs 'dir khyad par ma tshang zhes pa ni/ 'grub byed dam rigs kyi khyad par/ bya ba'i khyad par/ yon tan gyi khyad par sogs ci rigs ma tshang pa la go zhing / de'i khyad par ma tshang yang / khyad bom nam 'bras bu yod par ston pa zhig la 'jog dgos so//dper na/ mang thos khyed kyi blo gros ni/rno min ngar min sra ba'ang min/de ltar med kyang dka' gnad kun/zang thal 'bigs 'di e ma mtshar/ zhes pa lta bu'o//dbye ba so so'i don la lnga ste/ yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par badzod pa'i rgyan dang / rig ma tshang ba'i khyad par baji+od pa'i rgyan/ bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par badzod pa'i rgyan/ rdzas ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan/rgyu ma tshang ba'i khyad par badzod pa'i rgyan dang lnga'o//

—341 —yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par badzod pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ 'grub byed yon tan ma tshang yang /grub 'bras gsal ston yon tan khyad/ces yon tan gyi khyad par badzod pa'i don bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya'i dngos po de la nye bar mkho ba'i yon tan gyi cha lag gam khyad par zhig ma tshang ba dngos su bkod nas/ yon tan gyi khyad par ma tshang ba de dag gi rgyu rkyen gyis 'bras bu 'gog par ma nus par/ yon tan de'i byed las sam khyad 'phags kyi 'bras bu thob pa gsal bar brjod pa'i rgyan zhig la yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par ba4ོda pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ byang chub chen po'i sku 'di ni/lci ba ma yin lhu 'thug pa'ang min/sra 'thas min kyang nyer 'tshe'i rkyen/gang gis mi bskyed e re rmad /ces brjong bya byang chub chen po'i sku zhes rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang /rdzogs pa'i sku de nyid lci yang gi khyad bon 'byed skabs/ lci ba'i yon tan dang ma ldan pa ma zad/ ྅ tshig rnams sbom la rag pa yang ma yin/ sra 'khregs can yang ma yin par/ rang re'i phal gyi mthong tshul de dag gi yon tan dang cha/ ldan yang / nyer 'tshe'i rkyen gyis bag mi pig pa ste/ lci ba min kyang lci ba'i yon tan gyi gang gis 'gul bskyed mi nus pa sogs khyad gzhi ma tshang yang khyad bon ldan pa lta bur ston pa'o//sha mkhas pa dpal gyi rnam bzhag thal 'gyur rnarme/sa /rno min sra ba ma yin ngar ba'ang min/de lta na yang gzhung lugs mtha' dag gipaṅka dka' gnad ma lus zang thal 'bigs 'di mtshar/

— 342—zhes khyad gzhi mkhas pa rme'u dpal chen pos mdzad pa'i mdo rgyud kyi dgongs don nying bcud las rang lugs bzhag pa/ gzhan lugs dgag pa sogs kyi thal 'gyur dang rgyu mtshan ni/ khyad gzhi rtse mo rno ba ma yin pa ma zad/ sra ba 'khregs can gyi rdul gyi phung po yang ma yin pas/ gang gi dgag bzhag spongs gsum gyi rnam bzhag la yon tan nam khyad bon ldan pa rtse mo sra 'khregs rno ngar bcas min kyang / de dag gi yon tan gyi 'bras bu ldan pa ste/ dka' ba'i gnad kun zang thal du 'bigs par byed pa'o// zhes so//ra/ yid 'ong pha mtha' bral ba'i 'jug ngog nas/ma bsus mgron du 'gug pa'i nyi gzhon mas/skal me 'bum gyi slag pa ma 'khrungs kyang /'khyag rum dmigs med gzhil ba ches ya mtshan/rigs ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ 'grub byed rigs khyad ma tshang yang /grub 'bras gsal ston rigs khyad de/zhes rigs khya/ da kyi don bstan te/ rang gi brjod bya'i bon nam dpe can gang yin pa'i de la/ rang latshorigs kyi cha lag gam khyad par 'ga' zhig ma tshang par gsal bar ston zhing / rigs de dag gi khyad bon nam rgyu gang gi rigs de ma tshang yang / de ma tshang ba'i skyon mi 'byung zhing / de dag tshang ba'i 'bras bu'am yon tan lhag par grub par ston pa'i rgyan zhig la rigs ma tshang ba'i khyad mtshar gyi rgyan zhes badzod do//gzhung las/ gser ldan grong nas ma bskyed cing /seng ge'i khong nas ma 'khrungs kyang / 'gro mgon chen po'i thal ngag gis/rgol ba tshar gcod gzhan zil gnon/

— 343 —zhes gser ldan grong zhes sum cu rtsa gsum lha yi gnas nas yong ba'i lha dbang brgya sbyin gyi rigs kyad+ngha ma yin/ rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i seng ge ni rigs te/ seng ge'i khongs nas 'khrungs pa'i seng phrug kyang ma yin pa ste rigs de gnyis dang mi ldan yang / 'gro mgon 'a zha blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi/ blo gros las thon pa'i thal ngag giru// rig pa smra ba'i rigs rnams kyi rgol ba ma lus pa zil gyis gnon pa'i khyad par gyi yon tan grub par ston pa'i don te/ gang gi rigs kyi khyad par de dag ma ldan yang ldan pa lta bu'i rgol ba'i rigs kun 'jom pa'i don no//sha 'o mtsho gsar pa'i srub las ma thon zhing //yid 'ong pad dkar sbubs las ma 'khrungs mod/de ltar na yang dkar 'jam phyu sras skus/srid zhi'i lus can yid dbang 'phrog par nus/zhes mtshon bya dpe can phyu sras keng tse'i sku de la/ rigs mthun gyi khyad gzhi'i rigs 'o ma'i mtsho las byung ba yang min la/ pad ma dkar po'i sbubs nas kyang ma 'khrungs pa'i phyu sras kyi sku mdog dkar po'i 'od mdangs 'bar ba 'di ni/ gang gi rigs mthun de dag gi yon tan nam 'bras bu grub pa ste/ srid pa dang zhi bar gnas pa'i lus can yo da do cog gi yid 'ong 'phrog par nus pa bcas kyi khyad bon dang ldan pa'o//ra/ mtha' bral 'chi med lam gyi bla bre ru/ma brten gnas skabs dus rkyen gyir+sā/ dben pa'i/dam pa'i rnams dpyod rig pa'i mda' mo yi/rgol ngan ris can rkyal pa'i khong bu bshigs/bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ 'grub pa'i bya ba ma tshang yang /

—344—grub 'bras gsal ston bya khyad de/zhes bya khyad rgyan gyi don ni/ gang gi brjod don nam brjod 'dod kyi dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig ste/ brjod bya khyad gzhi de la khyad bon bya ba 'ga' ma tshang ba gsal bor ston pa ma zad/ brjod bya dngos kyi bon de la bya ba de dag ma tshang ba'i skyon gang yang mi 'byung zhing / bya ba de nyid tshang ba las lhag pa'i yon tan nam/ legs 'bras khyad par can thob par ston pa'i rgyan zhig la bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ khros pa'i bzhin nyams ma bzlog cing /ngar ldan rno dbal ma bstan yang /dbyar mo thang ba'i rnam dpyod kyis/mkhas kun yid rab choms 'di ci/zhes mtshon bya dpe can mkhas pa dbyar mo thang zhes pa ni gnyos tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la zer zhing / khong ni thugs nyid zhi ba ma zad/ 'jig rten bon brgyad kyi kun slong rtsa ba nas med pa ma zad/ khros pa'i gar dgu dang ngar ldan ral gri'i ngar bsdar ba sogs kyi bya ba gang yang ma mdzad na yang / gang gis bya ba dang cha byed de dag bstan pa las lhag pa'i mkhas pa kun khong mthong bas lung dang rig pas tshar thag gcod yong bsam nas lkug thag chod pa lta bur gyur ba dngos su brjod pa'o//sha dbang sdud man ngag dang du blang min cing /'gug pa'i las sbyor ma byas dus dag kyang /ma btab kho bo'i mdun sar blo gsal kun/'dus nas bon sgo'i dka' gnad gad gdar byed/ces gshen gyi mkhas grub tshul khrims rgyal mtshan khong nyid dpe can du bzung nas gzhan 'khor tshogs 'dus pa'i dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo dang

— 3 45 —rdzas sogs ma bsags pa ma zad/ thabs shes sna tshogs kyis 'khor du 'du ba'i bya ba gang yang ma byas kyang / de dag gi bya byas pa bas lhag pa'i blo gros gsal ba'i skal ldan du ma 'ob kyi mdun du lhag nas g.yung drung gi bon rin po che'i dka' ba'i gnad kun la sbyor brdar mthar phyin par gnang dang gnang bzhin pa'o// zhes so//ra/ tshogs gnyis rin chen gter la ma spyod cing /byang chub sems kyi sa bon ma bskyed pa'i/rgyal kun yum gcig ma ma er sangs mas/'jigs brgyad g.yul ngo zlog par mdzad 'di rmad/rdzas ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ 'grub thabs rdzas rigs ma tshang yang /grub 'bras gsal ston rdzas khyad de/— zhes rdzas khyad kyi don ston te/ rgyan de'i brjod bya'i dngos po de la r+sha slo rang 'bras khyad par can 'grub byed kyi rdzas rigs 'ga' ma tshang ba gsal bar bkod nas/ rdzas rigs de dag ma tshang yang skyon du mi 'byung bar rdzas mi rigs de dag tshang ba las lhag pa'i khyad nus ston nus pa dang / de dag gi byed las kyang mngon gsal dod pos bstan nus pa'i rgyan zhig la rdzas ma ri tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ sra ba'i go dang rno ba'i mtshon/mgyogs pa'i rta dang mang ba'i dmagatsho med kyang gshen rab gtso 'khor ྅/cosdu rī wa rī ’chi — bdud srin dpung las rnam par rgyal/cihūṃtsho ༷—‘skyi/4 zhes ston pa gshen rab mi bo bod la 'gro ba'i don du phebs pa la gtso wa /sdokhor lnga ste/ mtshan ldan khye'u bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas nas byon pa las/

— —246— pha rol bdud lha srin sde brgyad bzlog pa'i rdzas gri mtshon dang/ go cha/ mang ba'i dmag dpung dang / mgyogs pa'i rta sogs gang yang med kyang / bod kyi lha srin sde brgyad kun bka' dam 'og tu 'dus nas bran du bskul ba ma tshad/ bdud dmag bye ba'i dpung rnams dbang med du brgyal ba dang /rengs par gyur zhing / gshen gyi rta bdun rang sar lon pa dang / bod yul rgyu+o bon gyi char chen dbab pa sogs kyi mdzad 'phrin bya ba rlabs po che grub ba//sha dpa' ba'i dmag dang ra mda' gcig dben zhing /sra ba'i go dang rno mtshon mi ldan kyang /lha bdun zhal bstan tsam gyis snang mdog rje/khro bdag rgol ba'i dpung las rnam par rgyal/zhes dpe can gshen nam mkha' snang ba mdog can gyis/ mu stegs rgol ba'i khro bdag brlog pa'i thabs/ mtshon cha dang go cha/ gzhan dmag gi dpāng la ma brten yang / shes rab lha bdun gyi zhal mthong ba tsam gyis mu stegs rgol ba'i tshogs rang sar zhi nas dpung de las rnam par rgyal bar gyur zhes/ lo rgyus las sngon nam mkha' snang ba mdog can de nyid byams ma sgrub nas bzhugs bzhin pa'i skabs/ dus rtag tu mar sbyin de nyid bya rog zhig la sbyon gyi yod pa la/ nyin zhig bya rog de 'byer min la song bya gzhan zhig gis zos nas med pa la/ slar bya rog 'byor bas byin zin pa la/ bya rog khong khros te/ rgya gar nas mu stegs rgol ba'i khro bdag sogs mu stegs mang po zhig gdan drangs nas nam mkha' snang ba mdog can 'dul du khrid yong ba la/ nam mkha' snang ba mdog can gyi go mtshon gang yang med kyang / rgyal ba'i thugs rjes nam mkha' nas byams ma mu

— 34 7—stegs 'jigs skyobs sam shes rab lha bdan zhal gzigs pa tsam gyis mu stegs kyi dpung las rgyal bar bshad pa dang sbyar nas brtsams pa'o//ra/ bda' dgu'i zas kyi 'tsho ba dang bral zhing /'jam mnyen dar dang skyems kyis ma gsos pa'i/ston pa dka' thub lo dgu mdzad pa'i skabs/mdzes bzang bkrag mdangs sngar las lhag par gyur/rgyu yi khyad par ma tshang ba'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ 'grwab byed rgyu khyad ma tshang yang /grub 'bras gsal ston rgyu khyad de/zhes rgyu'i khyad par ma tshang ba'i rgyan gyi don ston te/ rang gi brjod 'dod kyi dngos po gang yang rung ba'i skye byed kyi rgyu'i khyad par ram/ bye brag 'ga' zhig ma tshang ba gsal por balngod pa gang zhig la/ rgyu de'i tshogs pa ma tshang yang / rgyu'i khyad par tshang ba las lhag pa'i 'bras bu phun tshogs khyad par can gzi brjid dang ldan pa zhig bskyed nus par ston pa ste/ skabs 'di'i rgyu'i khyad par ni sngon ma bzhi ni rang rang ngo skal gyi rgyu 'ga' re ma tshang ba brjad kyang / 'di rang rang gi rigs mthun kyang bdag rkyen dngos ma yin pa'i cha nas/ rang las rigs gzhan pa'i bdag rkyen gyi rgyu'i dngos 'bras khyad du 'phags pa thob par ston pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ chen po'i go sa dbang yig dang / / cilnge phun tshogs stobs 'byor mnga' thang sogs/ k+ṣe/chi/ med kyang rje btsun khro tshang bas/ shā 'jig rten gsum po zil gyis gnon/ zhes dpe can rje btsun khro tshang 'brug lha de nyid la/ thams cad zil gyis gnon pa rgyu'i khyad par/ dpon po'i go sa dang / dbang cha'i dpang yig

—348—phun tshogs kyi mnga' thang / 'jig rten gyi nor rdzas sogs kyi khyad par ram rgyu ma ldan zhes nyer len gyi rgyu 'ga' ma tshang bas skyon du me 'asding zhing /nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dang bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i yon tan gyis snyan pa'i grags pas 'jig rten gyi khams kun grags pas khyab par gyur ba lta bu badzod pa'o//sha mang bkur rgyal po'i sras su ma 'khrungs shing /stobs 'byor mnga' thang gyis dben bka' btsan gyis/kun la dbang bsgyur min yang spyan gcig pas/ru bzhi'i dkyil du bshad sgrub srol bzang btsugaces mtshon bya dpe can rje mnyam med chen po yin zhing / dam pas mdzad spyod ni gong ma lha las bkos pa'i bod rgyal gyi sras su ma 'khrungs pa ma zad/ zang zing gi 'byor ba dben pa'i khar gzhan la bka' bstsal ba'i dpon rigs sogs gang yang min yang / de dag rgyu'i khyad bon thams cad ldan pa ji bzhin bod ru bzhi'i dkyil du bon gyi 'du gnas chen po gsar du bskrun pa ma zad/ mdo sngags zung 'brel gshen gyi bstan pa'i grags dkar phyogs kun khyab par mdzad pa lta bu la sbyar nas brjod pa'o//ra/ ya rabs can gyi skye ba'i zhwa mo bral/bslab dang mkhas gral 'grim pa'i phyag rtags dben/dman bdag ca kas dben pa'i snying khongs su/lnga rig mdza' mo mgron du phebs 'di ci/zhes snyan gzhung rin chen lde mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa ste nyer lnga pa'o//

— 349— mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan ni/mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi/ dbye so so'i don no//gzheng las/ mtshungs rla 'gal dang dngos don de'i/khyad bon mtshungs brjod mtshungs sbyor te/zhes mtshungs sbu+or gyi rgyan gyi don bstan te/ gang zhig brjod byar bzung ba'i bon gang yang rung ba zhig rang gi brjod bya de dang / mtshon byed kyi dpe du ma mtshon bya dpe can nam mtshungs bya'i dpe'i rla bor sbyar ba de dang / dngos po'i gnas tshod kyi ngos nas phan tshun mi mtshungs shing /'ga' ba ltag sprod du song yang / rang gi brjod 'dod kyi dbang gis bstod smad ci rigs kyi khyad bon 'ga' zhig la brten nas mtshungs par sgro btaṭa te brjod pa zhig ste/ skabs 'dir 'gal zhes pa ni/ don du dpe don mi mchungs kyang / mtshungs sbyor zhes pas mi mtshungs pa mtshungs par ston pa lta bu ste/ dpe rgyan gyi mtshungs sbyor las mtshungs gsal yod med kyi khyad par dang ldan pa ni mtshungs par sbyor ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o//dper na/ ka la ping ka'i mgrin 'gyur dang /dri za'i pi wang tam bu ra/sgra dbyangs rgyal mo'i gsung snyan rnams/rna ba'i gson zhes kun gyis sgrog ces pa lta bu'o//dbye na gnyis te/ bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor rgyan dang / smad pa'imatshungs sbyor rgyan gnyis so//bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan ni/ gzhung las/ mtshungs zu 'ga' dang dngos don de'i/

— 35 0—yo/na tan mtshungs badzod bltod mtshungs te/zhes bstod mtshungs kyi don te/ rang gi brjod bya'i dngos po de'i rang bzhin dang khyad nus dngos su mi mtshungs pa yin yang / brjod pa po'i 'dod pa'i dbang gos khud bon nam khyad par gang rung zhig la brten nas/mtshon bya de la dpe du ma zhig phan tshun mtshungs par sgra sbyar ba ste/ brjod 'dod kyi bstod pa'i don la smos pa zhig la/ bstod pa'i dbang gi mtshungs par sbyor ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ phyu rje yab bla bdal drug dang / klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen dang /gshen rab mi mgon rgyal po rnams/'jig rten dbang po che zhes grags/zhes mtshon bya dpe can gshen rab mi mgon rgyal po dang / mtshon byed dpe rgyal po dang / gtsug na rin chen ni klu yi rgyal po ste/ gang gi lha yi rgyal po dang / klu yi rgyal po gnyis la/ rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo la mtshungs pa'i yon tan nam khyad bon med cing / 'jig rten la dbang che ba zhes pa'i don la'ang mi mtshungs par khyad par chen po yod kung / rang rang gi las dbang gi cha nas sa skyong gi rgyal po che gsum zhes mtshungs tshul la sgro btags te brjod pa'o//sha rtsa gsum mtshal rir lha bon yongs dag dang /chu mig brgyad cur klu grub ye shes snyi/nga /rgya mkhar ba chod mi lus bsam legs gsum/'gro kun bon sgor 'dzud pa'i mchog ces grags/zhes dpe can lha yi gshen po lha yi bon po yongs su dag pa de nyid la/ mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe lta bu ni/ klu yi gshen po klu grub ye shes snying po/ mi

— 35 1 —yi gshen po rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs gsum phan tshun yon tan nam khyad bon so so nas tha dad pa ma zad/ so so'i 'gro don gyi 'dul zhing sogs tha dad pa yin yang / brjod 'dod kyi dbang go 'gro ba kun la bon ston pa'am/ so so'i yul du bsgrags pa gsum gyi bon sde re ston pa'i rgyu mtshan du byas nas mtshungs par brjod pa'o//ra/ bden gnyis do mnyam 'phrul ngag g.yung drung bon/gdul bya'i snang ngor sa dge bka' rnying sde/dka' thub bzod sran phul byung phyi rol sogs/kun bzang bde ba'i don du bang rtsal 'gran/smad pa'i mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ mtshungs rla 'gal dang dngos don de'i/skyon rnams mtshungs brjod smad mtshungs te/zhes smad mtshungs kyi don bstan te/ rang gi brjod 'dod kyi mtshon bya dpe can de nyid rang bzhin dang mi mtshungs pa don du gnas kyang / rang gi badzod 'dod kyi brjod bya'i khyad par dang khyad bon du gyur ba'i ngag mtshon dang skyon du ma zhig breji+od nas/ de dag bon gzhan zhig dang / khyad bon mtshungs par sgro btags nas rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig dbang gi mtshungs par sbyor ba la smad pa'i mtshungs sbyor zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ sha rgyas gtsug gi dung rwa dang /ri dwags lte ba'i rtsi mchog dang /ba/sog can blun po'i nor dang gsum/legs kyang rang nyid phung la sbyor/zhes brjod don ri dwags sha ba'i mgo bor skyes pa'i rwa dang / ri dwags gla ba'i lte ba'i rtsi gnyis/ blun pos mchod sbyin ma nus pa'i nor

— 352—rdzas dang sbyar ba ste/ gang gi blun pos nor la rang gi longs su spyod mi nus pa ma zad/ yar lha la mchod pa dang / mar dman la sbyin pa mi bya bar ser sna dam du 'ching ba'i skyon de rnams/ mthar blun pos nor ar pas 'phrog pas sdug bsngal myang ba de sbyar nas gang de ri dwags sha ba'i rwa'i phan yon dang / bla ba'i rtsi'i phan yon la bsnyo/na nas de dag ma brjod pas mthar rang phung la sbyar ba la mtshungs par sbyar ba'o//sha mig sngar mdzes pa'i brgya byin gzhu ris dang /rmi lam glog sprin g.yo dang dbyar skyes tshal/lang tshos gang ba'i bzhin dpal 'du byas bon/kun kyang 'phrul blo'i snang tshul grub pa med/ces sgyu ma 'ja' tshon mig lam du mdzes pa dang / rmi lam nang du 'char ba'i gzugs brnyan rnams/ dbyar gyi rnga gsang dar ma'i sgra dang /shin tu mdzes pa'i lang tsho'i rnam par bkra ba'i bzhin par dang / gzhan 'du byas kyi bon thams cad 'di tsam du grwab pa med pa tsam gyis gang bis rmi lam lta bu dang / dbyar rnga rnams gzha' tshon dang mtshungs par sbyor ba lta bu'//ra/ g.yo can rdzun mgo bskor ba'i gyad bu thung /chags sdang gzhan grub smod pa'i rtogs ge ba/'jig rten mi ngo srung ba'i zhal lce mkhan/'di dag ngan song bgrod pa'i gru chen lags/zhes snyan ngag rin chen lde'u mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las/ mtshungs sbyor rgyan gyi rab tu byas pa ste nyer drug pa'o//

'gal ba'i rgyan/mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ brjod gzhis bskyed dam de ldan gyi/'gal tshig gsal badzod 'gal rgyan te/zhes 'gal ba'i rgyan bstan te/ brjod bya'i bon gang dang gang yin yang / rang gi rang bzhin dang 'gal bar gnas pa ni bsgrab bya/ de sgrab byed kyi 'gal rla can gyi bon gzhan de dang 'gal bar ston rtos pa'am/ ༄yang na/ 'gal che can gyi bon de la ldan pa'i khyad par la khyad bon dang bya ba sogs 'gal ba'i sgras zin nas bkod pa ste/ gzhi gcig la 'gal ba lhan gcig pa'am dus gcig pa 'grogs par ston pa'i rgyan te / skabs 'dir 'gal zhes pa ni khyad gzhi gcig la/ rang tshig dngos 'gal lam khyad bon sogs gang rigs kyi brjod bya gtso bo de dang 'ab/la bar ston pa zhig la rung snyam/dper na/ na so gzhon yang bsam pa rgan/‘nyon mongs chung yang bzod sran che/rang nyid rgyal yang srin sde pham/keng tse 'phrul rgyal bstan pa'i snod/ ces pa lta bu'o//dbye ba so so'i don la/ khyad gzhi tha dad pa la bya ba 'gal ba'i rgyan/gzhi gcig yon tan 'gal ba'i rgyan/ gzhi gcig la rdzas 'gal ba'i rgyan/gzhi gcig la bya ba 'gal ba'i rgyan/ sbyar ba 'gal ba'i rgyan/ khyad gzhi tha dad pa la byed las 'gal ba'i rgyan dang drug go/

— 354—khud gzhi tha dad pa'i bya ba 'gal ba'i rgyan/gzhung las/ gzhi dang bya ba tha dad gnyis/lhan gcig ston pa tha dad 'gal/zhes tha dad bya ba 'gal ba'i rgyan bstan te/ rang gi dngos kyi badzod byar gyur ba'i khyad gzhi de dang / ngo bo tha dad pa'i bon gzhan zhig bkod nas//de gnyis phan tshun du gcig la/ bya ba mi 'dra ba gnyis tha dad par 'gal ba ru 'gyur ba ste/ gzhi gcig la dus mnyam du dngos po'i bya ba mi 'dra ba 'gal bar dngos su ston pa'i rgyan zhig la bya ba tha dad cing 'gal ba'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ 'bras dus ga pur rdul brtsegs rnams/dkar ba'i gzi mdangs rgyas pa dang /kun brten nor gyi blo gros ma/ljang bkra'i dpal ni nyams par 'gyur/zhes khyad gzhi ga pur rdul brtsegs zhes pa ni/ kha bas bkab pa'i ri la zer zhing gangs kyi ri bo la 'od zer 'bu ma phrag g.yo ba dang / de dag tha dad pa'i khyad gzhi kun brten nor gyi blo gros ma ni/ sa gzhi la go ba ste/ sa gzhi la dus mtshungs su spang ljang gi mdog nyams pa gnyis bya ba kāgal ba dus gcig tu gyur zhing / dper na/ dgun kha'i dus su dbyar gyi lang tsho nyams par 'gyur ba gzhi sbyar te brjod pa'o//sha bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab rnon po de/rang gi rgyud la nye bar gnas pa'i tshe/dngos 'dzin gdon gyis brlams pa'i byis pa'i blo/zhi zhing ring du lus pa gnyug ma'i gshīs/
