4 20—rigs tha dad pa'i thog ma'i zung ldan gyi rgyan/gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung thog ma'i gzugs/'dra min skyor che+os rigs tha dad/rkang pa bzhi po'i thog ma'i gzugs zung ldan rnams bar chod pa zhes pa ni snga phyi zlos pa'i gsal byed de gnyis kyi bar la rang gi 'go mjug yi ge'i gzugs mi mtshungs pas bar chod pa'i tshig rkang gang rung thog rkang bzhi thog ma'i gzugs rigs mi gcig pa 'dra min zung ldan skyor du zlos pa zhig la rigs tha dad pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//dbye na gsum ste/ thog mtha' rigs tha dad bar chod pa'i zung ldan/thog dbus rigs tha dad pa'i zung ldan/ dbus mtha' rigs tha dad pa'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan dang gsum mo//thog mtha' gnyis rigs tha dad pa'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ blo gros ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/blo ngan srog la bab kung mim///khri gdugs nyi ma'i rnam 'gyur las/khri mun nam yang 'byung mi/ srid/zhes rkang pa snga phyir gzugs tha dad pa'i zung ldan te/ blo gros can gyi bla ma dang slob dpon gyis rang la phan pa'i bya ba las lam log pa ni rang gi srog la thugs kyang mi ston pa ste/ dper na nyi mas mun pa bskyed mi srid pa rī bzhin no//sha rab dwangs ston gyi sprin bral lha lam sngo/rab dwangs nyal 'gro'i klung rnams bdud rtsir bab/

— 4 2 1 —mdzes ldan bde 'byung gtsug rgyan rab tu gsal/mdzes ldan rtsi 'bras sdog pa'i dumu/ 'di mchar/zhes snga phyi zung du che+os pa la bar chod pa'i rgyan 'di ston kha'i dus kyi khyad bon dang rang bzhin la bstod pa'i tshig go/ra/ lung rtogs bon gyi 'jug sgo ru/lung rig gdar sha ma bcad na/nor ldan rin chen gling stod na/nor bus nor nyams ma chod 'dra/thog dbus rigs tha dad cing bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rig dang thos pa ldan na yang /gtan grogs mo 04 zugadza' che na/rig pa log 'tsho'i grogs 'gyur te/gtan du 'khor ba'i mu la 'khyams/zhes rigs tha dad pa'i zung ldan 'di'i badzod bya ni/ rang nyid rigs rgyud bzang po dang thos pa dang ldan na yang / rang gi chung ma'am bud med la mdza' che nas de'i rjes su 'brang grags na/ rig pa dang thos pa ldan pa de dag ma rabs 'chal spu+od kyi grogs su sdir nas/ dus rtag tuha 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar mi 'gyur bar bshad do//sha yid 'ong mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i sku mnga' zhing /byams ma chen po rgyal ba'i yum chen la/yid 'ong mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs/byams ma sras dang bcas pas bskar la 'dud/ces dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ciyum gyur byams ma chen mo la 'khor byams phran 'bum phrag gi bskor ba la skyabs su gsol ba'o//

— 4 2 2 —thog ma'i zung ldan gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung thog ma'i gzugs/zung 'brel 'gres skyor chod ma chod/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ tshig bcad gcig nang gses rkang pa thog ma'i zwang ldan gzugs re bar ma chod pa dang / rkang snga phyi'i tshig re snga phyi bar chod pa la sogs zung 'brel du skyor ba'am ci rigs sbyor ba'i rgyan zhig la bar chod cing ma chod pa'i thog ma'i zung ldan zhes bya'o// dbye na bzhi'o//thog mtha'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ gces gces trī/nga gi grogs po tsho/gces gces nor la ma 'dzin a/myur myur dge la ma brtson na/mūr myur gshin rje'i pho nya slebs/zhes blo gros gsal ba'i grogs po la gdam pa ste/ nor la shin tu gces spras ma 'dzin zhing / de la 'bad pa gcig pu ma byed la/ tshe 'di ni mi rtag k+ṇi/ dus nam du phyi mar 'gro dgos cha med pas dge ba 'bad pa gces zhes dge ba la bskul ma gtong ba'o//sha dkar dkar bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum pa'i dbus/dkar dkar thag bzang bzhi bcu'i phreng ba dgamang mang lus can snyi/nga gi dpyid du gsal/mang mang skye rgu'i mchod 'os dbyang sa can ma/

— 423— ra/ lha dang lhag pa'i bla ma dam pa la/bcu phrag rig pa'i dka' gnad yar zhus pas/lha zhal dgyes brtse'i 'dzum mdangs g.yo bzhin du/bcu phrag rig pa'i sbyin brgya rab tu 'gyed/rkang pa dbus mtha'i thog ma'i rigs tha dad pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ bzod tsam dus su bsran na mdzes/mi thub pa la do bsdos na/mi theg khur po rang la 'brebs/bzod glag med kyang rang sdug yin/zhes rkang pa mtha' dbus gnyis kyi thog ma'i zung ldan 'dis bstan bya ni/ dus gang la'ang gnad chung ngu'i dus su bzod pa sgom nas mi gzhan la 'gran rla ma btsal na rang gzhan gnyis ka bde ba las/ mi thub bzhin du 'gran che btsal na/ rang nyid sdug bsngal la sbyar ba las 'os med ces so//sha snyigs dus r+bho ṭa'i 'gro ba skyong ba la/brtse ldan rgyal ba gzhan las ches lhag pa'i/brtse bas kun gzigs gyer spungs dran pa yis/snyigs ma'i lus can 'dor med rjes su bzungs/zhes lnga snyigs kyi dus 'dir bod gangs can la bka' drin lhag par che ba'i bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la bstod pa'o//ra/ gang zhig skyid pa'i dpal la rol 'dod na/rnam dag bsam pas kun slong bya ba yis/rnam dkar dge ba'i grogs dang 'grogs gyur na/gang zhig rang gzhan gnyis ka bde la sbyar/zhes thog ma'i zung ldan gyi bar chod pa'i rgyan rdzogs so//

— 424—ra/ mang mang 'dus pa'i zhing sa ru/‘skyeng ‘skyeng tshig la 'asgyur med dgos/mang mang dran tshad gleng che na/nyung ‘skyeng brjod 'bras sil bur 'thor/rkang pa thog ma dang tha ma'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ mtho mtho'i khri la 'gying na yang /dma' dma' 'gro la brtse gzigs gces/dbya 'a dbya 'a ‘nyazugarngan lug 84 phan na/mtho mthor 'gying ba'i dgos don bral/zhes rang la yon tan dang go sa dzi tsam ldan yang / ma nus pa'i sems can nyams thag pa rnams la phan pa'i snying rje zhig dgos pa las/de dang ma ldan na/ shes yon dang go gnas ji tsam ldan yang phan med don med du 'gyur ro zhes bya'o//sha nges nges zhib mo'i blo dang ldan 'dod rnams/gsal gsal gzhung lugs kun la thos bsam 'bad/gsal gsal dka' gnad phra zhib rtogs gyur na/nges nges bden bzhi'i bon la blo gros rgyas/zhes snga phyi bar chod pa'i rgyan te/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la rīblos zhib mor dpyad nas/ yang yang du 'bad pas sbyang mthar yang dag pa'i sdug kun 'gog lam bzhi'i don rnams gsal bar rtoṭa par 'gyur ro//ra/ dung dung lus kyi sgrom bu des/gces gces byams kyi bskyangs pa'i tshul/gces gces yid la dran thengs rer/dung dung mig mtha' chab kyis khengs/

— 4 25 —zhes thog mtha'i bar chod cing ma chod pa 'di yi brngu+od bya gtso bo ni dkor gsal gyi cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbyangs can lha mo la bstod pa'//ra/ dmar dmar lang tsho'i bzhin ras la/dmar dmar srog ltar brtsi dgos ci/dkar dkar rang sems 'char sgo ru/dkar dkar rla bzhin bskyed na 'grigarkang pa thog mtha'i thog ma'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ mang mang thos pa'i blo ldan de/mdzes mdzes rgyan gyis ma spras kung /mang mang tshogs kyi 'dun sa ru/mdzes mdzes srid pa'i mig ltar 'bar/rgyan 'di'i don ni/ bcu phrag rig pa la ma mongs par byang chub pa'i skyes bu de phyi tshul dar dang na bza' la sogs mdzes pa'i rgyan gyi nor dang ma ldan na'ang / mkhas pa mang po tshogs pa'i dbus nas nyi ma ltar kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir 'byur ro zhes so//sha dung dung snyigs 'gror gzigs pa'i tshe dpag med/mer mer tshe chus bltams pa'i bum bzang de/dung dung brtse bas bdag la dbang bskur bas/mer mer tshe yi ye shes rgyas mdzod gsol/zhes dang gsum bar chod pa'i rgyan 'dis/ tshe yi lha mchog tshe dpag med kye bdud rtsi bum pa'i kha nas bdag cag rnams la tshe yi dbang dang dngos grub stsol bar smon pa'o//

— 4 2 6 —rkang pa bzhi'i ka'i thog ma'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/ba/zhung las/ 'grig 'grig tshig la mkhas na yang /'grig 'grig smra spobs che drags na/'grig 'grig ston pa'i dpyod ldan 'gas/'grig 'grig tshad ma'i thal skyon 'brebs/zhes rkang bzhi'i thog ma'i zung ldan 'di nyid kyi badzod don ni/ tshig kho nar 'bad cing ha cang bshad drags na/ tshig don gnyis kar rtsod pa'i tshad ma'i skyes bus tshig don la rtsod pa'i tshe rang nyid la thal ba 'bab pa'i nyen kha yod ces ji tsam mkhas kung nga bo rlom sems ma bskyed ces bslab bya'i tshig go/ sha dkar dkar pad ma rla ba'i gdan gyi steng /dkar dkar mdzes sku bcu drug lang tsho'i tshul/dkar dkar bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum pa'i dbus/dkar dkar tshems phreng mngon pa'i mtsho byung ma/zhes rkang bzhi bar chod cing ma chod pa 'dis lha mo sgra dbyangs rgyal mo'i sku'i ra nga bzhin rnams brjod pa'o//ra/ mdzes mdzes spang ljongs stegs bu'i dbus/mdzes mdzes pad dkar lang tsho bzhad/mdzes mdzes bung ba'i gshog zung skyong /mdzes mdzes dbyar gyi spro nyams la/ 'dis mtshon nas thog ma'i zung ldan gyi rgyan dzi snyed zhig sbyar kyang rung bas dpyod ldan rnams kyis dpog par byos//

dbus kyi zung ldan rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa so so'i tshig dbus ma/bskor rlos byed pa dbus zung ste/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang bzhi gang rung gi thog ma dang tha ma kun la yi ge bar chod cing rkang pa rang rang gi dbus su yod pa'i gsal byed kyi zung ldan la bar chod pa dang / ma chod pa ci rigs yod pa'i sgo nas dbus ming tshig zung ldan nam skyor rlos byed pa'i rgyan zhig la go/dbye na/ bar ma chod pa'i dbus kyi zung ldan/ bar chod pa'i dbus kyi zung ldan/ bar chod cing ma chod pa'i dbus kyi zung ldan dang gsum mo//rkang pa thog ma'i dbus kyi zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ kun la 'jam 'jam tshig snyan can/zhi zhing dul ba'i mtshan nyid ni/me tog ha lo'i ngang tshul can/byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar yin/zhes rkang pa dang po'i dbus su 'jam 'jam zhes pa'i zung ldan can gyi gyi rgyan 'dis/ 'gro ba kun la phan pa'i sems rnam par dag pa byang chub sems kyi ngang tshul 'di ni me tog nang nas me tog ha lo lta bu byang sems pa'i ngang tshul las ma 'das zhes brjod pa'o//ra/ yid 'ong mdzes mdzes lha yi ne thang na/sna mang ro 'dzin rgyu skar bkra ba bzhin/blo gsal lha yi khye'u pho mo kun/rkang pa drug pa'i 'gros ltar rtsed dgar rol/

—428—rkang pa bar ma'i dbus kyi zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ ngo tsha khrel 'das mi rnams la/bsam pa dkar dkar byas na yang /bzang lam ngan gyis gcod pa ste/dug sprul gso ba'i byi'u la ltos/ces rkang pa gnyis pa dbus zung 'dis khrel med kyi mi la phar phan thabs gang byas kyang bzang lan ngan gyis sbyar ba ste/ dper na sgrul dgur khar grang bas brgyal ba'i dus byi las sems bzang pos gsos pas mthar sbrul gyis byi la zos pa'i gtam dang sbyar ba'o//ra/ skyes sbyang dman pa'i gzhon skyes tsho/bzhin bzang mdzes mdzes bus kung ci/ dkar zlum chu yi lhu ba yang /mi rtag skad cig zhig par 'gyur/rkang pa gsum pa'i dbus su yod pa'i thog zung ni/gzhung las/ ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'chang ba rnams/bslab bzhi gces par mi 'dzin zhing /gzhan ngor mdzes mdzes byed pa de/ya rabs rnams kyis smad pa'i rgyu/zhes rkang pa gsum pa'i bar mdzes mdzes zhes zung dang ldan pa'i phyi tshul gcig pu la gzab nas nang khrims dang shes rab de nyid dam par mi 'dzin pa'i btsun pa ni mi shes skye bo'i ngos la mdzes kyang / ya rabs dam pa rnams kyis smad byar gyur ba'o//ra/ mkhas mang 'dus pa'i do ra yangs pa'i khar/don dben kha spobs can gyi mkhas rdzun 'ga'/

—429—spyan mig zem zem byas kyang phan pa gang /dka' gnad tshig sna sgrogs pas rang mtshang ston/rkang pa bzhi pa'i tha ma'i dbus su ldan pa'i zung ldan ni/ gzhung las/ slob tshogs skyong ba'i skyes bu rnams/skal bzang can gyi 'du ra ru/gzhung don 'grel tshig ma gtogs pa'i/smra ba nyung nyung mdzad na legs/rkang pa tha ma'i dbus su nyung nyung zhes pa'i zung ldan yod pa ma zad/sho lo ka 'dis/ blo gros can gyi gang zag dag gis 'khor la slob khrid gnang bzhen pa'i skabs su gzhung tshig dang ma 'brel ba'i 'jig rten pa'i gtam ni spang gang thub dgos te/ de dag ni rig pa 'chal ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur bas thag//ra/ lo na rgas pa'i dus nyid du/phyi ma'i don zhig ma bsgrub na/klu dbang phyogs kyi nyi gzhon ma/nub nas myur myur bzhud la ltos/rkang bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyi dbus su gnas pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ lang tsho nag nag duḥkha la/bsam pa 'khyog 'khyog ngan g.yo can/mthong na spro ba'i dang kha 'gaga'agrogs na rang gzhan gnyis ka sdugaces rkang pa dang po gnyis pa'i dbus kyi nag nag dang 'khyoga'akhyog kyi zung ldan zhing / lo na chung yang phyi yi zhal mdangs mi mdzes par nag pa/nang gi rgyud kyang mi legs par bsam ngan dang ldan pa'i na gzhon 'di ni/

—430—mig gis mthong ba tsam gyis yid mi rangs shing / de 'dra ba'i grogs dang 'grogs na mthar phung la sbyar ba'o//ra/ zhal ras mdzes mdzes ngom drags na/spyod pa rtsing rtsing rgyu ru 'gyur/mes po'i rig gzhung sbyong pa la/lang tsho'i rgyal kha dgos yin nam/rkang bzhi'i thog ma dang gsum pa'i dbus zung ni/gzhung las/ gzhon sku dkar dkar gangs ri'i mdogagasung snyan lha yi tam bu ra/thugs nyid zab zab nam mkha'i dpe/gang 'di srid pa'i rgyan 'di che/rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa'i dbus zung 'di/ rje btsun phyu srasadapa' bo ni sku mdog dkar po gduli bya la bon ston pa'i gsung snyan la/brtse ba'i sems nyid zab par byuranaba'i phyu keng tse len med la bstod pa'o//ra/ rkang 'thang phung phung g.yo ba'i gling /rgyu skar bstar 'dra'i grong skyer nga/bus/ma bris mdzes mdzes lha mo'i gzugs/su dang gang yin phyang mo nyugarkang pa thog ma dang tha ma'i dbus kyi zang ldan rgyan ni/gzhung las/ thos par nan nan ma brtson na/lan res nges don mi rtogs te/byis pa klog la 'jug pa'i skabs/skyor zlos rdzu5nga yang byed la ltos/

—431 —rkang pa thog mtha'i dbus zung 'di/ gzhi gang la 'jug kyang dang po thos pa'i shes rab la gom par bya dgos pa las/ thob re tsam dang cung zad tsam gyis don la 'jug mi nus te/ dper na byis pa rnams kyis yi ge klog thabs la 'bad skabs mang po skyor te ngal ba byed nas 'bad pa lta bu'o/ra/ gus zhum lce chung nar nar byed mkhan tsho/nang sems gya gyu'i bya ba nyung dgos te/lo nar song ba'i ngang pa rgas po 'gas/snying med nya mo yang yang bza' 'di skyo/rkang bzhi bar ma gnyis kyi dbus zung ldan rgyan ni/gzhung las/ 'jug ngogs yul gyi rnam pa gang /yid kyis nges nges ma zin na/ngag nas lhang lhang mi sgrog ste/'ol tshod rdzun du gyur ba mang /rkang pa bar ma gnyis kyi dbus zang 'di/ rang gi yul gang la 'jug kyang don du ma rtogs par kha nas mang po sgrog par bya mi rung ste/ gal te sgrog na phol cher zer sgros rdzun tu gyur ba sogs kyi rkyen ngan 'byung bar 'gyur ra//ra/ gnas lugs rje na par rtogs 'dod tshe/dben gnas legs legs ma btsal na/mgo bo bde bde'i bslu brid kyi/mi ring bar chad yong bar nges/rkang pa dbus mtha'i dbus zung can gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ brda don 'phrod pa'i skyes bu la/bka' mal gzabs gzabs ma byas na/

—432—phyogs kyi mi sna 'dus pa'i sar/jil chu phrum phrum byed dogs yod/ces rkang pa ma—tha' dbus gnyis kyi dbus zung gis/ lang tsho gsal ba'i skyes bu rnams bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la mnga' brnyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa la bsten nas rig pa'i gnas kun la yang dag par sbyang dgos pa la/ de ltar ma byas pa yin na/ nam zhig mkhas pa mang po tshogs pararang nyid ngo skyengs te rngul chu thon pa las 'os med do//ra/ 'dul 'dzin bye bas dkrig pa'i dga' tshal na/tshul ldan long long g.yo ba'i blo gsal la/shes med ngo tsha bral ba'i na chung mas/ngakūs ris zur zur khring 'di skyo ba la/rkang bzhi'i tha ma gnyis kyi dbus su zung ldan can gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ byang chub sems dang ldan pa yis/rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos kyi/dka' gnad lhug lhug 'grol shes na/sa steng snyan snyan grags pas khyab/ces rkang pa tha ma gnyis kyi dbus kyi zung ldan 'dis/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i skyes bu rnams/ cha rkyen dang po gzhan phan gyi byang sems zhig dgos pa ma zad/ de nas de dag gi gnad don rnams legs par bslab nas byang chub na mkhas pa'i grags pa thob pa ni the tshoms mi dgos so//ra/ las 'phro ldan pa'i skyes bu des/dge bar phyi shol mi byed de/

—433—chu bo lhung lhung 'bab pa'i tshe/su kyang 'khyil 'khyil 'gog pa dka'/rkang bzhi'i snga ma gsum gyi dbus su zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ dbal me lhab lhab 'bar ba'i rtser/'jigs pa'i tsha tsha skar ltar 'khrugagadon bgegs thul thul bsreg mdzad pa/zhang zhung me ri'i lha tshogs rgyal/zhes rkang pa dang po gsum gyi dbus zung 'dis/ gtsang ma zhang zhung gi yi dam lha me ri dang gsang drag sogs kyi rang bzhin dang yon tan sogs badzad pa'//ra/ mchog sku brjid brjid bsril ri lhun po'i ltor/bzhin bzang 'dzum 'dzum 'gro la brtse ba'i sems/gsung dbyangs snyan snyan sgrogs pa'i dbyangs can ma/rtag tu kho bo'i gsos su bzhugs shig kye/rkang bzhi'i thog ma gnyis dang tha ma'i dbus su zung ldan can gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ mdzes sku ldem ldem g.yo ba dang /rgyang blu zil zil sgrog tsam na/lung rig smra ba'i skal ldan kun/dga' ba'i ma ma dbyangs can ma/zhes rkang pa thog ma dang tha ma'i zung ldan 'di ni/ brjod bya dbyangs can ma'i rang bzhin ste/ shin tu sgeg mo'i dpal dang ldan pa/ snyan pa'i dbyangs dang 'phang 'gro 'khrol ba tsam gyis blo ldan rnams la bcu rig gi pad mo 'byed pa ma zad/ mdor na rig pa'i gnas la brtson pa'i skyes bu kan gyi ma lta bu'o//

— 434—ra/ dbu skra 'jam 'jam g.yo ba'i 'ogaspyan mig 'khyug 'khyug sgril che na/gangs dkar sems la gdon zhugs te/mi snyan ngan ngan smra ba 'ong /rkang bzhi'i thog ma dang phyi ma gnyis kyi dbus su zung ldan can gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ ngo mtshar che che bstod ma snga/seng ral 'dam gyis sbag dus yod/mig rtsa zhan zhan brnyas ma thal/dung phrug chung chung chu srin bdud/ces cung zad yon tan nam zas nor byung bar bstad pa dang /nyams chung mi la smad ra brnyas bcos sogs ha cang thal drags pa'i las rnams spang dgos te/ seng ge'i g.yu ral 'dam la zag pa dang / lus stobs zhan pa'i dung phrug chu srin gyi kha gnon yin pa sogs kyi dpe ru 'os sa//ra/ dbyar ston mdzes mdzes bkrag che yang /skyi bsil rlung bu gcig gis 'jigalang tsho dar dar dpal che yang /rgas dgra ngan ngan gcig gis 'joms/rkang bzhi'i phyi ma gsum gyi dbus zung ldan pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rgyal chen shel khrab 'bar ba yis/rkan sgra thag thag brdab tsam na/dgra khrag lhud lhud skyug pa dang / skad ngan tser tser 'byin par nus/

— 435—zhes rkang pa phyi ma gsum du dbus zung ldan pa'i rgyan 'di'i bstan bya ni/ cigashen gyi bstan srung rgyal chen shel khrab 'bar ba'i khyad bon bstan pa ste/ lngags kyi rkan sgra brdab pa tsam gyis bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur ba bstan la gnod pa'i rkyen ngan rigs kun de ma thag tu bsgral bar nus pa'o//ra/ ljang mdog lcang gling gru bzhi'i 'khor yug tu/gsung dbyangs snyan snyan 'jo ba mgrin pa'i glu/kho bo'i bu gar lhung lhung 'beb dang lhan/rang sems dal dal spro bas rab tu khengs/rkang pa bzhi yi dbus su zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rtag tu bsnyen bsnyen bsgrub pa'i lha/khyod zhakhub lhag lhag zugajakhu4 tsazug na/ba spu zeng zeng g.yo ba dang /phung po shig shig 'thor la khad/rkang bzhi dbus su zung ldan can gyi rgyan 'dis/ skal pa dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa des tshe gang la bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i yi dam de grub pa'i rtags thon nas/ gsas zhal dngos su mjal ba dang / dad mos shugs drag gis lus ba spya g.yo ba sogs dngos yod kyi dad pa'i rtags du ma mngon gsal phyi la thon bzhin yod ces so//sha phya sras sku mdog dkar dkar gangs ri'i mdangs/gang gi gsung dbyangs rnyi/na snyan dun+tu bhi/thugs nyid spros bral mang mang 'gro la brtse/skal bzang mgon khyed yang yang bdag blor rol/zhes rkang bzhi zung bar ma chod pa 'di ni/ phya keng tse len med kyi sku gsung thugs dang che ba'i yon tan rnams gsal bar brjod pa'i rgyan no//

— 43kyo—ra/ rang sems thang thang shor ba yi/yul ba/nga gsal gsal mthong tsam gyis/snying khang dmar dmar bzhad pa'i dbus/tshor snang lhab lhab 'bar bzhin mchis/zhes rkang bzhi'i dbus su yod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan bar ma chod pa rdzogs so//

—43 7—dbus kyi zung ldan bar chod pa ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung dbus kyi gzugs/skor zlos bgre ba bar chod de/zhes dbus kyi zung ldan bar chod pa'i mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi po gang yang rung ba'i dbus kyi gzugs de nyid lan gcig ste gzugs 'dra ba gnyis rkang pa gcig thog zlos pa min pa'i rgyan zhig la dbus zung bar chod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//dbye na rigs gcig pa dang / riṭa tha dad pa'i dbus zung gnyis so//rigs gceg pa'i dbus zung ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung dbus gzugs gcigaskor rlos dgres pa rigs gcib/ pa/zhes rkang bzhi gang yang rung ba'i dbus su yod pa'i gzugs de nyid rkang pa gzhan gyi dbus la zlos pa rigs gcig pa'i dbus kyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan zhes bya'o// dbye na bcu gcig ste/gzhung las/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng ba'i gshen/zu ba rgyakhugo zug65na zhe'ag bya ba /sangs rgyas sems dpa'i rnam 'gyur can/skye dgu'i bsod nams dpal du shar/zhes mdo smad snang zhig gi gdung las 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi skal pa ru 'khrungs pa'i snang ston zla ba rgyal mtshan ni/phye nang gi bon kun thugs su chud nas phyogs kun la bon bstan spel bar cosems dpa' kun gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur ba dang / phul du phyin par ston

— 438—cing / rgyan 'di'i rkang pa snga ma'i dbus kyi gzugs rgyal mtshan zhes pa de slar rkang pa gnyis pa'i dbus su rlos par rigs gcig tu 'dod pa'o//ra/ myong rtogs kun grol dam pa'i phul/rig 'dzin kun grol zhes bya ba/mdo smad rngul rdza'i yul gru ru/rmad byung gshen gyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/rkang pa thog ma dang bar ma'i rigs gcig pa'i dbus zung ni/gzhung las/ bru rje g.yung drung bla ma yi/dge legs mdzad bzang rlab che bas/mdo sngags g.yung drung bon bstan gyi/bdag nyid chen po zhes su grags/zhes bru yi gdung las 'khrungs pa'i bru rje nam mkha' g.yung drung gi mdzad pa ni shin tu rgya che ba ma zad/ khyad par du rmad byung mdo sngags zung 'brel rgyal ba bru yi ring lugs rma med gong 'phel du gtong ba'i bdag nyid chen po zhes kun gyis gshen rab bstan pa 'dzin skyong spol gsum byed por smra ba dang / rgyan 'dir rkang pa snga dbus rigs gcig pa'i sgra g.yung drung zhes smos pas bar chod pa'i dbus zung du ngos 'dzin pa'o//ra/ sku mdun bsod nams blo gros kyis/bstan sbyin mnga' thang rab spel bas/las ldan bsod nams can rnams kyis/yo byed dad pa'i tshogs su bsags/rkang pa snga phyi'i dbus su bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ gdams ngag bdud rtsi myong ba'i 'gro g.yung drung theg pa'i sa 'phar nas/

— 4 3 9—bde chen zhing du skyel nus pa'i/'gro mgon bdud rtsi rgyal mtshan mchogaces 'gro mgon 'a zha bdud rtsi rgyal mtshan ni rang gi slob bu rnams la theg pa chen po'i bon bstan nas mthar sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas mtha' bral dbu ma'i gnas lugs rtogs par byed pa'i khyad bon dang ldan par bstan cing / rkang pa snga phyi'i dbus su bdud rtsi zhes pa'i zung ldan rigs gcig par smos pa'o//ra/ gshen bstan nor 'dzin phang ba ru/bcu rig sgeg mo'i mgo lcog ldem/blo gsal rkang pa drug pa'i khyus/'dod pa'i nor rdzas len la brel/rkang pa bar ma gnyis kyi zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ dri med skyon bral theg pa che/gshen bstan rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan/zhu ston rin chen 'od zer gyi/bka' drin dpag pa'i yul las 'das/zhes gdung rgyud che bzhi'i nang tshan dbang ldan zhu yi gdung las 'khrungs pa'i zhu ston rin chen 'od zer ni theg pa chen po gshen bstan g.yung drung bon gyi ring lugs 'di nyid 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas spel ba'i gshen bo yin par bstan pa ma zad rkang pa bar ma gnyis kyi dbus su rin chen zhes pa'i tshig riṭa gcig par ldan zung ldan gyi rgyan yang yin no/ra/ gshen bstan rin chen bdal ba'i sar/khyad 'phags lung rtogs bon gyi rgyan/

— 440—phunu/ byung lung rtogs nyi ri'i mtshan/grags snyan 'dzin ma'i lto ba lder/rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa'i dbus kyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ dmu rigs 'phru4 gyi gdung 'dzin pa/gshen ston nyi ma rgyal mtshan zhes/gsang mchog mi yi cha byad can/bstan pa'i nyi ma khyed min su/zhes rgyal rigs gshen gyi gdung las 'khrungs pa'i ma rgyud kyi lha gsang mchog mthar thugs mngon sum du byon pa smra dbang nyi ma rgyal mtshan ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa gsal byed kyi nyi ma lta bu dang / rkang pa thog mtha'i dkyil du rigs gcig pa'i zung ldan nyi ma zhes pa'i tshig dang ldan pa'i rgyan no//ra/ phyi gling mtha' 'khob yul ljongs su/rgyal bstan 'dzin skyongs spel gsum gyi/phan bde'i 'od rlabs g.yo ba che/smra dbang bstan 'dzin rnam dag mtshan/rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi dbus su yod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ bsil mo'i ljongs la brten pa'i mi/lnga bcu'i tshe kha ma ral dus/las skal bzang po mi brjod rgyu/spa la bzang po bcu gsum 'khrungs/zhes spyir tshe lo lnga bcu kha ral pa'i dus 'dir skyes pa rmams las skal bzang po yin yang de'i nang nas gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gshen rab bstan pa la shin tu bka/bhe drin che ba ma zad snyigs ma'i sems can la

— 441 —shin tu phan che ba'i grub thob spa yi gdung las bzang po'i mtshan can rim bzhin byung bar bshad pa dang / rgyan 'dir rkang pa phyi ma gnyis bzang po zhes rigs gcig pa ldan pa bcas so//ra/ bsil ldan kha ba'i khyon yongs su/mkhas pa'i grags snyan ral khur can/lha mchog shes rab rig pa'i lha/mnyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan zhes/rkang pa snga ma gsum dbus kyi zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ 'khor 'das ro gcig rtogs na yang /'gro kun bu gcig ma yi tshul/— skyob pa'i rje gcig ri khrod pa/rme'u sgom g.yung drung rgyal mtshan lags/zhes 'khor ba'i bon dang myang 'das kyi bon thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rje btsun sgom chen ri khrod pa'am rme'u g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis brtse ba chen pos 'gro drug sems can kun rang gi bu bzhin skyob pa'o zhes dang / rgyan 'di yang bar chod pa'i zung ldan 'gro tshul ni/ gcig cesi pa'i tshig rigs gcig pa de rkang pa snga ma gsum gyi dbus su zhugs pas so/ ra/ mu med gsal stong gzhi dbyings nas/rang sems bde stong bon gyi sku/'dzin med snang stong 'od brgya 'bar/sgom chen nyams 'di skyid pa la/rkang pa snga gnyis dang phyi ma'i dbus zung ni/gzhung las/ lha mi'i lugs gnyis rnam bzhag la/gces pa skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang /

—442—rme'u ston tshul khrims dpal chen zhabs/'dzam gling rkang gnyis mi yi togargyan 'di ni rme'u gdung sras mkhas mchog tshul khrims dpal chen la bstod pa'i tshig ste dam pa khong ni bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la phul du phyin pa'i lo tsā ba yin zhing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid la phan che shos yin pa'i cha nas 'dzam bu gling gi mi yi nang nas mchog tu gyur ba yin zhes baji+od pa dang / rkang pa snga mthar rigs gcig pa gnyis zhes pa ldan pa dang bcas so//ra/ sems nyid skyon bral zhing mchog na/bdag 'dzin spros bral mkhyen brgya'i phul/rje btsun mnyam med bla ma zhes/ rtag tu 'bral med 'gro la brtse/rkang rma snga phyi gsum gyi dbus zung ni/gzhung las/ rab 'byams mchog gsum 'dus pa'i zhal/'gro mgon blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi/mkhyen pas dus gsum sa ler gzigs/brtse bas khams gsum bde la bkod/ces rkang pa snga ma dang phyi ma gnyis kyi dbus su bar chod pa'i rigs gcig pa'i gzugs gsum zhes pa ldan zhing / rgyan 'di'i brjod bya ni 'a zha'i gdung las 'khrungs pa'i 'gro mgon blo gros rgyal mtshan de nyid/mkhyen pa'i yon tan gyi skye ba snga phyi sogs dus gsum mngon sum gzigs nus pa dang / gzhi snying rje chen po'i 'gro drug sems can yod do cog rnams bu bzhin du skyobs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par ston pa'o//

—442—rme'u ston tshul khrims dpal chen zhabs/'dzam gling rkang gnyis mi yi togargyan 'di ni rme'u gdung sras mkhas mchog tshul khrims dpal chen la bstod pa'i tshig ste dam pa khong ni bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la phul du phyin pa'i lo tsā ba yin zhing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid la phan che shos yin pa'i cha nas 'dzam bu gling gi mi yi nang nas mchog tu gyur ba yin zhes baji+od pa dang / rkang pa snga mthar rigs gcig pa gnyis zhes pa ldan pa dang bcas so//ra/ sems nyid skyon bral zhing mchog na/bdag 'dzin spros bral mkhyen brgya'i phul/rje btsun mnyam med bla ma zhes/ rtag tu 'bral med 'gro la brtse/rkang rma snga phyi gsum gyi dbus zung ni/gzhung las/ rab 'byams mchog gsum 'dus pa'i zhal/'gro mgon blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi/mkhyen pas dus gsum sa ler gzigs/brtse bas khams gsum bde la bkod/ces rkang pa snga ma dang phyi ma gnyis kyi dbus su bar chod pa'i rigs gcig pa'i gzugs gsum zhes pa ldan zhing / rgyan 'di'i brjod bya ni 'a zha'i gdung las 'khrungs pa'i 'gro mgon blo gros rgyal mtshan de nyid/mkhyen pa'i yon tan gyi skye ba snga phyi sogs dus gsum mngon sum gzigs nus pa dang / gzhi snying rje chen po'i 'gro drug sems can yod do cog rnams bu bzhin du skyobs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par ston pa'o//

— 4 4 3 —ra/ gzhi stong rtsal shar gzugs sku'i rten/'gran bral snang ston rla ba'i mtshan/rig pa rang shar rnal ma'i thugs/gser rir nyi shar ji bzhin gsal/rkang pa phyi ma gsum dbus bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ 'dul ba'i mnga' bdag sman gong ba'i/tshad med rnam bzhi'i gzengs chen gyis/skye ba sgo bzhi'i rnam pa can/sdug bsngal chu bzhi'i 'jigs las bsgral/zhes rkang pa phyi ma gsum gyi dbus su rigs sam gzugs gcig pa bzhi zhes pa ldan zhing / rgyan 'di'i brjod bya ni/ rje btsun sman gong ba'am mar ston rgyal legs kyi rnam dpyod brjod pa ste/ phyi so thar gyi sdom pa'i gzhi rtsa 'dzin zhing / gzhi tshad med snying rje chen pos sems can gyi nad dang sdug bsngal rnam rang gis dang du blangs nas sogs kyi gtam rgyud yod pa ma zad/ duru/ rtag tu rig can rnams sdug bsngal gyi chu bzhir skyob pa'i don du 'bad pa sogs khyad bon du bstan pa'o//ra/ ston mchog 'chi med gtsug phud kyis/'gro ba rigs drug sems can rnams/'khor ba'i rgyu drug gzhom pa'i phyir/'dul ba gshen drug sku ru sprul /rkang pa bzhi'i dbus su yod pa'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ gshen rab dug lnga 'dul don du/gzigs dgongs tshad lnga bkram nas phebs/

—444—sgo bzhi mdzod lnga gtan la phab/skye bzhi rgyud lnga thar par drangs/zhes rkang pa bzhi ka'i dbus su rigs gcig pa'i gzugs lnga zhes pa ldan zhing bar chod pa ste/ 'di'i brjod bya ni/ rang cag ston pa rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i mgon po gshen rab mi bo kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i byung ba brjod pa ste/ ston pas ni rtsod dus kyi sems can zhes sdang dang / 'dod chags/ gti mug nga rgyal/ phrag dog bcas dug lnga kha ral ba rnams 'dul ba'i don du/ 'od gsal lha nas gzigs tshad lnga/ gdul zhing mi mjed 'jig rten/ 'dul bya mi/ gling 'dzam bu gling / 'khor sog kha'i mi/rigs rgyal rigs la gzigs pa dang dgongs tshad lnga/ yul 'ol mo lung ring / mkhar bar po so brgyad/ nor rin chen gter/ yab rgyal bon thod dkar/ yum rgyal bzhad ma bcas la dgongs pa re re nas bkram nas gnas mchog stag gzig 'ol mo'i gling du phebs pa ma zad/ sgo bzhi mdzod lnga'i bon 'khor rnam gsung zhing / 'gro ba rigs drug sems can rnams 'dren pa'i ston par sprul nas ji snyed cig thar par drangs pa'o//sha bsgyur bkod bsnon khri'i 'khor lo rab bskor bas/snang srid dus kyi 'khor lo bde brlag tu/gsal byed rgyu 'phrul 'khor lo ston pa yi/rtsis mkhan shes rig 'khor lo rnam bkra rmad/ces bar chod pa'i dbus zang 'di ni/ gzhi skar rtsis kyi rig pa'i rnam dpyod kyi nyi zu gza' skar dus kyi 'gyur 'gros sogs ma rmongs so sor gsal bar ston pa'i skar rtsis la bstod pa'o//ra/ ston pas 'khor brgyad gshen phran la/bon mchog khams brgyad gtam phab nas/
—445—'dir snang bon brgyad 'phrul ba kun/mi bden mtha' brgyad bral bar gsungs/zhes rigs gcig pa'i dbus kyi zung ldan rgyan rdzogs so//

— 44kyo—bar chod pa rigs tha dad pa'i dbus kyi zung ldan rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung dbu ma'i gzugs/'dra min skor chos rigs tha dad/zhes rkang pa bzhi po gang rung gi dbus su gzugs snga phyi mi 'dra ba ci rigs skor zlos byas pa la dbus gzugs de nyid rkang pa rer mi zlos pa snga phyi gang rung ldan pa zhig bar chod cing rigs tha dad pa'i dbus zung zhes brjod pa'o//rkang pa snga phyi rigs tha dad pa'i dbus zung bar chod pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ mi thabs ha cang gces drags na/lha thabs ha cang thal ba'i rgyu/snga mas g.yo rgyu kho na gnyer/phyi mas g.yo rgyu gtsang bkag yin/zhes rkang pa snga ma gnyis dbus su ha cang zhes pa'i gzugs dang ldan zhing / phyi ma gnyis dbus la de ltar mi ldan zhing g.yo rgyu zhes pa'i gzugs ldan pa rkang pa snga phyi gzugs mi gcig pas rigs mi mthun pa tha dad pa ste/rgyan 'dis 'jig rten 'khor ba'i bya ba mi chos don du gnyer mkhan de ni dus rtag tu g.yo rgyu kho nar gnyer bas/ lha thabs sam phyi ma'i don la bya bas de rigs ha cang thal ba'i rgyu ru byur bas na/ rnam grol don gnyer can rnams 'jig rten gyi mi chos don du gnyer ba spang dgos par bstan pa 'o//ra/ lang tsho dbyar gyi mgron po la/dal 'byor til gyi nying khus khengs/bcu rig rtsi la dgyes pa'i sde/

— 44 7—blo rig gshog pa rgyang la brel/rkang pa bzhi ka'i dbus su rigs gcig pa'i bar chod pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ tshig la ji tsam sbyang ba bzhin/ don la de tsam cha/ bsgom na/smra ba ji tsam mkhas na yang /mdo don de tsam 'grub mi 'gyur/zhes rkang pa bzhi ka'i dbus su rigs gcig pa'i gzugs tsam zhes ldan pa'i bar chod pa'i rgyan 'dis/ deng dus kyi mkhas pa phal cher rgyal ba'i bka' lung la tshig spyi tsam gyi go ba la brten nas 'bad med du glog bshad thob na mkhas pa smra na'ang / de tsam gyis mi chog par don rang rgyud la ‘nyams su len dgos pa dngos su gdam pa'o//ra/ bshad sgrub dbyar gyi sgeg mo la/thos brtson dbyar gyi lang tsho bzhad/mkhas mang dbyar gyi spron chogs 'dus/legs bshad dbyar gyi lha rnga sdir/rkang pa snga phyi dbus dang rigs tha dad pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ 'di bde 'ba' zhig don gnyer ba/skyid 'dod sdug gi sna 'dren yin/bzod med sdug gi gnyen po la/bdag med 'ba' zhig bsgom pa gces/zhes rkang pa snga phyi gnyis rigs gcig dbus ma gnyis dbus su rigs gcig pa ldan pa'i bar ched pa'i zung ldan gye rgyan 'di/ 'jig rten 'khor ba'i 'du 'dzi dang gnas skabs 'khyag ltog gi sdug bsngal sel/ thabs kyi tshe 'di'i don zas nor ji tsam bsags kung / mthar sdug bsngal bskyed

— 448—pa las med phyir/ sdug bsngal gyi gnyen po ni bdag med sgom pa de mchog tu gyur ba ste/ mdor na nyams len la brtson dgos par bskul ba'o//ra/ 'byor ldan rten bzang can gyi rigs/sku gsum rgyal ba'i rjer 'dod na/bla med rgyal ba'i sras dang 'grogs/gang sku'i rten bzang rnyed par 'gyur/ zhes bar chod pa rigs tha dad pa'i dbus kyi zung ldan rdzogs so//

— 449—dbus kyi zung ldan bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung dbus kyi gzugs/zung 'brel bskor ba ma chod chod/zhes dbus zung gi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi po'i rang rang gi dbus mar bkod pa'i zung ldan nam rigs gcig pa'i yi ge de nyid la rkang pa rang rang gi thog mthar yi ge gzhan gyis bar chod pas bar chod pa dang / rang dbus zung ldan de gnyis kyi bar gzhan gyi yi ge med pas bar ma chod pa ste des na bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//snga ga nyis gzugs mnyam pa'i dbus zung bar chod cing ma chod pa 'i zung ldan/gzhung las/ blo rgya che che ma bskyed na/'dod don che che mi 'grub ste/blo sna thung thung bgyis tsam na/skyid sna thung thung shugs kyis 'byung /zhes rkang pa snga ma gnyis kyi dbus su rigs gcig cing phyi ma gnyis dbus su yang thung thung zhes pa'i rigs gcig pa ldan pa la gzugs re re 'i dbar gzhan gyi ma chod cing / snga phyi rnams kyi bar chod pa la bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan zhes dang / 'di'i bstan don ni/ spyir bya ba gang la zhugs na blo rgya che bskyed dgos pa gal che zhing / gnas skabs kyi bde dga' tsam la 'bad na bde ba de tsam las mi 'gyur bar ston pa'o//ra/ thar lam ྅/ra dzo/ra tshul mkhan rnams/

— 45 0—dam par myur myur bsten la recha// rang sems lhag lhag mthong byur na/gnas lugs lhag lhag ngang gis 'char/rkang pa thog dbus gnyis gzugs mnyam pa'i bar chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ kun rdzob lam lam sgrog shes kyang /don dam nges nges ma rtogs na/'di don lam lam 'grub mod kyi/bde ba nges nges 'thob mi 'gyur/ces rkang pa snga dbus gnyis dang phyi dbus gnyis so so nas rang rang gi bar gzugs gzhan gyis bar ma chod cing thog mtha' so sor bar chod pa ste/ dang po lam lam phyi mar nges nges zhes par ldan pa'i bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan te 'di'i brjod don ni/ kun rdzob kyi tshul te phyi tshul gyi sgo nas mdo sngags sems gsum gyi bon tshig tsam shes pa'am bshad shes pa tsam gyis mthar thugs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ngam 'bras bu yang dag pa thob par mi 'byur ro zhes baji+od pa'o//ra/ gnas lugs gsal gsal sgom pa la/brtson 'grus che che ma mdzad na/nyams rtogs gsal gsal mi 'char la/nges don che che rnyed pa dka'/snga phyi gnyis dang bar gnyis dbus mtshungs pa'i bar chod cing mchod pa'i zung ldan ni/ gzhung las/ brjod pa so so'i go lam nas/ bden don legs legs 'tshol shes na/

— 4 5 1 —skabs don legs legs 'grub pa dang /mthar bde so so'i 'dod bzhin 'byung /rkang pa snga ma dang phyi ma gnyis kyi dbus su gzugs gcig pa'i yi ge so so'i zhis pa rlos nas brjod pa dang rkang pa bar ma garātes kyi dbus gabyegs legs legs zhes pa'i gzugs bar ma chod par rlos pa'i snga phyi bar chod cing / dbus zung bar ma chod pa'i rgyan te 'di'i bstan don ni/rang nyid thos bsam gyi don gang la 'jug kung de nyid ston pa'i dpon gsas kyis ji ltar dkrol ba'i don rnams gnad du bsdus nas ‘nyams su len shes dgos pa gal che zhing / skabs don gyi gzhung lugs rnams la legs par brtags nas bden pa'i don rnams gces su 'dzan shes na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba thob par 'gyur la ji ltar 'ardod pa'i don rnams ngang gis 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so//ra ngo mtshar mdzes mdzes bsil ri'i+o ra ba nas/lka lus dkar dkar gangs phrug gdang lnga pas/grabs pa dkar dkar lnga rig nor bu'i mdzod/yid 'phrog mdzes mdzes nor 'jen rgyan du spud/rkang pa bzhi ka'i dbas kyi gzugs mnyam pa'i bar chod cing ma cho da pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ thas pa brtan brtan ma ༷nings na/bsam pa brtan brngan gang 'i/ gtong /gom pa brtan brtan mi skye bas/ bde ba brtan brtan mam zhig thob/ces rkang pa bzhi kakhyi dbus su gzugs gcig pa'i yi ge brtan brtan zhes pa rlos nas bar gzhan gyis cha/ chod cing / snga phyi gzugs gzhan gyis

— 45 2 —bar chod pa ste/ bar chod cing ma chod pa'i dbus zung dang 'di'i bstan bya ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab gang la 'jug kyang dang po thos pa'i shes rab dam pa'i ngag la bsten nas khrid lung sogs la 'bad pa de don ji bzhin thos par bya ba ni shin tu gtso che zhing / de nas rim bzhin don de bsam zhing blos brtags pa dang / de gom nas rang rgyud la nyams su len dgos pa las/ de ltar ma 'bad na/ go lo thos lo tsam gyi bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la 'bad khul byas na bde ba brtan po zhig thob pa ni shin tu dka' bar gsungs so//sha gshen bstan rnams gsal gsal byed nyin mo'i mgon/ye shes kun gsal gsal la 'grib pa med/blo gros rab gsal gsal khyab yongs la gdal/mkhyen dpyod bkra gsal gsal ba'i kun mkhyen mtshan/zhes dmu rigs gshen gyi gdung 'dzin gshen kun mkhyen ye shes blo groso kyi phul byung gi mkhyen dang brtse ba chen po'i rnam dpyod dang yon tan brjad pa'//ra/ gnas lugs zab zab dri med cher/blo gros zab zab bskyed dgos te/rgya mtsho zab zab 'khyil ngogs nas/dgos 'byung zab zab len dang mtshungs/zung ldan rgyan gyi nang tshan dbus kyi zung ldan rgyan rnams rdzogs so//

tha ma'i zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i dper badzod do//gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung gzugs tha ma/—skor che+os byed pa tha ma'i zung /zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi po'i tha na gnas pa'i gzugs bskor zhing che+os pa la rkang pa snga phyi ci rigs kyi tha na zung ldan yod pa'i bar chod pa dang / ma chod pa sogs gang rung ldan pa'i sgra rgyan la tha ma'i zung ldan gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//dbye na gsum ste/ bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ bar chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan dang gsum mo//bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan las/ rkang pa dang po'i tha mar yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ bsod nams ldan pa'i mi re re/ldod na de phyogs kun la phan/lo 'bras legs pa'i dpag bsam gcigamanga' ba'i lha khams dar la rgyas/zhes rkang pa dang po'i tha mar yi ge'i gzugs gcig pa re re zhes pa de'i dbar gang gis ma chod par che+os te smos pa la rkang pa dang por yod pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan zhes dang / 'di'i bstan don ni/ tshad dang ldan pa'i blang dor gyi gnas la mkhas pa'i ya rabs spyod bzang can yul la re re tsam yod na yul der mi kun la phan pa ste/ mig ltos su 'gyur ba ma zad yul mi kun zhi zhing 'jam par 'gyur ba/ dper na/ shing dri ldan dpag

— 454—bsam ljo+on pa gcig kho nas lo 'bras kyi lha khams yongs skyong nas zas nor dar sheng rgyas par byed pa bzhin no zheru/ so//ra/ brtson 'grus can gyi mi la la/mang 'dus mkhas pa'i rgyan yin te/rgya mtshor skyes pa'i pad dkar gzugs/gang la srid pa'i mig ltar mjes/rkang pa gnyis pa'i tha mar yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan rgyan ni/gzhung lan// don dang ldan pa'i skyes mchog cigagatsug tu bsnye/na pa'i 'gro so so/'dir skyid phyi mar bdo+o ba so/gas/'bad pa thams cad dan yad 'byur/zhes rkang pa gnyis pa'i tha mar gzugs gcig pa'i zung ldan so so zhes pa bar ma chod par ldan pa ste/ rgyan 'di'i brngu+od don ni/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar gtong ba'i bla ma dang slob dpon dam pa rnams gtsug tu bkur zhing bka' ji bzhin sgrab par nus pa'i skye bo rnams tshe 'dir yang bde skyid ldan pa ma zad/༄ skye ba phyi mar yang thar pa'i lam sne brgyud de thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob par bstan pa 'o//ra/ gyer bstan skyongs pa'i dga' tshal du/mkhas mang bung ba ci li li /bcu rig rtsi la dgyes pa'i blus/gangs can 'dzin ma'i mngal du sbram/rkang pa gsum pa'i tha mar gnas pa'i baje ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ thos chung blun po'i gral gong nas/dad pa shes rab mi ldan pa'i/

rang mthong can gyi mi la la/stongs skad nam mkha'i 'brug bas che/zhes rkang pa gsum pa'i tha mar bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan la la zheru/ ldan zhing rgyan 'di'i bstan bya ni/ yang dag pa'i don rtogs shing rig pa'i gnas la sbung brtson gyi shes rab med pa'i rang mthong can rgu mi 'ga' re/blun po mang po zhig bsdus nas de'i dkyil da brjid nyacha/sa/ ston zheng 'dāg pa 'di dag ni/ rgyud la yar dkon mchog la dad pa dkon zhing / legs/ nyes 'byed pa'i shes rab med kung / che ba shes mdog ge stong skad 'brug grags pa nang bzhin byed pa 'di ni blun po'i rang mtshang dngos gnas yon pa go bar rigs so// ra/ mi tshogs 'dus pa'i do ra ru/brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na chung ma/kun gyis mig zur ya la la/khyed las lhag pa med dam ci /rkang pa phyi ma'i tha na yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan no/gzhung las/ rgan rabs mkhas pa'i zhal snga nas/lugs gnyis gtam gyi bdud rtsi la/myong rgya can gyi shes ldan 'ga'/kun gyis bkur kyang dma' zhum zhum/zhes rkang pa phyi ma'i mthar gzugs gcig pa bar ma chod pa'i byeng ldan zlos pa'i rgyan 'di'i bstan bya ni/ skyes bu dam pa'i ngang tshul smra ba ste/mkhas shing dam pa'i gsung go bdud rtsi myong zhing blang dor gyi gnas kun lagyulegs nyes 'byed shes pa'i skyes bu dam pa 'di ni/ mkhas mang dbusatshosu

— 456— kun gyis bkur kyang dregs pa'i nga rgyal cung zad tsam yang med par dman pa'i sa bzung ba ni skyes bu dam pa'i rang gshis brjod pa'o//ra/ gangs can sgeg mo'i phang ba ru/gyer bstan dbyar mtsho slar la 'phel/shes ldan blo gsal nya mo'i khyu/'khyugs pa'i rlabs phreng nyi li li/rkang pa thog ma gnyis tha mar gnas bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan rgyan ni/gzhung las/ gzhan sma 'beb na 'dzum wang wang /legs bshad mthong na nag sdug sdugaphal pa yengs kyi tha shal te/ma shi ro yi rnam thar yin/rkang pa snga ma gnyis kyi tha mar gzugs gcig pa zung du rlos pa'i bar ma chod pa ste/ 'di'i brjod don ni/ skye bo tha ma'i rang mtshang brjod pa ste/gzhan la sma 'beb pa dang ngan smra byed pa la shin tu dga' ba/ blang dor gnas la yid mi rang ba 'di lta bu ni mi lus thob kyang don med du thal ba ste/ skye bo phal pa yongs kyi tha ma'i tha ma ru bzhag kyang rung bar ston pa'o//ra/ dal dus so dkar rgob 'dzum 'dzum/rang mtshang smra ba'i skye bo 'ga'/dma' bo'i mi la ngo nag nagadeng sang dus 'dir skyo ba la/rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa'i tha mar bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ drung nas bstod pa'i tshig mdzes mdzes/g.yo rgyu yin gyi dga' nas min/

phag na smad pa'i gtam shib shib/rang mtshang yin gyi gzhan skyon min/rkang pa thog dbus gnyis thar zung ldan gcig pa dper na thog mar mdzes mdzes dang dbu mar shib shib gnyis bar ma chod par smos pa ste/rgyan 'dis ma rabs 'chib lto'am g.yo rgyu can gyi skye bo tha shal 'ga' res ngo dga' dang lkog bshad la mos pa 'di rnams 'jig rten mi gral nas rang gi mtshang rnams brtol ba'i rgyu las gzhan gang yang mi 'byung bar ston pa'o//ra/ smin legs ke sa'i len bu 'khyog ldem ldem/phyag sor gdu bu'i nyams 'gyur la brten nas/rgyud mang 'phang 'gro sbreng ba'i dbyangs snyan snyan/e ma mtsho byung bu mo lha yi rgyan/rkang pa snga rjes gnyis tha na yod pa'i bar chod pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ nyin mtshan 'khor yug sku ngal ngal/rnam dkar thar pa'i 'dun ma la/rtag tu 'bad pa'i dge sbyor ba/'gro ba kun gyi phud tog togaces rkang pa snga rjes gnyis su yod pa'i gzugs dper na/ ngal ngal dang phyi mar tog tog ces so so nas bar ma chod par gnas pa'i tha ma'i zhezung ldan 'di'i brjod bya ni/ ya rabs can gyi skyes bu dam pas nyin mtshan dus drug tu rnam dkar dge ba'i las la 'bad pa dang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba rnam rgyab tu bskyur nas/ rang gzhan gyi thar bde'i don la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum thos bsam sgom gsum sogs kyi sgo nas 'jug pa ni dal 'byor don yod can gyi bya ba'o zhes so//

bhe 45 8—ra/ log can bdud sde'i gnya' gnon gnon/dbal chen bdud 'dul khro bo'i lhas/'dre srin dam sri'i glo snying kun/ljags chen zhal du rol lam lam/rkang pa bar ma gnyis kyi mthar gnas bar chod zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ mchog dman bar gyi 'gro ba gang /ngo bstod can la mgu lags lags/snying brtse'i grogs la khro tshig tshigarang don 'chor ba'i snga ltas yin/zhes rkang pa dbus ma gnyis kyi mthar lags lags zhes pa dang tsheg tshig sogs so so nas bar ma chod pa'i zlos pa'i zung ldan te/ 'di'i brjod bya ni/ mtho dman drags zhan su yin rung rang la ngo bstod byed mkhan la thugs dgyes pa dang / snying nas brtse ba'i grogs kyi bshad pa rnams mi nyan zhing / khong khro ba'i rigs dag ni/ rang gi don de med par gyur ba'am 'chor ba'i rgyu bsags pa yin zhes brjod do//ra/ kha thung ngo thung byi la'i rigs/kun dang mi mthun khro rngam rngam/ma rabs grogs dang 'grogs dga' dga'/tha shal dman pa'i rang mtshang yin/rkang pa dbus phyi'i tha na yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ grogs ngan rkyen gyis mi bskyod pa'i/pho rab rin chen gser 'dra 'dra/mngon par bstod kyang so mar banas/smad kyang rang bzhin 'dzum lhug lhug

—459—ces rkang pa dbus phyi'i tha na 'dra 'dra zhes pa dang / lhug lhag ces snga phyi rang rang gi sgra zlos par bar ma chod par gnas pa 'di'i brjod bya ni/legs nyes blang dor gyi gnas la mkhas pa'i skyes bu dam pa ni/ grogs gzhan gyi rkyen dbang gis bsgyar da mi gtub cing / bstod na mi dga' ba dang smad nas mi khro ba rang bzhirne so mar gnas pa 'di ni/ ya rabs skyes bu dam pa'i rnam dpyod brjod pa'o//ra/ bslu brid can gyi sgeg mo 'ga'/mi 'dod bzhin dpal smrag lhang lhang /legs bshad rnam dkar phung po la/mos brtson las la dpa' zhum zhum/rkang pa phyi ma gnyis mtha'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ ngo tsha khrel 'das ma rabs 'ga'/lto chus lad pa'i sta gon la/bda' dgu'i zas la 'dzum shig shigabacol ba'i las la dpa' 'khum 'khum/zhes rkang pa phyi ma'i tha mar shig shig dang 'khum 'khum sogs rang rang gi gzugs kyi bar du gzhan gyis ma chod par gnas shing 'di'i brngu+od bya ni/ gshis ngan can gyi mi 'ga' za rgyu kho na'i ched du ma gtogs bsam blo gzhan med pa ma zad/ bshīl ba'i las la mi 'bad pa'i tha shal ni 'jig rten mi gral nas shin tu khrel 'das kyi mi yi rang gshis so//ra/ yid 'ong bsil ldan 'dzin ma'i ltor/zhang zhung bla gnas gangs mtsho'i gzugs/mtshar rdzogs lta sdug ya la la/kun gyi dad skor ci li li/

—460 rkang pa snga ma gsum gyi tha ma'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ ya rabs rnams la dma' gus gus/dkos thag 'gro la ngag 'jam 'jam/dkar nag rgyu 'bras las zhib zhib/brtsi ba phal pa'i yang rab yin/zhes rkang pa dang po gsum gyi tha mar gus gus 'jam 'jam zhib zhib sogs rang rang gi gzugs zlos pa'i bar du ma chod pa'i rgyan te 'dis/ya rabs rnam dpyod ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la gus pas bkur zhing / ma gyur nyams thag can gyi 'gro ba la brtse phan thabs la 'bad pa dang / las rgyu 'bras dang dge sdig la shin tu phra zhib brtsi ba 'di ni/ skyes bu dam pa'i khyad bon zhes bya'o//ra/ dbyibs legs dung shog dkar lam lam/rmad byung gser smyug spus legs legs/sgeg ldem 'dzub mo glog 'khyug 'khyugadapyod ldan mkhas pa'i ngang tshul lo//rkang pa snga gnyis dang phyi ma'i tha mar gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rang sar bzhag na khag drang drang /blo gtad bcol na srog dmar dmar/'thab rla btsal na khong 'khyug can/skye bo'i nang nas phud gtsug gtsugaces rkang pa dang po dang gnyis pa bzhi pa gsum gyi tha mar rim bzhin drang drang / dmar dmar/ gtsug gtsug ces pa so so'i rlos pa'i bar ma chod pa'i rgyan 'di'i brjod bya ni/ ya rabs skye bo dam pa ni/ kun la

—461 —bsam ngan dang g.yo rgyu mi byed pa/ blo gtad bcol na srog la thugs kyang mi bslu ba/ gal srid dgra rlar gyur na dus rtag tu yang blo mi 'gyur ba blo gcig las gzhan dran 'phrul mi byed pa'i mi de ni skye bo'i nang nas mchog tu gyur bar brjod pa'o//ra/ 'dzin ma'i yul ljongs sngo thing thing / dri ldan me tog mdzes lam lam/rmad byung dbyar gyi sgeg mo la/ blo gsal bung ba dgyes 'dzum 'dzum/rkang pa snga ma dang phyi ma gnyis kyi mtha ra yod pa bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/ gzhung las/ yid 'phrog lang tsho'i dpal mdzes mdzes/'dzang legs ngang bzang shes ldan ma/rang lus btsa' ba'i thabs zab zab/mdza' bo'i blo dang bstun mkhas mkhas/rkang pa dang po dang phyi ma gnyis kyi tha ma'i zung ldan gyi rgyan te/ rkang pa dang po nas mdzes mdzes/ zab zab/ mkhas mkhas sogs rang gi gzugs rlos pa'i bar gzhan gyis ma chod pa ste/ 'dis ni/ rigs rgyud che ba'i bud med mdzang ma ni/ ngang rgyud bzang zhing / rgyud zhi ba rang gi mdza' bo'i blo dang bstun nas gang gsung las/ gzhan bya ngan gyi rigs kun mi spyod pa phyi nang gi skye bo kun la ya rabs spyod bzang gi ngang tshul ston pa sogs ni bud med 'dzang ma'i rang gshis so//ra/ dkar gsal zu 'od bkra lam lam/yid 'ong nor 'dzin 'dzum mul mul/dgyes pa'i tshems dkar 'od lhag lhag

—4kyo2—sgeg ldan pad mo 'dzum mul mul/rkang pa phyi ma gsum gyi mthar gnas bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ go med shes chung 'dod ldan ma/gtan khyo smod pa'i gtam nyob nyob/byi pho kun la lag yang yang /phung sri nag mo'i mig kyog kyogaces rkang pa phyi ma gsum mthar nyob nyob dang yang yang kyog gyog bcas rim bzhin rang mthar zlos pa la gzhan pa'i bar ma chod pa 'dis ni/ bud med tha shal ba'am ngan pa'i rang gshis brjod pa ste/ rang gi khyo ga la sdang zhing / gzhan la byams pa sogs rang gshis ngan pa'i tha shal 'di ni ngan rigs su gtogs so/ /ra/ lho gling 'dzin ma'i lte ba ru/lnga rig sgeg mo'i gzugs mdzes mdzes/blo gsal dran pa'i sems tshub tshub/khyed nyid dga' mar bsnyegs 'dod 'dod/rkang pa bzhi ka'i tha mar yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ gzi brjid byin ldan mtshan bzang bzang /rnam dag 'dul ba'i gzhi brling brling /gzhan la brtse ba'i thugs dkar dkar/ rje khyed dran na spro sangs sangs/zhes rkangu pa bzhi ka'i tha mar rim bzhin bzang bzang / brling brling /dkar dkar/ sangs sangs sogs rkang pa rang rang gi tha mar rlos bzhin gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa ste/ brjod bya ni/ phyi yi tshul dang nang gi khrims ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa ni/ sku gzi brjid che zhing bslab pa'i khrims rnams

—463—rab tu brtan pa 'gro ba ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la brtse ba dang snying rje chen pos skyong bar byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i rang bzhin nam rnam dpyod do//sha mdzes sdug dgyes pa'i bzhin ras 'dzum lhug lhugamanyen lhags gar byed 'khyug pa'i sku ldem ldem/reg 'jam shi shon na bza' pu ru ru/mchod 'bul sgeg mo'i tshogs rnams ya la la/zhes bar ma chod pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan 'dis/ lhug lhug ldem ldem/ru ru/ la la sogs bar ma chod par smos shing / brjod bya gtso bo mchod 'bul gyi lha mo'i nyams 'gyur la drangs te brjod pa'o//ra/ mtshan dpe'i spyan zung khra khyug khyugagayu lo'i dar sham sngo ljang ljang /rgyu mang rnga sgra'i dbyangs snyan snyan/lha mo'i sku dkyil dngas sangs sangs/zhes bar ma chod pa'i tha ma'i zung dzin gyi rgyan re zhig bshad zin to//

— 464—tha ma zung ldan bar chod pa'i rgyan/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis so//gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung gzugs tha ma/skor che+os bgre ba bar chod pa/zhes bar chod pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi ka'i tha mar bar chod pa'i zung ldan nam/ yang na rkang bzhi gang rung sogs ci rigs kyi sgo nas rkang pa rang gi tha ma'i sgra de nyid rigs gcig gam tha dad ci rigs kyi sgo nas blos pa la de'i bar du yi ge snga phyi gzhan gyis chod cing zlos pa'i zung dang ldan pa la bar chod pa'i tha ma'i zung lngan zhes bya'o//dbye na de la rigs gcig pa bar chod pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan dang /rigs rigs tha dad pa bar chod pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan gnyis so//rigs gcig pa bar chod pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung tha ma'i gzugs/'dra ba skor zlos rigs gcig ste/zhes rigs gcig pa'i bar chod zung ldan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/rkang pa bzhi po gang rung gi tha ma'i gzugs de nyid snga phyi'i gzugs 'dra bar skor rlos byas nas bar chod par bkod pa ni rigs gcig pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan no// de la dbye na bcu gcig go/rkang pa dang po gnyis kyi tha ma'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ mkhas pa zhi dul ldan na mdzes/ sgom chen bya ba nyung na mdzes/

— 4kyo5—btsun pa bag zon legs na dang / nor ldan gtong phod che na 'o//rkang pa dang po dang gnyis pa'i tha mar mdzes zhes pa'i sgra de nyid rlos pa ma zad/ sgra de nyid kyi bar gzugs gzhan gyi chod pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan te/'di'i brjod bya ni/ rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa ni thugs zhi ba dang rang rgyud dul ba dgos la/ gnas lugs kyi don la nyams su len mkhan gyi sgom chen pa yin na/ 'dzig rten gyi bya ba sogs bya byed kun mang na mi legs te/ de dag sgom 'phro ba dang g.yeng ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ tshul ldan rnam blang dor gyi gnas la brtson dgos pa ma zad/ zas nor phyug pa'i skye bo kun gyis yar dkon mchog la mchod pa dang / mar ngan song la sbyin gtong ba shin tu gal che bas dang du blang bar bya'o//ra/ rang skyon rang gis mthong na legs/gzhan la gnod 'tshe med na legs/rigs ldan mang po 'dus pa'i sar/kun gyi blo dang bstun pa gces/rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa'i tha na yod pa'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rtsa dam nyams pa'i btsun gzugs de/tshul 'chos mdzes kyang khyi bas lod/rdza bum zhig pa'i gyo mo de/ tshon rtsi legs kyang thal skya'i grogs/rkang pa dang po gsum pa'i tha mar de zhes pa'i sgra zlos shing gzugs rang gi dbar yig gzugs gzhan gyis chod pa ste/ 'di'i bstan bya ni/ phyi

— 466—yi tshul tsam las nang bi khri/ mas meng/ na ngaper na rdza ma chab/ pa ma/nga bajin tha shal dman pa'i bya ba las ma 'das par bshad do//ra/ sred pas 'ching ba'i en chung rnams/yud gcig bde ba'i don phyir du/bslab gsum rin chen phung po rnams/thal ba bzhin du 'dor phod dam/rkang pa thog ma phyi ma'i mtha' na gnas pa'i bar chod pa ni/gzhung las/ btsun pa btsun gral mi sdod ci/mu khyar 'tshogs na lha yis smron/gcig pu grong gseb nyul drags na/skye bo'i kha mda' phog tshe ci/zhas rkang pa snga phyi gnyis kyi tha na gzugs gcig ci zhes pa'i sgra de smos shing snga phyi yi ge gzhan gyis bar chod par bstan cing / tshul ldan gyi btsun pa rnams dben dgon du rigs mthun dang / lhan du bzhugs na lha dang mi kun gyis bkur zhing / smon pa ma zad/ rang nyid gcig pur grong gse ba tu 'khyams na ma rabs kyi mi kha ngan pa 'phog pas/ de rnams zon par gces gsungs so//ra/ yid 'ong mtshar sdug 'gro ba'i snang ngor 'bab/zab gsung mkhyen pa'i pha mtha' nor bu'i mdzod/tshad med snying rjes 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs/'phrin las sprin rdul pad mo'i gnyen du 'bab/rkang pa bar ma gnyis kyi mthar gnas zung ldan bar chod pa ni/gzhung las/ kye ma bdag 'dra'i thos chung 'ga'/gzhan mthong ma myong rang mthong che/

— 46 7—mkhas gral ma 'grims rtsom 'dod che/dpyod ldan zhig dang 'jal na ang /zhes rkang pa dbus ma gnyis kyi sgra che zhes pa'i sgra snga phyi zung du smos zhing rkang pa snga phyi bar da sgra gzhan gyi bar chod pa ste/ 'di'i brjod bya ni//thos bsam sgom gsum mam 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo la 'jug pa'i bya yun dben pa 'ga'/ mkhas 'dod che ba ma zad/ yang dag pa'i don mi shes na'ang / tshortsom rigs mang dag spol ba 'di rnams/ yang dag pa'i mkhas pa zhig 'phrad nas rnam dpyod mthong na phan par 'gyur zhes bya'o//ra/ gsang gsum bon gyi 'jug sgo ru/ lta ba rgya mtsho'i 'dzing las zab/spu+od pa pad mo'i mdangs las zab/khyed 4ted srid zhi'i rgyan du mdzes/rkang pa dbus dang mtha' mar yod pa'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/ji/gzhung las/ rang bzhin 'dra thang bshad na yang /mchang can mi la smras pa 'dra/sha rgyas gtsug gi ru thur de/mkha' la mdzub ris byed pa 'dra/zhes rkang pa dbus mtha'i mjug gi gzugs rigs gcig te 'dra zhes pa de nyid kyi sgra de'i dbar gzhan gyis chod pa ste 'dis ni/ spyir btang gi dge sgrub sdig spong sogs legs nyes kyi blang dor bshad nas ma rabs tha shal ba'i bya ba rnams sma 'beb byas tshe/ ma rabs spyod 'chal can rnams gdong pa dmar por 'gyur ba de rang bzhin gyi gnas stangs te dper na/sha ba'i ra de'i rang bzhin nam mkhar mdzub mo ston pa bzhin du gyur ba dang 'dra'o//

— 468—ra/ sman ljongs kha ba'i yul gru kun/sum rtsen gnas nas 'chad pa bzhin/tshar long gangs phrug gzhon nu kun/dga' bde lha yi khye'u bzhin/rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi tha ma'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ legs nyes bya ba gang la yang /ma brtag bar du mi 'jug ste/byiso pa'i ku re thal ba mang /g.ya can kha mdas phung ba mang /phyi ma gnyis kyi tha mar mang zhes pa'i tshig snga phyi rigs gcig cing /rang mtshams bar chod pa ste/ 'dis ni/ rang nyid legs nyes kyi bya ba gang dang gang la 'jug na'ang / byis pa'i rtse mo lta bu ma yin par/ dang po 'jug yul la legs par brtags nas 'jug dgos pa ma gtogs de ltar min na/ mi g.yo can gyi mgo skor 'og tu tshud srid pas de bas dang po nyid nas brtag pa gal che bar gsungs so//ra/ tsan dan nags kyi dra rgya nas/ris bkra stag mos nga ro sgrogagangs/ seng sma/da par thos min nam/bsil bus gdung ba'i smre ngan nam/rkang pa snga ma gsucha/ gyi tha ma'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung laru// thos pas tshig gi sgro 'dog gcod/bsam pas don gyi gdar thag gcod/sgom pas 'khor 'das spyi rgya gcod/de gsum mkhas pa'i pha nor yin/

— 4kyo9—zhes tshig rkang snga ma gsum gyi tha mar gcod ces pa'i tshig smos shing sngaphyi b.rachod pa'i don dang / 'dis ni/ dam pas rig pa bslab pa'i tshe na dang po dam pa'i gsung thos pa la sbyang ba dang / gnyis pa de'i don la bsam pas yang yang sbyang ba/ gsum pa don nyams su len cing sgom pa ni dam pa'i rnam dpyod dang khyad bon yin no zhes so//ra/ 'khor ba sdug gi btson ra yin/pha ma nye 'brel btson srung yin/nor rdzas 'du 'dzi lcags sgrog yin/de phyir dben pa'i ri la brel/rkang pa snga ma gnyis dang phyi ma'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni /gzhung las/ mkhas pa dpyod ldan dbus na skyid/'dul 'dzin btsun pa'i gral na skyid/ glang chen ku sha'i gling na bde/khri snya sman gyi tshal na skyid/ces rkang pa snga ma dang / phyi ma'i mthar rigs gcig pa'i gzugs skyid ces pa snga phyi bar chod par gnas shing / gzhung 'dis/ dper na mkhas pa mkhas pa'i gral du brjid pa la/ blun po'i gral du mkhas pa rmyongs zhes pa bzhin/ su yin yang rang rang gi rigs mabyen dang khams mthun gling du brjid chags shing mdzes pa dang / 'thad par 'gyur zhes bya 'o//ra/ gnas lugs rjen par rtogs na ci/ swāsdisnyu ྅/ra du sangs rgyas thob na ci/༈4 ci dal 'byor thengs gcig rnyed pa la/— ji don med g.yeng bar 'grogs 'di ci/

—4 70—rkang pa dang po dang phyi ma gnyis kyi tha na yod pa'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ mkhas pa khe skam che na lod/btsun pa chang dad che na sme/rje bo nor 'dod che na lod/ na chung 'gro 'dug skyen na lod/rkang pa dang po gsum pa bzhi pa bcas kyi tha na yod pa'i rigs gcig pa ldan pa ste/ 'dis ni dper na ཿpakhas pa yin yang mkhas 'dod dang che 'dod che na/ btsun pa rnams chang la dad che na dam tshig nyams pa'i snga ltas dang / dpon po rnams nor la shin tu rngam drags na dmangs kyis ngo log pa dang / na chung bu mo 'gro 'dug mang drags na byang khog nad kyis zin pa'i skyon sogs yod pas de rnams ni spang byar bzung dgos par bshad do//ra/ phul byung mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod mdzad pa'i phul/bgrang yas bskal pa'i grangs ldan rgyan du bsnyil/zhal gsung bden gnyis rnam bzhag snyan pa'i phul/mtha' klas 'gro la spros pa sbyin pa'i phul/rkang pa phyi ma gsum gyi tha na yod pa'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan rgyan ni/gzhung las/ dpyod ldan yid kyi rtsis gdab la/gnod tshad dgra ru bzung na phung /phan tshad grogs su 'bad na phung /kun la rang 'dod che na phung /byu zhes rkang pa phyi ma gsum gyi mthar gnas gzugs gcig pa'i sgra phung zhes pa bar chod par gnas shing / 'di'i brjod don ni/ tshul dang mthun par ya rabs can gyi gang zag dag gi legs nyes blang dor gyi gnas bstan

—4 71 —pa snye/ rang la gnod skyel mkhan tshang mar dgra ru mi bzung zhing phan sems bskyed pa dang / rang la cung zad phan mkhan yod rigs la grogs su bzunganas bstod drags na rgyus med 'gas nam zhig rang nyid bslu ba'i nyenakhayod pa ma zad/ mi gral du 'gro ba la rang 'dod che 'dod drags na rang nyid phungabar 'gyur ba de dag la gzab dgos par bshad do//ra/ kye ma rtsod ldan 'khor ba'i nang /rang mthong can gyi mi rnams sdugargyu 'bras khyad gsad byas pa sdugaphyi mar mi bsam dpon rnams sdugarkang pa bzhi ka'i tha mar gnas pa'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ lung rig thos rgya che na legs/thos don mdo ru dril na legs/ci nor la gces 'dzin chung na legs/longs spyod chog shes ldan na legs/zhes rkang bzhi'i tha mar gzugs gcig pa legs zhes pa bar chod par smos pa ste/ 'di'i brjod bya ni/ blo gsal lang tsho ldan pa'i mi rnams bcu rig gi gnas la 'jug pa la mkhas mang gi zhal snga 'grim nas yon tan phyogs gcig tu bsag dgos pa ma zad/ chud zos su gtong mi rung la 'jig rten 'du 'dzi nor la shin tu gces su mi 'dzin nas yod na mchodaspyo sbyin gyi tshogs su gtong pa 'di ni ya rabs can gyi 'jug sgo dang po'i cha 'ukhosko du lags so//sha rmangs pa'i tshogs su mkhas par byed pa mang // dbul po'i khrod du phyug por gyur ba mang /nyams chung 'du sar dpa' bo'i ming thob mang /

— 4 72 — glen pa'i khu ru glang po shin tu mang /zhes tha ma'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan 'dis/ phan tshun ltos 'jog gi sgrub bya ste/ spyir 'jig rten gyi gnas stangs sam gshis lugs ji bzhin la drangs nas badzad pa'//ra/ nor la chags zhan med na bzang /sgom chen smra ba nyung na bzang /dbang dang byin rlabs thob na bzang /bla ma mang du mjal na bzang /zhes mtha' ma'i trīgs gcig pa'i bar chod pa'i rgyan rdzogs so//

tha ma'i zung ldan rigs tha dad pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung mtha' gzugs gnyis/skor rlos 'gre ba rigs tha dad/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi po'i tha ma'i gzugs gang rung ri zung ldan zung min ci rigs kyi de nyid snga phyi'i gzugs tha dag mi gcig pa ste/snga phyi rigs gcig pa'i nges pa med cing bar chod pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan zhig la tha ma'i zung ldan gyi rigs tha dad pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//rkang pa snga phyi mthar rigs tha dad pa bar chod pa'i zung ldan rgyan ni/gzhung las/ seng chen gangs ri'i spo la 'gying /dpyod ldan mkhas pa'i khri la 'gying /gang khyed skal ldan khrod na brjid/gcig shos sder chags gseb na brjid/zhes rkang pa snga ma gnyis la 'gying zhes pa zung du bzlos shing / phyi ma gnyis la brjid ces rlos pas snga phyi so sor gzugs sam rigs tha dad par brjod pa ste 'dis ni/ mkhas pa dam pa'i rnam dpyod ldan pa ni mkhas mang 'dus sar brjid dang ldan pa ste dper na seng ge gcan gzan gyi rgyal — rī por gyur ba lta bu'o// ra/ tshul ldan dben pa'i gnas na mdzes/ngang rgyal g.yu mtsho'i dbus na mdzes/dam ldan thar pa'i ded dpon nyid/'dab ldan mtsho mo'i brtse dga' nyid/

— 4 74—rkang pa snga phyi tha ma'i riṭa tha dad pa'i bar chod pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ gces pa'i srog la bab na yang /bslab pa blo yis gtong rung min/chu srin mgo lus phral na yang /'dod 'byung kha nas skyug pa min/rkang pa snga phyi gnyis phan tshun tha ma'i gzugs tha dad pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan te/ dper na/ yang dang min zhes ldan pa'i rgyan 'dis/ so thar gyi sdom pa dang / rnam pa ni rang gi srog las gces par 'dzin pa dgos pa dper na/ chu srin gyi gre bar yod pa'i nor bu ni kho rang mgo lus phral na yang phyir mi gtong ba lta bu dgos gsungs pa ste/ so thar gyi sdom pa 'di na shin tu rtsa chen dgos par gsungs pa'o//ra/ stag shar dgra sar 'gro ba la/dpa' mdzangs rang tshod zin pa dgos/natshochung gnas sgo 'grim pa la/ya rabs spyad dang ldan pa dgas/rkang pa thog dbus tha ma'i rigs tha dad pa'i zung ldan rgyan ni/gzhung las/ doge la brtson pa'i dod ldan lags/khra gtum can la gdang ma ldagartsub mo'i tshig la lan ma ldogagayung drung sems dpa'i rang gshis lags/zhes rkang pa snga dbus rim bzhin lags dang ldog ces gzugs tha dad ldan zhing / 'dis ni ya rabs skyes bu dge la brtson mkhan dag gis bzod pa khro gtum can la sgoms zhing / gang ltar gnod pa byas kyang ngan lan mi

— 4 75 —skyel zhing / g.yung drung sems dpa'i spyed la bslab dgos par gsungs pa ste/ zhakhu4 gad84 tsan stag go/mo ra/ rmad byung dge legs bye ba'i char/bcu rig dbyar gyi lang tsho rgyas/'phri las 'od stong phyogs kun rgyas/kun gso phan byed bdud rtsi'i char/zhes bar chod pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan bshad zin to//

—4 7kyo—tha ma'i zung ldan las bar chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/rla/tshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung mtha' ma'i gzugs/zung bcad 'gro ba chod ma chod/ces bar chod ma chod pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan rgyan gyi mtshan nyid de/rkang pa bzhi po gang rung gi mtha' ma'i gzugs de rkang pa snga phyi gang rung zhig gi gzugs kyis bar du chod pa dang / tha ma'i gzugs de nyid zung ldan du smos pa la/ bar ma chod pas bar chod pa'i ma chod ces bya'o//rkang pa snga phyi so sor bar chod ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'gro mang mang /'du 'dzi 'khrul pa'i las mang mang /spongs la bden pa'i bon dkar dkar/slob dang rgyu ba'i lam dkar dkar/zhes rkang pa snga ma gnyis la mang mang zhes pa'i gzugs smos pa dang phyi ma gnyis kyi tha mar dkar dkar zhes rkeng pa rang rang gi tha mar bar ma chod par zung ldan du smos pa ma zad/ rkang pa snga phyi'i yi ge gzhan gyi bar ched par smos pas na bar chod ma chod pa'i zung ldan zhes bya'o//ra/ dpyid dpal skad snyan sngo lngang ljang /nor 'dzin la ba ser ljang ljang /brtse ldan mdza' grogs rgod 'dzum 'dzum/bco lnga'i che ba dga' 'dzum 'dzum/

— 4 77—rkang pa snga phyi so so nas bar chod cing ma chod pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ g.yo rgyu can gyi kha 'jam 'jam/pha rol bslu ba'i thabs mkhas mkhas/sder chags byi la'i ngag 'jam 'jam/gzan la 'jug pa'i stabs mkhas mkhas/zhes rkang pa snga ma'i mjug gi zung ldan 'jam 'jam zhes pa gnyis kyi bar tshig rkang gzhan gyi chod cing de bzhin bar ma dang / tha ma'i zung ldan mkhas mkhas zhes pa gnyis kyi bar gzhan gyis chod pa ste rang rang gi mjug tu bar ma chod par rlos par sbyor bas chod cing ma chod pa 'dis ni/mi ngan pas kha nas bslu brid kyi gtam snyan smra zhing don bsam ngan g.yo byed mkhan ni/ dper na sdig mi 'dzems mkhan le lo can dang 'dra'o//ra/ dbang phyogs chu 'dzin smug long long /g.yu 'brug skad gsang 'ur dir dir/dbyar skyes spang ljongs sngo long long /g.yang dkar 'ba' skad ki dir dir/rkang pa snga phyi'i bar rkang pa gnyis kyis chod pa'i tha ma'i bar chod cing ma chod pa ni/gzhung las/ dbyangs can sku dkyil phra khyug khyugayid tsam bye ba'i zhal 'dzum 'dzum/'gro la rjes brtse'i spyan 'dzum 'dzum/rla ba'i cod paṇa 'od khyug khyugaces rkang pa snga ma'i mthar khyug khyug ces pa dang / phyi ma'i bar rkang pa bar ma gnyis kyi chod cing bar ma gnyis la 'dzum 'dzum zhes pa rang rang

—4 78— gi mgo mjug gi chod pa ste/ 'di'i bstan bya ni/ sgra dbyangs rgyal mo'i rang bzhin nam khyad bon baji+od pa lta bu'o//ra/ gang sku mi 'gyur brjid chags chags/'phrin las glog zhag 'khyug ldem ldem/zag med spyan dkyus phra ldem ldem/re 'bras pad dkar 'od chags chags/ rkang pa so so'i mgo mjug gi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ smra seng 'gying ba'i gar ldem ldim/pad dkar sdong bu phra ldem ldem/shes rab ral gri 'od ldem ldem/g.yu yi zur phud sngo ldem ldem/ zhes rkang pa so so'i mjug tu ldem ldem zhes zung ldan du bar ma chod par smos shing / rang gi mgo mjug gi so sor bar chod pa'i rgyan 'di bar chod cing ma chod pa zhes pa ste/ 'dis ni shes rab lha mchog smra ba'i seng ge'i rdzas so sor ston pa'i rang bzhin nam gang yod pa de'i rang bzhin drang por shes par bstan pa'o//sha bzhin ras dkar mdzes zur phud g.yo ldem ldem/mnyen 'jam sku yi dkyil 'khor 'khyug ldem ldem/pi wang khrol ba'i phyag sor mnyen ldem ldem/lha rdzas na bza' klubs pa'i sku ldem ldem/zhes rkang pa tha ma'i bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan 'dis ni/ lha mo sgra dbyangs rgyal mo'i sku mdog dkar la rigs lnga'i zur phud ldan zhing / phyag gis pi wang 'khrol ba mdzes pa'i dar tshon sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa bcas lha mo'i khyad bon la sbyar nas bkod pa'i rgyan no//

— 4 79—ra/ rgyal ba'i sku mchog gsal lam lam —mtshan bzang sum cu mdzes lam lam/tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs snyan lam lam/thugs nyid nam mkha' stong lam lam/zhes rigs tha dad pa'i tha ma'i zung ldan gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'irgyan te/ tha ma'i zung ldan gyi rgyan bshad zin to//

— 4 80—dbus dang mtha' ma'i zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba/ so so'i don no//gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung dbus mtha'i gzugs/skor rlos byed pa dbus mtha'i zung /zhes dbus mtha'i zung ldan rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi po gang yang rung ba'i dbus su yod pa'i gzugs de nyid slar yang rang gi mthar zlos pa'am yang na/ rkang pa rang gi dbus kyi dbus kyi gzugs de nyid che+os par badzod nas slar rang gi mthar gzugs gzhan zhig rlos par brjod pa gang rung byed pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan zhig la dbus mtha'i zung ldan gyi rgyan zhes bya'o//dbye ba la gsum ste/ bar ma chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan dang / bang ma chod pa'i dbus/ skye/t+nabo zung ldar/ bar chod cing ma chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan dang gsu.e mo//bar ma chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan rgyan ni/ gzhung las/ gzhon sku dkar dkar gsung snyan snyan/dbu skra nyil nyil rgyan mdzes mdzes/thugs gshis 'jarma 'jam blo gsal gsal/gang khyed yang yang dran lhang lhang /'di'i bstan bya ni/ yid 'ong tshangs pa'i bu mo'i mjes pa'i yon tan nam khyad bon dmigs gsal gyi rnam dpyod dang rang gshis badzod pa ste/ spyir rgyan 'di ni bar ma chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan gyi nang tshan/

— 481 —rkong pa bzhi ka'i dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan skyodi//sha rlung lcam sgrol ma'i bzhin ras 'dzum 'dzum g.yu mdangs 'od 'phro'i sku lngang ljang /mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i sku dkyil mdzes mdzes rin chen rgyan cha'i dbyaṅga khrol khrol/gnag snum dbu skra sil ma nyil nyil mar zhi'i thod lding 'od 'tsher 'tsher/phyag na rlung gi ba dan ldem sdem lha rdzas na bza'i tshogs lhab 99rnga//ces rkang pa dbus mtha'i zung ldan bar ma chod pa 'dis ni/ rlung lcam sgrol ma chen mo'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan sogs rang bzhin gang yod po rnams 'khyog por ma badzod par drang por gsal bar brjod pa'i (spreskyodi tshud// ra/ sku lu+os ldem ldem phra khyug khyugaskra la phung phung spyan zum zum/mkhur tshos dmar dmar mdangs mdzes mdzes/khyed mthong brtse brtse sems dung dung /zhes 'di na dper mtshon tsam zhig bkod pa las/ 'di la dbye na nang gses bco lnga ste/ rkang pa dang po'i dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan dang / rkang pa gnyis pa'i dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar hūṃ ri ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa gsum pa'i dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma snyi chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa bzhi pa'i dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma chod — pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa dang po gnyis pa'i dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma

— 48 2— chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma dang gsum pa'i dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis kyi dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa bar ma gnyis kyi dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa dbus tha gnyis kyi dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma gsum gyi dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga gnyis dang phyi ma'i dbus mthar gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa phyi ma gsum gyi dbus mthar bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma dang phyi ma gnyis kyi dbus mthar bar ma chod pa'i zung ldazan/ rkang pa bzhir kar yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan dang bco lnga ste/ de rnams kyang re re bzhin gang gis dper brjod de la brten nas 'phri bsnan sogs byas tshe de rnams tshang ma'i dpe brjod du bsgur rung bas dpyod ldan rnams kyi dam pa'i ngag rgyun bzhin rang gi rig pablanyi rnam dpyod kyis dpog pa las da lan tshang ma'i dper brjod yig rdzogs 'jigs phyir rgyas par ma spros so//

— 483—dbus mtha'i zung ldan gyi bar chod pa'i rgyan ni/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung dbus mtha'i gzugs/ ngadhe skor zlos byed pa bar chod pa/ tre ji— zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi po gang rung gi dbus su gnas pa'i ’gzugs de nyid slar rang gi rkang pa'i 'jug tu brlos nas brjod pa gang zhig rang 'dra'i bar nas chod cing zhes pa snga phyi yig gzugs gcig dang tha dad ci rigs zlos pa'i yig gzugs gzhan gyi bkag pas de gnyis rlos pa'i bar chod pa ste dbus mtha'i zung ldan gyi bar chod pa'i rgyan zhes bya/dbye na rigs gcig pa'i bar chod pa dang / tha dad pa'i bar chod pa gnyis so// sgyusta bar chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan rgyan ni/ mi ningarī las/ 'khrul pa med na ye shes med/tsho byusta/ sto mun pa med na gsal ba med/ kyitā 4 sdug bsngal med na bde ba med/ / ngan song med na mtho ris med/chi tsho ces rkang pa snga phyi dbus mtha'i gzugs rlos pa rnams rigs gcig spu ste dper na 'khrul ba med na ye shes med ces pa'i med pa'i gzugs de ltad rkang pa snga phyi kun la rlos par rigs gcig pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan ju pa/ra zhing / 'dis ni dper na mun pa med na mun pa de las grol ba'i gyide gal ba zhes tha snyad yong mi srid pa bzhin snga phyi so so nas spang gnyen nam spang dra'idang grorkugo cha sogs kyi sgo nas bzhag pa'o//

—484—dpon gsas mnyes byed thugs bzung bkur bsnyi byed/yi dam bsgrub byed bsnyen sgrub bskyed rdzogs byed/mkha' 'gro dgyes byed dam tshig tshul srung byed/ —mgron bzhi bskang byed mchod sbyin las brtson byed/ces dbus mtha' bar chod pa 'dis bla ma dang / yi dam/ mkha' 'gro gsum la bab mos byed cing / mchod pa ma zad gzhan sri zhu yon tan snying rje'i mgron bcas la mchod sbyin dang 'brel 'gro drug sems can la phan sems sgrub tshul la drangs nas brjod pa'o//ra/ yon tan ldan na blo gros ldan/kun spyod ldan na longs spyod ldan/mos gus ldan na lhag bsam ldan/byams sems ldan na gzhan phan ldan/'di la dbye ba bcu gcig tu yod de/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis kyi dbus mtha'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa'i dbu mtha'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma dang phyi ma'i dbus mtha'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa bar ma gnyis kyi dbus mtha'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa dbus mtha' gnyis kyi dbus mtha'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan/rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi dbus mtha'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma gsum gyi dbus mtha'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma dang phyi ma gnyis kyi dbus mtha'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa dang po dang phyi ma gnyis kyi dbu mtha'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa phyi ma gsum gyi dbus mtha'i bar chod pa'i zung lngan/ rkang pa bzhi ka'i dbus mtha'i bar chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan dang bcu gcig tu dbye ru yod pas de dag gi rnam
rno dam pa'i zhal rgyun da/sa pas ma bsnun kyang rtso

—486—dbus mtha' zung ldan rigs tha dad pa'i rgyan ni/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung dbus mtha'i gzugs/'dra min skor zlos rigs tha dad/ces rigs tha dad pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi yi gang rung ngam tha dag gi dbus su yod pa'i yig gzugs de dag gi rkang tha na yod pa'i gzugs de5gnyis yang na/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis mtshungs shing tha dad pa gang zhig la dbus mthar yod pa'i gzuṭa de nyid kyi bar yi ge gzhan gyis chod pa zhig la bar chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan gyi rigs tha dad ces brjod pa'o//gzhung las/ bzang po yod na ngan pa yod/lha zhig srid na bdud gcig srid/skye ba yod na 'gag pa yod/'char ba srid na nub pa'ang srid/ces rkang pa bzhi kar yod pa'i bar chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan 'di ni rkang pa snga ma'i dbus mthar bar chod cing de bzhin du rkang pa snga phyi rim bzhin bar chod rngoprer gnas pa'i zung ldan gyi dbus zung bar chod pa'i dpe mtshomyo/ tsam ste/ 'di'i badzad bya ni dper na bzang po yod na ngan pa yod ces pas ltos sa ltos 'jog gi sgo nas 'jog pa'i rten 'brel gyi mtshan nyid du grub par ston pa'i rgyan no//tāri/ mi rigs 'dzom na shes rab 'dzom/gzhan phan shes na byams sems shes/

— 4 8 7—brtson 'grus 'dzom na yon tan 'dzom/dga' ba shes na bde ba shes/'di la spyir dbye na gsum yod ste/rkang pa snga ma dang phyi ma'iske bar rigs tha dad pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan/rkang snga ma dang bar ma'i rigs tha dad pa'i dbus mtha'i bar chod pa/rkang pa dbus ma gnyis dang snga phyi'i rigs tha dad pa'i dbus mtha'i bar chod pa bcas gsum yod pas sngar bzhin rigs 'gres su shes par bya'o//

—488—dbus mtha'i zung ldan bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung dbus rmātha'i gzugs/zung sbrel skor che+os chod ma chod/ces bar chod cing ma chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi po gang rung gi dbus mtha'i gzugs rnams zung du rlos shing / slar rkang pa gzhan pa'i dbus mthar de las ldog par smos pa'am yang na rkang pa gang rung gis bar du chod pa zhig ste/ rkang pa snga phyi bar chod pas na bar chod pa dang / rkang pa rang sar zung du zlos pas bar ma chod pa ste/ bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ sku lus dkar dkar rgyan dkar dkar/zhal ras dkar dkar tshems dkar dkar/kun slong dkar dkar thugs dkar dkar/mdzad pa dkar dkar bon dkar dkar/zhes rkang pa so so'i 'go mjug gi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyarme gyi dper brjod de/ rkang pa dang por dper mtshon na/ sku lus dkar dkar zhes gzugs zlos pas bar ma chod cing slar tha mar rgyan dkar dkar zhes pa rgyan zhes pa'i gzugs de dang snga ma'i sku lus zhes pa sogs kyi yig gzugs kyi bar chod pa lta bu'o// 'dis ni phyu sras keng tse len med kyi rang bzhin smor+sā pa tsam du'o//sha rgyal ba'i bzhin mdzes mdzes sdug sku mdzes mdzes/mtshan dpe mdangs mdzes mdzes spyan g.yo mdzes mdzes/

489——na bza'i tshogs mdzes mdzes byed rgyan mdzes mdzes/gzi brdzid mdangs mdzes mdzes ldan khri mdzes mdzes/zhes dbus mtha'i bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan 'di ni rgyal ba kun 'dus dpon gsas bla ma dam pa'i sku dang mtshan dpe rgyan cha bcas dam pa'i rnam dpyod dam khyad bon brjod pa'o//ra/ thugs nyid gsal gsal bzhin gsal gsal/spyan zung gas04 gsal 'khu/ga gas04 gas04/zha95 zangar gathagasgog gathagakhugo dkazang gathagakhug garngaskokhugo/tu/ra rab gas04 gas04 64khyen gas04 gsal/'di la dbye na bzhi ste/rkang pa snga phyi gnyis so sor bar chod cing ma chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga phyi so so nas chod cing ma chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zu nga ldan/ rkang pa snga phyi bar rkang pa gnyis kyi chod cing ma chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan/ rkang pa bzhi po'i 'go mjug gi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan bcas bzhi ru dbye ba yod pas de dag so so'i dper brjod sogs rig pas 'gres su shes par bya'o//zhes bar chod cing ma chod pa'i dbus mtha'i zung ldan gyi rgyan rnams rdzogs so//

— 490—thog dbus kyi zung ldan rgyan ni/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i+o don no/gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung thag dbus gzugs/skor zlos byed pa thog dbus gzugs/zhes thog dbus zung ldan rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi po'am gang rung gi thog ma'i gzugs de dang dbu ma'i gzugs de gnyis bar chod ma chod ci rigs pa'i sgo nas rlos te gzugs gcig par smos pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan zhig la thog dang dbus kyi zung ldan rgyan zhes bya'o//de la dbye na/ bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan dang / bar chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan dang / bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan dang gsum mo//rkang pa bzhi kar bar ma chod pa'i thog dbus kyi zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ brjid brjid sku mtshan mtshan dpe bzang /'jen 'jen gsung snyan snyan 'gyur ldan/gsal gsal kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i bdagalegs legs ston mchog mchog bzhi'i gtso/zhes rkang pa bzhi ka'i thog dbus kyi zung ldan gyi dper brjod 'di ni rkang pa dang po lta bu dper mtshon na/ brjid brjid ces pas thog ma'i zung ldan bar ma chod pa dang sku mtshan mtshan bzang dpe zhes pas dbu ma'i zung ldan bar ma chod pa ste/ thog dbus kyi zung ldan bar ma chod pa/ de bzhin rkang pa gzhan rnams rigs 'dres pas shes sla/ rgyan 'di'i bstan bya ni/rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i ston pa rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo de la mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu rtsa gcig tshangs pa'i

—491 —gsung dbyangs drug cu kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes gzhan la brtse ba'i snying rje sogs ldan zhing yul mchog bzhi yi gtso bo de nyid do//sha 'bol 'bol stan sa la 'dug 'dug snyams dang /skyid skyid 'dod yon la zhen zhen chags che/lhod lhod gdeng med 'phyar g.yeng g.yeng lugs kyis/yang yang 'khor mtshor gtan 'khyams 'khyams su nye/zhes thog dbus kyi bar ma chod pa 'di yis/ tshe 'di yi bde skyid kho na don du byed pa'i de dus kyi skye bo pho mo rnams kyi rang bzhin dang bya spyod la sbyar te 'jig rten mkhan ni yang nas yang du 'khor bar 'khyams par the mi tshom pa'o//ra/ dkar dkar rdzogs sku sku 'khor rnams/mdzes mdzes gzha' bkra bkra ba'i dbus/'dzum 'dzum ngang dgyes dgyes bzhin du/dung dung gzhan brtse brtse ba'i mchoga'adi la dbye na bco lnga yod de/ —rkang pa dang po'i thog dbus kyi zung ldan/rkang pa gnyis pa'i thog dbus kyi zung ldan/rkang pa gsum pa'i thog dbus su gnas pa'i zung ldan/rkang pa bzhi pa'i thog dbus gnas pa'i zung ldan/rkang pa dang po gnyis kyi thog dbus gnas pa'i zung ldan/rkang pa snga ma dang gsum gyi thog dbus kyi zung ldan/rkang pa snga phyi gnyis kyi thog dbus kyi zung ldan/rkang pa bar ma gnyis kyi thog dbus kyi zung ldan/rkang pa dbus dang tha ma'i thog dbus su gnas pa'i zung ldan/
