—55 7—gzhung las/ bden bden bon spyod spyod lam gtsang /dkar dkar gangs ri'i rtse zang zang /sme smi las log log pa'i lam/nag nag chu bo'i sna mar mar/zhes rkang pa re rer bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan thog dbus sam thog mtha' ci rigs bar ma chod par ldan pa'i rgyan 'dis/ las dkar nag gi 'bras bu so sor dper mtshon byed du bkod pa ste/ bden pa'i bon spyod la yang dag pa'i lam sne yar zin pa dang / log pa'i bon nam 'khor ba'i las la brtson na mar mar ngan song gi gnas su 'gro ba ste/ dpe gangs ri'i rtse mo dkar ba/ chu yi sne mar las yar 'gro mi srid pa gnyis kyis so sor mtshon pa'o//ra/ gsal gsal rang rig rig pa de/stong stong bden med med pa de'i/bden bden rtag chad chad mtha' bral/grags grags gnas lugags 99gas bzhin grags/de la dbye na drug ste/ rkang pa snga phyi thog dbus dang gzhan mtha' thog ldan pa'i bar ma chod pa'i sgrag zung / rkang pa dang po gsum pa gnyis thog dbus gzhan thog mtha' ldan pa'i bar ma chod pa'i sbrag zung / rkang snga phyi dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog mtha' bsnol ba'i bar ma chod pa'i sbrag zung /rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus dang gzhan mtha' mtha'i bar ma chod pa'i sbrag zung / rkang pa dang po gsum pa dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog mtha' bsnol ba'i bar ma chod pa'i sbrag zung / rkang pa snga ma gnyis dbus dang gzhan thog dbus bsnol ba bar ma chod pa'i sbrag ma'i rjes mthun dang bcas drug yod pas sngar bzhin 'bes sa shes par bya'o//

—558—bar chod pa'i thog dbus dang thog mtha' 'gres pa'i sbrag mthun ni/gzhung las/ thog dbus thog mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/skor zlos bsnol ba bar chod pa/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ sho lo ka gcig gi rkang pa so so'i thog dbus sam thog mtha' gnyis po gang rung gi gnas la zung ldan dbyangs gsal ldan zhing rkang pa so so'i snga phyi dbyangs gsal rigs gcig snga phyi thams cad gnas gnyis po'i dbyangs gsal rigs gcig dang mi gcig gang rung la rkang pa re'i gnas re la rlos te/ bkod pa med pa zhig la bar chod pa'i thog mtha' dang thog dbus kyi zung ldan rjes mthun zhes bya'o//de la dbye na gnyis te/ rigs gcig pa'i bar chod pa'i thog dbus thog mtha' dang / rigs tha dad pa'i bar chod pa'i thog dbus thog mtha' zung ldan gnyis so//rigs gcig pa bar chod pa'i thog dbus dang thog mtha' can ni/gzhung las/ thog dbus thog mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/'dra ba bskor bsnol rigs gcig pa/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa so so'i thog dbus dang yang na thog mtha'i gnas gnyis sbrag ste yod pa'i dbyangs gsal gcig pa'i zung ldan la gnas gcig la zung ma bkod cing / rkang pa re rer dpes mtshon na thog ma dbus gnyis zung ldan pa dang rang gi 'go mjug gis bar chod pa zhig la rigs gcig pa'i bar chod pa'i thog dbus thog mtha' sbrag zung zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ sems dkar dge sems can rnams la/sems nyid rjen par ston na sems/sems ngan gnod sems gtong ba'i 'gror/

—559—sems lugs 'khyud spyad byas na sems/zhes rkang pa bzhi ka'i zung ldan rigs gcig pa ste/ sems zhes pa dang / snga phyi thog dbus thog mtha' bsnol mar ston pa'i rgyan 'dis/ dad pa dang mos pa can gyi ya rabs blo gsal rnams la dkar po dge ba'i don rnams bshad pa dang / don dam gyi gnas lugs ngo sprod byas na yang rigs la/ dad med bsam ngan can rnams la dam pa'i man ngag rnams gsang na legs par go zhes so//ra/ dkar po'i shog dkar yangs pa'i gzhir/dkar gsal 'phrul yig gangs ltar dkar/dkar ba dge dkar sdig citshogs nagadakar nag 'byed byed shes na dkar/de la dbye na drug ste/ rkang pa snga gnyis tho dbus gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod rigs gcig pa'i sbrag zang / rkang pa dang po dang gsam pa rang ring gnyis thog dbus gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod cing rigs gcig pa'i sbrag zung / rkang pa snga phyi gnyis dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod pa'i rigs gcig pa'i sbrag zung / rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod pa'i rigs gcig pa'i sbrag zung /rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa thog mtha' gzhan thog dbus can gyi bar chod pa'i rigs gcig pa'i sbrag zung / rkang pa snga ma gnyis thog mtha' dang gzhan thog dbus bsnol ba'i rigs gcig pa'i sbrag ma'i rjes mthun dang drug go/de dag gi dper brjod ni sngar bzhin 'gres su shes par bya'o//rigs tha dad can gyi bar chod pa'i thog dbus dang thog mtha' can gyi sgrag zung ni/5gzhung las/ thog dbus thog mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/

—560—'dra min bskor bsnol tha dad pa/zhes rkang pa so so'i thog dbus thog mtha'i gnas gang rung la ldan pa'i dbyangs gsal rkang pa rang gi snga phyi gcig la rkang pa gzhan rnams kyi phan tshun zung ldan gyi dbyangs gsal rnams mi mtshungs par ston pa gzhir bcas snga phyi thog dbus dang thog mtha' phan tshun bsnol ba'i sbrag zung zhig la go/gzhung las/ don rtsa sems don skyong shes na/nye lam zab mo bgrod la nye/don med las don gnyer drags na/nye 'khor 'khyams po'i gling la nye/zhes rkang pa snga phyi rim bzhin don dang nye zhes zung ldan rigs tha dad cing gnas thog dbus dang thog mtha' bsnol mar ston pa 'di'i baji+od bya ni/yang dag pa'i gnas lugs sems nyid don la nyams su len mkhan de/myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob la/ de ltar min par don med kyi bya bar 'bad na 'khor bar 'khyams te sdug bsngal gyi btson rar lhung ba ltar ro//ra/ ri bo tsa ri bskor 'dod na/dgos pa dka' sdug bzod gsan dgos/ri mchog gangs ri mjal 'dod rnams/dgos pa nor mchog 'phrul rta dgos/de la dbye na drug ste/ rkang pa snga gnyis tho dbus gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod rigs tha dad pa'i sbrag zung / rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa gnyis thog dbus gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod cing rigs tha dad pa'i sbrag zung / rkang pa snga phyi gnyis dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi

—561 —bar chod pa'i rigs tha dad pa'i sbrag zung / rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod pa'i rigs tha dad pa'i sbrag zung /rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa thog mtha' gzhan thog dbus can gyi bar chod pa'i rigs tha dad pa'i sbrag thung / rkang pa snga ma gnyis thog mtha' dang gzhan thog dbus bsnol ba'i rigs tha dad pa'i sbrag ma'i rjes mthun dang drug go/ de dag gi dper brjod ni sngar bzhin 'gres su shes par bya'o//bar chod cing ma chod pa'i thog dbus dang thog mtha'i sbrag ma'i rjes mthun ni/gzhung las/ thog dbus thog mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/zung bskor bsnol ba chod ma chod/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa so so'i thog dbus dang yang na thog mtha'i gnas su yod pa'i dbyangs gsal rang sa ru zung du rlos pa la gzugs gzhan gyis bar ma chod cing snga phyi rang gi 'go mjug ci rigs kyis bar chod cing rkang pa snga phyi zung ldan rnams rigs gcig mi gcig sogs gang rung la snga phyi gnas phan tshun bsnol ba la bar chod cing ma chod pa'i thog dbus dang thog mtha' can gyi zung ldan zhes bya'o//de la dbye na gnyis te/ rigs gcig pa'i bar chod cing ma chod pa'i thog dbus thog mtha' can dang / rigs tha dad pa'i bar chod cing ma chod pa'i thog dbus thog mtha' bsnol ba'i rjes mthun dang gnyis so//rigs gcig pa'i bar chod cing ma chod pa'i thog dbus dang thog mtha'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ thog dbus thog mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/ 'dra ba zung bskor bsnol ba gcig

—5kyo2—ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa so so'i thog dbus sam thog mtha' gang rung dbyangs gsal zung du zlos shing snga phyi zung ldan rnams rigs gcig ces gnas phan tshun bsnol la snga phyi rang gi 'go mjug gis bar chod pa zhig la go/gzhung las/ la las dbyings la la chen bzla/la las tshig la la rgya gcod/la las bdag med yin la la/la las snang tshad bden la la/zhes snga phyi zung ldan rnams la la zhe/sa rigs gcig tu ldan zhing / rang gi 'go mjug gis chod la zung du che+os pa bar du ma chod pa rkang pa so sor thog dbus dang thog mtha' bsnol ba 'dis dam pa 'ga' res bla med rdzogs pa chen por nyams su len pa dang / re 'gas rtsod pa kho nar lhur len pa/ 'gas bon thams bdag med yin par mtha' gcig tu 'dzin pa 'ga' res bon thams cad bden par 'dzin pa de la zhen pa sogs skyes bu rab 'bring tha ma'i blos nus tshad do//ra/ legs legs sku legs legs 'byung ldan/legs legs gsung legs legs shing snyan/legs legs rjes bzhag bon legs legs/legs legs 'dus pa'i 'khor legs legs/de la dbye na drug ste/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis ṅgāg dbus gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigar+sā gcig ga rkang pa snga phyi thog mtha' dang gzhan thog dbus can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs gcig pa/rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa thog dbus dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs gcig pa/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus dang

—5kyo3—gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs gcig pa/ rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa thog mtha' dang gzhan thog dbus can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs gcig pa/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis thog mtha' dang gzhan thog dbus can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs gcig pa bcas drug gi dper brjod sngar bzhin 'gres su shes par mdzod /rigs tha dad kyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i thog dbus dang thog mtha' bsnol ba ni/gzhung las/ thog dbus thog mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/'dra min zung bskor bsnol tha dad/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa rang gi thog dbus dang thog mtha' gang rung la yod pa'i zung ldan du ldan pa'i dbyangs gsal rkang pa snga phyi rigs mi gcig cing / rkang pa so so'i gnas su che+os par bar ma chod cing snga phyi 'go mjug dbyangs gsal gzhan gyis bar chod pa la/ snga phyi thog dbus dang thog mtha' gnas sbrag mar ston pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ 'grig 'grig gtam 'grig 'grig drags na/nges nges bden blo bskyed nges nges/'grig 'grig go 'grig 'grig legs na/nges nges brjod don 'grub nges nges/zhes rkang pa snga phyi'i dbyangs gsal 'grig 'grig dang / nges nges sogs phan tshun rigs mi gcig la gnas thog dbus thog mtha' sbrag mar ston pa 'di'i brjod don/ deng dus kha mkhas bshad mkhas rnams kyi tshig 'grig po bshad nas pha rol pos bden du 'dzin pa dang / don la gnas pa g.yung drung gi bon sogs bden pa'i don go rim ma nor bar yang dag par

— 5 64—bslabs pas pha rol po la phan thog nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu 'gyur zhis so//ra/ brjod brjod ji na brjod brjod thal na/ring ring grogs dang rgyang ring ring /badzod brjod bden brjod badzod mkhas na/ring ring kau tshe yun ring ring /de la dbye na drug ste/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus gzhan thog mtha' can gyitsho bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs tha dad/ rkang pa snga phyir thog mtha' dang gzhan thog dbus can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs tha dad/rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa thog dbus dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs tha dad/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs tha dad/ rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa thog mtha' dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs tha dad/ rkang ma snga ma gnyis thog mtha' dang gzhan thog dbus can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs tha dad kyi rgyan dang drug yod pa 'dis dper brjod rig pas 'uphrul dgos so//

— 5kyo5 —thog dbus dang dbus mtha' 'dres ma'i sbrag mthun la/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//jigazhung las/ rkang pa thog mtha' dbus mtha'i gzugs/gnas gnyis bskor bsnol tha ma ste/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa so so'i thog dbus kyi gnas dang dbus mtha'i gnas gnyis gang rung yod pa'i sbrag ma'i zung ldan la gnas snga phyi'i zung ldan gyis rigs gcig mi gcig ci rigs yod cing dbyangs gsal gzhan gyi bar chod ma chod sna tshogs kyi sbrag zung zhig la thog dbus dbus mtha'i zung ldan 'dres ma'i sbrag mthun zhes bya'o//de la dbye na gsum ste/ bar ma chod pa'i thog dbus dbus mtha' 'dres ma'i sbrag mthun/ bar chod pa'i thog dbus dbus mtha' 'dres ma'i sbrag mthun/ bar chod cing ma chod pa'i thog dbus dbus mtha' 7'dres ma'i sbrag mthun dang gsum mo//bar ma chod pa'i thog dbus dbus mtha' 'dres ma'i sbrag mthun ni/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no// tsho gzhung las/ thog mtha' dbus mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/ sna tshogs zung bsnol bar ma chod/ji dī dzi ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa thog mtha' gnyis sam dbus ma tha' gnyis gang gi gnas gnyis la dbyangs gsal zung du zlos shing snga phyi rkang pa so so'i thog dbus dang dbus mtha' bsnol mar ston nas rkang pa / rdzoso'i zung ldan gyi gzugs sna tshogs ldan pa zhig la bar ma chod pa'i thog dbus dang thog mtha' 'dres ma'i sbrag mthun zhes bya'o//

—5 66—ge/zhung lar+sā / brjid brjid sku yi mtshan bzang bzang /rigs rgyud gtsang gtsang thugs gsal gsal/ zab zab rig gnas kun mkhas ma /bas/kun la dgyes dgyes 'dzum 'dzum lhug lhugarkang pa dang po dang gsum pa gnyis thog mtha' dang gzhan gnyis dbus mtha' can gyi zung ldan 'di'i brjod bya ni/ ya rab spyod bzang can gyi skyes bu dam pa'i rgyud las skyes pas chung nas rgyud dul zhing bcu rig gi gnas la brtson pa/ kun la zhi ba'i sems kyis skyong ba dang / shes bya'i gnas kun la ma rmangs pa de dag ni/ ya rab can gyi gshis so//ra/ mdzes mdzes mtshan dpe'i bkrag lam lam/'phang 'gro snyan snyan 'khrol brel brel/zab zab gnas lnga'i don gsal gsal/yid 'ong 'dzum 'dzum bzhad lhag lhagadabye na drug ste/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi ma chod pa sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis dbus mtha' dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi ma chod pa sbrag mthun/ rkang pa dang po dang gsum par thog dbus dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi ma chod pa'i sbrag ma thun/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi ma chod rma 'i sbrapo/ mthun/ rkang pa dang po gsum par dbus mtha' dang po/zhan thog dbus can gyi ma chod pa'i sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar ma chod pa'i sbrag mthun bcas drug gi dper brjod tsam sngar bzhin 'gres su shes par bya'o//

—567—bar chod pa'i thog dbus dang dbus mtha' can gyi bsnol ma'i sbrag mthun ni/gzhung las/ thog mtha' dbus mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/skor zlos bsnol ba bar chod pa/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa so so'i thog mtha' dbus mtha' gnyis la ldan pa'i zung ldan la snga phyi gzugs gcig mi gcig ci rigs ldan zhing gnas so sor gzugs gcig zung du zlos pa snga phyi thog mtha' dang dbus mtha' bsnol mar ston pa zhig go/de la dbye na gnyis te/ rigs gcig pa'i bar chod pa dang rigs tha dad pa'i bar chod pa'o//rigs gcig pa'i bar chod pa'i thog mtha' dang mtha' dbus bsnol ba ni/gzhung las/ thog mtha' dbus mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/'dra ba bskor bsnol rigs gcig pa/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa so so'i thog dbus dang mtha' dbus gnyis gang rung la yod pa'i zung ldan dbyangs gsal gcig pa yod pa'i zung ldan te/ rkang snga phyi zung ldan rnams dbyangs gsal rigs gcig cing / gnas gnyis la zlos te/ mi brjed par ston zhing / snga phyi thog dbus dang dbus mtha'i gnas bsnol mar ston pa'i rgyan zhig la go/gzhung las/ zhwa dkar rtse rgyal sgom chen zhwa/stag gzig rgyan zhwa sngags pa'i zhwa/— zhwa ser ltag sgro rtsod pa'i zhwa/skyon bral pad zhwa 'dul ba'i zhwa/

—568—zhes rkang pa snga phyi kun gyi zung ldan zhu zhes pa'i dbyangs gsal de ldan zhing gnas thog dbus mtha' dbus bsnol mar ston pa ste/ zhwa dkar mo rtse rgyalo ni g.yung drung bon gyi thun min gyi sgom nyams len pa'i zhwa dang / stag zhwa gzig zhwa ni gsang ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor ba'i zhwa dang / zhwa ser rtse zhwa'am ltag sgro can ni rtsod pa byed pa'i zhwa/ pad zhu ni skyon dang bral ba mtshon te 'dul pa'am drang srong pa'i zhwa ru nges so//ra/ rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin khri gtsug rgyal/rje btsun shes rgyal gtsug gshen rgyal/rgyal bstan zab mo bon bstan rgyal/phyogs las rnam rgyal kun gyi rgyal/de la dbye na drug tu yod de/ rkang pa snga phyi thog dbus dang dbus mtha' can gyi chod pa'i sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog dbus can gyi chod pa'i sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga ma dang gsum pa thog dbus dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi chod pa sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi chod pa'i sbrag mthun/ rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod pa'i sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog dbus can gyi bar chod pa'i sbrag mthun bcas drug go/ de dag gi dper brjod sngar bzhin shes par mdzod/rigs tha dad kyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i thog dbus mtha' dbus bsnol ba'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ thog dbus dbus mtha'i gan sa gnyis gzugs/'dra min bskor bsnol rigs tha dad/

—5 69—ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa so so'i thog dbus sam thog mtha' gang rung gi gnas la rkang pa so so'i zung ldan dbyangs gsal mtshungs shing / gnas gcig la zung du ma zlos par snga phyi gzugs gzhan gyis bar chod cing rkang pa snga phyi'i zung ldan gyi gnas dang gzugs mi gcig par ston pa zhig la go/gzhung las/ kun rdzob bon can 'khor ba'i bon/zab brling rgya mtsho'i 'jing ltar zab/don dam bon nyid myang 'das bon/zab yangs nam mkha'i gtos ltar zab/ces rkang pa snga phyi'i dbyangs gsal gyi zung ldan dang gnas rnams mi gcig cing / zlos pa'i dbar gzhan gyis chod pa ste/ 'di'i baji+od bya ni/kun rdzob 'khor ba'i bon rnams gting zab pa rgya mtsho'i 'jing lta bu dang /don dam myang 'das kyi bon rnams nam mkha' ltar rgya che zhing kun la khyab pa mu mtha' med pa ste/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba ste don dam pa dang /bden par med cing bden pa'i don ltar snang ba ni kun rdzob kyi don no//ra/ tsan dan shing mchog 'phags yul shing /sman mchog nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman/ba lu shing bzang gangs can shing /sman bsang dri zhim spos kyi sman/de la dbye na drug tu yod de/ rkang pa snga phyi thog dbus dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi chod pa'i sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog dbus can gyi chod sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga ma dang gsum pa thog dbus dang gzhan mtha' can gyi chod pa'i sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi chod pa'i sbrag mthun/

—5 70—rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi chod pa'i sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog dbus can gyi bar chod pa'i sbrag mthun dang drug go/ de dag sngar bzhin 'gres su shes par bya'o//bar chod cing ma chod pa'i thog mtha' dang dbus mtha' 'dres ma'i sbrag mthun ni/ gzhung las/ thog mtha' dbus mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/skor zlos bsnol ba bar chod pa/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa thog mtha' dang dbus mtha'i gnas gnyis gang rung la ldan pa'i zung ldin la/ rkang pa snga phyi'i dbyangs gsal rigs gcig mi gcig ci rigs dang gnas gcig la zung zlos mi zlos nges med kyi sgo nas ston pa'i rgyan zhig la bar chod pa'i thog dbus dang dbus mtha'i rgyan zhes bya'o// de la dbye na gnyis te/ rigs gcig pa'i thog mtha' dang dbus mtha' 'dres ma'i sbrag mthun dang / rigs tha dad pa'i thog mtha' dang dbus mtha' 'dres ma'i sbrag mthun gnyis so// chorigs gcig pa'i thog mtha' dang dbus mtha' 'dres ma'i sbyag mthun ni/gzhung las/ thog mtha' dbus mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/'dra ba bskor bsnol rigs gcig pa/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa so so'i thog mtha' dang dbus mtha' ci rigs zung du zlos pa la bar ma chod cing rkang pa so so'i 'go mjug gi gzugs gzhan gyis bar chod pa zhig la go/ gzhung las/ brel brel dran 'gyu'i yid brel brel/

brel brel grangs brjod kha brel brel/sor mo brel brel spyod brel brel/lcags myug brel brel 'khyug brel brel/zhes rkang pa snga phyi kun gyi zung ldan rigs gcig pa bar ma chod par brel brel zhes pa rkang pa snga phyi 'go mjug gi bar chod cing phan tshun dbus dang mtha' dbus gnas bsnol mar ston pa zhig ste/ 'di'i brjod bya ni/rtsom pa po mtshan nyid ldan pa 'ga' zhig bstan bcos rtsom pa la thog pa med pa ma zad/ 'chad pa la yang ngal ba med par don bkral ba la mkhas pa de dag gi dus tshod 'phro brlag tu mi gtong bar 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la dus 'da' ba rnams kyi rang bzhin brjod pa'o//ra/ 'khug 'khug chu 'bur mig 'khyug 'khyuga'akhyug 'khyug dran pa'i sems 'khyug 'khyugaglog 'od 'khyug 'khyug phra 'khyug 'khyugagazha' tshon 'khyug 'khyug stong 'khyug 'khyugade la dbye na drug ste/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog mtha' dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi chod ma chod pa'i sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog mtha' dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi chod ma chod pa'i sbrag mthun/ rkang pa dang po dang gsum par thog mtha' dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi chod ma chod sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog mtha' dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi chod ma chod sbrag mthun/ rkang pa dang po gsum par dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi chod ma chod pa'i sbrag mthun/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi chod ma chod pa'i sbrag mthun dang drug go/ de dag gi dper brjod ni sngar bzhin rigs 'gres su shes par bya'o//

—5 72—rigs tha dad pa'i bar chod cing ma chod pa'i thog mtha' dang dbus mtha' can ni/gzhung las/ thog dbus dbus mtha'i gnas gnyis gzugs/'dra min bskor bsnol rigs tha dad/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa thog dbus dang dbus mtha' gnyis gang rung la ldan pa'i zung ldan la so so'i gnas su dbyangs gsal zung du rlos pa la gzhan gyis bar ma chod cing rang gi 'go mjug sogs kyis bar chod pa la snga phyi'i zung ldan rnams rigs mi gcig pa zhig la gnas phan tshun basmol mar ston pa ste/ gzhung las/ dal dal 'khor spangs lus dal dal/dal dal chags bral sems dal dal/'phro 'du lhang lhang gsal lhang lhang /lha bsnyen lhang lhang sgrog lhang lhang /zhes rkang pa snga ma gnyis la dal dal dang phyi ma gnyis lhang lhang zhes rigs mi mthun zhing gnas thog dbus dang thog mtha' ldog pa ste 'di'i brjod bya ni/ bslab pa gsum rgyud la ldan pa'i grwa btsun ni/ lus sems gnyis ka 'khor ba las thar pas zhi bde dang ldan pa ma zad yi dam gyi bsnyen 'dzab rnams sgrog cing gnas pa'o zhes so//ra/ mdzes mdzes ngur smrig rgyan mdzes mdzes/mdzes mdzes lang tsho'i mdangs mdzes mdzes/mgur dbyangs snya na snyan sgrogs snyan snyan/gling bu snyan snyan skad snyan snyan/dbye na drug ste/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi bar chod cing ma chod tha dad pa'i rjes mthun/ rkang pa snga phyi

—5 73—gnyis thog mtha' dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi bar chod cing ma chod tha dad pa'i rjes mthun/ rkang pa dang po dang gsum par thog dbus dang gzhan dbus mtha' can gyi bar chod cing chod ma chod tha dad pa'i sgrag mthun/rkang pa snga phyi gnyis thog dbus dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod cing ma chod tha dad rjes mthun/ rkang pa dang po dang gsum pa dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod cing ma chod tha dad rjes mthun/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis dbus mtha' dang gzhan thog mtha' can gyi bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rigs tha dad pa'i rjes mthun dang drug go/ de dag sngar bzhin dper brjod rigs 'gres su shes par bya'o//gzhan 'di dag gis mtshon te rjes mthun gyi zung ldan mtha' yas pa zhig ni dpyod ldan rnams kyi blo gros kyis dpog kyang rung ngo // sbrag ma'i rjes mthun gyi zung ldan zhes bya ba'o//

—574—gnas gsum ka'i zung ldan ni/mtshad nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung thog dbus mtha'i/gzugs bskor thog dbus mtha' zung ldan/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang grangs ci rigs kyi rang rang gi gnas thog ma dang bar ma tha ma gsum kar ldan pa'i zung ldan la dbyangs gsal gzhan gyis bar chod ma chod dang rigs gcig mi gcig sna tshogs ldan zhing /rkang pa rer snga phyi gnas gsum ldan pa'i zung ldan zhig la gsum ka'i zung ldan zhes bya'o//gnyis pa dbye na gsum ste/ bar ma chod pa'i gsum ka'i zung ldan dang / bar chod pa'i gsum ka'i zung ldan/ bar chod cing ma chod pa'i gsum ka'i zung ldan dang gsum mo//bar ma chod pa'i gsum ka'i zung lden ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung gnas gsum gzugs/sna tshogs zung 'brel bar ma chod/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi ka'am gnyis gsum gcig sna tshogs la rang gi thog ma dang bar ma tha ma'i gnas gsum la ldan pa'i zung ldan la rang snyor zung du zlos pa la dbyangs gsal gzhan gyis bar ma chod cing snga phyi zung ldan rnams rigs mi gcig par ldan pa zhig go ba'o//gzhung las/ zagazab dgung sngon sngon sangs sangs/dkar dkar sprin dpung dpung 'thug 'thugamadzes mdzes gzhu bkra bkra 'khyuga'akhyug

—575—gsal gsal nyid 'od 'od lam lam/zhes rkang pa bzhi kar gnas gsum zung ldan te/ rkang pa snga phyi'i gnas so so'i zung ldan rigs mi gcig kyang / rang sar zung du zlos pa la bar ma chod pa 'dis nam mkha'i khyad par rnams rim bzhin brjod nas/ rtags sems nyid la dpe de bzhin du mtshon nas/ mthar bon nyid bdal pa chen po'i gnas lugs gtan la 'beb byed kyi dper 'os par ston pa'o//sha 'khyug 'khyug srung ma'i tshogs rnams 'khyug 'khyug 'phrin las sgrub pa'i sku 'khyug 'khyuga'adzigs 'jigs zhing bcu sgrol byed 'jigs 'jigs 'tshoms rngams rtsub 'gyur ston 'jigs 'jigs/'ur 'ur gad rgyang sgrog cing 'ur 'ur 'khor tshogs spral pa'i dpung 'ur 'ur/'dzum 'dzum dgyes zharla gshen la 'dzum 'dzum ha he'i sgrar bcas bzhad 'dzum 'dzum/zhes bstan srung ma bdud btsan rgyal rnams kyi nyams 'gyur dang byed las la bstod pa'o//ra/ dkar dkar gnas ri ri brjid brjid/ mdzes mdzes spang ljang ljang mthing mthing /dwangs dwangs bya skad skad snyan snyan/gsal gsal rang gems gems dga' dga'/'di la dbye na bco lnga yod de/ rkang pa dang po'i thog mtha' bar gsum la yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa gnyis pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa gsum pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa

—5 76—bzhi pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/rkang pa snga ma gnyis thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma gsum gyi thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa bar ma gnyis kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa dbus dang mtha' gnyis kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma gsum gyi thog mtha' bar gsum du gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga gnyis dang phyi ma'i thog mtha' bar gsum du gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma dang phyi ma gnyis kyi thog mtha' bar gsum du gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/rkang pa phyi ma gsum gyi thog mtha' bar gsum du gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan/ ṅkang pa bakhyi/ ka'i thog mtha' bar gsum du gnas pa'i bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan dang bcas bco lnga po'i dper brjod sngar bzhin 'gres su shes par mdzod/bar chod pa'i gnas gsum ka'i zung ldan gyi rgyan/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no// gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung gnas gsum gzugs/skor rlos byed pa bar chod pa/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang grangs ci rigs rkang pa so so'i thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i zung ldan te/ rang gi gnas gsum re re nas dbyangs gsal zung du ldan zhing gnas so so'i rkang pa gcig snga phyi riṭa

—5 77—gcig la zung ldan tha dag rigs gcig mi gcig sna tshoṭa dang dbyangs gsal gnas gcig zung du mi ldan pas bar chod pa zhes bya'o//de la dbye na gnyis te/ rigs gcig pa'i gnas gsum zung ldan dang / rigs tha dad pa'i gnas gsum zung ldan no//rigs gcig pa'i gnas gsum zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung gnas gsum gzugs/'dra ba skor zlos so so'i don/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi ka dang gnyis gsum gcig sogs gang rung gi thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i dbyangs gsal snga phyi rigs gcig pa la gnas gcig la zung du ma zlos par snga phyi so so'i 'go mjug gi bar chod cing zung ldan 'dra bar bstan pa zhig la go'o//gzhung las/ bzang rab thugs bzang skubs su bzang /bzang po rigs bzang bshes su bzang /bzang po ngang bzang grogs su bzang /bzang khams gzhung bzang 'bangs su bzang /zhes rkang pa bzhi kar yod pa'i rigs gcig pa'i bzang zhes pa'i thog dbus mtha' gsum gyi zung ldan can 'di ni/ ya rabs rgyud pa bzang po dang ldan pa'i spyod pa can gyi mi de ni grogs su bstsal na'ang rang gzhan gnyis kar phan pa dang skyabs su song na 'di phyi gnyis kar phan pa 'bangs su bskul na rang 'dod don ltar sgrab par 'gyur ro zhes so//sha mchog bzhi'i nang nathe mchog gi bla ma mchogamachog thun mnga' brnyes mchog sprul chen po mchog mchog dman kun las mchog tu jorephags pa mchog/ cimachog 'dzin legs spangs mchog grub rig 'jin mchog

—5 78—ces thog dbus mtha' yi bar chod pa'i zung ldan 'di'i brjod bya ni bla ma sems dpa'i tshogs kun la bstod pa'o//ra/ mchog gsum dkon mchog skyabs kyi mchogamachog gyur bon mchog grub mtha'i mchogamachog chen 'phags mchogagashenagyi mchogamachog ston skyabs mchog bla ma mchogade la dbye na bcu gcig yod de/ rkang pa snga ma gnyis gnas gsum ldan bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa dang po dang gsum par gnas gsum can gyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga phyir gnas gsum can gyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa bar ma gnyis gnas gsum can gyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa dbus mtha' gnyis gnas gsum can gyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa phyi ma gnyis gnas gsumajican gyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma gsum gnas gsum can gyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan/rkang pa snga ma gnyis dang phyi ma'i gnas gsum can gyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan/rkang pa dang po dang phyi ma gnyis gnas gsum can gyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan/rkang pa phyi ma gsum gnas gsum can gyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa bzhi kar gnas gsum can gyi bar chod pa'i zung ldan bcas bcu gcig po de dag ni dper brjod sngar bzhin shes par bya'o//rigs tha dad pa'i bar chod pa'i gnas gsum gyi zung ldan ni/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ rkang pa gang rung gnas su gzugs/'dra min skor zlos rigs tha dad/

—5 79—ces mtshan nyid bstan te rkang pa snga phyi thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa'i dbyangs gsal gnas gcig tu ma zlos par rkang pa snga phyi zung ldan riṭa mi gcig par ston pa'i rgyan zhig la bya'o//gzhung las/ mtshan bzang sku mtshan 'phags pa'i mtshan/ bkra shis rtags bkra sku la bkra/mtshan nyid dpe mtshan rdzogs pa'i mtshan/bkra gsal rnam bkra thugs la bkra/zhes rkang pa snga phyi rim bzhin thog mtha' bar gsum du mtshan zhes pa dang bkra zhes pa sogs snga phyi zung ldan rigs mi gcig cing zlos pa la snga phyi 'go mjug gi bar chod pa ste 'di'i brjod bya ni/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa ni snu la mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu rtsa gcig dang ldan pa 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum thams cad sa ler bkra ba'o zhes so//sha 'khyug 'khyug srung ma'i sde tshogs 'khyug 'khyug 'phrin las sgrub 'khyug 'khyuga'akhyug 'khyug dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad 'khyub/ 'khyug myur mgyoṭa mthus 'khyug 'khyuga'akhyug 'khyug gshen gyi sdong byed 'khyug 'khyug ci bcol mnyes 'khyug 'khyug 'khyug 'khyug rgyal bstan skyong la 'khyug 'khyug glog phreng ltar 'khyug 'khyug — ces thog mtha' dbus su gnas pa'i bar chod cing ma chod pa'i rgyan 'idis bstan pa'i bku' srung rnams kyi nyams 'gyur dang byed las la bstod pa 'o//

—580—ra/ shes rgyal mchog shes dam por shes/zab la/ ma yang zab gdam pa zab/shes bya'i don shes bden med shes/zab gsang yang zab bon bstan zab/de la dbye na gsum ste/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis rigs tha dad pa'i gnas gsum ldan pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma dang bar ma'i rigs tha dad pa'i bar chod pa'i gnas gsum zung ldan/ rkang pa snga phyi gnyis gnyis rigs tha dad pa'i bar chod pa'i gnas gsum ldan zung ldan dang gsum gyi dper brjod sngar bzhin shes par byos/bar chod cing ma chod pa'i gnas gsum zung ldan rgyan ni/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ rkang pa so so'i gnas gsum gzugs/zung sbrel bskor ba chod ma chod/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi po so so'i gnas thog ma bar gsum du zung ldan zung sbrel du zhes bar ma chod par rlos pa la rkang snga phyi dang rang gi 'go mjug dbyangs gsal gzhan gyis bar chod pa zhig bar chod cing ma chod pa'i gnas gsum zung ldan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ dkar dkar dkar dkar sku dkar dkar/tsā dkar dkar dkar dkar gsung dkar dkar/dkar dkar dkar dkar thugs dkar dkar/dkar dkar dkar dkar las dkar dkar/zhes snga phyi 'go mjug bar chod cing ma chod pa 'dis sku mdog dkar gsal phyi nang sgrib med 'od kyi sku dang / gsung ba'i bka' dre ma med pa

— 5 81 —yang dag pa thugs rje phyogs ris dang nye ring med pa dang / gzhan gyi don kho na'i las byed pa gshen lha 'od dkar lta bur mtshon no//yang na/ choms shig choms shig bdud choms shigathul cig thul cig bgegs thul cigasgrol cig sgrel cig dgra sgrol cigamadzod cig mdzod cig las mdzod cigaces pa rkang snga phyi rigs mi gcig cing bar chod cing ma chod pa'i gnas gsum gyi zung ldan ni bstan pa'i bka' srung rnams la bskul ba'i rgyan no//ra/ 'khyug 'khyug 'khyug 'khyug lus 'khyug 'khyuga'akhyug 'khyug 'khyug 'khyug spyan 'khyug 'khyuga'akhyug 'khyug 'khyug 'khyug se+oms 'khyug 'khyuga'akhyug 'khyug 'khyug 'khyug glag 'khyug 'khyuga' dis la dbye na brazhi ste/ rkad+ngha pa snga ma gnyis bar chod cing ma chod pa'i gnas gsum zung ldan/ rkang pa snga phyi rim bzhin bar chod cing ma chod pa'i gnas gsum zung ldan/ rkang pa snga ma dang bar ma gnyis bar chod cing ma chod pa'i gnas gsum zung ldan/ rkang pa bzhi ka'i thog mtha' bar chod cing ma chod pa'i gnas gsum zung ldan dang bcas bzhi'i dper brjod ༷r+sha 'a gres su shes par bya'o// rāsgyu sdo / — rme zhes gnas gsum zung ldan gyi rgyan bshad zin zhing / dper mtshon tshuṣ+kas gnas gsum gyizung ldan jiske snyed cig blos dpog par byos/

—5 82—mtha' thog skrur ba'i zung ldan/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ snga rkang mtha' dang phyi rkang thogagazugs mthun sbrel ba mtha' thog sbyar/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi yi sho lo ka thog ma'i mthar zung ldan dang / rkang pa tha ma'i 'go zung ldan yod cing / bar ma gnyis la thog mtha' gnyis kar yod pa'i zung ldan zhig la snga ma'i mthar yod zung ldan de nyid phyi ma'i thog mar yod pa ste/ snga phyi'i zung ldan gyi dbyangs gsal rigs gcig cing / bar chod ma chog ci rigs dang gzugs gcig pa zung du rlos mi zlos ci rigs dang ldan pa zhig la go/gnyis pa dbye ba la gsum ste/ bar ma chod pa'i mtha' thog sbyor ba'i zung ldan/ bar chod pa'i mtha' thogasbyor ba'i zung ldan/ bar chod cing ma chod pa'i mtha' thu+og sbyar ba'i zung ldan no//bar ma chod pa'i mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan/gzhung las/ snga rkang mtha' gzugs zung sna tshogs/phyi rkang thog 'dren bar ma chod/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bzhi yi thog ma'i mthar gnas kyi gzugs de nyid zung du che+os pa ma zad rjes ma'i 'go bor slar bar ma chod par zung du rlos shing / mtha' thog sbyar ba'i gzugs gcig cing / snga phyi rnams zung ldan rim bzhin de mtshungs ci rigs dang ldan pa zhig la bar ma chod pa'i mtha' thog sbyar ba'o//

—583 —gzhung las/ don gyi 'dug tshul stong sangs sangs/ra ngarnga rnganangs rang 84dngas gsalug lhag lhagalhag lhag rang grol bde lam lam/lam lam sngar gyi shul du yal/zhes rkang pa thog ma'i mtha' dang de rjes kyi thog ma gnyis sangaru/ sangs zhes zung ldan du bar ma chod par rigs gcig pa sbyar ba bzhin phyi ma rnams lhag lhag lam lam rnams sbyar ba 'dis/ yang dag pa'i bla med rdzogs pa chen po'i gnas lugs rang 'byung ye shes de nyid ngo bo stong pa dang / rang bzhin gsal ba ste/ de nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa dang / de nyid rtogs dang ma rtogs kyis sems can dang sangs rgyas kyi lha snyid 'dogs pa'o//sha thos bsam nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing /zhing khams kun tu bon sde so sor 'chad/'chad rtsod rtsom gsum mi 'jigs spobs pas smra/smra seng rnam dag 'od zer zhabs la 'dus/zhes mtha' thog sbyor ba'i zung ldan 'dis yongs 'dzin rnam dag 'od zer la bstod pa'i rgyan no//ra/ rmad byung 'dus sde brel 'khyug 'khyuga'akhyug 'khyug dgag sgrub gnad zab zab/ zab zab bon la 31sa lam lam/— lam lam bon bde sgrub la phyogs/bar chod pa'i mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ tshig rkang snga ma'i mtha'i gzugs re/phyi ma'i thog 'dren bar chod pa/

—584—zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa dang po'i mtha' ma'i zung dang bar ma'i thog ma'i zung ldan gnyis kyi dbar dbyangs gsal gzhan gyi bar chod pa ste/ phyi ma de ltar ldan pa'am yang na/ snga ma phyi ma gnyis gnas gcig la zung du mi zlos par gnas so so'i bar chod cing rigs tha dad dang gcig pa sna tshogs ldan pa zhig la bya'o//de la dbye na gnyis te/ rigs gcig pa'i mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan dang / rigs tha dad pa'i mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan no//rigs gcig pa ni/gzhung las/ snga phyi rkang mtshams sbyar ba'i gzugs/'dra ba skor zlos rigs gcig pa/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang ji/ snga phyi mtha' thog sbyor bablu mtshams kyi zung ldan gnas gcig la ma zlos kyang snga phyi'i zung ldan gyi dbyangs gsal rigs gcig pa ston pa'i rgyan zhig la go/gzhung las/ dpon gsas bla ma mkhyen stobs ldan/stobs ldan yi dam mthu stobs ldan/stobs ldan mkha' 'gro nus stobs ldan/stobs ldan bon skyongs tshogs la 'dud/ces stobs ldan zhes snga phyi 'go mjug gis bar chod pa 'di'i baji+od don ni/ bla ma dam pa ni 'di phyi gnyis ka mkhyen pa'i dpal dang ldan zhing / yi dam lha tshogs ni 'gal rkyen bar chad sogs la skyobs pa'i nus pa dang ldan la/ mkha' 'gro dang bon skyong rnams ni sangs rgyas g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa srung ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'o// yang na gzhung las/ rig 'dzin sems dpa' kun gyi rgyal/rgyal kun ngo bo rla ba rgyal/

—585—rgyal khams bde la 'god pa'i rgyal/rgyal ba gnyis pa khyed min su/shesarang gi gnas la gzugs gcig pa zung du zlos pa bar chod pa 'dis/ snangaston zu ba rgyal mtshan ni rig 'dzin sems dpa' kun gyi ngo bo 'gro ba'i don du mngon par byon pa yin zhing / rgyal ba gnyis pa'am ston pa gnyisapamanyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan ni rgyal khams bon gyi 'khor lo bskor nas sems can rnams sdug bsngal las sgrol ba'i don du byon no zhes dam pa gnyis kyi yon tan brjod pa'o//sha rnam 'dren mkhas mang rgya mtsho'i 'dzum zhal bcud/zhal bcud bdud rtsi nod pa'i las skal ldan/skal ldan bdag ni mkha' mnyam 'gro 'dren mchoga'adren mchog bstan pa'i dpal du gyur bar smon/zhes bar chod pa'i mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan 'dis/ dpon gsas bla ma dam pa'i gdam pa nod pa'i skyes bus rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la bstod pa'o//ra/ dam pa'i ngang rgyud ches ya rabs/ya rabs can gyi rgyud ya rabs/ya rabs mdzad pa'i don ya rabs/ya rabs can gyi skyes bu nyid/rigs tha dad partsobar chod pa'i mtha' thog sbyar ba'i rgyan ni/gzhung las/ snga phyi rkang mtshams sbyar ba'i gzugs/'dra ba sna tshogs rigs tha dad/

—58kyo—ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa snga phyi mtha' thog sbyar ba'i dbyangs gsal gyi gzugs rnams rkang pa snga phyi mi gcig par ston pa'i bar chod pa zhig la bya'o//gzhung las/ mkha' mnyam skye dgu'i re gnas mchogaganas mchog dam pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/sangs rgyas bstan dang dmu rgyal sras/rgyal sras sems dpa'i tshogs bcas bstod/ces rkang pa snga phyi zung ldan gnas mchog sangs rgyas sras sogs phan tshun ribs mi gcig cing / snga phyis bar chod pa zhig gis/ rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i mgon po rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo de nyid la bstod pa'am rang bzhin brjod pa'o//yang na gzhung las/ zab yangs rig pa'i gnas rnams kun/kun mkhyen shes rab blo ldan mchogamachog gyur rgyal ba'i snang brnyan spyi/spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'bral med bkod/ces kun dang mchog spyi sogs ldan pa'i zung ldan 'di snga phyi bar chod cing rigs tha dad pa 'dis g.yung drung gling gi mkhan po shes rab blo ldan la bstod pa ste/ gnas lnga rig pa'i sgo kun la mkhas pa phul du phyin pa ma zad/dus gsum sangs rgyas kun kyi ngo bo lnga snyigs 'gro ba'i don du mngon par byon pa zhes brjod pa'o//ra/ rmad byung mtshan dpe'i sku brjid ldan/brjid ldan zil gnon gzi 'od 'bum/'od 'bum 'phrin las 'gro kun mkhyen/ kun mkhyen rgyal sras bla mar bstod/

—587—bar chod cing ma chod pa'i mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan/gzhung las/ snga phyi rkang mtshams sbyar ba'i gzugs/zung 'dra skor zlos chod ma chod/ces mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa snga ma'i mjug dang phyi ma'i 'go sogs snga phyi mtha' dang thog rim bzhin sbyor ba la gnas so sor zung ldan du zlos pa la gzhan gyis bar ma chod kyang / snga phyi rang gi 'go mjug sogs kyis bar chod par ston pa zhig la go/gzhung las/ stag skyes lha bu'i sku rngam rngam/rngam rngam khro stabs 'gying rngam rngam/rngam rngam drag po'i gdangs rngam rngam/rngam rngam bdud srin sgrol la dpa'/rkang pa snga phyi tshang mar rngam rngam zhes pa'i dbyangs gsal gcig pa ldan zhing snga phyi rang rang gi 'go mjug gis bar chod pa 'dis/ yi dam stag lha me 'bar gyi drag po'i tshad bcu gcig bstan tsam gyis bdud dang srin po 'byung po kun rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus pa dang dam la btags pa sogs kyi khyad nus dang ldan pa'o//sha dpyod ldan dgyes pa'i zhal sgo 'dzum lhag lhug lhug lhug ཿkhag ba'i legs bshad bkra lam lam/lam lam gtan la phab pa kun gsal gsal/gsal gsal gzhan la 'dom mkhas 'dzig rten migaces bar chod cing ma chod pa'i mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan 'dis smra dbang gshen gyi gdung sras nyi ma rgyal mtshan la bstod pa'o//ra/ 'gro ba 'dren phyir bon zab zab/zab zab rgya mtsho'i 'jing zab zab/
—588—zab zab gnyugs ma'i gshis zab zab/zab zab bla med rdzogs pa che/zhes 'dis mtshon nas mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan ji snyed cig dam pa'i zhal gdams dang rtsom pa po'i blos dpog par bya'o//

—589—kun tu bsres pa'i zung ldan/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ kun tu zung ldan zhes bya ba/tshig rkang skor ldab byed pa ste/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ snga ma nang bzhin gyi tshig rkang gcig gnyis kyi zung ldan ma yin par kun tu zung ldan zhes bya ba 'di ni tshig bcad phan tshun gzugs mtshungs pa'am zung ldan du ston pa ste zu+os par snga phyi 'dis 'phrul gyi bkod pa ste/ 'di ni rang lugs la zlos pa'am ldab pa zhes brjod kyang rung par sems te/ rkang pa snga ma de phyi mar yang zlos shing don snga phyi so sor go byed cig la bzhag kyang rung ngo //de la dbye na bcu drug yod de/ tshig rkang ya ldab pa'i zung ldan/ tshig rkang snga ma ldab pa'i zung ldan/ tshig rkang dbus dang thog mtha' ldab pa'i zung ldan/ tshig rkang snga gnyis ldab pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa ya gcig dang gsum ldab pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa gcig dang bzhi ldab pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa gnyis gsum ldab pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa gnyis bzhi ldab pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa phyi ldab pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa gnyis gsum ldab pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa gsum pa gang 'dod gnyis ldab pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa gsum bzhi ldab pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa dang po gsum bzhi ldab pa'i zung ldan/ rkang pa gnyis gsum bzhi ldab pa'i zung ldan/ rkang bzhi sho lo ka ldagapa'i zung ldan/ tshig rkang gcig lan bzhi ldab pa'i zung ldan dang bcu drug go/tshig rkang snga ma ldeb pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ sgo ston bstan pa'i nyi ma shar/ — mdo sngags bshad sgrub pad tshal rgyas/

—590— sgo ston bstan pa'i nyi ma shar/mdo sngags bshad sgrub pad tshal rgyas/sgo rje rgya yi gdung las bstan pa'i gsal byed de nyid kyis mdo sngags sems gsum gyi bstan pa phyogs bcur spel ba'o//sha bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal dang ldan pa'i sku/lus can kun gyi mig gi nyer 'tshor gsal/bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal dang ldan pa'i sku/lus can kun gyi mig gi nyer 'tshor gsal/zhes sgeg ldan dbyangs can lha mo'i mdzes dpal brjod pa 'o//ra/ lung rig dbyar rnga sdir ba'i dpal/mdo sngags zung 'brel sman ri ba/lung rig dbyar rnga sdir ba'i dpal/mdo sngags zung 'brel sman ri ba/tshig rkang snga ldab phyi ldab kyi kun tu zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ tshig rkang snga ldeb phyi ldab ste/phan tshun tshig don 'brel chags pa/zhes tshig rkang dang po gnyis pa gnyis ldab pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa phyi ma ldab pa zhes zung du zlos pa zhig la go/gzhung las/ snang ston rgyal ba'i mtshan can byung /snang ston rgyal ba'i mtshan can byung /bon bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan phyar/bon bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan phyar/

—591 —snga ma snga ma ldab cing / phyi ma phyi ma ldab pa 'dis snga phyi rim bzhin skyabs mgon snang ston rla ba rgyal mtshan gyis bon bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur khyab par spel zhes pa'o//sha 'dzad med rin chen gter la mnga' mdzad pa/'dzad med rin chen gter la mnga' mdzad pa/skye rgu'i re bskong gnod sbyin nor gyi lha/skye rgu'i re bskong gnod sbyin nor gyi lha/zhes snga phyi gnyis baches pa'i rgyan 'dis ni/ nor gyi lha aru 'dzam r+bha lha yi rang bzhin brjod pa'o//ra/ mdo sngags zung 'brel 'phrul ngag bon/mdo sngags zung 'brel 'phrul ngag bon/gshen bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan du che/gshen bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan du che/dbus dang thog mtha' ldab pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ tshig rkang dbus ldab thog mtha' lda ba/phan tshun tshig don 'drel chags pa/zhes rkang pa dbus ma gnyis gzugs mtshungs pa dang snga phyi gnyis mtshungs par ston zhing phan tshun 'brel ba'am don ldan can gyi rgyan zhig la'o//gzhung las/ gshen bstan rnam rgyal kun grags gling /lho gling gsal ba'i sgron me che/lho gling gsal ba'i sgron me che/gshen bstan rnam rgyal kun grags gling /

— 5 92 —snga phyi gnyis phan tshun gzugs mtshungs pa dang dbus gnyis mtshungs pa 'dis ni/ grwa sa chen mo g.yung drung gling ngam rnam rgyal kun grags gling 'di ni lho 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan nam dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu lta bu mun pa sel ba'i sgron me bzhin du gnas so//sha rgya mtsho'i gos can snyan pa'i grags pa 'gengs/rnam 'dren mtshungs rla bral ba'i bka' drin can/rnam 'dren mtshungs rla bral ba'i bka' drin can/rgya mtsho'i gos can snyan pa'i grags pa 'gengs/zhes mtha'i gnyis dang bar gnyis brlas pa'i rgyan 'dis/ rnam 'dren mi yi seng ge rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rnam dkar gyi grags pa sa gzhi kun khyab bo zhes so//ra/ sred ldan nor 'dod mi la la/ rtag tu 'phang ba'i grogs la sbran/rtag tu 'phang ba'i grogs la sbran/sred ldan nor 'dod mi la la/rkang pa snga ma gnyis ldab pa'i zung ldan /gzhung las/ snga rkang gnyis po ldab pa'i don/ ༄ sna phyi rkang gnyis dang 'brel r+ṣags pa/ zhes tshig bcad dang po gnyis gzugs gcig par ldan zhing phyi ma gnyis dang phan tshun mtshon du yod pa'i zung ldan zhig la'o// gzhung las/ theg chen— zab ཿmo'i mdo khuhuXn pa/ri theg chenaskezarme— tsasa'i ma do 'idzin pā/ —3 spral sku ta pyi skre tsa ste/ — bye dar nyi ma 'od zer yang /

—593—zhes tshig rkang snga ma gnyis ldab par ston zhing rim bzhin theg chen zab mo'i mdo 'dzin sprul sku mchog ta pi hri tsa dang / rim bzhin theg chen zab mo'i mdo 'jen pa bya dur nyi ma 'od zer zhes mtshon pa'o//sha skal ldan blo la dgos 'dod ci yang 'jo/skal ldan blo la dgos 'dod ci yang 'jo/smra ba'i rgyal po phywa sras dpa' bo dang /ngag gi dbang phyug lha mo dbyangs can ma/zhes rkang gnyis baches pa'i rgyan 'di ni shes rab kyi lha phyu keng tse dang sgra dbyangs rgyal mo'i tshogs la bstod pa'o//ra/ gtsang dag skye rgu'i gdung ba sel/gtsang dag skye rgu'i gdung ba sel/ma pham g.yu yi mtsho mo ste/rgyal mchog dam pa'i thugs rje yang /rkang pa ya ldab pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa ya ldab zung gang bde/phan tshun tshig don 'brel chags pa/zhes rkang pa dang po de gsum par len gcig ldab cing gnyis pa dang bzhi pa phan tshun 'brel ba mtshon du yod pa zhig go/gzhung las/ lung dang rig pa'i dbang phyug rje/gnyos rgyal smra ba'i seng ge ste/lung dang rig pa'i dbang phyug rje/'gro mgon blo gros rgyal mtshan yang /zhes lung dang rig pa'i mnga' bdag ces pa des rkang pa snga phyi tshang ma la mtshon du nus pa ste/ rgyas par spros na bon gyi spun ldan chen po dang

—594—gnyos rgyal smra ba'i seng ge dang 'gro mgon blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis ka la mtshon nus pa'o//sha rig gnas rgya mtsho'i gzhung lugs dar rgyas mdzad/sngon byon 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan drug dang /rig gnas rgya mtsho'i gzhung lugs dar rgyas mdzad/da lta bdag blo'i sgo 'byed rje rnams dang /zhes dang po gsum par baches shing / sngon byon gyi skyes bu dam pa 'dzom gling mkhas pa'i rgyan drug dang bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la bstod pa'//ra/ 'jam mnyen zhi ba'i lang tsho can/shes rab rig pa'i lha mchog ste/'jam mnyen zhi ba'i lang tsho can/shes rab rig pa'i lha mchog ste/rkang pa dang po dang bzhi pa ldab pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa dang bzhi ldab pa'i don/gnyis pa gsum pa 'brel chags pa/zhes rkang pa dang po dang rkang pa bzhi pa gnyis gzugs gcig tu ldab cing / de dag rkang pa gnyis pa dang gsum par 'brel chags pa zhig ste/gzhung las/ snyan tshig gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang /baṇa tsha rgyal ba'i 'od zer te/gshen mkhas tshul khrims rgyal mtshan yang /snyan tshig gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang /zhes rkang pa snga phyi ldab cing / rim bzhin snyan tshig gzhung lugs zha mkhas pa smra ba'i dbang po gshen gyi mkhas grub tshul khrims rgyal mtshan no//

—595—snyan tshig gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang po paṇa tsha rgyal ba 'od zer zhes gnyis pa dang gsum par 'brel ba dang ldan pa'o//sha legs bshad kho nas rjes 'jug re 'dod skong /mu cho'i rnam rol gshen ston nam mkha' dang /yas kyi gdung 'dzin ye shes rin chen kyang /legs bshad kho nas rjes 'jug re 'dod skong /zhes thog mtha' brlas pa'i rgyan 'dis gshen ston nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang zhu yi gdung sras ye shes rin ches gnyis kyis mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i legs bshad rgyas par spel ba bcas gshen zhu gnyis kyi gdung sras rnams la bstod pa'o// ra/ rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor pa/rje btsun khro tshang 'brug lha zhes/bod rje mu khri btsan po yasde /rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor pa/rkang pa gnyis gsum ldab pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa gnyis gsum ldab pa'i don/dang po bzhi bar 'brel chags pa/ zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa bar ma gnyis po'i gzugs zung du ldan pa'am ldab pa ste/ de dag snga ma phyi ma gnyis la 'brel chags dang ldan pa zhig la go/ gzhung las/ rgyal ba gnyis pa mnyam med pa/gshen bstan gdugs dkar spor ba'i gnyen/gshen bstan gdugs dkar spor ba'i gnyen/kun 3yibyen rla ba rgyal mtshan yang /

—59kyo—zhes rkang pa bar ma gnyis zlos pa des snga ma la mtshon na/ rgyal gnyis pa mnyam medacashes rab rgyal mtshan nyid gshen bstan mi nub gdugs chen sgreng ba'i gnyen zhes snang ston che ba rgyal mtshan gyis gshen gyi bstan pa mi nub gdugs chen bsgrengs so zhes mtshon no//sha bder gshegs thugs sras lha bu stag la skyes/za byed srin po'i g.yul ngo gzhom pa'i gshed/za byed srin po'i g.yul ngo gzhom pa'i gshed/rgyal ba'i dgongs 'dus pad ma mthong grol yang /zhes bar gnyis brlas pas/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar dang bla chen dran pa'i sras g.yung drung mthong grol gnyis ni 'dre srin bgegs kyi kha gnon yin par bshad do// ra/ yid 'ong tshogs kyi zhing khams su/mdzes ldan me tog lha yi rdzas/mdzes ldan me tog lha yi rdzas/phul byung rgyal ba'i mdun sa ru/rkang pa gnyis bzhi ldab pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa gnyis bzhi ldab pa'i don/dang po gsum par 'brel bar ste/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rkang pa gnyis pa'i tshig rkang dang bzhi pa'i tshig rkang gnyis bldabs pa la gsum pa gnyis pa'i tshig rkang 'brel chags pa zhig go/ gzhung las/ gyer spungs snang bzher lod po yis/'byung lnga rol ba'i stabs su sgyur/dbra ston shes rab dgongs rgyal yang /

—5 9 7—'byung lnga rol pa'i stabs su sgyur/zhes 'byung lnga rol pa'i stabs su sgyur zhes ldab pa'i tshig rkang gi dang po lamatshon pa'i tshe na/ gyer spungs snang bzher lod pos rdzu 'phrul gyis 'byung ba lnga rang dbang thob nas dbang bsgyur nus pa dang / sman ri'i mkhan posmra dbang bsod nams blo gros sam dbra ston shes rab dgongs rgyal gyis 'byung ba lnga la rang dbang thob nas dbang sgyar nus pa sogs tshig don gnyis ka nas mtshon du yod pas so// ༄sha lnga bdo'i 'gro mgon gyer spungs dran pa rje/skye ba snga phyi dus gsum sgrib med mkhyen/sprul pa'i sku mchog khro gnyen rgyal mtshan yang /skye ba snga phyi dus gsum sgrib med mkhyen/zhes bar ma dang tha ma brlas pa 'dis/ dus snga phyi gsal ler gzigs pa'i spyan ldan thams cad mkhyen pa bla chen dran pa dang sprul sku khro gnyen rgyan mtshan gnyis kyi rnam dpyod bshad pa'o//ra/ phul byung gnas lnga 'chang ba'i bdagagangs can bstan pa'i rgyan du che/lnga rig 'byung gnas g.yung drung bon/gangs can bstan pa'i rgyan du che/rkang pa phyi ldab can gyi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa phyi ldab snga gong bde/ zhes rkang pa gsum pa dang bzhi pa gzugs gcig cing de dag snga ma gnyis la 'brel ba chags pa mtshon du yod pa'i rgyan zhig ste/ gzhung las/ lung rig smra ba'i mkhas pa dang /bslab gzhi brling ba'i btsun pa yang /

— 5 98—'jig rten mig gi nyer 'tshor gsal/'jig rten mig gi nyer 'tshor gsal/zhes phyi ma gnyis kyi gzugs rlams ldab cing / dang po dang gnyis pa'i rkang par 'dres nus te/ lung dang rig pa'i gnas kun la mkhas pa'i skyes bu ni 'jig rten mig ces nyi ma ste nye3 'tshor ni mtshungs pa lta bu'am 'dra ba dang / bslab pa gsum ni tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ shes rab kyi bslab pa/ ting 'dzin gyi bslab pa dang gsum ldan pa'i skyes bu ni 'jig rten mig gi nyer 'tshor 'gyur zhes so//sha gshen bstan bshad sgrub gnyisaji kyi 'dzin sde dang /bon brgyad spangs pa'i bshes gnyen rjes rnams la'ang /gus blo snyems pa'i pad mo tsirtar zum/gus blo snyems pa'i pad mo tsirtar zum/zhes phyi ma gnyis brlas pa 'dis/ phul byung gi bla ma dang dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas par ston no//ra/ g.yu ral bsigs pa'i gdong lnga dang / 'dzom drug rgyas pa'i stag mo yang /nor 'dzin dga' ma'i pang la rtse/nor 'dzin dga' ma'i pang la rtse/rkang pa snga ma gsum ldan pa'i kun bsres zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang dang gnyis gsum ldab pa'i don/bzhi pa'i steng du 'dril ba ste/zhes rkang pa dang po dang / gnyis pa/ gsum pa bcas ldab cing / de rnams kun rkang pa bzhi pa'i don gyi mtshungs pa'am mtshon nus pa zhig la'o/

—5 99—gzhung las/ gshen bstan mdzes pa'i dpal du shar/gshen bstan mdzes pa'i dpal du shar/gshen bstan mdzes pa'i dpal du shar/rgyan drug gshen brgyad mkhas bzhi'o//zhes rkang pa snga ma gsum po gzugs gcig cing / phyi ma'i rkang par rim bzhin mtshon du yod pa ste/ gshen bstan mdzes byed ces gshen gyi bstan pa spel ba'i bdag nyid/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i rgyan drug dang / zhu ba'i gshen brgyad/ bod kyi mkhas pa mi bzhi bcas pa ste rgyan drug ni/ hu lu par ya/ dmu tsha tra he/ khri thog par tsa/ lha bdag sngags grol/ legs tang rmang po/ gser thog lce 'byams dang drug go/ zhu gshen brgyan ni/ gto bu 'bum sangs/ yid kyi khye'u chung / rma lo/ g.yu lo/ dpyad bu khri shes/ 'a zha gsang ba/ lung 'dren gsal ba/ rgyud 'dren sgron ma dang brgyad do//mkhas pa mi bzhi ni/ stong rgyung mthu chen/ sha ri dbu chen/ gyim tsha rma chung / lce tsha mkhar bu dang bzhi'o//sha bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag bslab gsum 'dzin skyongs spel/bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag bslab gsum 'dzin skyongs spel/bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag bslab gsum 'dzin skyongs spel/dam pa dgongs cha/dzod me ston yab sras zhabs/zhes snga ma gsum brlas pa 'dis ni/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rtsa ba bslab pa gsum la 'dzin skyongs gnang mkhan dam pa la bstod pa'o//ra/ so thar bslab pa'i lang tsho rdzogs/so thar bslab pa'i lang tsho rdzogs/so thar bslab pa'i lang tsho rdzogs/yongs 'dzin dam pa rnam bzhi'o//

—kyo00—rkang pa dang gnyis bzhi ldab pa'i kun tu zung rgyan ni/gzhung las/ gsum pa gang 'dad gzhan ldab pa/zhes rkang pa dang po gnyis pa bzhi pa bcas gzugs gcig par ston zhing / rkang pa gsum pa'i gzugs de gang 'dod la gsum po 'dren nus par ldan pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ bcu rig smra ba'i paṇa tri ta/bcu rig smra ba'i paṇa tri ta/rme'u ston rang ston sga ston yang /bcu rig smra ba'i paṇa tri ta/zhes tshig bcad dang po dang gnyis pa bzhi pa bcas kyi gzugs gcig cing de dag tsheg bcad gsum pa'i steng du mtshon du yod pa zhig ste/ rig gnas che ba lnga dang chung ba lnga bcas gnas bcu la byang du chub pa'i mkhas pa rme'u mkhas pa dpal chen dang / rong ston shes bya kun rig sga ston tshul khrims rgyal mtshan bcas tshang mar de ltar ldan pa'o//sha thog med mkha' 'gro'i lam gyi ngos la rgyu/thog med 'kha' 'gro'i lam gyi ngos la rgyu/de bzhin gshegs pa 'dab chags skabs gsum la /thog med mkha' 'gro'i lam gyi ngos la rgyu/zhes thog gnyis bzhi par brlas pa 'dis/ dam pa mchog ni nam mkha'i bya lam la rgyu bzhin par ston pa'o//ra/ 'gro kun0phan bde ster ba'i dpal/'gro kun phan bde ster ba'i dpal/ bla ma nyi ma pha ma yang /'gro kun phan bde ster ba'i dpal/

—kyo01 —rkang pa dang gsum bzhi ldab pa'i kun ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang dang gsum bzhi ldab pa'i don/ gnyis pa'i steng du 'dril ba ste/ zhes tshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa bzhi pa bcas kyi gzugs gcig cing / tshig rkang gnyis pa'i gzugs dang mi mtshungs kyang don gyis rim bzhin 'grel chogs pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ bde chen zhing la 'jug pa'i ngogs/spang lam bsgyur dang sgrol lam yang /bde chen zhing la 'jug pa'i ngogs/bde chen zhing la 'jug pa'i ngogs/zhes tshig rkang dang po bde chen zhing du 'jug pa'i ngogs zhes gsum pa dang bzhi pa bcas mtshungs pa'i don de rnams tshang ma rkang pa gnyis pa'i thog spang lam mdo dang bsgyur lam sngags/ sgrol lam bla med rdzogs pa chen po gsum la mtshon te/ thar pa thob byed kyi 'jugs ngogs sam lam de gsum la brten dgos so//sha gting mtha' mi mngon ches zab rgya khyon ya nga /rla ba'i ma ma lha la rgyal ba'i thugs/gting mtha' mi mngon ches zab rgya khu+on yang /gting mtha' mi mngon ches zab rgya khyon yang /zhes bla ma dam pa'i thugs ni mtha' gting tha dag dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'o zhes thugs rgya che ba'i don bstan pa'o//ra/ 'di phyi don gnyis sgrub pa'i grogs/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yang /'di phyi don gnyis sgrub pa'i grogs/

— 602 d+ngha'adi phyi don gnyis sgrub pa'i grogs/rkang pa gnyis gsum bzhi ldab pa ni/gzhung las/ rkang gnyis gsum bzhi ldab pa'i don/dang po'i steng du 'dril ba ste/zhes tshig rkang gnyis pa dang gsum pa bzhi pa bcas kyi gzugs gcig cing / de dag tshang ma tshig rkang dang po'i thog tu rim bzhin drol ba zhes 'brel ba dang de la khyad bon de ldan pa zhig ste/gzhung las/ yongs dag bsam legs klu grub gsum/zab lam sngags kyi gnyer dpon rje/zab lam sngags kyi gnyer dpon rje/zab lam sngags kyi gnyer dpon rje/zhes tshig rkang gnyis pa'i zab lam sngags kyi gnyer dpon rje lha gshen yongs su dag pa dang / rgyal gshen mi lus bsam legs/ kla grub ye shes snying po bcas te/ lha klu mi gsum gyi yul du zab lam sngags kyi gnyer dpon gsum por tshig rkang gsum gyi 'dres pa zhig go/sha phyi dar sprul sku gsum gyi rim pa bzhin/dpa' bo ḍak+ko'i myur lam thugs bcud lon/dpa' bo ḍak+ko'i myur lam thugs bcud lon/dpa' bo ḍak+ko'i myur lam thugs bcud lon/zhes phyi ma gsum baches pa phyi dar gyi gter ston gshen gyer rma gsum gyi khud bon no//ra/ khyung chen seng chen sgom chen yang /rgya gsum ral nas rtsal gsum rdzogs/rgya gsum ral nas rtsal gsum rdzogs/

—kyo03— rgya gsum ral nas rtsal gsum rdzogs/kong pa bzhi ldab kyi kun bsres zung ldan ni/ gzhung las/ tshig rkang rang skya thub pa zhigalan bzhi ldab smra byed pa ste/zhes rkang pa gcig la don tshang ba zhig snga phyi rkang pa bzhi kar gzugs gcig pa ston pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ grub mtha'i rgyal po g.yung drung bon/grub mtha'i rgyal po g.yung drung bon/grub mtha'i rgyal po g.yung drung bon/grub mtha'i rgyal po g.yung drung bon/ zhes tshig snga phyi tshang ma'i gzugs gcig cing / 'di'i brjod don ni/phyi nang gi grub mtha' mang na yang de yi nang nas mchog tu gyur ba'am gtso bo ni g.yung drung gi bon rin po che'o// sha theg chen phyag rdzogs dbu ma'i gsal byed migatheg chen phyab rdzogs dbu ma'i gsal byed migatheg chen phyag rdzogs dbu ma'i gsal byed migatheg chen phyag rdzogs dbu ma'i gsal byed migaces mdo sngags sems gsum gyi lta ba mthar thug ston pa'i rje bo ni nyi ma lta bu mtshon pa'o//ra/ bcu rig gter 'chang tshul rgyan pa/bcu rig gter 'chang tshul rgyan pa/bcu rig gter 'chang tshul rgyan pa/ bcu rig gter 'chang tshul rgyan pa/

—604—tshig bcad zung ldan kun bsres ni/gzhung las/ shad bar gzhi ldan sho la kazung gcig ldab pa tshig bcad de/tshig bcad gcig la rkang pa snga phyi ldab la sho lo ka snga ma ji bzhin ldab pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ phyi ltar yang dag khri gtsug rgyal/nang ltar ston mchog 'chi med gtsugagasang ba gdod ma'i mgon po ste/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gtso la 'dud/zhes tshig bcad dang po de nyid slar gzugs gcig par zlos pa'i rgyan 'di'i brjod don ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa rgyal ba gshen rab mi bo bstan pa'i gtso bo de nyid/ phyi 'dul ba ltar na ston pa khri gtsug rgyal ba dang / nang sngags kyi dbang du byas na ston pa 'chi med gtsug phud/ gsang ba bla med rdzogs chen ltar na gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po bcas kun gyi 'dus zhal ston pa gshen rab mi ba'o//sha rgyal ba'i rnam sprul bstan 'gro'i don la byon/thos bsam sgom gsum bshad sgrub srol bzang btsugalhar bcas skye dgu spyi dang skal ldan gyi/re gnas rnam 'dren dam pa gtan gyi skyabs/zhes rgyal ba'i dgongs rol dam pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'chad nyan sgom pa'i srol bzang btsug ste mthar thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar regs par byed po skyabs gnas bla ma la bstod pa'o//ra/ nyid sku mi g.yo bsil ri bzhin du brjid/ rmad byung lang tsho nyid 'od bzhin du gsal/

—kyo05—'phrin las zad med nyal 'gro'i rtul zhugasaske'achang /tshangs sras gzhon nu ma de lan brgyar bstod/zung ldan che ba ni/gzhung las/ rang skya thub pa'i tsheg rkang gcigalan brgyad bskyar ba zung ldan che/zhes tshig rkang gcig kho na len brgyad ldab cing tshig rkang de yang brjod don phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod pa la'o//bzhung las/ sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgya sa/sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/zhesatshig bcad gcig pa len brgyad rlos shing / smon tshig brjod don phun sum tshogs pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas na sems can gyi bde skyid zhor la 'byung ba'o//sha skad gnyis smra dbang skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang /skad gnyis smra dbang skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang /skad gnyis smra dbang skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang /skad gnyis smra dbang skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang /zhes skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po lo paṇa rnams la bstod pa'o//

—kyo0khyo—ra/ 'khor 'das bon kun sems nyid ngang /'khor 'das bon kun sems nyid ngang /'khor 'das bon kun sems nyid ngang /'khor 'das bon kun sems nyid ngang /'khor 'das bon kun sems nyid klong /'khor 'das bon kun sems nyid klong /'khor 'das bon kun sems nyid klong /'khor 'das bon kun sems nyid klong /zhes kun tu bsres pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan rdzogs so// gzhan 'dis mtshon nas rang gis rig pas dpog par bya'o//

—kyo07—'dres pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan ni/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ sgra rgyan nges med sna tshogs pa/ dzo 'dres pa 'dres pa'i zung ldan te/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ sgra rgyan nang tshan bcu gnyis po de dag nges pamed par phan tshun 'dres pa'am bsres pa'i zung ldan te/ 'di la sho lo ka gcig bsres pa la zung ldan grangs mang tshang pa tshig 'dres sogs sna tshogs ldan pa zhig la'o//dbye na gsum ste/ 'dres pa'i zung ldan dang / grangs 'dzin gyi zung ldan/ zur rgyan gyi zung ldan dang gsum mo// 'dres pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ zung ldan gcig tu ma nges pa/sna tshogs 'dres pa 'dres zung ste/zhes tshig bcad gcig la thog mtha' dbus sogs gcig tu ma nges pa sna tshogs ldan pa'i rgyan zhig la'o//gzhung las/ dkar dkar dge la la mor spyod/spyod pa zab zab tshul mdzes mdzes/'ol 'ol sob sob med pa ru/bsrung na thar dang thar chen thob/ces rkang pa snga phyi thog dbus dang dbus mtha' sogs sna tshogs 'dus pa'i 'di'i brjod don ni/ yang dag pa'i dge ba la brtson 'dod rnams 'jig rten gyi mi ngo bsrung ba tsam ma yin par/ phyi tshul nang khrims

—608—gnyis ka zung dang ldan par bsrung na thar pa tsam dang thar pa chen po thob par 'gyur ro zhes so//ra/ yang yang la lung lung par 'grim/gnas mang zab zab sbyang 'dod 'dod/mang mang ngal ngal myang na yang /gdam par gyur na 'bad kyang ci/grangs 'dzin gyi zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang gnas grangs rim rkang dod dam/bskor nas spras pa grangs tshig rgyan/rkang pa snga phyi zung ldan grangs kyi rnam dbye rim bzhin thog dbus mtha' gsum ci rigs kyi bsgrod pa'am yang na/ grangs zlos pa sogs gang rung ston pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ rje gcig sku gnyis mkhyen gsum ldan/las bzhi spyan lnga rtsal drug dang /nor bdun thar brgyad dbyings dgu'i mdzod/stobs bcu 'bras rtags bcu gcig rdzogs/ —zhes grangs gcig gnyis gsum nas bcu gcig par rkyang 'ded byas pa ma zad/ bajid don rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku yi che ba'i yon tan rnams dang mtshon te sbyar ba'o//ra/ rje gcig gsang mchog yab yum gnyis/gsang gsum sgo bzhi mdzod lnga'i bon/phyin drug nor bdun khamar+sā brgyad bcas/theg dgu'i bon bstan phyogs med spros/ /

—609—spyo 'dres zung gi zur rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rkang gnas gang rigs brjod 'dod sgras/'bru gzhon byed pa zur rgyan te/rkang pa so so'i gnas thog mtha' gang rigs la rang gi brjod 'dod kyi sgra de nyid bkod nas tshig 'grel byed pa lta bu ste tshig 'bru de dag snga phyi 'brel chags pa zhig la go/gzhung las/ bon sde mu med mkhyen pas mu/bskal pa'i cho rab ston pas cho/dung gi ldem shing rnam pas ldem/mngon shes rtsal drug rdzogs pas drugaces rgyal tshab mu cho ldem drug gi mtshan don la 'grel ba btabs pa mdo gzer mig nang bzhin drang ba'o/ /sha mdzes mdzes bzhin ras rab mdzes dgyes pas 'dzum/'dzum 'dzum zhal sgo rab mdzes tshems phreng dkar/dkar dkar sku mdog rab mdzes mnyen snrag ldem/ldem ldem 'gying bag rab mdzes tshangs sras ma/zhes 'dres pa'i zung ldan gyi rgyan 'dis/ lha mo sgra dbyangs rgya'akhamo'i sku'i rnam dpyod rnams brjod pa'o//ra/ shes bya'i gnas kun mkhyen pas shes/rab byung chas can rdzags pas rab/nyon mongs bdud las rgyal bas rgyal/mtshan bzang dpe byed 'dzoms pas mtshan/zhes 'dis mtshon nas zung ldan gyi rgyan ji snyed zhig blos dpog par bya'o// zung ldan rgyan rdzogs so//

—6 1 0—ldog pa'i zang ldan rgyan ni/༄mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ tshig bcad lugs 'byung lugs ldog gis/brda don 'phrod pa ldog zung ste/zhes mtshan nyid ston te tshig bcad gcig gi rkang pa snga phyi rnam cha tshang nam phyad ci rigs rim bzhin lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog tu klog tu yod cing don ma nor bar nus pa zhig la'o// dbye na dbus ldog gcig ldog phyed ldog tshig bcad rang ldog dang bzhi'o//dbus ldog gi zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang phyed lugs 'byung phyed lugs ldogabarjod don 'phrod pa dbus ldog ste/zhes rkang pa bzhi po so so'i 'go mjug gnyis nas yar mar phyed klog pas don gcig tu go ru yod pa dang / lugs 'byung lugs ldog gang du klog kyang klog gtub pa zhig ste/gzhung las gshen rab mi bo mi rab gshen/bstan pa rnam gsum rnam pa bstan/khams gsum rigs drug rigs gsum khams/bde chen dbyings drangs dbyings chen bde/zhes rkang pa dang po gshen rab mi bo/ gnyis pa bstan pa rnam gsum/gsum pa khams gsum rigs drug bzhi pa bde chen dbyings drangs zhes

—kyo1 1 —yaramar phyed phyed ldog pa 'dis/ ston pas sku gsung thugs kyi bstan pas khams gsum sems can rnams thar par 'dren par 'gyur zhes so//sha skyabs mchog mkhas btsun rje btsun mkhas mchog skyabs/rgyal kun rnam rol gar rol rnam kun rgyal/rtsod ldan mkhyen ldan rab yangs mkhyen ldan rtsod/mnyam med bla ma nyi ma bla med mnyam/zhes ldog zung 'di yi brjod don rgyal ba gnyis pa rje mnyam med chen po'i mkhyen dpyod rnams so//ra/ shes rab rgyal mtshan rgyal rab shes/bon bstan kun spel kun bstan bon/mdo sngags zung 'brel zung sngags mdo/bstan 'gror rjes bzhag rjes 'gror bstan/gcig ldog ni/gzhung las/ rkang pa re re 'byung ldog gnyis/brjod don 'phrod pa gcig ldog ste/zhes rkang pa re re bzhin snga phyi lugs 'byung ldog tu klog tu yod cing don ma nor bar ston nus pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ slob pa thos na bsam mchog mkhas/mkhas mchog bsam na thos pa slob/bsrung khrims gtsang spyod rnam dag yang /yang dag rnam spyod gtsang khrims bsrung /zhes rkang pa dang po slob pa thos na bsam mchog mkhas zhes dang / bsrung khrims gtsang spyed rnam dag yang / zhes de gnyis rang gi rkang pa phyi mar ldog ste smos zhing don 'khral med du ston nus pa ste/ slob dpon dam pa

—kyo1 2—la bstan nas thos bsam gyi don la brtson pa ma zad/ bsrung khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung na yang dag pa'i lam la 'khod par ston pa'o//sha dkar mdzes mdangs ldan rab gsal blo ldan rgyan/rgyan ldan blo gsal rab ldan mdangs mdzes dkar/gsung mchog tshangs dbyangs snyan sgrog ngag daspung lha/lha dbang ngag sgrog snyan dbyangs tshangs mchog gsung / zhes dbyangs can lha mo'i mdangs mdzes pa gsung snyan pa sogs la sbyar te brjod pa'i rkang pa gcig ldog gi rgyan gyi dper brjod do//ra/ mdo sngags theg chen 'phrul ngag bon/bon ngag 'phrul chen theg sngags mdo/thos sgom bsam sbyor gus phyag 'bul/'bul phyag gus sbyor bsam sgom thos/phyed ldog gi zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ rkang gnyis lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu/brjod don 'phrod la phyed ldog ste/zhes rkang pa bzhi po'i snga gnyis lugs 'byung dang phyi ma gnyis snga ma'i gzugs rnams lugs ldog tu bkod pa zhig la brjod don ston nus pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ rje btsun mkhas pa'i legs byas gang /dar zhing rgyas la yul ring gnas/gnas ring yun la rgyas zhing dar/gang byas legs pa'i mkhas btsun rje/zhes rkang pa dang po dang gsum gnyis lugs 'byung ldog dang de bzhin gnyis pa dang bzhi pa gnyis lugs 'byung ldog tu ston pa ste/ rkang pa gnyis

—kyo13—ri gyirgyal ba'i bstan pa rnams legs pa'i yon tan kun/ dar zhing rgyas pa'i smon tshig dang / phyi ma gnyis kyi de nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i skyes bu dam pa sku tshe gegs med yun ring du gnas par smon pa bcas so//ra/ ljongs can gangs yul bon skyi rgyal/glu bstan gnas mchog gangs ri mtsho/rgyal gyi bon yul gangs can lngongs/mtsho ri gangs mchog gnas bstan rgyal/tshig bcad ldog pa'i zung ldan ni/gzhung las/ kho bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu/ badzod don 'phrod pa tshig bcad ldogaces rkang pa bzhi ka ldog pa zhes/ tshig bcad snga ma rnams phyi ma rim — bzhin 'jug nas ldog par ston pa'i rgyan zhig ste/ sto gzhung las/ snga rabs lha rabs gshen rabs bon/mdo sde 'bum sde rgyud sde mdzod/'chad dang rtsod dang rtsom dang bsgrub/rgyal mchog bstan 'di dar zhing smin/smin zhing dar 'di bstan mchog rgyal/bsgrub dang rtsod dang rtsom dang 'chad/mdzod sde rgyud sde 'bum sde mdo/bon rabs gshen rabs lha rabs snga/zhes tshig bcad dang po'i rkang pa snga rabs zhes pa tshig bcad phyi ma'i rkang pa tha ma bon rabs zhes rim bzhin lugs ldog tu bkod pa 'dis gshen rabs rnams kyis sngarabs kyi gsang gi bon rin po che 'chad pa ci ༄ ༵

—61 4—dang rtsod pa rtsom pa sgrub pa gsum gyi sgo nas lho gling 'dir dar zhing rgyas so phyi ma rigs 'gres su shes par bya'o//ra/ bod yul rgya yul sog yul 'jang /snga dar bar dar phyi dar bon/lha gshen mi gshen klu gshen gyer/bsngags mchog 'dzin pa dam par bstod/'jang yul sog yul rgya yul bod/bon dar phyi dar bar dar pagyer gshen klu gshen mi gshen lha/bstod par dam pa 'dzin mchog sngags/'di ni mtshan gzhi tsam las ji snyed cig rang gi blos dpog par bya'o//sgra rgyan gyi nang tshan zung ldan gyi dbye ba bcu gcig po'i dper brjod sngar bzhin las/ de dag so so'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs tsam la rgyas par yig tshogs 'jigs phyir ma spros pas/ mtshan gzhi de dag la brtags nas rang gis dpog par mdzod ces zung ldan gyi rgyan rdzogs so//

— kyo1 5—sgra rgyan gyi nang tshan gnyis pa bya dka'i rgyan/tsho mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i dorme no//gzhung las/ gang zhig sgra mthun tshig gi mtshams/sbyor bar dka' ba bya dka' ste/ ri zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ re'u mig gi nang du sho lo ka re sgra mthun nam g.yas g.yon gzugs mi 'dra ba 'khor ba'i tshig gi mtshams yas mar 'khyog phyogs su 'gro ba sogs snga ma las bya ba shin tu dka' ba zhig la bya dka'i re'u mig sogs gzugs mtshungs zung ldan las sbyor ba dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis bya dka' zhes so//dbye na/ 'khyogs 'gro phyed 'khor/ kun 'khor/ dbyangs kyi bya — dka'/ skye gnas kyi bya dka'/ gsal byed kyi bya dka' dang drug go/'khyog 'gro'i bya dka' yi re'u mig ni/gzhung las/ gong 'og spel dang drang por bklagagazugs gcig 'byung ba 'khyog 'gro ste/zhes re'u mig gong 'og gnyis kyi dbang du byas na/ steng 'og gnyis yas mas bsnol nas klog pa dang / dkyus su klob/ pa gnyis gzugs cha/tshungs pa dang / rkang pa gnyis pa dkyus su bklag pa 'khyog nas bklag pa gnyis gzugs mtshungs pa lta bu zhig go/gzugs gcig zung mthun ni/skokhā+egazhung las/ yig gzugs zung mthun gong 'og ṣ+pel/r+ṣak+ṣa drang bklag gzugs gcig zung mthun te/

—620—dbyangs kyi bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ tshig rkang re re'i ming gzhi'i srogadabyangs res khyab rigs dbyangs nges te/zhes rkang pa bzhi ldan gyi sho lo ka la rkang pa re re bzhin gyi ming gzhi srog la dbyangs re nges par yod pa ma zad rkang pa re re la dbyangs nang nas gcig nges par cha mnyam du yod pa zhig gam sho lo ka re rer ming gzhi srog dbyangs a i e o u bzhi po gcig gnyis sogs ci rigs ldan zhing de dag gang byung du ma yin pa rkang pa so sor kho nar nges pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ rkang tshan rnam bzhi'i ming gzhi'i srogadabyangs res khyab pa bzhi ldan te/zhes dbyangs a i khru e o lnga rim bzhin nges pa'i bya dka' ba'i rgyan te/gzhung las/ thams cad ka dag khyab bdal ngang /srid zhi mi dmigs dbyings rig 'dril/dus gsum lugs kun 'ubs su chud/skye med bde chen ye shes che/zhes rkang pa bzhi ka la ldan pa ste/ rkang pa dang po la dbyangs a kho na ldan zhing / gnyis pa la i dang / gsum pa la u/ bzhi pa e bcas ldan pa'i rgyan 'dis/ spyir shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs sam bla med rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba'i khyad bon ji bzhin baji+od pa'o//sha dge legs gter chen bder gshegs ye shes te/g.yung drung sku gsung thugs gsum dus kun tu/

—kyo21 —ting 'dzin yid kyis dmigs shing zhing 'di yis/mchod do bstod do dgos 'dod blo gros stsol/zhes dbyangs bzhi ka nges pa'i rgyan 'dis skyabs gnas mchog gsum la mchod bstod 'bul ba'i don no//ra/ thams cad las can mngal nas bkram/mi yi srid pa'i gling gi gshis/rgyu lus gzugs phung dug gsum rgyu/bde chen ye shes skye med che/de la dbye na/ dbyangs gsal gsum nges pa'i bya dka'/ dbyangs gsal gnyis nges pa'i bya dka'/ dbyangs gsal gcig nges pa'i bya dka'/dbyangs gsal bzhi nges pa'i bya dka' dang bzhi'o//dbyangs gsal gsum nges pa'i bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ rkang tshan rnam bzhi'i ming gzhi'i srogadabyangs gsum nges pa gsum ldan te/zhes rkang pa bzhi po la dbyangs gsum kho nar nges pa'i bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ gī gī di ring nyi khyim 'dir/mchod do gsol lo bon skyong tshogs/dge legs gter chen dgyes bzhes te/dgos 'dod dngos po yod cog stsal/zhes dbyangs i dang o e bcas nges pa'i rgyan 'dis/ lha dang srung ne ma la mchod cing bstod nas rang la gang 'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol zhes bskul ba'o//sha lo ga rtog nyon mongs dngos po yongs 'joms blos/ ma dag las ngan bya ba gtan spangs nas/

—622—g.yung drung mthu nus rdzu 'phrul kun 'byung yul/dkon mchog gtso bor mchod do 'gro don mdzod/ces dbyangs o a u gsum ldan bya dka'i sgra rgyan 'dis skyabs gnas gsum la gsol ba 'debs te/ mar la 'gro kun skyobs pa'i re bskul zhu ba'i don no//ra/ 'di ni mi 'jig srid zhi dbyings/sgom gom tshogs rdzogs bon mchog po/skye med bde chen ye shes zer/don rtogs smon don dgos 'dod shogadabyangs gnyis nges pa'i bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ rkang tshan rnam bzhi'i ming gzhi'i srogadabyangs gnyis nges pa gnyis ldan te/zhes rkang pa bzhi po kun dbyangs gnyis kho nar nges pa ni/gzhung las/ dus su g.yu 'brug 'u ru ru/chim chim sprin zil si li li/khu smyag g.yu bun thu lu lu/rtsi shing smin 'grib nyi li li/zhes dbyangs yig i dang u gnyis kho nar nges pa'i bya dka' 'dis/dpyid dus kyi rang bzhin nam khyad bon brjod pa'o//sha kho bos bon 'khor yongs bskor tshogs gtor gtong /bde chen nges legs ye shes ches cher spel/theg chen bder gshegs mkhyen brtse bde legs ster/mgon pos dmod mo byol zor bzlog mdzod gsol/zhes dbyangs o e gnyis kho nar nges pa'i bya dka'i sgra rgyan no//

— 62 3 —rdzi ra/ mdzes mdzes me lce ye re re/ne rgyu mthun dud khun thu lu lu/snyi mer mer gser zer ber re re/zhazug zhazug bakhu1na khya garag zhazug zhazug/ri ༄ 4༄ thā 4༄ ༄ ༄ spe༄shā shetsho dbyangs gcag ngas pa' bya dka' na/t+t+waṃ lke dazhung las/ rkang tshan rnam bzhi'i ming gzhi'i srog7 dbyangs res khyab pa gcig nges te/ci rkang pa bzhi kar dbyangs gcig kho nar nges pa'i rgyan ni/ ṭ+wā ༷gzhung las/ bskal bzang bya ba gang la yang /cho lhag bsam rnam par dag pa na/ wadzi sa sngar bsags las dang bag chags rnams/ g.ya' bral nam mkha' dwangs ltar 'dag / ces rkang pa bzhi kar a kho na'i dbyangs gsal gyis nges pa la 'dis/rto bya ba gang la zhugs na yang rang bas gzhan gces pa'i sgo nas bsam pa smye/ rtebazang po gser lta bu bskyed nas/ dkar po dge ba'i las la zhugs na dus ṣ+ṭi cigasum du bsags pa'i bag chags khrig sgrib kun dag par 'gyur zhes so// ngh+ru sha skyabs gnas dam pa rgyal ba 'phags pa dang / rmye dad pas lha phyag lan grangs’brgyar bstsal nas/gzhan la phan snyams lhag bsam dang ldan pas/rnam dkar rla snang la 'gran yang dag 'bad/sto ces dbyangs a gcig pu nges pa'i bya dka'i sgra rgyan 'dis yar tsho bas gnas la dad pa dang mar 'gro drugal snying rje ldan pas rnam dkar gyi la// ge la 'bad dgos pa'o//
— 624—ra/ gsang ba yang gsang gsang bdag pa/rgyal sras dam pa 'phags pa gnas/rang cag dad ldan thams cad la/sangs rgyas sa la btsan thabs drangs/

—625—skye gnas kyi bya dka'i rgyan ni/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ rkang tshan re re'i ming gzhi rnams/skye gnas res khyab skye gnas nges/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ sgra yi skye gnas zhes pa ni 'phrul gyi yi ge bzhi bcu po de dag skye gnas brgyad du dbye ba la 'byed— dgos te/ skye gnas brgyad ni spyi bo mgrin pa rkan lce mchu sna so khog pa dang brgyad do// rang lugs la rkang pa so so'i nang gi ming gzhi skye gnas gcig kho nangari nges pa zhig dgos la/ tshig bcad re re'i ming gzhi la skye gnas gnyis gsum ci rigs nges par ston pa'i rgyan zhig la'o//dbye na bzhi ste/ skye gnas bzhi nges pa'i bya dka'/ skye gnas gsum nges pa'i bya dka'/ skye gnas gnyis nges pa'i bya dka'/ skye gnas gcig nges pa'i bya dka' 'o//skye gnas bzhi nges pa'i bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ rkang tshan bzhi pazhi ming gzhi rnams/skye gnas bzhis khyab bzhi ldan te/zhes rkang pa bzhi ka'i ming gzhi la gang gi skye gnas brgyad po'i nang gi skye gnas bzhi kho nar nges pa zhig go/gzhung las/ gangs khrod kha lngas skad sgrogs skabs/nye gcan bcol chung 'chi char chas/mdangs ldan na dar 'dab gdugs bsdu/dbyar 'brug spur mo bye ma'i phag

—626— dzezhes rkang pa dang po ming gzhi rnams mgrin skyes dang / rkang pa gnyis pa rkan skyes/ gsum pa lce skyes/ bzhi pa mchu skyes bcas rkang pa re re'i ming gzhi la skye gnas re nges pa ste/ 'dis gangs gi seng ges ngar skad sgrog pa'i tshe ri dwags gzhan rnams dbang du bsdu ba ma zad/ me zhag can gyi mokha' la 'phur ba'i g.yu 'brug kyang bye ma'i nang du yib par 'gyur zhes thag//sha dbal me dmar po 'bar ba'i pho brang dbus/gtum drab/ nus mthu gdon 'dre dam btags 'dul/dgra bgeges klad 'gems khro rgyal mkha' 'gyingaltar/mnyes mchod ja chang ji snyed chabs cig mchod/zhes rkang pa dang po mchu/ gnyis pa lce/ gsum pa mgrin/ bzhi pa rkan la skyes pa'i bzhi ldan gyi rgyan 'dis khro bo gtso mchog mkha' 'gying la bstod pa'i bya dka'i sgra rgyan no//ra/ srid gsum sa gsum sa lerne gas la/rgyal khams kun dga'i 'khor gyi bskor/'bad 'bung bya byed spros pa bral/mthar thugs don rtags gnad du thebs/skye gnas gsum nges pa'i bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ rkang tshan sde bzhi'i ming gzhi rnams/skye gnas gsum nges gsum ldan te/zhes sho lo ka gocig gi ming gzhi kun sgra yi skye gnas gsum kho nar nges pa'o//gzhung las/ gtsang mdzes btsun tshul gtsor 'dzin tshogs/zhal zas yid 'ong rla bzhin gzhon/

—62 7—rang rig gshis lugs rang la shar/lung rig slob bshad sa le gsal/zhes rkang pa dang po sna skyes dang / gnyis pa so skyes dang / gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis spyi bor skyes pa bcas phyi tshul dang nang khrims zung du 'brel ba'i btsun pa rnams ji srid bar du rgyal ba'i bka' lung la thos bsam sgom gsum dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum byed pa'i sgor zhugs na shin tu bzang ngo zhes so//sha 'khon 'gras skyo sngogs kun ka'o rgyu kun bsgyur/zhal bzang bla bzhin yid gzhung gzhung yang bzang /dbul phong sprang por sbyin pa dpag med sprel/skye rgu'i skyon skyob sgom sgrub skyabs 'gro skyor/zhes rkang pa dang po mgrin dang / rim bzhin so mchu mgrin bcas la skyes pa'i yig gzugs gnas pa'i bya dka'i/ sgra rgyan no//ra/ spyod 'phrul 'bad med sbyor ba'i dpal mo'i dbang /rgyal khams kun gyi bka' 'khor kun dga'i rgyan/phan byed ma mo'i 'phrul mo mi 'bral bar/gtan bdes mthar thugs don rnams bde gter thob/skye gnas gnyis nges pa'i bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ rkang tshan sde bzhi'i ming gzhi rnams/skye gnas gnyis nges gnyis ldan te/zhes sho lo ka gcig gi ming gzhi rnams skye gnas gnyis kho nar nges pa ste/ rkang pa gnyis gnyis mtshungs pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ 'gro mgon rgyal gyi bka' 'khor gang /mthong thos blta rtogs don ldan rnams/

— 628—mthu dang nus stobs mthar thon te/kun khyab klong lnga mngon gyur grol/zhes rkang pa dang po dang phyi ma gnyis mgrin skyes dang / bar ma gnyis lce skyes kyi bya dka' 'dis/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i bka' 'khor thog mtha' bar gsum la 'bad pa'i skyes bu dam pa ni grub pa mthar thugs nas sku lnga'i 'bras bu smin par 'gyur zhes so//sha rmad 'byung spobs pas blun po'i rmongs mun phyagaspros bral daspus phyin spang blang bye brag byed/sgom sgrub rgyal bskyed skye 'gro kun kyang bkol/kun rmekhyen mkhas grub skye dgu'i mgon khyong/ rgyal/zhes rkang pa dang po ni skye gnas mchu dang / rim bzhin mchu mgrin mgron bcas kyi skyes gnas nges pa 'phags pa dam pa'i khyad bon dang sbyar te badzod pa'i bya dka'i sgra rgyan no//ra/ 'bad med dpyid dpal sprin dpung 'phel/kun dga'i 'gyur khug mgrin blu sgrogakye kye 'grogs dga'i grogs kyi khyu/'phang med 'byor ba dpung bar brel/skye gnas gcig nges pa'i bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ rkang tshan sde bzhi'i ming gzhi rnams/skye gnas res khyab gcig ldan te/zhes rkang pa bzhi ka'i ming gzhi la sgra'i skye gnas gcig kho nar nges par ga/ gzhung las/ 'phrul bon sbyang pa phul phyin pa'i/smra ba'i dbang po dbu ma bas/
