—629—blos byas ma spang mi dmigs par/dbyer med spros bral bde ba myong / zhes rkang pa bzhi kar mchu las skyes pa'i ming gzhi kho nar nges shing 'asdo'i brjod bya ni/ mdo phar phyin theg pa'i lam la zhugs pa'i skyes bu dam pas bon thams cad blos bzhag par rtogs pa dang bon thams cad spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral bar rtogs nas mthar myang 'das chen po thob ces so//sha gyer sgo kun mkhyen rgyal kun bka' dgongs skyong /mgrin skyes glu sgras kun dga'i 'gyur khugs kun/sngon sgoms mkhas grub kun kyang dgyes bskyed ngang /kun gyi mgon 'gyur 'gro mgon kun grol grags/zhes mgrin pa kho nar nges pa lnga snyi/gas sprul sku rnam bzhi'i nang tshan kun grol grags pa zha bstod pa'i bya dka'i sgra rgyan no// ra/ gyer gyi skad dgu sgrogs mkhas 'ga'/khams kun skye rgu kun ka dgyes/mkhas mkhas kha lnga'i ngar skad kyis/mkha' rgyu'i glog 'gyur kun ka skragaces skye gnas kyi bya dka'i rgyan 'dis mtshon gzhan kun dzi snyed cig rig pas 'phrul/

—630— —gsal byed kyi bya dka'i rgyan ne/mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung 'a sa/ rkang tshan re re'i ming gzhi rnams/gsal byed res khyab gsal byed nges/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang pa bzhi po'i ming gzhi la gsal byed sum cu'i nang gi rkang pa re re'i ming gzhi gcig kho nas khyab cing / tshigs su bcad pa rer ming gzhi bzhi 'am gsum gnyis gcig sogs ci rigs ldan pa zhig la'o//dbye na bzhi ste/ gsal byed bzhi ldan dang / gsum ldan dang / gnyis ldan dang / gcig ldan gyi bya dka' dang bcas so//gsal byed bzhi ldan gyi bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ rkang tshan sde bzhi'i ming gzhi rnams/gsal byed bzhis khyab bzhi ldan te/zhes tshig bcad gcig gi dbang du byas nas ming gzhi thams cad gsal byed sum cu'i nang nas bzhi kho nar nges pa'o// gzhung las/ skyid skabs bka' kun kyur kyur bklagakhral khrims khur 'khri khong 'khrug khro/gyer gyi dgon grwa dgag sgrub sgra/dngom dngags rngam rngam mngon mnga' nges/zhes gsal byed ka kha ga nga bzhi nges pa'i rgyan 'dis/ rgyal ba'i bka' la thos bsam sgom gsum byas nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgra chen bsgrags zhes so//

—63 1 —sha 'gro mgon dga' sgrub bgrod gling sgom bgyid sgrub/dus drug don ldan mdo sde mdor bsdus 'don/kyal ka klan ka kun skyung dkrongs bskyed skyong /'bras bu 'byung ba'i dbang byin bya bas brel/zhes pa ni bla ma dam pa'i rnam dpyod las sbyar ba'i ka ga da ba bzhi'i ming gzhi gsal byed nges pa'i sgra rgyan no//ra/ ka kor kang keng rkang kyog kye/kha khog khong khong 'khyog 'khyor khyed/ga gus gum gung gang gis rgyu/ rngam rngam ngam ngam brngan dngos ngom/gsal byed sum ldan gyi bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ rkang tshan sde bzhi'i ming gzhi kun/gsal byed gsum khyab sum ldan te/tshig bcad gcig gi ming gzhi kun gsal byed sum cu'i nang nas gsum kho nas khyab pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ dad ldan bdag dang bdag 'dra'i sde/dug 'dul bden don bdog 'dod du/rtag tu ston bstan tog ltar bsti/thabs thugs mthun mthus mthar thug 'thab/ces gsal byed da dang ta tha gsum kho nar nges pa'i rgyan 'dis/mos 'dun can gyi gang zag rnams kyis dus kun la rgyal ba'i bstan pa rnam gsum la gtsug tu 'khur nas 'jug sgo ma nor spyod na mthar sangs rgyas kyi sa non pa'o//

—63 2—sha sku skyes skyon kun bskrad kung bka' kun bklagam smad mang mod mor mor dmod mi med/rang re'i rigs rus rab red ri rab dang /myag myog sma smi dmigs pa mongs su rmad/ces pa ni dam pas spang blang gi don bstan tshul dang 'brel ba'i ka ma ra gsum gyi ming gzhi gsal byed nges pa'i sgra rgyan ni/ra/ ca cor gcen gcung ca co can/gcug gcug cer cer cag cag ci/che chung chachuraches cher chags/nyal nyu nyin nyal gnyid nyob nyob/gsal byed gnyis ldan gyi bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ rkang tshan sde bzhi'i ming gzhi kun/gsal byed gnyis nges nyis ldan te/zhes tshig bcad gcig gi ming gzhi rnams gsal byed sum cu'i nang gi gnyis kho nar nges pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ la la lung log lam la logal la le lo'i las la lus/rang rig ras rim rab rib re/rig rung rang re rab rang red/ces gsal byed la dang ra gnyis kho nar nges pa'i rgyan 'dis deng dus kyi dge sbyor phal cher ni yang dag pa'i bla med rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba la rlom ste/ zhi gnas tsam la dus 'dab ba ma ma zad/ 'ga' ni don med la 'khyams nas le lot+t+waṃ dbang du shor ba sogs la gzhigs na/ rang rig ye shes kyi don phyogs tsam mthong mkhan ni dge sbyor ba rab red ces so//

—633—sha mgrin blu mgur gyi gros gling dga' mgu'i rgyu/rgyud grol dge sgrub dge rgan dgon gyi rgyan/dam ldan bdag 'dra don ldog 'di don dor/don dam mdo sde'i drung du bdag 'dud do//zhes bder gshegs mchod pa'i zhing la bstod pa'i ga dang da gnyis kyi ming gzhi gsal byed kho nar nges pa'i bya dka' ba'i sgra rgyan no//ra/ gtan gtan tig tig gtam btang ste/tar tar blta ston btong ste bstan/mthar thugs thabs thugs 'thob thang thob/riri 'thum 'thum 'thom thal thod thog thobs/gsal byed gcig ldan gyi bya dka' ni/gzhung las/ rkang tshan sde bzhi'i ming gzhi rnams/ gsal byed res khyab gcig ldan te/zhes tshig bcad gcig gi ming gzhi kun gsal byed gcig kho nar nges pa zhig ste/gzhung las/ dbal bon dbyangs dbyugs dbang byin dbab/dbus bum dbur blangs bon dbang dbogabu blo'i bag byang bogs 'bum 'bar/bon dbyings 'bras bur breng breng brod/ces gsal byed ba kho nar nges pa'i sho lo ka 'dis/ dpon gsas bla ma dam pas slob bu la dbang bskur bas/ slob bu'i shes rgyud bkral nas yang dag sa non pa'o zhes so//sha bdag mdun mdangs ldan gdan 'ding der bsdad de/dug 'dam 'dren dang 'dre gdon 'dul don du/

—kyo34—dal dus mdo sde 'don dang don dam der/dad 'dun dos drag des 'dud mdun du bdar/zhes dge la dad pa dang mos pa sogs bcas 'jug tshul bstan pa'i gsal byed da kho na'i ming gzhi nges pa'i bya dka'i sgra rgyan no//ra sa sa sociso'i sems so so/so sos su bsam sems su gsal/gsal gsal so so sems so srung /srog bslus bsrel bsam bslab sems srungs/smras pa/ snyan 'jebs skad 'gyur so so'i bon/thun min mkhas pa'i zhal snga ru/cung zad 'grul ba'i rnam dpyod 'ga'/gsang por smra 'di ci dgar spyod/'grig 'grig 'phrul gyi tho yig bzhi bcu'i tshal/mdzes mdzes sgra rtsol rnam 'gyur ze'u 'bru 'bum/gzhon gzhon bung ba dga' ba mgrin pa'i glu/stsan snyan rnam par sgrogs pa dam pa'i gshis/zhes 'dis mtshon nas bya dka' ba'i rgyan ji snyed rig pas 'phrul kyang rung ngo // skabs 'dir yig tshogs 'jigaraske phyir sgra rgyan so so'i rtsa ba'i mtshan gzhi dang rnam grangs tsam las rgyas bshad byas med pas/ blo ldan rnams kyis dpog par bya'o// zhes snyan ngag gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las sgra rgyan gyis rab tu byed pa ste gnyis pa'o//

— 635—le'u gsum pa gab tshig rgyan la/yid 'ong mtshan dpe'i cha shas ston kha'i che/dgyes pa'i 'dzum rlab 'bum phrag g.yo ba'i gzi/skal bzang yid kyi kun d+ngha bzhad pa'i gnyan/er sangs sgra dbyangs lha mos skyongs shig kyi/zhes bstod tshig me tog chun pos mdun nas bsus te/ skabs 'dir bshad par bya ba ni/ thun mongs rgyan gyi nang tshan gsum pa gab tshig rgyan la/ mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ don gyi khyad par tshig skyobs kyi/phag tu ṣ+ped pa gab tshig ste/zhes gab tshig gi rgyan gyi don bstan te/ skabs 'dir gab ces pa ni/rang gi gang 'ardod pa'i brjod bya'am brjod don gtso bo de nyid kyi ngo bo dang khyad par de kun gyi thun mong da gsong por mi smra ba'am/ kun gyis spyod yul du gyur mi thub par/ tshig sbyor gzhan sgrib byed du bkod de/ brjod don tshig de dag gi phag tu yib par byas te/ sbyor tshul gyi sgo nas gzhan la rmyongs par byas nas badzod bya thad kar rtogs mi nus shing rnam dpyod dang shes rab kyis don rtogs dgos pa ste/ rgyan 'di la brten nas mkhas blun gyi khyad par 'byed pa la shaṃn tu gal chen du brtsis kyang rung bar 'gyur ro//dper na/ khyed nyid yid la 'char ba'i las dbang gis/'khyug ldem myug gus sor mo'i grogs bstsal nas/dkar mjam yid 'ong rgya shog 'gram ngos su/las dbang ri mo 'bri bar brel zhing rgyu/ zhes pa lta bu'o//

—63 6—dbye ba so so'i don ni/ kun tshogs kyi gab tshig rgyan/ bslu byed kyi gab tshig rgyan-i/ rim bral gyi gab tshig rgyan/ rab bcom gyi gab tshig rgyan/mthuno gzugs kyi gab tshig rgyan/ rtsub mo'i gab tshig rgyan/ grangs kyi gab tshig rgyan/ rab btags kyi gab tsheg rgyan/ ming 'dus kyi gab tshig rgyan/sgrib pa'i gab tshig rgyan/ mthun sgra'i gab tshig rgyan/ rmyongs pa'i gab tshig rgyan/ yongs 'phrog gi gab tshig rgyan/ gcig sgrib kyi gab tshig rgyan/ gnyis ka sgrib pa'i gab tshig rgyan/ yongs 'dres kyi gab tshig rgyan dang bcu drug go/kun 'tshogs kyi gab tshig rgyan ni/gzhung las/ mang tshig mtshams sbyor sgra 'dres pas/don sbas pa ni kun tshogs te/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ sgra yi mtshams sbyor skabs yas mas 'dres pa'am/ yang na ming tshig du ma zhig yar mar 'dres pa ltar du snang ba ma zad/ tshig grogs kyis gcod mtshams tha dad pa/ don gzhan du go bar dngos kyi brjod bya de gab pa la mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra mi ldan pa zhig la kun 'tshogs kyi gab tshig rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ dkar mdzes lang tsho legs pa'i bu/mo 'dis bcu phrag rig gnas mi/spro bas dbyangs can ma yin smad/ tshong ma legs pas bsten mi mang /zhes sgrib bya mkha' 'gro sgra dbyangs lha mo la sgrib byed dpe ni/ smad tshong ma ste tshig gi gcod mtshams kyi dbang gis/ dkar mdzes lang tsho legs pa'i bu mo 'di ni bcu phrag rig gnas mi spro bas/ dbyangs can ma yin/ smad tshong ma yin pas shin tu mnyam du 'grul mi mang zhes tshig 〉 dngos su gsal yang / don du brjod bya dkar 'jam lang tsho legs pa'i

—kyo3 7—bu mo 'dis/ bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas spro bas lha mo dbyangs can yin/legs pas bsten mi mang pa'o lta bu brjod do// sha lha chen khyod kun bdag la yid 'ong na/chung rigs bzang dang dkor 'phrul mkho rgyan dpe'i/cha rnams phyags bcu kun nas bcud bsdud la/dngos grub lhag par stsol cig glang po'i gdong /zhes gab bya'am yang na sgrib bya ni yid 'ong na chung ma dang / dkor cha/ 'phrul cha/ 'khor cha/ rgyan cha dpe rnams yin la/ gab byed tshogs bdag ste/ tshig rkang sngon ma gnyes tshig mtshams sbyar bar go zhing / dkor 'phrul mkho rgyan dpe lnga steng 'tshogs par kun tshogs zhes bya'o//ra/ mtshar sdug lang tsho'i rnam par myos pa'i gar/rtag tu brtse bas skyongs pa'i lus phra ma/skye rgu'i bde dga'i dpal ster rigs ma 'di/yid 'ong tshangs pa'i bu mo ma ma lags/bslu byed kyi gab tshig rgyan ni/gzhung las/ gzhan la grags pa'i sgra bkod nas/don de der 'khrul bslu byed de/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ gab bya'i dngos don gang yang rung ba zhig dang / sgrib byed kyi dngos po de gnyis ming ngam sgra thun mong du 'jug pa ma zad/ sgra mthun de nyid yongs grags zhig gis dngos kyi brjod don de 'khrul du gzhugs pa zhig la bslu byed kyi gab tshig rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ ngang pa'i rgyal po dag gi ngagasnyan pa'i 'gyur khug stong ldan pa/thos pas dga' bde gsar du 'phel/

—638—nang skyon can la ci byar yod/ces sgrib bya'am gab bya tshul 'chal spyod pa'i 'chab spyod kyi dge slong 'ga' dang / sgrib byed ngang pa smas ma'am skyon can la ste/ ngang pa'i rgyal po zhes pa'i sgraci de bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i mkhan po dang / ngang pa'i khyu tshogs kyi gtso bo gnyis kyi ming du 'jug pas/ don bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i mkhan po dam pa'i gsung la zab cing snyan pas thos pa tsam gyis dad ldan slob ma kun dga' bde gsar du 'phel kyang tshul 'chal can 'ga' la rna bar gzan par 'gyur zhes pa lta bu'o//sha bdag nyid sdig pa la ni shin tu 'jigs/de yi phyogs su nye yang ga la nus/gal te de la mi skrag yod pa na/ngan pa ci rigs gyis shig grogs po dgaces gab bya sdig pa la rang bzhin du 'jug mi phod pa dang / ngan pa zhes sdig pa dang las kyi ming 'jug pa yin la/ gab byed srog chags sdig pa rwa tsa la rang bzhin gyis 'jigs pa dang / ngan pa ci rigs gyis zhes mi skrag pa rnams sdig par ngan sbyor gyis zhes go zhing / gab bya dang gab byed phan tshun 'khrul bar ston pa lta bu'o/ /ra/ 'chor sgeg lang tshos myos pa'i mdongs mtha' mas/dgyes brtse'i gar gyis sbran pa'i yid 'ong gzugs/mdzes pa lha yi rgyan du gyur na yang /lhan du 'grogs pa'i skal pa dben 'di ci/rim bral gyi gab tshig rgyan ni/gzhung las/ tshig sbyor dkrugs pas don rim dag 'chol bar rmyongs byed rim bral te/

—639—zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ sho lo ka de'i badzod bya dngos de rkang pa snga phyi so so'i thog mtha' gnyis tsam rkang pa snga phyi yar mar go rim dkrug ste/klog pa ma gtogs don go mi nus par/ shar mar bkod pa bzhin klog na don phyin ci ma log par ston nus na'ang / brjod don rim pa ltar mi ldan pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ kho pa'i lta nyan mgo gcod pa/tshor na 'o skol bya ra bas/bdud rgyal nag pa ma byas na/gsang gras gzabs par khrags su brlagaces tshig go rim bsgrig na/ gsang gros gzab par ma byas na/ kho bo'i lta nyan bya ra bas/ bdud rgyal nag po mgo gcod pa/ tshor na 'o skol khrogs su brlag ces btson khang du bcug pa'i nyes can lta bu zhig la dper mtshon na/ rang gi grogs po dag dang gsang ba'i gros bya ba la shin tu gzab dgos pa la gal te/ kho bo'i bya ra ba zhes btson srung gis mthong na mgo gcod pa sogs tshang ma gsod pa'i nyen kha yod tshul brjod pa'o//sha bdag 'dzin dbang gis rnam dkar ci byas kyang / 1don gnyis mthar phyin mya ngan 'das pa thob/ 4tshad med rgyun sring snying rje'i don bsgom na/ 3khams gsum sa dgu'i gnas las thar mi gyur/ 3zhes rkang pa snga phyi dkrugs pa ste/ don du bdag 'dzin dang chags sdang gis dbang byas nas bskrun pa'i rnam dkar gyi dge bas/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sa dgu las thar pa thob mi nus zhes khams gsum gyi sa dgu ni/ 'dod khams sa gcig gzugs khams sa bzhi/ gzugs med khams kyi sa bzhi dang dgu'o// tshad med snying rje chen pos gzhi bzung ba'i rnam

—kyo40—dkar gyi dge bas/ bdag don dang gzhan don lhan gyis grub cing mthar mung 'das kyi sa non pa bcas so//ra/ rang gar ma bzhag (7)nyams 'gyur gyis/spung)kho bo'i yid kyi (5)pho nya mos/9)'jo sgeg lus kyi (3)rta mchog de/(wu)'jig rten 'dir snang (1)brkus te thal/(8)rab bcom gyi gab rgyan ni/gzhung las/ brjod don rtogs dka'i tshig phreng gis/rmangs par byed pa rab bcom ste/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi baji+od don gab bya gang yin pa de nyid/ gsal byed kyi tshig 'jig rten 'di na yongs su grags pa zhig gi sgra dngos su bstan nas/ don de nyid shin tu rtogs dka' bar byas te/ dzod byed kyi tshig de nyid gab byar 'jug pa chung yang / don de ltar brjod du rung ba tsam gyis brjod don dngos kyi don de nyid bcom pa zhig la bya'o//gzhung las/ gshog bral 'dam zan ngur pa zhigabya rog spu med phag tu zhon/brda don 'phrod pa'i bya rigs kyis/mthong gi dog zon can 'di skyo/zhes gab bya bud med dang / btsun pa/ gab byed gshog bral ngur pa dang / bya rog spu med te/ gshog bral gyi ngur pa/ bya rog la spu med pa gnyis yongs ma grags par brten/ skabs 'dir bu mo la sdom pa shor ba'i grwa btsun tshul 'dzin zhig gis/ grwa ba gzhan gyis mthong bar dwogs pa byed cing 'dug go zhes brjod pa'o//

—641 —sha spu dang mjug ma med pa'i spyang ki de sa/rkang gnyis pa yi phyugs rnams lkog tu zos/ri tsho nang du bkra ba'i rgya stag gis/gzhom dwogs yang yang dgos pa de su zhig chices spu dang mjug ma med pa'i spyang ki dang / rkang gnyis pa yi phyugs sogs 'jig rten na yongs su ma grags pa ma zad/ gab bya'am sgrib byed/sde pa'i bcu dpon nam brgya dpon gyis mi sde'i nor rnams lkog tu zos nas/gong ma rnams kyis mthong bar dogs pa skye ba lta bu ste/ gab byed/ spyang kiphyugs/ stag sogs bkod pa'o//ra/ bsil ri'i spo la 'cha' ba'i ngur ba zhigashar gyi nyal 'gro'i rlabs kyis nub tu bskyal/drod 'jam tsan dan ljon pa'i tshal gseb tu/gnas shing bsil ri'i klung la re rgug byed/mthun gzugs kyi gab tshig rgyan ni/gzhung las/ gab bya don dang tshul mthun dpe'i/tshig sbyor sdebs pa mthun gzugs te/zhes mthun gzugs kyi gab rgyan ni/ brjod bya'i gab bya gang yin pa de nyid dngos su ma brjod par/ don dang khyad bon gyi phyogs tsam mthun pa'i bon zhig sgrib byed du bkod nas/ gab bya de'i khyad bon mthun pa tsam la sgro btags nas dngos kyi brjod bya de nyid rtogs dka' ba'i tshul du ston pa zhig ste/ mthun pa'i gab rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ thang shing rtser 'dzin sprel rgan zhigame long gnyis phyar bya ra byed/shing khog 'bus zos ma tshor 'gyel/

—6hūṃ2—sprol rgan gar 'khyams cha yang med/ces gab bya ni mig dang / gzugs phung / rnam par shes pa dang /gab byed dam sgrib byed ni/ me long / thang shing / sprel rgan bcas pa ni mi lus rin po che 'di nyid thob pa'i mi rnams mi rtag skad cig par gnas shing / mthar rgyu lus kyi gzugs phung dor nas rnam shes gtan med sprel rgan bzhin du gnas rigs drug gar 'khyams nges pa med par 'gro ba la/des na don med mi tshe stong pa min par skabs thob kyi/ dka/ra po dge ba'i las la brtson dgos par bshad do// rang lus mi rtag par mi shes nas gzhan la lam ston byed pa 'di dag snyi nga rje ba dang ya mtshan pa zhes so//sha dbyar rnga sgrog dang sprin bcud rgyun babs la/dga' zhing than pa gdung tshe de ltar min/rtag tu ha las myos pa'i mdongs mtha' de/rnam bkra'i sgro mdangs legs kyang su yis 'dod/ces sgrib bya'am gab bya snyad bkur dang snyan grags la dga' ba'i zog po dkor la gzan pa'i smu+on pa chas bzang can la/ gab byed rma bya ste phyi yi tshul bzang zhing mdzes kyang / nang la dug gis khengs pa'i dpe bzhin dkor la gzan pa'i zog po'i nang la yon bdag gi dkor zas dang / g.yo rgyu'i khengs pa bcas mthun par bsdebs so//ra/ sha chen bam la dgyes pa'i gnyis skyes bu/dur khrod tshal chen yid la bcing ba'i 'bras/mtho ba'i brag dkar rdzongs chen ma zin nas/mjug sgro dh+wa ki'i tshogs kyis bcom 'di skyo/rtsub mo'i gab tshig rgyan ni/gzhung las/ mtshan nyid nges tshig ldan tsam la/

—643—rtsub cing gab pa rtsub mo ste/zhes rtsub mo'i gab tshig don ston te/ sgrib bya'am gab bya ni/ spyir brjod don gyi mtshan nyid dang nges tshig ldan pa tsam las/ phul du phyin pa min pa la yin par rlom pa lta bu la/ 'gog byed dam sgrib byed de'ang /der mtshungs kyi tshig mthar tshig rtsub mo'i rnam pa can zhig gam/ brda sprod las bsten tshul ltar gyi phyad dang rnam dbye'i mtshan nyid ldan pa tsam dang /sgra bshad rung ba tsam la tshig rtsub mos rkyen sbyar ba'o//gzhung las/ me chu'i reg bya ma myong ba'i/wa skyes grwa legs rnga ma de/rlung gis spur dus sbom bdog bdogalag tu bcang na ngan mtshang rtogs/zhes sgrib bya mkhas pa'i zhal snga 'grim ma myong ba'i blun po mi shes shes mdog can te/ sdib byed ni me dang chu yi reg bya gang la ma myong ba'i wa yi rnga ma ste/ mkhas 'dod can gyi blun po de dag gzhan gyis bskur tshe shin tu che 'dod dang mkhas 'dod ldan pa la/ don du mkhas pa'i mdun sar phyin tshe blun po'i rang mtshang gsong por ston pa ste/ sgrib byed wa rnga rlung la sbyar tshe shin tu sbom pa lta bu snang yang / lag tu blangs tshe phra ba las med par/ dper mtshon nus shing / mthar rang mtshang ston zhes tshig rtsub pos brjod pa'o//sha mkha' la rgyu nus bral ba'i me khyer des/rang 'od med par gzhan mun sel lo zhes/snang byed mkha' la shar tshe phag tu yib/ji ltar 'bad kyang rang mtshang myur bar ston/

—644— zhes mthon por 'phags nus bral ba la rgyu nus bral ba dang / shes bya dbul ba la rang 'od med pa sogs nges tshig yod tsam gyi sgo nas/shes med gzhan mgo bskor ba mkhas pa dang / phrad dog byed pa gab bya/gab byed ni srin bu me khyer sogs te/ rang gi mtshang ston zhes rgub mo'i tshig gis sma 'beb pa lta bu badzod pas/ don du gzhan mgo bskor ba'i mkhas rdzun rnams la'o//ra/ bsil bu'i reg byas mgron du ma bsus pa'i/sgeg ldem lang tsho ngom pa'i pad mo 'dis/blo ldan rkang pa drug pa'i gzhon nu tsho/don med mi tshe 'tshol ba'i re sgug ma/grangs kyi gab tshig gi rgyan ni/gzhung larngashaṃ/ don gang grangs kyi rmyongs byed pa/de ni grangs gab zhes bya ste/zhes grangs kyi gab rgyan bstan te/ rang gi gang brjod pa'i don nam gab bya gang yin pa de/ rjod byed grangs ka'i mngon badzod kyi yi ge'i rnam grangs sde ba dang phan tshun mngon baji+od kyi lam nas rnam grangs thog ci rigs baji+od pas/ dngos kyi brjod bya de nyid mngon du mi gsal zhing /grangs kyi phag tu yib ba lta bu byas nas/ yas mar grangs kyi go rim bsgrig pa yin na don de nyid ston pa zhib/ la grangs kyi gab rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ yon tan (18)khams dang ldan pa'i dus/bon 'byung thabs shes (350r+sāms rdzogs shing /stobs (10)kyi rig pa dpyis phyin na/sa phyogs (1sde)lam dbang (5)mthar phyen 'byur/

—645—zhes khams zhes pa bco brgyad kyi ming dang / bon ni thig le dang /'byung ni lnga/ thabs shes zhes pa ni gnyis/ stobs zhes pa ni bcu dang /phyogs ni bcu/ dbang po ni lnga yi ming du yin pas/ mdor na/ yon tan bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus thob dus/ dag pa drang srong nyis brgya lnga bcu blang nas rig pa'i gnas bcu la 'bad nas/ sa bcu lam lnga rim gyis bgrod nas mthar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'gyur zhes so//sha gza' yi zhal can dus che'i phyag dang ldan/klu yi zhabs bsgrad chas chen dus mes srega'akhor tshogs ro dus me yi dbus na 'gying /lha phyag mkha' thig gzugs kyis dgyes par bstod/zhes lha gsang mchog mthar thug zhal bdun/ phyag bcu drug zhabs brgyad/ chas chen sum cu rtsa drug 'khor sum brgya drug cu rtsa drug gi bskor ba la/ rkyang phyag grangs brgyar 'tshal bar gab bya/ gab byed grangs kyi mngon brjod ni/ gza' ne bdun/ dus zu ni bcu drug klu ni brgyad/ dus mes sum cu so drug ro dus me ni sum brgya drug cu re brgyad/ mkha' thig gzugs ni brgya tham pa bcas pa'o/ra/ ming bdag (1wu)lang tsho'i dpal mnga' ba'i/yid 'ong lha mo bkra shis (8toms/mtshams dang srid pa'i (8wu〉bro tshogs la/'dod yon (5)nor (8)gyi dgyes dag bsham/rab btags kyi gab tshig gi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ don gang rnam pa gzhan dag tu /sgro btags pa de rab btags te/

—kyo4kyo—zhes rab btags gab rgyan gyi don bstan te/ rang gi brjod don dngos sam gab bya de nyid dngos po dang / rnam pa mtshungs pa'i bon gzhan zhig gi don du btags te/ gab bya 'di nyid mi gsal bar byed pa dang / skabs 'dir dngos su tshig nus can zhig gis gab bya de nyid sgrib par byed pa dang /gab byed gsal bar bstan pa zhig nges can du dgos par sems so//gzhung las/ bdag mig zur mda' khyed gdong la/yang yang gzir 'di chags nas min/ud dpal mthing ka'i rna rgyan gyi/mtshar sdug yid la bkod pa lags/zhes sgrib bya'am gab bya ni dbyangs can ma la yid rang ba'am chags te lan mang blta ba de yin zhing / sgrib byed ni skra yi rgyan mdzes pa dang / rna ba'i rgyan sogs zhi rgyan mdzes pa la blta ba'o zhes sgro btags te dngos su badzod pa ste/ zhi rgyam dang mdzes pa'i skra lo sogs yid la bkod pa yin pa lta bus sgrib pa'o//sha skyes phran gang zhig sems kyi zug rngus mnar/tsha gdung drag pos myos shing thibs pa 'di/bsil can khyod min sus kyang mi bache+og pas/lhod min 'phral du mi brtse 'dor phod dam/zhes skye bo zhig shin tu chags pas gdung ba ni gab bya dang / gab byed ni tsha ba drag po myang zhing shin tu tsha ba'i reg bya sel mkhan bsil can ma zhes bud med la sgro btags te brjod pas/ don tsū skyes phran de'i chags pa'i gdung ba sel mkhan gyi bud med ces brjod pa'o//ra/ mtha' med shes bya'i pha mtha' ru/ngal med rgyal khams bskor ba'i bdag

— 64 7—rang 'byung rig pa'i gyi ling rta/khu mchog mgyogs 'gro rlung gshog min/sgrib pa'i gab tshig gi rgyan ni/gzhung las/ mtshungs pa'i bon gyis der go zhing /dngos don sgrib pa sgrib pa ste/zhes sgrib pa'i gab tshig rgyan gyi don bstan te/ rang gi brjod don nam gab bya de nyid dngos su gab byed de la brnyi/da btags nas baji+od pa min kyang / brjod byed kyi chig de sgrib bya sgrib byed gnyis kar mtshungs par 'jug cing / gtso cher sgrib byed la 'jug yang ming don 'khrul rgyu yod pa'i sgo nas don dngos de nyid sgrib par byed pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ snying pos dben pa'i 'dzum dkar can/ rlab phreng gcig steng gcig non pa/zin men rgya mtsho'i gnyer ma la/spyod na zhi bde'i go skabs phra/zhes sgrib bya 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang las/ sgrib byed chu'i gnyer ma ste/ 'khor ba la spyod pa'i skye bu dag gnas skabs la bde ba re yod na'ang / snying po med pa chu'i lhu ba nang bzhin la/ sdug bsngal zad pa med pa gcig steng gcig bsnan chu'i ngog lta bu dang / de'i khyad bon zad pa med pa dang / snying po med pa sogs mtshungs kyang / dngos su go mi nus par sgrib byed chu'i lda ba bkod pa bzhin no//sha legs par brtags tshe rang bzhin ma grub cing / sngo bden par stong yang snang ba bsgyur du gtub/ skad cig mi rtag skye 'gag kho nar byed/sgyu ma'i rnam rol mtshungs der su yid ston/

—648— zhes gab bya ni 'jig rten 'dir phun tshogs kyi n+tu+okhu rdzas rnams yin zhing / de nyid sgrib byed ni rmi lam nang gi rgyu nor bde skyid de/ rmi lam gsalta nas med pa bzhin du/ 'jig rten 'di bde ba phra mo rnams ni de'i rjes su 'gro bar ston pa'o//ra/ rnyed dka'i 'dod 'byung yid bzhin nor/bskur bsti byi dor legs bgyis na/rtag 'chi zad med dbul ba'i zhing /lhag med bde ba'i go skabs sbyor/mthun sgra'i gab tshig rgyan ni/gzhung las/ thun mong sgra yi rnam grangs kyi/don rtags dka' ba mthun sgra ste/zhes mthun sgra'i gab rgyan gyi don bstan te/ brjod tshul du ma'i sgo nas brjod don dngos de nyid kyi ming gi rnam grangs du ma bkod kyang / don de nyid mi gsal bar gab byed de dang ming ngam/ sgra mthun kyang rjod byed kyi sgra yi rnam grangs kyis don de nyid sgrib cing / snga phyi go rim bsgrig pas brjod don ston nus pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ bgrod bya'i lam la zhug 'dod na/bzhed don sgrub par byed pa'i yum/'du 'bral med par brten dgos te/sras rgyud nye bar skye ba'o//zhes sgrib bya ni byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhad don sgrub byed kyi yum zhes theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la sogs brten nas/ sems bskyed thar lam las sku gnyes kyi sras sam rgyal ba'i srasdo 'khrungs zhes pa dang /sgrib byed lam dang 'dod don sgrub pa'i yum dang / 'du 'bral med par

— 649—rtag tu 'grul na sras 'khrungs zhes sgra de dag gnyis kar 'jug tu rung ba'o//sha dang 'dren sngo bsangs ma yi mtshan ma de /khu ba'i dkyil 'khor babs pas rab tu dkar/bcud med mang du 'tshogs pas mtha' bskor nas/dad cing zhen pas chog shes med par bsten/zhes sngo bsangs ma ni bud med dang / nam mkha' gnyis la 'jug cing / mtshan ma ni mo mtshan dang rla ba'i ngos ri mo la 'jug khu ba ni skyes pa'i sa bon dang gza' pa sangs/ bcud med ni sa bon rla ba shar ba dang lha min rnams la 'jug pa'o// tshig snga ma bud med sogs ni gab bya yin la/ gab byed nam mkha' dang phyi ma rnams yin pas so//ra/ 'jog sgeg lang tsho'i dpal bsnyeg dbyangs ldan ma/'bral med khyod nyid re ba'i skyal chung bdagayud tsam dgyes brtse'i 'dzum zhal mi ston par/ring du bskal ba'i las 'di ci yis nyes/rmyongs pa'i gab tshig rgyan ni/gzhung las/ dngos don bstan kyang sbyor khyad kyis/rmangs par byed pa rmyongs pa ste/zhes rmangs pa'i gab rgyan gyi don ston te/ rang brjod don nam skabs 'dir gab bya gang yin pa de nyid dngos su bstan pa lta bu'i sgo nas/ brjod tshul gyi dbang gis/ brjod don dngos la gong 'og 'gal rla 'gro bar ston pa lta bus rmongs par byed pas/ brjod don dngos su mi ston nas sbas par ston pa zhig la'o//

— 65 0—gzhung las/ 'di lta'i rten 'brel snang cha kun/ ci ye nas nam mkha'i ngang tshul can/stong zhing bdag med yin bzhin du/la sa 'bras mngon sum 'byin 'di ci/zhes bon thams cad kyi ngo bo'am gnas lugs stong zhing bdag med par rang ngo nas ma grub pa thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin da gnas pa bden par ma grub pa de gab bya dang / de mngon sum gsal la/ gab byed de la dge sdig gi 'bras bu mngon sum du 'byin/ bsgrib bya ru sgrib byed du byas nas bon thams cad bden par ma grub pa las/ dge sdig gi 'bras bu 'byi+on zhing las 'brag kyi rnam bzhag byas pa 'a/ ci zhes rmangs par byed pa 'a//sha phying nang snod bcud 'khor 'das kun/ye nas sangs rgyas yin mod kyang /'khrul 'khor mun pa'i smag rum du /thar med sbyang ba 'di ci zhigaces dngos don rnams sgrib bya rang sems ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la 'khor ba la yang nas yang du 'khyams pa 'di ni rtogs dang ma rtogs kyi khud par la sgrib byed/ ye nas rang bzhin gyi dri ma med pa la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar ba med pa sdug bsngal byang ba 'di ci zhes bya'o//ra/ yid 'ong bcu gsum rgyan mdzes pa'i/skye sro'i yum byur byams chen mas/'gro kun 'jigs brgyad skyobs bzhin du/dgra dang grogs su 'byed 'di ci/

— 65 1 —yongs 'phrog gi gab rgyan ni/gzhung las/ ring nas sbyor ba'i phreng can gyis/dngos don sba ba yongs 'phrog ste/zhes yongs 'phrog gi rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ rang gi brjod don gab bya gang yin pa de nyid la/ rim bzhin sgrib byed kyi bon tshig gi phreng ba ltar bkod pas snga ma'i don de nyid la/ phyi ma phyi mas 'phrog pa'am sgrib pa ste mi gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan zhig la yongs 'phrog gi gab rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ shing ma'i gos can mdangs 'byur dang /mun dgras nub ri'i rtser 'dzin dus/srid mtsho sgrol ba'i rten can la/rtag min rnam pa re re 'char/zhes gab bya dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di nyid mi rtag par ston pa ste/sgrib byed nam rla dbyar kha nas rim bzhin ston kha dang rgun kha'i dus su shing dang sa gzhi'i mdog 'gyur ba dang / nyi ma dang rla ba sogs shar phyogs nas shar bzhin nub tu bzhud pa sogs sgrib byed snga phyi rim pa can du bkod de/ don du dal 'byor 'di nyid dge la ma sgrab na myur du mi tshe ni rim bzhin 'jig par ston pa'o// ༄sha lus can phal cher bde ba sgrub 'dod blos/sna tshogs thabs dang sgo gsum bya bas brel/ji ltar bgyis kyang sdug bsngal yod do 'tshal/'bad pas bsgrabs pa yin par rang las 'byung /zhes rgyan 'dis gab rū ni/ ma rig pa dang bdag du 'dzin par bcing ba dang / sgrib byed ni/ sreg med ni me dang / de'i dgra bo chu/ de'i gter chen ni rgya mtsho/ de nas thon pa nyi ma/ des phye ba pad ma/ de'i grogs min

—65 2—pa rla ba/ de'i lam nam mkha' ste/ dbus su sleb pa'i dus so// shing gi ——ma chu de'i dgra sa/ de'i mthong po ri rab/ de la gnas pa ri dwags/ de'i mig can bud med de la yang yang rol ba'o//ra/ nor 'dzin sgeg mo ngur smrig mdangs kyis mdzes/yid 'ong dri ldan nyin byed dbang por 'grogs/'dzig rten gsar pa'i snang ba sbyin pa'i dus/ngang pa'i khyu dang 'grogs 'di nyams re dga'/gcig sgrib kyi gab rgyan ni/gzhung las/ rten ni gsal zhing brten pa'i khyad/ sba ba'i sbyor ba gcig sgrib ste/zhes gcig sgrib kyi don bstan te/ gtso bo'i brjod don gang yin pa'i rten gzhi'am khyad gzhi de nyid gsal bar bkod nas/ de la brten pa'i bon nam de'i khyad bon de dag sgrib byed kyi ming tshig du mas skyor ba zhig ste/ rten dang brten pa zhes pa ni/ shing sdong lta bur mtshon na/ shing gi sdong po de nyid khyad gzhi dang / yal ga dang lo 'dab rnams khyad bon nam brten pa ste/brten sgrib la brtan pa gcig kho na sgrib pas gcig sgrib ces bya'o//gzhung las/ rmad 'byung tshul ldan drang srong ba'i/ud dum wa ra'i me tog la/dus kyi sad mda' ma phog na/phun tshogs 'bras bu smin la nye/zhes gab bya ni bslab gsum gyi sdom pa la nyes pa ma byung na thar ba dang bde ba'i 'bras bu nges par thob par 'gyur ba dang / gab byed ni/ me tog nang nas khyad par 'phags pa u dum wa ra la bar chad sad kyis ma

—653—gos pa dang / bslab gsum gyi sdom pa la skyon gang gis ma gos pa la'o//phan tshun sgrib bya khyad bon dal rten la ldan pa'i sdom pa de nyid la sbyar ba'o//sha 'khor yug dri zhim pad mos bskor ba yi/rab rib dwangs rnyog bral ba'i chu po/ter/dkar dang nag pa'i lus can mang po yis/rol pa'i mgrin glu thos 'dzin bcud du rnyi na/zhes rten gzhi dro zhim rab tu khengs pa'i me tog gi rdzum ra dang /dwangs shing gtsang ba'i mtsho mo gnyis gsal zhing / de nyid la brten pa ngang pa dkar po'i tshogs dang bung ba sogs kyis gang 'dod kyi brtse dga' rol ba sogs sgrib byed dang / sgrib bya gsang sngags pa dang / blo gsal rnams kyi rnam dpyod mngon sum ston pa'o//ra/ gos dkar lcang lo can gyi rnal 'byor pas/mtha' bral kun rtogs sprin gyi khring khang nas/sna tshogs chu 'dzin lang lang 'khrugs dang lhan/myur mgyogs me zhags phyogs su bskye la sbran/gnyis sgrib kyi gab tshig ni/gzhung las/ rten dang brten pa gnyis —ku'i khyad/sba ba'i sbyor ba gnyis sgrib ste/zhes gnyis sgrib ste/ gab bya gang yin pa de yi rten gzhi'am khyad gzhi dang / khyad bon gnyis ka sbas te brjod pa ste/ brjod don de'i rten dang brten pa gnyis ka dngos su ma gsal bar/ sgrib byed nus ldan bkod pa'i gab rgyan zhig la gnyis sgrib ces bya'o//gzhung las/ yul lnga'i khams las ma grub pa'i/skyon yon du ma'i za ma tog

— 65 4—rig na 'khor 'das gzhi rtsa chod/ma rig 'khrul pa'i mu la yan/zhes sgrib bya gzhi rang 'byung ye shes di nyid/ ngo 'phrod na thar pa chen po thob par 'byur la/ ma rtogs na 'khor bar 'khyams pa sogs sgrib byed dbang po lnga yi yul mig rna sna lce lus kyi dbang po bcas kyi yul du gyur zhing / spyod mi nus pa'i skyon thams cad 'dus sa'i snod sogs bkod pa ste/bsgrib bya'i rten rang 'byung ye shes sam shes bya'i gnas lugs la brten pa rtogs dang ma rtogs kyi khyad par thar pa dang 'khor ba'i khyad par sogs 'gyur ba'o//sha rdul mang mthon por brtsegs shing 'phyur ba yis bsil zhing dkar ba gos su gyon pa'i spyod/der gnas dngos po'i ngang tshul mngon pa'i tshe/dud 'gro phal gyi rang stobs bag la zha/zhes bsgrib bya rten gangs ri dang / brten pa seng ge gnyis ka sgrib cing sgrib byed/ gos dkar dang dud 'gro phal gyi sogs nas rim bzhin tshig gis sgrib pa ste/ don du gangs rir seng ge gnas pas/ sder chags kyi tshogs rnams dbang du bsdus par byed do// zhes bshad pa'o//ra/ rab mdzes bsil ri'i rdul gyi khang bzang nas/grags pa'i mu khyud 'gengs pa'i gdong lnga pas/brjid pa'i ral khur bsigs pa'i ngang tshul gyis/dman can wa sde'i tshogs kun bag la 'khums/yongs 'dres kyi gab tshig rgyan ni/gzhung las/ gab tshig dag gi mtshan nyid ni/sna tshogs 'dres pa yongs 'dres te/

—655—zhes yongs 'dres kyi gab rgyan ni/ gab tshig gi—rgyan bco lnga po'i nang nas rkang pa bzhi po la ci rigs 'dres par snang zhing / mtha' gcig tu nges pa med cing / bsgrib bya de nyid mngon du ma gsal bar sgrib byed bkod pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ rgyal mkhar gru bzhiṣ+ṭisgo brgyad na/rje btsun kun yin gang min des/nang blon lnga dang phyi blon brgyad/mkha' thig stong sde lha 'bang skyong /zhes rkang pa dang po mthun gzugs kyi gab rgyan dang / gnyis pa mongs pa'i gab rgyan po/sum pa sgrib pa'i gab rgyan/ bzhi pa grangs kyi gab rgyan bcas gab bya ni byang chub kyi sems rnams yin te/ dbang po lnga dang / rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong / sgrib byed ni/ mkhar/ sgo/rje btsun/ nang blon/ phyi blon/ dmag dang bcas zhing / de ni lus la rten pa'i sems de la dbang po lnga dang rnam shes nyon mongs sogs la rgyu bar bstan pa'//sha gzhal med khang 'dir bla ma 'gro ba'i migastobs ldan 'chi bdag 'tsho byed bdud rtsi spro/chu skyes dmar po la sogs legs mchod kyis/gnas 'dir nad dang dug rnams bsal du gsol/zhes gab bya ni bla ma ni phur bu/ 'groba'i mig nyi ma/ stobs ldan ni sgra can 'chi bdag ni ṣ+pen pa mtsho byed ni lhag pa/ bdud rtsi spro ni rla ba/ chu skyes ni pa sangs/ dmar po ni mig dmar sogs kyis sgras gza' bdun 'khor dang sprul pa'o// yang na rgyu skar dang bcas pa legs par mchod cong / gnarme 'dir gza' skar gyi nad rnams bsal du gsol/ gab byed

—656—ni/ 'jig rten na gsal bar byed pa'i bla ma stobs dang ldan pa'i 'chi bdag gi bdud 'jom pa'i sman pas bdud rtsi spros zhes sman gyi sbyin pa 'gyed pa bcas/ gyi mchod kyi gtso bo me tog dmar po sogs legs par phul bas gnas 'dir nad dang gnod pa bsal du gsol zhes pa'o//ra/ 'jo sgeg lang tsho'i dpal bsnyegs sked med mas/(sgrib pa/)rnyed dka'i chu gter 'dod rgu'i phung po 'di/thob phyir 'bad pa brgya yis bskrun na yang /(rmyongs pa/)'grub pa'i skal pa dben 'di ci yi don/ zhes pa lta bu'o//smras pa/ 'di na dbyangs can dgyes pa'i 'dzum rlabs kyis/rnam dpyod nyams mtshang khad dang lde'u'i bon/mes po'i zhal rgyun bdud rtsi'i zegs ma 'bum/skal ldan skug kha 'byed pa'i gsos su sbyin/dpyod ldan blo gsal rig pa'i rtsed 'jo (ge /snyan 'gyur shes bya'i ri mo rnam par spud/sde snod yid bzhin mdzod la 'jug ji 'i sgo/skal bzang bstan 'gro'i gsos su smin shig guzhes tshigs su bcad pa'o// snyan ngag rin chen lde mig gi 'grel ba er sangaso bu mo'i mgul rgyan las gab tshig rgyan gyi rab tu byed pa ste gaXs84 pa'//

—65 7—le'u bzhi pa skyon sel gyi rgyan/mtshan nyid dang / mtshan gzhi/ dbye ba so so'i don no//gzhung las/ lung dang rig patshogang rung gis/gnod byed 'beb pa'i mtshams sbyor skyon/zhes skyon sel gyi rgyan gyi mtshan nyid bstan te/ spyir gong du bstan pa'i snyan ngag gi rgyan rnams/ khyad bon ldan pa rnams ni tshig don gang gi cha nas kyang / phun sum tshogs pa yod pa la/ de'i ldog phyogs su gyur ba'i tshig sbyor la rgyal ba'i bka' tshad ma dang— / 'phags pa'i lung dang ma 'gal ba/rang gi rigs pas kyang brtags na gnod med du grub pa zhig la brjod cing /sgra don ci rigs la yid du mi 'ong zhing gnod byed du ma yod pa la ni snyan ngag gi skyon yin pas/ de dag las grol ba sbyor ba shes shing / rang gi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig ni skyon de las grol ba'o//dper na/ brda sprod rig pa'i srong du ma bgrod pa'i/sgra snyan phul byung yid 'ong thos rgya can/sgeg ldan rkang med ma de dgyes pa'i phyir/tshul ldan drang srong phul byung 'di ci zhig ces lta bu'o//dbye ba ni/ don nyams pa/ don 'gal ba/ don gcig pa/ the tshom can/ rim pa can/ sgra nyams pa/ gcod mtshams nyams pa/ sdebs sbyor nyams pa/ mtshams sbyor nyams pa/ 'gal ba'i skyon dang bcu'o//don nyamar+sā pa'i skyon ni/gzhung las/ baji+od bya 'phral phug gang rung gidon gyis dben pa don nyams te/

—658—zhes don nyams pa'i don bstan te/ rjod byed tshig gi sho lo ka des brjod don de gnas skabs dang mthar thugs kyi bya ba gang la yang / don gyis stong pa ste/ don gyi snying po med pa'i rgyan zhig la'o//gzhung las/ thang dkar rgod po'i sma ra can/lang tsho yol ba'i na chung ma/ma ning bu yi mag pa la/ 'byor ba'i dga' ston rgya cher 7gzabs/zhes gong gi sho lo ka 'di yi brjod don ni/ rgod la sma ra mi srid pa dang / de bzhin lang tsho'i dus tshod yol zin pa'i na chung ma ni med pa la ma ning gi bu dang / de dang mnyam du bag ma'i dga' ston gzab pa mi srid pa bzhin no//sha rin chen rdul brtsegs ri phran gtos dang mnyam/kha lnga pa dang nor srung rtsal 'gran byed/rgyu lam 'di ni rgya chung shin tu dgod/mya ngan thang la chu bo rab med 'khrugaces snga phyi gang la ltos pa med cing / brjod don dzi yang ma grub par/don med kho na ru byung rgyal du smra bar zad pa'o//gzhung las/ dgung la pad mo'i dga' tshal bzhin/ri dog la rgyu skar tshom bu ste/nyi ma'i drod kyis ku mud bzhin/che ba'i zer gyis chu skyes kyang /zhes pa 'di lta bu ni brjod don rim bzhin ma grub kyang / tshig bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pas skyon du mi 'gro gsungs/

—kyo59—don dang 'gal ba'i skyon ni/gzhung las/ brjod donasnga phyi'i nus pa dga'abrel ba med pa don 'gal te/zhes rang gi rjod byed rkang pa bzhi po'i snga phyi brjod don rnams phan tshun 'brel ba med pa ma zad/ don rnams snga phyi'i 'gal 'du'i phung por grub par ston pa'i rgyan zhig la don 'gal gyi skyon zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ ka kha'i rnam 'byed mi dpog pa'i/bcu rig phul phyin dpyod ldan khyed/mdza' mo'i bzhed don bsgrab bzhin du/so thar rma med mthar phyirno shogaces bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhi ma yi ge shes dgos pa las/ de ma shes pas bcu phrag rig gnas phun phul phyin mi srid cing / bud med kyi 'dod pa bskang bzhin phyi so thar gyi sdom pa mi nyams pa mi srid pa bcas snga phyi'i don rnams 'gal bar ston pa'o//sha lang tshos gang ba'i ston dbyal khyod cag zung /ci srid 'tsho yi bar du legs/ par 'grogs/dga' mgur spyod cing 'phan dar rgyas bzhin par/tshangs spyed skyon dris ma gos mthar son shogaces snga phyi brjod don 'gal te/ 'jig rten srid pa'i chags pa spyod pa dang tshangs spyod 'dul ba mi nyams pa gnyis mi srid cing 'gal bas so//gzhung las/ bstan dang 'gro ba spyi btsan la/rtag tu 'tshe ba'i gdug rtsub can/srog dbang dgag pa'i thabs yod na/bzod thob bslab pa nyams kyang ci/

—660—zhes spyir 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa'i don la sems nas 'di ltar sbyar yang skyon du mi 'phywar ro//don gcig gi skyon ni/gzhung las/ brjod bya'i don de yang nas yang /skyor zlos byed pa don gcig ste/zhes rang gi brjod bya'i don gang yin pa de nyid/ tshig rkang snga phyi tshang mas yang nas yang du blos pa zhig la ste/ brjod bya snga phyi gcig pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis don gcig gi skyon zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ mu la dal 'dzin nam mkha'i ltor/nyi ri khri gdugs nyin byed rgyas/khi khar gzi mdangs 'od zer 'bar/bzhad ldan pad ma 'dab brgya grol/zhes rkang pa dang pos nam mkha' kho na la zlos pa dang / gnyis par nyi ma kho nar rlos pa/ gsum 'od zer la zlos pa/ bzhi pa me tog la zlos pa te/ khyi khar dang / mu la/ nyi ri sogs ni zhang zhung go skad yin no//sha kun khyab 'chi med lha yi lam yangs por/rab dkar cha shas rdzogs pa'i nya gang rla/shar bas rlabs phreng can gyi chu bo'i gter/rgyas shing 'phel nas mer mer yar la 'phyur/zhes rkang pa dang po'i baji+od bya ni nam mkha' la/ gnyis pas rla ba gsum pas chu bo'am rgya mtsho dang / bzhi pas rgyas pa bcas la zlos pa'o//gzhung las/ rgyas so rgyas so rgyal ba'i bstan/dar ro dar ro rig lam kun/gsal lo gsal lo 'khor 'das bon/

— 661 —grub po grub po mthar thug 'bras/zhes pa lta bu ni zlos kyang rlos pa'i skyon du mi 'gro ba'o//the tshom gyi skyon sel ni/gzhung las/ mtshams sbyor khyad kyi dngos don gang /'di zhes ma nges the tshom ste/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ rjod byed kyi tshig brjod stangs dang gcod mtshams sam tshig sbyor bzo stangs kyi khyad par gyis/ rang gi brjod bya de nyid la rmyongs pa'i rgyan zhig la'o//gzhung las/ bltar bzod 'od dang bltar med kyi/zer dang ldan pa'i gzi brjid can/kun gsal nor bu'i thig le'am/gshen rab rnam par rgyal ba'i sku/zhes mig gis blta ba'i tshe na mthong du yod pa'am/ med pa 'di la gzi brjid can gyi nyi ma dang gshen rab rnam par rgyal ba gnyis su yin su min gyi don la rmyongs nas lus pa ji bzhin gyur pa zhig la'o//sha gnag snum ral pa'i zur phud lnga pa can/de ni 'jo sgeg nyams ldan smra ba'i seng /bar snang mkha' la rgyu ba dri za'i rgyal/thang lha yar bzhugs 'dzam gling bar gyi bdagaces ral pa'i zur phud ces rigs lnga 'di nyid/ shes rab smra seng yin nam yang na/ dri za'i bu mo yin nam/ bod kyi mgur lha bcu gsum gyi nang tshan thang lha yar bzhugs yin nam cha ma chod de/ the tshom nas lus ri pa lta bu'o//

—6 62 —gzhung las/ snying stobs zhan pa'i sdar ma'am/g.yung drung sems dang ldan kyang rung /rtswab mo'i rnam 'gyur gang la yang /bzhin mdangs mi ldog khyad re mtshar/zhes don la the tshom yod kyang sbyor ba shes na skyon med pa'o//rim pa nyams pa'i skyon ni/gzhung las/ brjod don snga phyi'i go rim dga'achol ba rim pa nyams pa ste/zhes rang gis ji+od byed kyi tshig des brjod bya de nyid ston la/ brjod bya rjod byed gnyis ka'i cha nas nam rgyun ltar du mi gnas par sngon rjes rim 'khrugs pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ mthar thug gtan bde 'thob 'dod na/gom pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin skyongs/bsam pa dpa' bo'i mda' bzhin gzir/thos pa bung ba'i rtsi bzhin sogs/zhes spyir 'gros la thos bsam sgom gsum zhes rim can du 'gro dgos pa las 'di ni de las ldog ste/ sgom bsam thos par bkod pa sogs nam rgyun dang rim pa nyams pa'o//sha bdag gzhan sgo gsum sgrib pa sbyang 'dod rnams/rgyal ba'i sku gsum thugs kyi dpe'u tse/yengs med bsgom dang ldan pa legs par bzhengs/gsal dag snyan par bklag la brtson par gyis/zhes rgyan 'di nyid rim pa nyams tshul ni/ cirgyal ba'i bka' lung rin po che nyams su len pa la thog mar yi ge klog pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa ma

— 6kyo3—zad de nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rnam gsum la 'jug nas nyams su len dgos pa las 'di ni de las ldog pa'o// gzhung las/ rgyal ba'i go 'phang 'thob pa la/sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan dgos/de la skyabs sems khyad par can/de la dad pa snying rje gces/zhes 'di lta bu ni skyo nadzādu mi 'gro ba'o//sgra nyams pa ni/gzhung las/ phrad rkyen rnam dbye dben pa dang /nor ba'i mtshams sbyor sgra nyams te/zhes mtshan nyid bstan te/ brjod don mtshon byed kyi rang lugs brda sprod pa'i lam nas phrad dang / rnam dbye sogs 'thob tshul dang mi mthun pa'am nor ba sogs ci rigs pa'i sgo nas sgra don nyams pa zhig la'o//gzhung las/ phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa yis/zhal skyin bstan pa rnam gsum dang /rjes 'breng sems dpa'i tshogs rnams la/rtse gcig dad pa'i yi rangs 'bul/zhes rkang pa dang po 'brel sgra dang / byed sgra nor zhing / gnyis pa dang sgra mi dgos pa sogs phyi ma byed 'brel sogs nor bas brda sprod pa'i gzhung 'gal ba'i skyon no//sha 'gro rnams zhi bde'i sa la dgod pa'i phyir/mnyam nyid thod dkar sras kyi dbang drug la/'dul ba'i gshen drug spros pa'i phrin las kyi/ rigs drug kun gyis sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod/

—664—ces dbang drug la dang las/ 'phrin las kyi dang / kun gyi dang kyi nor ba sogs kyi sgra nyams nas don phyin ci log tu ston pa'o//gzhung las/ ye dbyings nam mkha'i yangs rdzongs nas/sgra bla khyung nag g.yu ral can/lha dmag bye ba dpungo sdus la/byad phur thun zar byal khram be+egaces pa lta bu ni skyon du mi 'gro ba'o//gcod mtshams nyams pa'i skyon ni/gzhung las/ snga phyi'i rkang mtshams ming dbus su/ngal gso byed pa gcod mtshams rnams/zhes rjod byed kyi ming tshig gang dang gang yin yang / tshig gi gcod mtshams ma yin pa la bcad pa sogs/ brjod don nam ming sogs gang brjod pa yang cha tshang ma la tshang pa ma zad/ brdzod mtshams bzhag pa lta bu la sgra nyams pa zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ sngon thal rgyal ba sras bcas sangs/rgyas par gshegs shul legs lam zab/mo la rtse gcig dad pas 'jugaspyod na pha rjes bu yis zin/zhes rgyas par gshegs dang mo la rtse gcig ces pa lta bu snga phyi gcod mtshams nyams pas don dngos de nyid mi gsal bar log par go ba ru 'byur ba'o//sha dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum chen rje btsun byams/ma yi mkhyen dang brtse bas srid zhi'i lus/can yod do cog phan dang bde ba yang /

— 6kyo5—mchog myur du stsol cig 'bags ma chen/zhes byams ma dang / lus can bde ba mchog ces pa ltar 'god dgos kyang / de dag gcod mtshams kyi dbang gis ngal gso nyams pa ste/gcod mtshams mi legs pas don tha dad du ston pa'o//gzhung las/ mi mthun dus kyi rgud pa kun/sel zhing 'dod dgu yid bzhin du/'grub pa'i nor 'di sngon bsags kyi/ bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal las 'khrungs/zhes pa lta bu yas mar tshig kha 'thor du snang yang skyon du mi che ba'o//sdebs sbyor nyams pa ni/gzhung las/ tshig rkang ring thung 'dres ma 'am/ming gzhi nor ba sdebs nyams te/zhes pa bzhi po snga phyi tshig grangs ma mnyam pa dang / yang na sgra ji ltar bkod pa'i sgra de dang / brjod bya de la mi go bar/ ming gzhi sogs nor ba zhig la sdebs sbyor nyams pa zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ bskal pa'i dang po la/phyi snod mas yar chags shing /nang bcud sems can yas mar bab/snod bcud de ltar brten zhing 'brel byung /snga phyi rkango pa mi mnyam zhing 'thing por 'gro ba dang grangs yang mi mnyam pa lta bu'//sha gang zag so so'i blo stobs dpag pa ni/dka' spyad sla 'byur gnyis ka min pa yi/bon sde rnams gsum gang zag gis/

666——che sbyangs phrad shes bslabs pas go ba'i khyad par ro//zhes rkang pa snga phyi grangs mi mnyam zhing / sla 'gyur nga phrad shes sogs ming gzhi nor ba bcas yod pa'i sdebs sbyor zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ pha myes lha rtsog 'gron bzhi kun/mar mye dri brtsung ngad la spyon/rang mthun dges pa'i bdan la bzhugs/gnyi zer 'dril bzhi gnyig tu gyur/zhes pa lta bu ni brda rnying gi brgyan pas sgra dang sdebs sbyor nyams pa'i skyon rnams mi 'byung ba'o//mtshams sbyor nyams pa'i skyon ni/gzhung las/ brjod pa snga phyi 'brel med pa'i/ming tshig bsdeb pa mtshams sbyor nyams/zhes rang gi rjod byed tshig des brjod bya snga phyi 'brel ba med pa'i ming tshig yar mar mnyam du sbyor la sdeb pa zhig la mtshams sbyor nyams pa'i rgyan zhes bya'o//gzhung las/ g.yas ru mkhas grub bco brgyad byon/bshad srol mdo sde bstan pa dar/sgom bsgrub a dkar mthu byin ldan/gdul bya smin grol bde chen bkod/ces brjod bya snga phyi 'brel ba med pa ma zad/ ming tshig tshad ldan du ma grub pas brjod don gsal bar ston mi nus pa'o//sha rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshab mu cho ldem drug byon/klog bshad lo gsum 'dzam gling mkhas pa drugamatshan nyid sde lnga gang zag blo stobs sbyar/

—kyokyo7—bka' la brten pa sde snod mang du phye/zhes byon nas/ klog bshad lo gsum mdzad pas/ mkhas pa drug byungacizhing / mtshan nyid sde lnga sogs/ so so'i dgos pa'i mtshams sbyar de rnams med pas skyon du che ba'o//gzhung lasadzha/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba gshen rab mchogarjes 'bring g.yung drung sems dpa'i sde/rtag gzigs zhang bod rgya dkar nagalo paṇa yongs la gus brgyas 'dud/ces pa lta bu ni tshig bsdud 'di rnams skyon du mi 'gyur ba'o//mtshams sbyor gyi 'gal ba ni/gzhung las/ lung rig gang la'ang ma ltos pa'i/'bral med mtshams sbyor 'gal ba ste/zhes rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'phags pa'i lung gang la ma ltos shing rig pa tshad ma la sogs kyis ma grub cing / gzhi gang la sbyar na yang 'gal ba ltag sprod du snang ba brjod don nam rjod byed 'brel mod don gzhan gyur ba — zhig la bya'o//dbye na drug ste/ yul dang 'gal ba/ dus dang 'gal ba/ rgyu rtsal dang 'gal ba/ 'jig rten dang 'gal ba/ rig pa dang 'gal ba/ lung dang 'gal ba dang drug ga/yul dang 'gal ba ni/gzhung las/ lung dang rig pa'i skyon 'beb pa'i/brjod yul 'brel med yul 'gal te/rang gi brjod bya'i yul gang yin pa de la med bzhin du da dung sbyor ba'i tshad mas dngos su skyon du 'beb pa zhig la bya'o//

—kyo68— gzhung las/ mo gsham bu mo bzhin bzang ma/dmu long snang ba'i nye3 'tshor gsal/kha med skug pa'i glu snyan yang /zha sgre rnams kyi bskal bzang thob/ces pa lta bu ni yul med bzhin du sbyor bas yul gyi dbye bar skyon 'beb pa'i rgyan no//sha rta gdong me las byung ba'i dal 'gro'i rgyun/'khyil ba'i rdzing bur gnyis 'thung 'jug par byed/kun gsal phang par skyes pa'i ud+mal la'i/do shal gzhon nu mdzes pa'i rgyan du che/zhes rta gdong ni chu 'thag mkhan las chu mi 'byung / nyi ma'i kha la skyes pa'i me tog med bzhin du yul la sbyar bas skyon du 'gyur ro//dus la 'gal ba'i rgyan rini/ gzhung las/ snga phyi dus dang mi mthun pa'i/mtshams sbyor 'brel med dus 'gal te/dus snga phyi sogs mi mtshungs bzhin du mtshungs par sbyor zhing /'das ma 'ongs sogs kyi rtogs byed tshad mas gnod pa'am skyon 'beb pa zhig ste/ gzhung las/ phyogs kyi bu mo sngo bsangs mas/nyi ma'i gdugs la skar khrab can/thun gsum smag la srid pa'i migabagrad de gling bzhi dus gcig gzigs/zhes rkang pa snga phyi brjod bya rnams snga phyi 'das ma 'ongs kyi baji+od tshul mi mthun pa dngos su mtshungs pa'i phyir/

sha nyin dus kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram sa la/rgyu sbyore phra tshom mdzes pas kun yid 'phroganges nyal dus su nam mkha'i nor bu'i gzis/gling bzhi kun gyi smag rum dus cig bcom/zhes pa lta bu ni snga phyi rim pa nyams pa'o//rgyu rtsal dang 'gal ba'i skyon ni/gzhung las/ gar dgu la sogs rnam 'gyur dang /'brel med mtshams sbyor rgyu rtsal 'gal/nyams 'gyur gar dgu la sogs kyi phan tshun 'brel ba med bzhin du phan tshun mtshungs par sdebs pa'o//gzhung las/ 'jigs rung dug chen ha la dang /mthun pa'i dkar 'jam mdzes sdug can/dgyes 'dzum zhi ba'i drag tshad kyis/'jig rten phung ba'i dkos thag ma/zhes pa ni 'jig rten 'dir yongs su ma graṭa pa rnams graṭa par sbyor ba'o//sha srid gsum dbang bsgyur rgyal mo yum chen gyis/bka' sdod ma mo 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas/dgyes pa'i tshul gyis he he bzhad bzhin par/khros pas 'dzig rten dus gcig phung par byed/ces dgyes pa'i bzhad pa dang khros pa 'dzig rten phung pa sogs tshigasnga phyi nyams 'gyur rnams 'gal bar 'gyur ba lta bu'o//'jig rten dang 'gal ba'i skyon ni/gzhung las/ tha rnyi/da smra ba spyi btsan gyi/rig pas gnod pa 'jig rten 'gal/

—670—zhes spyir 'jig rten gsum na yongs su ma grags pa/ 'jig rten dang 'gal ba'i sgra sbyor ba sogs dngos su bkod kyang / yongs su ma grags pa rnams grags par sbyor ba'o//gzhung las/ chu bo gyen 'bab rlabs rtse na/me stag tsha tsha skar ltar 'khrugadog nas lhung ba'i char rgyun mkhar/'khyil bas lha yi rdzing ring zhes/zhes 'jig rten 'di na yongs su ma grags pa rnams grags pa lta bu bkod pa'o//sha pha las btsas pa'i 'o ma'i mgrin can gyi/mgo skyes dkar po'i thor cog yon par g.yo/bu rgan las byung nu zho'i rgyun bzang po/pha ma gzhon nu gso ba'i bcud du 'jo/zhes pa ni 'jig rten 'dir ma grags par gzhan gyis nyes pa'o//rig pa dang 'gal ba ni/gzhung las/ rjes dpag rig pa tshad ma yis/gnod pa'i mtshams sbyor rig 'gal te/zhes tshad ma rjes dpag la sogs kyi tshul gsum la brtem nas dngo+os kyi brjod bya de nyid la skyon 'beb pa zhig la rig 'gal gyi skyon zhes bya'//gzhung las/ rig gnas ya bcu zung lnga zhes/mi rgan bcos pa'i gtam nyob kun/bskal par bsher kyang bden don gyi/'bras bu nges pa ga la rnyed/

—671 —ces nang don gyi rig pa sogs rig pa'i gnas chen lnga yi skyon 'beb pas so//sha zung rngu'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa(bzhi po/tsha grang gnyis kyis bsdus pa rtsad srid dam/gso byed gnyen po stong dang rtsa gnyis kyi/grangs su ma nges bsam gyis ga la khyab/ces pa lta bu ni gso ba'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi skyon du 'beb pa'o//lung dang 'gal ba'i skyon ni/gzhung las/ mdo 'bum rgyud mdzod gang rung gis/gnod pa'i mtshams sbyor lugs 'gal te/zhes mdo 'bum rgyud mdzod dang 'phags pa'i bka' lung ci rigs la 'gal ba'i rgyan gyi brjod bya ldan pa zhig la bya'o//gzhung las/ 'di lta'i snang ba ji snyed pa/bden pa'i dngos por ma grub na/rgyu las 'bras bu ci te 'byung /des na bdag nyid can du nges/zhes pa lta bu ni bden med bstan byed kyi bka' lung gis gnod pa 'beb pa'o//sha mkhas btsun smin rdzogs brten pa'i yon tan lnga'i/sna re tsam yang lhan pa ci smos te/'dul ba'i gzhung lugs zur tsam ma mthong bar/gzhan la so thar sdom pa 'bog par byed/

—672—ces pa lta bu ni mkhas btsun bzang pa'i yon tan med la 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs ma mthong bas gzhan la sdom pa 'bog pa ni/ gzhung lugs dang 'gal ba song tsang lung 'gal gyi skyon zhes bya'o//'gal skyon drug po de dag las grol ba'i rgyan ni/yul skyon med ni/ rang gi brjod yul de nyid kun gyi thun min du song yang / de ltar sbyar ba shes na skyon du grol tshul ni/gzhung las/ bon kun bdag med mngon rtags pa'i/'phags pa rnams kyi gzigs ngo ru/ri bo'i gtos dang phra rab rdul/che chung med de mnyam pa nyid/ces pa lta bu ni 'phags pa'i gzigs ngor bkod nas sbyar ba yin pa skyon med do//sha dregs ldan mi rje khri shi dbang gi rgyal/mtshams med las bsags lan chags ma khel bas/dmul bar sbu+ong tshe ston pa'i thugs rje yis/sdug bsngal dang bral bde ba'i skabs kyang rnyed/ces pa lta bu ni ston pa'i thugs rje la sbyar nas bkod pa lta bu ni skyon med do//dus kyi skyon med ni/ dus kyi snga phyi sogs thun mongs dang 'gal ba yin na'ang / srid pa tsam mam khyad par tsam 'gal dang sbyar bas skyon du mi 'gro ba ni/gzhung las/ phal pa 'ga' zhig gson po'i dus/tsha grang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong /pha rol gnas su 'khyams pa'i tshe/

—673—'di kha'i snang ba kyug kyug 'char/zhes pa lte bu ni skye bo 'ga' la ngan dbang gi rkyen dang sbyar te bkod pa'//sha dam pa gang zhig mtshan mo'i spyod yul gyi/rmi lam snang ba nyin mor rtag tu 'char/snang dus nyer spyod 'dis snang dngos 'dzin kun/mtshan mo 'od gsal ngang nas dbyings su gsal/'e/sa pa lta bu ni dam pa rnal 'byor pa'i nyams dang sbyar bas skyon med do//sgyu rtsal gyi skyon med ni/ thun min gyi gar dgu nyams 'gyur can 'ga' zhig dang sbyar te/ nyams 'gyur khyad par can 'ga' dang ldan pa la bkod pa sogs te skyon med par grub pa'o//gzhung las/ ye shes dbyings kyi bya ra mas/mngon spyod 'bar ba'i tom zhal du/srid gsum kham du rol bzhin par/'gro drug bu gcig ma ltar skyong /zhes 'jig rten gyi thun mongs dang 'gal ba'i nyams srid gsum zhal du gsol ba dang / 'gro drug bu ltar skyob pa lta bu ni thun min nyams 'byur dang rgyu rtsal dang sbur bas skyon med do//sha mkha' la 'gro rnams 'phur ba'i dbang rdzogs nas/ dogs la mi 'bab rang dbang ci zhig yod/shug 'bru'i bcud len tsam gyis legs 'tsho ba'i/nyi ma 'od gsal 'phur zhing sgod dang brtse/zhes pa lta bu ni dam pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang sbyar ba'i dpe ru drangs pa'o//

—kyo74—'jig rten skyon med ni/ 'jig rten 'dir yongs grags kyi bshad sgros dang yon tan 'dod tshul cung zad mi mthun yang skyon du med pa lta bu ni/gzhung las/ grub pa mchog brnyes bon gshen bzhi/gshegs shul yar chab gyen la ldogaco bza' bon mo ma lags na/bod yul rgya mtshos 'gengs la khad/ces bon dar nub skabs stobs dang rdzu 'phrul rtsal 'gran dang sbyar bas skyon med do//sha rtogs pa mngon gyur zhu sgom 'khrul zhig gis/las su rung min sra brten pha bong yang /rta ru zhon nas gshegs 'di 'jig rten na/grags pa min yang gyub pa'i mthu las byung /zhes pa lta bu ni rnal 'byor pa'i rdzu 'a sdel gyi rtsal las byon pas skyon med do// rig pas skyon med ni/ 'gro ba'i gdul bu bkris drang gi lung dang sbyar nas 'ga' zhig la skyon med du sbyor ba ni/gzhung las/ sgom chen 'bar bas tha snyad kyi/rig pa'i cha tsam ma bslab kyang /sa lam yon tan gcig char du/rdzogs te sku gsum mngon du byur/zhes pa lta bu ni blo dbang po yang rab dang sbyar bas sku+on du mi 'gro ba'o/

—6 75 —sha rdzogs chen gsang ba'i dpa' bo li shu rjes/brag la phur phug mkha' la lding ba'i tshe/rtags dang dngos po thog bcas thog med kyi/tha snyad mi dmigs ming gi lhag mar byas/zhes pa ni snya chen li shu'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rtsal la sbyar nas bkod pas skyon med do//lung go skyon med ni/ rgyal ba'i bka' lung zab mo dag gi skyon du 'beb kyang dmigs bsal tsam du thun mongs dang brgal bar skyon med du 'dod pa'o//gzhung las/ 'ga' zhig spang bsgyur grol lam la/ma zhugs gshen zhal mjal tsam na/'ja' lus 'od kyi phung por gyur/mthar thug mngon sangs rgyas te song /zhes pa lta bu ni sangaru/ rgyas kyi thub/sa rje kho na la brten nas skyes pa'i don la sbyar ba'o// sha skyon bral slob dpon smad pa'i ghu ling ma/sdig sgrib lci yang ston pa'i thugs rje yi/ring min myur bar lha mor gnas gyur na/gom pa bor rjes sa la lam lam brdol/zhes pa ltene+e༄ ni ston pa'i thugs rje dang sbyar nas bkod pas skyon du mi 'gyur ra//zhes snyan ngag rin chen lde mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan las skyon sel gyi rab tu bshad pa'i skabs tu bzhi pa'o//

—6 76—gsum pa rjes mjug gi don/gzhung las/ snyan ngag rin chen lde mig 'di/ grags 'dod co 'dris ma gos par/ rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin la/ sri zhu bgyi ba'i blos bskul te/ dri med gzi brjid ma rgyud dang / sha ri'i sgra 'bum bkol byang dang / mtshan nyid srid pa'i mdzod rnams kyi/ dgongs don dri ma med pa dang / 'gro mgon blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / rgyal ba gnyis pa shes rab rgyal/ gshen mkhas tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang / nyi bstan yongs 'dzin rnam 'od sogs/ mkhas pa'i legs bshad la brten nas/ rtogs bzo'i skyon gyis ma bslad par/ gong ma'i dgongs pa rji lta ba/ go sla 'jug bde'i gzhung 'di sbyar/zhes rtsom pa pos bzod pa gsol te snyan ngag gzhung 'di nyid rang nyid mkhas 'dod grags 'dod sogs dre ma gsum gyis ma gos pas/ spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che ridang / der 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa phyogs bcu'i mu mtha' med pa na bzhugs de dag thams cad la sri zhu'i tshul gyis rkyen bskul te/ rang lugs bka' dang bka' rten rnams la gzhir bcas/tshad ma'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi dgongs don rji bzhin blo gsal rnams la go sla ba dang 'jug bde ba'i phyir bkod pa las/ rang gis rtog bzo'i skyon gang gis kyang bslad med pa'o//

mjug tu smon pa ni/gzhung las/ rin chen dang po'i lhun po la/ nyi gzhon bye bas mkhyud mdzes bzhin/ rgyal ba'i bstan dang mkha' mnyam 'gro dus rnams kun tu shis gyur cig ces gser gyi ri bo la nyi ma 'bum shar bzhin du rgyawe/ ba'i bstan pa 'di nyid/ mkha' khyab 'gro ba yongs kyi don du dzi srid bar dar zhing rgyas par shog ces shis smon gyi 'tsham sbyar ba'o// bzod gsol ni/ gzhung las/ bka' lung rig pa zung sbrel nas/ lhag bsam dag pas bshad mod kyi/ ma rig 'khrul skyon ci mchis pa/ rin chen gsum la snying nas bshags/ zhes zhes mkhas pas khengs skyung ba sto/ gzhung 'di nyid rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'phags pa'i lung rig zung du sbrel nas lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas sbyar na yang / rang rgyud la ma rig pas brlan pa sogs kyi skyon gyis 'khrul ba byung srid na/ skyabs gnas dam pa dkon mchog gsum la 'chab pa med par bshags zhes so//bsngo ba ni/gzhung las/ blo gros bzang po'i mthur brtas pa'i/ rnam dkar dge rtsa ci mchis pa/ dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs bcas/ 'gro kun

—6 78— byang chub 'thob phyir bsngo/ zhes 'di lta bu blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa 'di yi rnam dkar dge ba'i cha yod do cog dang bdag gi dus gsum du bsags pa'i bde ba yod cog rnams 'gro kun thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo zhes so//smon khugom ni /gzhung las/ 'di la 'bad pa'i bsod nams kyis/ gshen bstan dar rgyas yun gnas shing / skye dgu bde skyid phun tshogs te/ rdzogs ldan skal bzang yar 'phel shog ces gzhung 'di la 'bad pa'i rnam dkar mthu yis rgyal ba gshen gyi bstan pa 'di nyid mi nyams gong nas gong du 'phel zhing / mtha' yas sems can rnams bde skyid phun sum tshogs nas/ rdzogs ldan bskal pa ru 'phel bar smon zhes smon lam rnam par dag pas mthar rgyan te mjug rdzogs pa'i bkra shis pa lags so//slar smras pas/ 'di lta'i snyan gzhung mar zhi zlum po'i lus/brjod don rnam rgyal yid bzhin nor bu'i srogaleṭa bshad tshangs dbyangs 'bum dang 'groṭa pa'i rgyan/sdeb legs 'phang 'gro 'khrol 'di bdag gi skal/bcad lhug spel ma'i dka' gnad tshang tshing dbus/rab mang rgyan gyi rnam dpyod sa mchog ljon/dpyad stobs dri gzhon 'bum gyis drang ba yi/legs bshad dri bsrung 'thul ba dngos po'i gshis/

—6 79 gtsang gshen zhal rgyun gdam bzang yu ti'i chang /zhus 'thung myong ba dpyid dpal myos pa'i glu/lhag bsam chu khur can dang 'grog pa 'di/skal bzang pad dkar rgyas pa'i rkyen du btegs/mi lus rin chen dang po 'dod rgu'i rten/tshul 'dir sgo gsum 'bad pa thar pa'i dpung /shes na 'gyur khug 'bum ldan snyan pa'i glu/sgrog la dga' ba'i spobs pa lhag tu 'phel/gna' bo'i srol rgyun gangs can mes po'i nor/legs bshad rnam par gdam pa dri za'i blu/ris can 'on pa'i spyod skal ma lags kyang /don ldan blo gros can la sman du 'gyur/'di ltar rmad 'byung brda don snyan pa'i dbyangs/sdebs legs sor mo'i 'du byed la brten nas/blo gsal dga' skyid 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel du/rgyud mang 'phang 'gro'i rol mo 'di nas dkrol/skal bzang bsod nams bsaṭa pa'i las dbang gis/rig pa'i dbang po gangs can sgeg mor sgrum/dmar ba'i zungs khrag gnas lnga'i bcud dang 'grogs/dga' ba'i lang tsho mdo khams sgang du rgyas/

—680—brtse ba'i drin gyis skyong mkhan a pha dang /zhim pa'i nus zho sbyin pa'i a ma la/zang zing nor gyi 'du 'god ma lags kyang /rnam dkar 'di nyid drin bzo'i skyes su btegs/lhag bsam rnam par dkar bas sbyar mad kyang /dman bdag lang tsho ma rig chus myos dbang /gzhung lugs rnal ma'i 'gros dang nong ba gang /don ldan bla ma lha yi drung du mthol/bzang po'i kun slong shar ri'i phrag gong nas/brtson 'grus rlung gi khyu mchog gis drangs pa'i/legs bshad snang ba dkar po'i 'od stong 'bum/rgyal bstan pad mo rgyas pa'i dpal du shoga'adi sbyar rnam dkar dge ba'i rtsa lag gang /pha mas thog drang mkha' khyab skye dgu kun/gnas ngan 'khor ba'i grong nas dbugs 'byin te/kun bzang bde ba'i rgyal sar 'jug phyir bsngo/zhes snyan ngag rin chen lde'u mig gi 'grel ba er sangs bu mo'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di/ slob dpon dam pa'i gsung gis gnang sbyin pa la brten nas/ kho bo dbra khyung skal bzang nor bu'am/ ming gzhan du 66phyu sras dbyes pa'i dpyod ldan 7gyis 'phags yul sa yi byang phyogs bon

—681gzhis thob rgyal gsar pa'i sa gnas/ 7dpal gshen bstan sman ri'i dgon du 'byung ldan sum brgya dang gcig gi nyag ma bco lnga'i thog 'go brtsams te/ slar 'byung ldan sum brgya dang nyag ma bcu drug gi sgron rla'i dkar phyogs dga' ba bzang po'i nyin mjug rdzogs par bsgrubs pas/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing sems can thams cad bde skyid kyi dpal la spyod pa'i shis smon dang bcas/mu tsug smar ro//1skya90 3rngu khyismo — sa/51ba1'i /ga05rngu1 dzusmo0rngusmosmo0pa3khyi'ibatharimekhriḥkhu3 20’ 1999
